description:
Welcome to Candymail.co.uk, your go-to destination for an unparalleled confectionery experience delivered right to your doorstep! At Candymail.co.uk, we're passionate about indulging your sweet tooth and spreading the joy of delectable treats from America and around the world.

Our journey began with a simple yet powerful belief – everyone deserves to savor the goodness of the finest candies and snacks. That's why we founded Candymail.co.uk, a confectionery mail-order website dedicated to bringing the best sweets and treats to Candy enthusiasts across the UK.

What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to providing an exceptional range of imported candy, snacks, treats, and sodas. Our carefully curated Candy boxes are designed to delight your taste buds with an array of iconic brands, including Reeses, Hersheys, M&Ms, Nerds, Jolly Rancher, Swedish Fish, Mountain Dew, Oreo, American Fanta, Dr. Pepper, Twinkies, and many more.

At Candymail.co.uk, we understand the joy that comes with unwrapping a box filled with your favorite treats, and we strive to make that experience accessible to Candy lovers everywhere. Our dedication to quality, variety, and customer satisfaction has earned us the trust of Candy enthusiasts who turn to us for an exciting journey into the world of international confectionery.

Join us at Candymail.co.uk and treat yourself or your loved ones to an unforgettable candy adventure. Indulge in the sweetest moments, one box at a time!

records.title: Perfect!
records.text: I had made several orders from Candymail and every single time has been a no fuss easy purchase from start to finish. Any order I've made where an item is out of stock I have received excellent communication and refunded incredibly quickly. The dates on all products are excellent unlike some sites I have used. Everything always arrives safely packaged and in excellent condition.

records.title: Kept up to date with timescales
records.text: Kept up to date with timescales. It was a quick delivery considering it was over the festive period. Sweets were as described and very enjoyable. Thank you.

records.title: Legit and tracked!! I highly recommend
records.text: Super trustworthy site- amazing condition of items and how they’re packaged plus can be tracked the whole journey. I think I received my order within 2 days of purchasing even at the end of December! Amazing 10/10 will be returning customer. Thank you!

records.title: After an initial problem it was sorted…
records.text: After an initial problem it was sorted asap and it was the best gift for my son he absolutely loved it all .. will absolutely use again simply for the customer service i received.

records.title: Sweets, drinks & cereals from around the world!
records.text: Great selection available of sweets, cereals and drinks from around the world! Competitive prices and fast postage, have used time and again!

records.title: Really quick delivery really happy with…
records.text: Really quick delivery really happy with my order thank you so much

records.title: This is very specific to my experience…
records.text: This is very specific to my experience but I had been looking for Twinkies for my son high and low literally everywhere online and in shops that sold American sweets. Finally found them on candymail and could not have been happier!! They arrived in time, fantastic price considering the shortage and easy to order. Will be returning the next time I fancy a little treat!

records.title: Fantastic online shop
records.text: First of all they have a great range of products so I was able to find all that I needed. I discovered lots more items I didn’t know existed but sounded super exciting so I added those to my order too. The order process was straightforward, the website easy to use. The prices are great, fair up better than most websites selling the same and similar products. Communication has been great throughout. Delivery was quick and items were well packaged. I’m happy with the entirety of my order so happy days.

records.title: Soo good
records.text: Soo good! Great service couldn’t fault it ordered on the last Sunday before Christmas paid for next day and it arrived the Monday. Cannot fault thank you.

records.title: Highly recommend
records.text: Really love this company, they sell quite a few hard to find items that I've previously had to purchase from abroad. I was sceptical the first time I bought something but it arrived quickly and as described. I've ordered a few time since then and everything is always great.There's been some delay with some preorders this time but I've been kept up to date of progress and had other items shipped out as they've become available rather than waiting for everything to be in stock, which is really appreciated! Would definitely recommend!

records.title: Let down by delivery
records.text: The service from Candymail was excellent and the product was dispatched very quickly, but the DPD driver did not read the very simple delivery instructions (to deliver to my neighbour) and as such the product did not arrive in time for Christmas. This was particularly annoying since I paid a king's ransom for pre-Christmas delivery (equivalent to around 67% of the order value)!I appreciate that this was not Candymail's fault, but delivery is part and parcel of online shopping, so I have downgraded my score from 5 to 4 stars. Apart from the delivery problem on this occasion, I can't fault Candymail and highly recommend them. Next time I'll try to be more organised and order sooner!

records.title: Was very happy with the quick delivery…
records.text: Was very happy with the quick delivery and price but they were a Christmas present and they go off on the 29th

records.title: Great range of products
records.text: Great range of products. Most at fair or competitive prices. Can't really fault Candymail but the delivery company (Parcel force) let them down, hence the 4 stars. Items packaged well.

records.title: Great selection
records.text: Great selection, fast delivery. My husband will be very happy!

records.title: Fast delivery!
records.text: Absolutely, amazingly speedy delivery! I got a mystery box for the second time and would have preferred less of the super sour sweets but obviously when it’s a “mystery”, you don’t get to choose. Overall, brilliant, thanks!

records.title: Christmas gift 🎁
records.text: Pleased with my purchase but because I only ordered 1 item postage made it an expensive purchase for a Christmas gift

records.title: Fast delivery but VERY aggressive email marketing.
records.text: Fast delivery of exactly what I ordered, however since my delivery a week ago, I must have received at least 5 marketing emails encouraging me to make another purchase. I don't like this type of aggressive marketing, so probably won't use this vendor again unfortunately.

records.title: Everything was good with my experience…
records.text: Everything was good with my experience with candymail quick enough delivery, reasonably priced. Only down 1 star because the butterscotch Mars bar was expired I don't think it was on a clearance, my partner said when he opened it the chocolate had turned white and the date was 2023

records.title: One of my monster cans was beaten up…
records.text: One of my monster cans was beaten up and pierced unfortunately but the rest of the experience was great! Care had gone into packaging so was unfortunate one can was damaged and the drink was pretty much ruined. Otherwise would have been 5 star.

records.title: Great selection of flavours and characters
records.text: Great selection of products! I purchased various character sweets and drinks for my son. After struggling to find sweet boxes on other sites with flavours that he would actually like, I decided to make my own using this company.

records.title: Slight bad experience with mystery box
records.text: Out of the order of mystery boxes, namely the drinks mystery box, unfortunately had a drink that ended up giving me a migraine, which was the ARIZONA Marvel Lemon Lime Citrus flavour, as someone who suffers from migraines, citrus is the worst thing to have, as it brings on a migraine. The rest of my order was fine. Just wish there was a way to avoid getting the Citrus drink. A.K.A. adding a notice/comment with order on the app/website to say 'check box content and make sure it doesn't have...' (which in my case, citrus). For health reasons.

records.title: Would repeat purchase
records.text: Rapidly delivered, products better condition than described. My son will be very excited for his birthday presents. Would buy from again.

records.title: sweet and on time
records.text: it arrived intact and right on time

records.title: Will ALWAYS order from these guys!
records.text: Ordered 1x chocolate of the world box, 1x drinks selection and 1x American snacks. Absolutely brilliant selection of stuff in the box, had so much to choose from, only negative being I asked for nothing with jalapenos and got jalapeno cheese puffs, but I just gifted those to a friend 😊 would always go to candymail, the mystery boxes are always amazing value and a fantastic selection :)

records.title: i got give a 22g jolly joes mike and…
records.text: i got give a 22g jolly joes mike and ike instead of the 120g jolly joes mike and ike i ordered

records.title: damaged cans poorly packed arrived again this year
records.text: Same as in 2023, this year also I ordered a pack of different Coca Cola cans from around the World as gift for someone who collects Coca Cola cans. Last year the majority of cans arrived damaged. I made a complaint, they sent undamaged, better packed cans for free. This year again- 3 cans out of 5 arrived damaged, again poorly packed, like last year. It is annoying that I have to make a complaint again and hopefully this time I will get a replacement sent again. It all wouldn't happen if the cans were packed nicely, like the replacement ones sent in 2023.

records.title: mystery boxes- big disappointment
records.text: I have ordered mystery boxes before but was a bit disappointed this time. Some of the items are just repackaged versions of what is available here or are low-quality items in their country of origin. Plus, why so many sour-flavoured items when people either love or hate them? I hate them by the way. Will happily order again though this company but will choose the items myself in future.

records.title: Ordered 2 bottles for my son for…
records.text: Ordered 2 bottles for my son for Christmas. The price was good, was kept up to date with all shipping stages and they turned up very quickly. The down side was one of the bottles is so crumpled it looks like ace Ventura delivered it. Still trying to work out how to pop it in to shape without opening. Lesson learned, when your buying to collect only buy what you can actually see

records.title: I received the wrong ratio of tropical…
records.text: I received the wrong ratio of tropical to fruit adventure flavours; there weren’t any missing, rather a mixup of how many of each which was a shame. Other than that the delivery was fast, next-day delivery.

records.title: Out of date....
records.text: The order came really quick but I did pay P&P for this. Was not happy with the lays crisps I purchased as was out of date but kids wanted them that night so I didn't complain. Please watch your dates your giving out as this breaking the law if the product is not reduced.

records.title: 50/50 honest review
records.text: Great products, poor packaging Ordered a number of items including special Pringles, upon arrival found both tubes of Pringles to contain just broken bits, I appreciate they are a delicate item but no bubble wrap and just some fragile tape on box I don’t feel is satisfactory. For this reason I wouldn’t use again.

records.title: Be careful ordering ‘pre-order’ items.
records.text: Ordered several times - but this last  order took forever to arrive. Defeats the object of pre-ordering so that you get items as they come out, then they arrive weeks after you’ve seen those items in shops everywhere. One very disappointed child over here!

records.title: I had 2 deliveries in the matter of a…
records.text: I had 2 deliveries in the matter of a few days apart. The majority of the stuff was ok but I had 3 items that was inedible. There was a Twix brownie that the chocolate looked like it had melted and re-set it wasn’t nice also there was a Cadbury mouse bar of choc where again the chocolate had melted and the wrapping paper had stuck to the chocolate as it reset. Plus an open pkt of crisps accidents happen so I ignored this at first but then I had the chocolate. Not really worth the money.

records.title: Ordered 2 pokemon boxes before…
records.text: Ordered 2 pokemon boxes before Christmas.  We opened them Christmas day and before eating checked ingredients as there was no sticker on them. Glad we checked the expiry date on 90% of the products are May 2021!!!! Will be contacting directly but fed up of the emails asking for a review

records.title: This order came very quickly but still…
records.text: This order came very quickly but still waiting on other order. Wish the company would update customers with what's going on,  even if its to say,  sorry for the delay

records.title: Excellent choice of sweets....however
records.text: Excellent choice of sweets....however,  postage and packing is far too expensive for uk postage and for that reason alone, I won't order again.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order, and quick delivery, everything was packed well! Just unfortunately I didn’t like 99% of what I ordered, which isn’t the sellers fault but it was disappointing the food didn’t taste nice to me :(

records.title: The website is the most glitchy website…
records.text: The website is the most glitchy website I have ever used. So slow and difficult to navigate. Pages not loading. Tried on 2 different browsers with the same results. Continuous pop-ups. Clicks to add to basket are slow and unresponsive. Given that I was attempting to shop for treats for our sons 7th birthday, I assumed I was adding 2 of every item into the basket. I also applied a 10% discount. On receiving the package today I've noted that half of the items I'd assumed I'd ordered were missing and the 10% discount hadn't been applied. I checked the basket numerous times to adjust the items and given that I was shopping for 2 boys, I managed to check out singular items for half the items I had increased to 2 and three items for items I wanted 2 of. My mistake to check out without triple checking, but given that I was limited in time, as I required next day shipping, and checked out via Klarna, I didn't recheck as I should have done. The whole experience was painful. The web pages became unresponsive on multiple occasions. Such a disappointing experience.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order, super quick delivery. My son got a mystery box, he did like most of the things in there. Only issue I have is that some of the sweets in the mystery box were a bit rubbish for the money we paid.

records.title: A little disappointed not what was advertised
records.text: I bought a sour mystery box which contain some sour products but was surprised and a little disappointed to find various chocolate bars and crisps which are not sour sweets

records.title: Ordered a large order online and when…
records.text: Ordered a large order online and when the order was sent I was missing two items. The items were refunded but i was given no prior indication of this being an issue when my order was 2 months prior to the delivery. No kindness shown when I complained just a standard we have refunded your item and that's it. Unhappy customer

records.title: Does not meet UK legal standards
records.text: I have placed 2 orders with this company, and both times something has arrived without a use by/ sell by date, therefore meaning that I cannot be sure that it is fit for consumption. After contacting customer service, I was told that best before dates are not a legal requirement in the USA, which is the reason why my drinks did not have one. However, I ordered the exact same thing from them previously, and it had a best before date. Also, although it may not be a legal requirement in the USA, it is in the UK, which is where the transaction took place.Will never be returning.

records.title: Ordered early Thursday afternoon and…
records.text: Ordered early Thursday afternoon and chose next day delivery at an extra cost so I had it ready to surprise my wife delivery never showed until Monday! Arrived Monday at 8pm I had to drive back from my holiday destination to surprise my wife DPD also awful 5 hours late after delivery window given. I will note that the products once received were flawless and enjoyable and well packed

records.title: The order took a long time to arrive and two items were dented.
records.text: The order took a long time to arrive, with no communication of expected delivery date.  Two of the bottles of Prime arrived dented - despite buying undamaged items.  I am unlikely to buy from Candymail again.

records.title: Didn’t receive what we ordered….
records.text: Ordered 4 new prime bottles for my child’s collection. They were advertising 5 ridge shape bottles (I know it’s only a bottle but when you’re collecting them it’s a big deal) and we received a 3 ridge bottle. I understand these are “UK produced” bottles but people are using the term “fake”. So if you’re wanting a 5 ridge bottle for your collection, you’ll be disappointed to receive a 3. I have reached out to candy mail and they didn’t offer any replacement, no help or a solution. Just a plain, rude (in my eyes) and unhelpful response. Quick to respond but won’t accept fault for misspelling products. Disappointing, especially when we are the paying customer. Order at your own risk.

records.title: Not all sweets in box were sweets
records.text: Bought the supreme Japanese sweet box as a birthday gift.It arrived promptly but i was a bit disappointed with products supplied.40% of the box was taken up by a large bag of Korean crisps and a packet dried noodles. "Pickled vegetable". Not the sweets I had expected.I queried candymail, and recieved a prompt response offering a 15% refund but no offer of an exchange or alternative product.I have now gone to a different supplier to make up for the shortfall from candymail. I don't expect to use this company again unfortunately

records.title: Biggest waste of £30
records.text: Biggest waste of £30, ordered a Japanese mystery box. A can of orange fanta?! Of all the flavours. A 3 pack of plain Oreos, very disappointing. Hello Panda biscuits that you can get anywhere. A few other bits and bobs but majority of it was very small items.Save yourself £30 and avoid Candy Mail. I was really expecting some weird and wonderful flavoured items, but I was severely let down.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Prompt service. The only problem was 2 of the chocolate bars had obviously been in the sun and reset (considering its Oct, it's a bit strange). The Cadbury wafer twirl was broken into 6 pieces. Bit disappointed. Good job these were not presents for anyone.

records.title: I otder the 45 pound mistory box there…
records.text: I otder the 45 pound mistory box there was hardly nothink there the stjStuff was shown on pic was no were near amount i got about 12 things got the cheep pretend lucky chRms u get from heron 1.99 about 20 pound stuff in box order pickle kit didnt come emailed they sent it out spent 92 pound all was rubbish

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Ordered two bottles of Haaland prime at 4.99 each. Husband came home with 8 bottles from Home bargains for much cheaper. Emailed to see of my order could be changed to a different prime product. It was a pre-order item to be delivered the following month. Emailed ignored all week until I got one 5 days later to say it couldn't be changed as it had been despatched. I wouldn't have minded an email to say sorry pre-ordered items can't be changed but ignoring emails is poor customer service. Their response is they are a small family business. Surely you wouldn't take more orders than you can handle as a small business! I think they realised that shops had released them at a low cost so they hurried orders out quicker than promised, ignoring emails like mine so they wouldn't be left with over priced stock! I won't be using this online store again in a hurry!

The staff was incredibly helpful and supportive. Kudos to exotic-estore. Once again, thank you.

description:
Shop sustainably with confidence on the eco-friendly milkround
We love hearing from our customers just as much as we hate waste, so thanks for sharing your reviews. Keep ‘em comin!
Arriving on your doorstep by 7:30am, our milkround is full of flavour and free of unnecessary waste.
Discover the freshest groceries from the finest farmers, bakers and makers, including eggs, bread, and milk and juices in returnable glass bottles. Just like the good ol’ days!
Ready to join the milkround everyone’s talking about? Check your postcode to find your friendly neighbourhood milkie, or get in touch with our team if you have any questions.

records.title: I can’t believe I didn’t move to the…
records.text: I can’t believe I didn’t move to the Modern milkman sooner. It’s far better in quality and an extremely efficient delivery. I’m a very happy customer so far. It may a slightly more expensive but I’d rather support local farms than supermarkets. :)

records.title: Great service and highly recommend
records.text: Decided to start using modern milkman to get my milk, from signing up to placing orders, the process is quick and simple.Orders are always on time and accurate, don't even hear the delivery person clanking empty bottles or anything.Not tried any of the additional products on offer but I intend to. Would highly recommend signing up and using this service, also helps to support British Farmers who often lose out to the big companies.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order, which can be changed easily. Products are lovely and fresh, and taste so good. The deliveries are great, my milkman is quiet when delivering and leaves my milk in my box, which you can get from the company.

records.title: Would recommend
records.text: Arrives early the products I have ordered have been good quality and worth the little bit extra The only complaint I have is received 2 veg boxes and in both the Brussels were black and got thrown in bin right away but everything else has been good quality

records.title: Absolutely love getting our milk…
records.text: Absolutely love getting our milk delivered- so much easier, the milk is great. The app is super easy to use - can easily add items or pause delivery’s.

records.title: 1st class service.
records.text: Couldn't be happier with both the excellent service and the quality fresh milk and eggs.The free safe box is ideal for the bad weather and will just as helpful in the summer months.

records.title: Excellent service and produce
records.text: We chose to move away from the supermarkets because of the use of Bovaer in their cattle feed.  The Modern Milkman supply milk from cows that are not fed Bovaer. We love the fact that we have glass milk bottles instead of plastic and It's extremely easy to use the app and book a delivery. The milk tastes so much better than the supermarket milk,  tastes like how I remember milk tasted (yum) the butter tastes like butter used to and the potatoes are better quality than the supermarket ones, every bit of produce we have tried so far has tasted better and has been of better quality than our supermarkets. The delivery is great, no complaints whatsoever, a very happy customer and I would recommend 100%.

records.title: my experience vvv good because plastic…
records.text: my experience vvv good because plastic bottle milk not good taste nd this milk vv tasty i m never drink milk b4 because i dont like plastic bottle milk bt i like it nd service also good . thank u

records.title: Amazing products
records.text: After switching to this from supermarket food, the food has gained back its taste and freshness. Genuinely, amazing quality products, plus I got the little storage box for free! :)I think people need to understand a lot of the service depends on their local delivery driver... Mine has been amazing, even got a little Christmas card, and some free pastries on the company!My one suggestions is - please, please, please, introduce more vegetables and fruits into Northamptonshire area! All I have available for purchase is potatoes (which are amazing potatoes) but I would like some variety.  :(

records.title: Never missed an order
records.text: Never missed an order, milk is delicious and kids love the milkshakes, delivery has always come before I’m up at 5am. I have an order 3x a week and look forward to it each time. Thank you for your hard work

records.title: Would recommend and its nice to know that I'm supporting local businesses
records.text: It's nice to wake up and know that there will be milk waiting on the doorstep.  In the short time I've been a customer all deliveries have arrived and everything is left with care.  Had a couple of issues ordering online but hopefully this was just initial niggles.  I like the fact that it's glass bottles which can be recycled.

records.title: I am still struggling to download the…
records.text: I am still struggling to download the app.  My husband and I share the phone, apps are in my name so there seems a conflict as his name and details fill the application.  Gael Evans

records.title: Milk delivery
records.text: We love a milk delivery my kids can't wait to check the wooden hut on delivery days to get the milk in and they absolutely love the milkshakes

records.title: Very excellent service and tasty milk
records.text: Very excellent service the milk and eggs taste amazing, my children love the chocolate milk too. The only thing I was not told of was when they couldn’t deliver it was not stated on the app this I waited for my delivery only to find out on the day I wasn’t going to get a delivery, but on the app they said they would deliver.

records.title: Very good service but still waiting on…
records.text: Very good service but still waiting on an answer to the note and email we left and sent regarding kefir

records.title: The service is great but the website…
records.text: The service is great but the website does not show the full order for the date chosen if I have added to a previous order. It is confusing and I do not know if I am getting the full order or just the new item I have just added.

records.title: Overall the milk quality is fantastic…
records.text: Overall the milk quality is fantastic best I’ve had in many years I wish I found this years agoPrices are affordable a little more than supermarket prices but the quality and to your door delivery makes it excellent value for money.Very few occasions it’s not turned up early but never normally run out so it’s never really an issue so highly recommended.

records.title: Fresh milkshakes!
records.text: Fresh milkshakes are at the end of our fingertips whenever my son wants some. I enjoy the Kefir yoghurt once a week. I buy these milkshakes because it’s healthier than store bought. I don’t normally purchase milkshakes so it’s been a new and great experience!

records.title: Fairly priced and good quality
records.text: Generally happy so far, a couple of miss deliveries but they deliver the missing items the following delivery day. Reasonably priced and it's nice to drink fresh silver top milk after years of having supermarket milk! Also received a free milk hut last month which was a nice suprise.

records.title: Doorstep milk
records.text: I liked the idea of waking up to fresh bread , eggs & milk delivered 2 x weekly early morning ,On a negative i didn’t realise you had to pay delivery charge , i wasn’t told about this when I  signed up , Also I wasn’t happy that they take from your account 5 days before delivery so if you change your order you are still charge then have to wait for a refund, on the whole it’s a great service

records.title: Really good quality products
records.text: Really good quality products. Delivery times good.Had one occasion when the delivery went to wrong address.App is tricky to amend orders

records.title: Great products
records.text: Great products. Efficient service. Would’ve given 5* but disappointed that when an item (organic whole milk) was out of stock it wasn’t substituted (eg. for organic simi-skimmed etc) so we still had to go to the supermarket to buy milk.

records.title: Great products and an alright service that needs a little improving.
records.text: Joined the modern milkman and also referred two family members after having a smooth first delivery.....Then i had a few issues with a missed delivery due to weather. Unfortunately the support are quite slow due to being busy but eventually they resolved the issue.Hopefully the support line will get on top of things and address issues better in the future.

records.title: The products are lovely.
records.text: The products are lovely.I have asked for delivery to be put in porch but is left outside. UpdateI've been contacted by modern milkman who very kindly explained how they are dealing with the situation. Excellent customer service. 100 stars.

records.title: Too much money not enough convenience
records.text: Milk plus delivery works out way too expensive Was told I can add on other essential items to the delivery the night before and they’d arrive the next morning. Big selling point. This is not the case. It takes 4 days. So pointless

records.title: No human person to contact and milk not fresh
records.text: No human person to contact.  I find it difficult to have to communicate via a computer.  When things go wrong you need someone there to speak to.The last three bottles of milk I have opened have been sour. Two were off the day after opening although they didn't smell right upon opening. This morning's milk broke up when I poured it into my cup of tea! And it smells sour already. I can't afford to keep tipping it down the sink and buying a same day whoosh delivery f07845116081or another pint.

records.title: Not bad
records.text: Products great only thing is they don’t collect used glass bottles and they don’t put order into the purchased hut… just left in a tray on doorstep which is annoying.

records.title: It’s good to have fresh milk delivered…
records.text: It’s good to have fresh milk delivered to my house.  However, the admin and reliability is still questionable for me.  I only started this month and have had one missed delivery already.  I’ve also had messages apologising for missed deliveries which were actually delivered successfully

records.title: The produce and options are fantastic
records.text: The produce and options are fantastic. This is solely scoring the poorly made up website to choose your deliveries. Twice I have not received my order on days I wanted because the process is so confusing and I missed out on the offer on my largest order? £35 charged for a single week is disgustingly expensive. I want to understand what I’ve bought for that cost!! Won’t be using any longer if this is the cost.

records.title: Delivery fee is too high, delivery time unpredictable
records.text: Delivery fee is too high if you have small orders. If you just want a £1.50 loaf of bread weekly, or a loaf and a pint of milk, you still pay £1.89 weekly delivery fees regardless of them already being in the street, or even at your next door neighbours house…so that £1.50 loaf costs you £3.39! Or a £1.50 loaf and £1.10 pint of milk costs £4.49!And you can’t do one off deliveries, you have to have a weekly subscription to be able to add one off items. Ok if you have a large family/ large order weekly, but if you’re a light user, it’s just not worth it.Also, orders can arrive the evening before. I went to walk my dog on a Sunday evening, came back at around 9pm, and my Monday morning delivery was on the driveway (not even in the delivery box!)

records.title: It’s ok could be better
records.text: I enjoy the convenience of having my milk and other products delivered, however they are delivered around midnight which is too early. This time during the summer months when weather is warmer would mean the order is left outside for at least six hours meaning they would spoil more easily also being left outside for that long means they’re at more risk of being stolen.Also the last two weekly deliveries the empties have not been collected which means I’ve had around 15 glass bottles stuck outside the door.

records.title: Updated review
records.text: *edit* I've since received a phone call from Tom in Customer Service to apologise who was professional and helpful. The issue is now resolved and I believe they will look for ways to improve response times with customers moving forward. Be careful this could be a scam company, they've taken payment but two deliveries have not shown up.There are no telephone numbers and the customer service email is non-responsive!My family are concerned we're now out of pocket and have had to pop to the shops to buy other food.I've since noticed others online have experienced same issue with 'The Modern Milkman'.

records.title: Good quality, empties is a problem…
records.text: Our empty bottle box that was sent on signup to the service has not been emptied in 3-4 weeks (since we signed up)! It is overflowing and more milk is being delivered?

records.title: Good evening,
records.text: Good evening,Let’s start with Delivery, I believe this was around 1:30 in the morning, with a torch in the front door and banging when trying to deliver in outside cupboard,Having looked and checked cost of products you were at least double than our usual supermarket even with your 50% off,The products provided were good, but just not cost effective even at 50%,Regards

records.title: Not delivered to where I asked…
records.text: I had asked that my milk be delivered into the box on my drive through the brown gates because milk is stolen if left on my doorstep.  Only once has it been put into the box on the drive and I now have a very large amount of empties mounting up in the box to be collected.  Not good recycling.

records.title: While I liked the service and the…
records.text: While I liked the service and the products it was just way to expensive

records.title: Not so Modern
records.text: Ok, where to start, first ordering my first order was a nightmare could not work out how to go back from the order basket as there was no back button or continue shopping option so had to keep using the back button on the browser.  The website messed up the first order, adding the same item twice. The delivery was never on time or was missed in the end I asked for my account to be closed but they still kept delivery.  Not recommended sorry.

records.title: I recently canceled my subscription due…
records.text: I recently canceled my subscription due to a series of issues that made the service frustrating and unmanageable.	1.	Delivery Problems: Deliveries were inconsistent, and there was no reliable way to contact customer support. The only communication method available was via a text box, which elicited no response. This lack of direct support was extremely disappointing.	2.	Spam Emails: I received an overwhelming number of pre-written promotional emails, which seemed automated and spammy.	3.	Billing Issues: Despite signing up for a two-week reduced introductory offer, I was charged the full amount for all deliveries. This felt misleading and unfair.	4.	Product Quality: While the products were decent, they only had a 2-3 day shelf life, which isn’t practical for weekly deliveries.Overall, this experience was disappointing. The initial promise of convenience and value was overshadowed by poor customer service, billing issues, and short shelf life of the products. I would not recommend this service to others.

records.title: Lots of unnecessary adjustments on…
records.text: Lots of unnecessary adjustments on bills making it difficult to check if we have been charged correctly. Also had one day where you had run out of skimmed  milk, and another day where we didn’t have any skimmed milk delivered

records.title: Amazing products
records.text: Amazing products. First 2 deliveries we had no issues at all. Then we had a few small issues all at once. One issue was that they delivered everything to one of my neighbours across the road, once she finally hunted down who it belonged, she told me that she always used to have the same issue when using them too. It’s a shame as really loved the concept & the products. It’s just not worth the hassle, especially if you have a query. Quick responses, just a lot of going back & forth.

records.title: Don't leave your bank details on the site.
records.text: They've been taking money from my bank on a daily basis. I get 3 deliveries a week.  I've had to take my account details off the payment schedule.  In credit for around £40 and although I've asked for a refund and to talk to a human nothing has been done.

records.title: You cannot cancel "modern milkman"
records.text: This company seemingly doesn't want me to cancel my order. I have emailed them and they do not do what I ask, nor do they reply.

records.title: Customer for a week and cancelled.
records.text: Customer for a week and cancelled.First order didnt get off to a good start as it was delivered to the wrong address, Second order was delivered correctly.Ordered bottle tops, they were out of stock. They dont refund back to your card and instead apply an account credit.Customer service replies are slow.Delivery charges were not clearly advertised at the time of signing up, which makes the service expensive.Have cancelled and will be using Milk and More.

records.title: Initially we loved the service you…
records.text: Initially we loved the service you provided BUT we found it almost impossible to contact you to change our order. Communication is not good; I suggest you have a telephone available where it would be possible to talk to a person.

records.title: Delivered too early
records.text: Great quality milk, however deliveries come too early, for example my Saturday delivery comes at 00:30 and I then left there all night.

records.title: Get the delivery correct i asked for 2…
records.text: Get the delivery correct i asked for 2 pints milk on a Saturday and cossiants Thursday and Saturday  6 eggs on Saturday  and 1.pack of bottle capsI've tried to adjust my order  but it comes up with there is problem with the basket so if it can't be sorted I will have to cancel my order Thank you Michele

description: Bespoke fresh Fruit & Vegetable and Organic boxes including locally sourced artisan produce delivered with minimal packaging and no plastics.

records.title: Always lovely to open the door to my…
records.text: Always lovely to open the door to my fruit and veg box from TheVeryGreengrocer 😍😍Always fresh, lasts twice as long as supermarket produce. No plastic packaging, delivered to your door, always reliable.

records.title: Sod the supermarkets; this is our go to for all our Fruit & Veg requirements
records.text: Forever a perfect service. I’ve been a customer for years now and never is there ever any issues. Nothing is ever missed and delivery is always when its due or a day early which is great. I really wish TVGG all the very best of success and will continue to use for years to come. The produce is always so fresh. You won’t even manage to get supermarket produce to last this long.

records.title: delicious selection of fruits
records.text: I ordered the fruit box and selected satsumas, red apples, a grapefruit, pears, lemons, plums and bananas. I've been reasonably making my way through them this past week and they have not showed signs of spoiling (stored at room temperature) I think it is worth noting how fresh and unbruised the bananas were !I also got a box of free range eggs. As someone who loves a fried egg in the morning I have been struggling during lockdown - I find supermarket eggs have dramatically decreased in quality. These eggs were lovely !Fair price, great quality produce and great service. thank you :)

records.title: Fantastic reliable company
records.text: Just received a large order for a family celebration meal this weekend. All in perfect condition, really fresh and I know will taste great. Never have to waste anything as it seems to last more than twice as long as stuff from supermarkets.  No plastic packaging, delivered to the door in a cardboard box. Have been using this company for years, always reliable, never been let down.

records.title: Fantastic local company
records.text: Have been using this company for more than 2 years. Always reliable delivery, fantastic fresh fruit and veg, last much longer than supermarket produce, no plastic packaging. Also supply dairy produce and milk in glass reusable bottles which they collect. I never waste any of my order.

records.title: Still my favourite!
records.text: I’ve been shopping with the Very Green Grocer since the beginning and with their commitment to fresh British produce they have challenged me to shop and cook seasonally. I have tried so many vegetables that you normally won’t find in a supermarket. I also love the fact that they are plastic free!

records.title: Amazing service and produce!
records.text: Amazing company!!! Excellent service, excellent fruit and vegetables (and other stuff). Everything is so much fresher than what you get in the store. And, no plastic packaging, which is how it should be.

records.title: Fantastic, reliable company
records.text: Fantastic fresh fruit, veg, dairy and other items. Lasts much longer than supermarket produce, so nothing is wasted. No plastic packaging so great for the environment too! Have been using them for several years and they’ve never missed a delivery, no missing items.

records.title: Excellent Produce
records.text: Have just had my delivery this morning and everything so fresh and so much better quality than elsewhere. Looking forward to making lots of tasty dishes. And Brussel Spouts back today. You can get everything you need from here, if you’re looking for excellent produce then have a look at their website. Trust me, you won’t be disappointed 👍👍

records.title: Great service & always a friendly face delivering your order.
records.text: We have been shopping with VGG for nearly 9 years now. They are always friendly and very helpful. Having such high quality produce & special extras delivered to our home on a weekly basis makes our lives so much easier. Highly recommended!

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: You can order your favourite grocery on single clik with amazing customer support and great delivery service

records.title: Great delivery and service as usual - satsumas a bit dry
records.text: Great delivery and service as usual.  Unfortunately, the satsumas haven’t been as juicy as usual. Not sure if this is due to where I keep them or whether they just are not as good. Otherwise, everything is great and I will keep buying and recommending you.

records.title: Nice fresh fruit and reliably delivered…
records.text: Nice fresh fruit and reliably delivered as always. Thanks.

records.title: Great service from @TheVeryGreenGrocer
records.text: Great service from @TheVeryGreenGrocer. Quick and easy to order, very efficient with receipt and with actual delivery. So polite too. Great produce always though my mango never ripened!

records.title: I'm very happy about the quality of…
records.text: I'm very happy about the quality of products that I received. I had some problems with creating an account and making an order but the overall impression is good

records.title: Great quality and service. . .
records.text: . . . . but for some vegetables (eg beetroot) it would be nice to have the flexibility to order smaller amounts.

records.title: Great produce
records.text: Great produce! The website is a little glitchy but their customer service is super helpful and quick which really helps.

records.title: Aiming for Zero Waste!
records.text: Aiming for Zero Waste!Reusable bags/containers, aiming for zero waste.Quick response on queries.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, highly recommended. Could have more seasonal offerings.

records.title: Great produce every time and always on…
records.text: Great produce every time and always on time and with a smile 🙂

description: Have that moment of luxury you deserve with our handmade, gluten-free French macarons. Online sales, corporate, wholesale and weddings catered to. More than just flowers - it's the perfect gift! UK shipping. Bespoke orders welcome.

records.title: Perfect Gift
records.text: Wonderful, efficient service and was personally contacted to query an error that I had made in my order. Recipients of the macarons were delighted and commented on the beautiful packaging and the delicious flavours. A lovely gift to give and I would definitely recommend.

records.title: Madamoiselle Macrons are delicious
records.text: Madamoiselle Macrons are delicious. There are numerous flavours to chose from and many of them will become favourites.  One can either chose a set box to buy or have the freedom to make your own choices.I have tried many different macrons and these Madamoiselle Macrons are the best on the market.  You will NOT be disapoointed.

records.title: Delicious & Reliable
records.text: It got there on the day and on time. Beautiful and secured packaging, everything perfectly as ordered. The macarons were delicious, we absolutely loved them! Will be coming back, for sure.

records.title: What a treat
records.text: Delivered when requested. Amazing packaging. A nice treat for Christmas.

records.title: An amazing company
records.text: Easy to order, lots and lots to choose from, no hassel, always delivered on time, overal a perfect service and amazing products

records.title: Brilliant Service, great Macarons!
records.text: Ordered box of 3 Macarons in the Wedding collection, to match my 18th Birthday themed cake.  Ordered them on the Monday for delivery Friday - they came on Thursday.  They were beautifully and safely packed and the colours were exactly what i needed. They came with a lovely "Macaron Passport" which is full of great information. Responded to all my emails, great service, would recommed and use again. Thank you.

records.title: Easy ordering
records.text: Easy ordering, help when I required it, arrived on time. Thank you and Merry Cristmas 🎄

records.title: I loved my macarons
records.text: I loved my macarons! I ordered them as gifts for my staff and cheekily ordered one for me too as I couldn't resists. Everyone was very happy! Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Stellar experience overall!!
records.text: Stellar experience overall!!We ordered a macaron tower for our wedding and it looked gorgeous but most of all was absolutely delicious. So many guests asked where we got the macarons from and it was the perfect choice of dessert. Most of all, though, the customer service was brilliant. The courier messed up the delivery two days before the wedding and Rachel and Becca went above and beyond to make sure we received it. We were ever so grateful for making it happen!

records.title: A welcome gift
records.text: I live in France, and frequently need to send gifts to friends and family in the UK. Since discovering Mademoiselle Macaron this summer, I have placed four or five orders, but sadly haven't had the opportunity to try their macarons myself. However, the website is user friendly, there is an extensive choice of flavours (with seasonal limited editions), and the service has been excellent every time. The recipients have all been delighted with their gifts.

records.title: Lovely macarons
records.text: Lovely macarons, coconut ones were delicious. A few broken inside.

records.title: unfortunate delay but delicious
records.text: Unfortunately due to no fault of yourselves the macarons went to the wrong post office sorting office so were not delivered on the correct date & therefore arrived too late to give to the person they were intended for. We have shared amongst ourselves & as always tasted delicious thank you

records.title: Macarons delicious, delivery a nightmare
records.text: The macarons are absolutely delicious; a real treat. However, the delivery process was stressful. I had asked for delivery on the Friday before Father’s Day to allow some latitude. The Post Office sent me an email promising on time delivery, then another telling me there would be a delay because they had sent it to the wrong sub-office. There was no indication that they would expedite getting my parcel to the correct place. In the event, it arrived on Saturday. However, the whole experience has left me questioning whether this is the right gift when arrival is time sensitive.

records.title: The macaroons were delivered on time…
records.text: The macaroons were delivered on time and beautifully presented. The flavours were just right, and the colours delightful. A lovely treat or special gift.

records.title: Macarons
records.text: Beautifully packed but somewhere in transit, they got bashed around which was unfortunate.Tasted lovely but had to eat them with a spoon as they were in bits!Flavours wonderful although they were a bit mixed, however this experience would not put me off buying them again.

records.title: Beautiful macarons
records.text: I ordered two boxes of six macarons for a special birthday cake I was making. I had several queries before ordering and each was answered in a prompt and helpful manner. The macarons arrived on the date I had selected but unfortunately two of the macarons had broken in the post. I understand this is a rare event and replacements arrived quickly on the following day..a very good service. The macarons looked beautiful and were delicious. The cake itself was a huge success.

records.title: Delicious but some were damaged
records.text: Delicious, but some were damaged in transit. I had a mix of 12 flavours and each one was really tasty, lovely texture and clear flavours. The box is charming with a nice menu booklet to identify flavours. I'm glad they weren't a gift, as a few of them had broken and bits were dusted all over the others. I suppose that's what you risk with mail order bakes, but they still taste fantastic!

records.title: Excellent but shame about the shipping!
records.text: excellent product as always, we could never doubt that.  BUT shipping via Royal Mail was the issue.  4 separate delivery times given, didn't arrive on selected date, and finally arrived 15mins before the end of the final delivery time leaving me worrying about getting replacements as the maccaron was needed for a 60th Party on the  Sat (order for Thur just in case).  perhaps a change of shipper is needed?

records.title: Pistachio, extra chewy and way too soggy..
records.text: The Pistachio came extra chewy and way too soggy.. But luckily the other two flavours I ordered were fine, rose and pumpkin spice. I have actually ordered the pistachio before and it was fine so I'm guessing there's a quality assurance issue, the flavours taste like the flavours but the sogginess of the filling and hardness of the tops and bottoms are really a gamble of each batch..

records.title: Recipient was pleased
records.text: Delivery was a day early, and recipients were pleased with their surprise gift, but I was disappointed when the photo they sent me showed at least five of the eighteen were damaged. Not sure where this happened, but would have thought MM would be careful with their packaging.

records.title: Love this company, but....
records.text: Love this company and their Macarons. Ordered macarons for my granddaughters birthday, and she loved them.My only complaint, and this is not about MM, but delivery by Royal Mail was not good. Tracker showed the were in the sorting office on Monday, but were not delivered till Saturday. My granddaughters birthday was on the Thursday, and I fully expected that the macarons would be with her by then.I will continue to use MM, but maybe lower my expectations on delivery.Keep up the excellent work.

records.title: Scrumptious
records.text: It was very easy and quick to place my order and there is no problem with the date I requested for delivery which is just before Christmas.  The range of macaroons to choose from was extremely good.  I was very pleased with the products on the previous order I placed.

records.title: Beautifully presented
records.text: Macarons arrived quickly and the presentation box is exceptional - makes them look v exclusive. Great range of flavours and you can make your own combinations. The downside was then trying to identify which flavour was which in the box! The macarons themselves didn’t blow me away - they felt airy rather and insubstantial to eat which was a little disappointing.

records.title: Coronation macaron selection fun and…
records.text: Coronation macaron selection fun and lovely flavours.4 stars, not 5 this time because one or two did not survive the post so well ( a bit crumbly at one edge) and they were a gift. However, would in no way stop me from buying these special treats.

records.title: Arrived fast
records.text: Arrived fast, well packaged and good selection. I've bought these both for myself and as gifts and would recommend.

records.title: Damaged macarons
records.text: I ordered 2 boxes of macarons, both as presents. Unfortunately, one of the boxes had not got an insert covering the macarons and all or the macarons were all cracked and unsuitable for giving as a present. The other box had an insert in the box and they were fine such a shame because it was  obviously an oversight, but an expensive one as I had to buy an alternative present. The broken box has been eaten by my family and tasted very nice.

records.title: A Happy Ending .....
records.text: We have purchased macarons from MM on other occasions and always been delighted with their service and the macarons. This time, thanks to the postal strikes and packaging and handling issues what we received wasn't great or on time. However, the test of a company worth buying from is how it deals with any problems that may arise. Having emailed MM and explained the problems, we received an reply and a resolution that sorted out the situation. Well done Rachel and team and thank you for your response.

records.title: No customer service
records.text: Taste of the macaroons didn’t wow me but customer service team was good and delivery was fast. The macaroons are a bit overpriced.

records.title: All sorted
records.text: Unfortunately things  went a little "haywire" with  this order the postal service seemed to send the macaroons around the county.before getting them to the correct address.....Rebecca from the company resolved the issue quickly and efficiently and the replacement macaroons were as delicious as always or so my friend told me.....Thank You ladies..

records.title: Delivered a day earlier than I’d…
records.text: Delivered a day earlier than I’d requested …. What’s the point of asking for a date, then doing different

records.title: Beautiful macarons; absolutely terrible delivery service
records.text: My first purchase arrived this morning, promptly and fabulously packaged - but unfortunately every single macaron (in the box of twelve) had been shaken to pieces en route.It's a great shame (and entirely Royal Mail's fault), as they appear to have been beautifully decorated. I'm sure the colourful little shards will taste divine, but they're ultimately far too damaged (not a single whole macaron left) to serve as a birthday gift for my friend. I'm so disappointed. Emergency birthday cake it is!

records.title: Usually flawless but not great this time
records.text: I tried these macaroons several times in the past and they were amazing. Unfortunately on this occasion the Christmas box included a few of them that were overly sweet for my taste.I suppose I'll go for my safe choices next time.Hopefully this review won't discourage anyone from trying this company as they usually offer great flavours and quality.

records.title: I’m sure they’ll be delicious but presentation was not the best.
records.text: I bought a Valentines gift box and just opened the box to check them before putting them in the fridge, I was a little disappointed that a couple of the macarons arrived cracked on the top. I don’t think I’d mind ordinarily, I’d just turn the macarons over, but given these were Valentines macarons decorated on the top, I can’t do that. It just lets it down as a gift a bit. I’ve no doubt they’ll taste delicious as usual though.

records.title: The delivery
records.text: The delivery, packaging and price were very good. Thebox was lovely and will be kept for bits and bobs but unfortunately two macaron  were broken and severalwere cracked.I found the macarons rather bland and similar tasting.They looked beautiful.

records.title: Delicious but late delivery
records.text: They do indeed taste amazing so I’d definitely recommend it to everyone. I got upset as it was meant to arrive on Valentine’s Day but due to the weather it got delayed and ruined everything I got planned, had to purchase different macarons from the local bakery and now we’re left with 24 macarons. I wished it arrived on time

records.title: Eurovision disappointment
records.text: I bought the Eurovision box and felt a bit underwhelmed. I always enjoy MM's macarons but these were not my most favourite. Maybe it was the lack of flavour choice or lack of flavour in the actual macarons but I didn't enjoy them the same.

records.title: Took 8 days to get Eurovision Box - 3 days after Eurovision!
records.text: Ordered a £40 box for Eurovision Macarons on the Monday before the Saturday Eurovision final..... It was on a next day delivery..... Royal Mail said was delivered to the Depot on Thursday morning..... but didnt actually get delivered until the Tuesday after Eurovision (8 days after we order it). So it after our event anyway - and I am away on business and wont be able to pick these up until next ween when it will  past the shelf life of the product. I did use the contact email on the Saturday to contact Mademoiselle Macaron but heard nothing.Addendum - the reply email was in my Spam folder - and they did offer a egift card which was perfect. Amending my experience to a 3 - didnt get the product but was Royal Mails fault.

records.title: Good price for decent macarons!
records.text: Placed my first order a few weeks ago and for the price, they were excellent! Packaged great as well and quick delivery (in my case, next day). It was so good that I decided to place a second order however I wasn’t as happy. Delivery, packaging and everything was good but the macarons themselves seemed like they had dried up a bit and this was immediately after delivery as I know you need to consume them within usually under a week. They weren’t as chewy as the first time. I ordered 3 flavour and they were all like this. I’m not sure if this is due to the packaging or not but was quite disappointed. However, would still recommend and place another order (hoping this is just a one time thing)

records.title: The vegan Macarons were very nice
records.text: The vegan Macarons were very nice, but the flavour wasn't that evident and slightly overpowered with a buttery taste.I do think they are overpriced too,at £16 +p&p for 6 macarons.

records.title: Delivery failure
records.text: Sadly, my order for my granddaughter’s birthday didn’t arrive in time much to our disappointment. Mademoiselle Macron immediately offered a refund or replacement. I can’t comment on the product itself, hence my ‘ neutral’ rating of three stars.

records.title: Great gift
records.text: Just to update you:Birthday girl has opened her macarons and ABSOLUTELY loves them 😍!!! Thank you 🙏 (Quite understand about the seasonal flavours.)Thank you once again.

records.title: The quality of the product is always…
records.text: The quality of the product is always amazing however, the courier you are working with is not handling packages with care at all and this, what was meant to be a birthday gift has been completely crumbled up. I have another order for Father’s Day and I’m slightly worried it’ll be a similar situation.

records.title: I liked the macarons they were very…
records.text: I liked the macarons they were very yummy, but I don’t know if it was the fault of mamosoielle or the post service I didn’t receive my delivery in time

records.title: Poor customer service and damaged order
records.text: I ordered for a friend who’d had a bereavement. The order was late, with no information sent after the selected delivery day had passed. When they arrived they were all damaged. I emailed to complain about the lateness and the damage, and did not get a reply. Simply a refund for postage only. Really poor experience. Won’t be using them again, especially with so many competitors out there!* since posting this the owner has contacted me. I did not receive her original email which was unfortunate. Will continue to support small businesses and if you’re reading this, hope you will too.

records.title: We weren’t happy with the quality of…
records.text: We weren’t happy with the quality of our photo macarons, happy to send in new set photos for another set macarons which were sent but they didn’t need them and the second set still weren’t good quality. They don’t show the same quality as shown on the website.

records.title: Pretty but poorly functioning packaging.
records.text: Packaging looks nice but does not protect the product very well at all - they rattle around in it so will never stand up to being put through the post. More than half the macarons arrived chipped and damaged which was a shame as they were for a birthday cake.

records.title: Late Delivery spoilt the experience
records.text: Booked macarons well in advance to be delivered Wednesday before Mothers Day as a gift.   Received email Wednesday morning saying they would be delivered that day.  They did not arrive till Friday afternoon.  The products themselves are great was just let down this time by poor delivery.

records.title: Very disappointed
records.text: Ordered a few times before for my sisters birthday and tasted amazing but this time it was just not up to standard unfortunately. especially disappointed as it was my sister’s 40th so I ordered her the big box. Moroccans came broken, all pretty much tasted the same part from a couple. Very disappointed, will not order again unfortunately.

records.title: They looked beautiful but had better at Aldi
records.text: They looked beautiful and tasted lovely in the sense that textures were great. However we couldn’t tell a difference between most of the flavours. For example I ordered chocolate mint and none tasted like mint choc. There was a pink one with chocolate inside which I assumed was chocolate strawberry however out of all of them, it tasted most like mint chocolate. A real disappointment. Also I ordered them for delivery on Monday, they arrived two days early and as they had to be stored in the fridge I had to find somewhere to store them cool enough that wasn’t the fridge (they were a surprise for my husband).

records.title: The video did not show the product…
records.text: The video did not show the product being made the camera was focused on the presenter There was no visualisation on the process of making the macaron it was only verbal

records.title: Paid for next day delivery then they…
records.text: Paid for next day delivery then they sent two days later, deliveries always arrive damaged private courier or not.

records.title: Arrived smashed :(
records.text: Macarons looked nice but unfortunately the middle macaron came smashed which I had personalised and as it was gift I felt too bad to gift it to someone so was a waste of my money :( shame as the packaging looked nice but perhaps abit more protection next time

records.title: delivered one day later than offered…
records.text: delivered one day later than offered before the order was made

records.title: Macarons were mostly damaged on arrival…
records.text: Macarons were mostly damaged on arrival which was disappointing as these were part of and afternoon tea.

description:
Thai Food Direct is a Thai & Oriental food retailer.
  Fresh items are delivered on a Monday.

records.title: Two recent orders...
records.text: Two recent orders...Very quick turnaround - items securely wrapped, and chilled by ice bottle!Thank you!

records.title: Ordered Satay Sauce, Quick Delivery!
records.text: I ordered some Satay sauce sat heya and they delivered on time and tasted great! Only issue was the stickers of ingredients did cover the instructions but that wasn’t a major issue.I will be order again.

records.title: Exceptional service
records.text: I rarely leave reviews... usually to highlight bad companies. In this case, the opposite. I admit, I chose Thai Food direct because of existing good reviews and I can add to those. Great selection, good prices, quick delivery and extremely well packed. Even a handwritten "thank you" on the invoice. Nice touch. I found them trying to find sushi ingredients which are difficult to get from the supermarkets where I live. But I cook plenty of Thai food too and will certainly be coming back to use them in the future.

records.title: Thai Food Direct is superb.
records.text: I ordered three food items from Thai Food Direct for next day delivery and the parcel was in fact delivered the next day. However, my three items were all individually wrapped in cardboard, for protection, within the parcel and there was even a bottle of frozen water also placed in the parcel to keep my fresh Kaffir lime leaves in perfect condition. The care and attention to detail with my order was a nice surprise and all three food items , which I used in a Hong Kong style vegetable and prawn curry were perfect and worthy of this review.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, quick shipping! Will use again.

records.title: Super fast delivery! Time for som tam.
records.text: My fiancée has been talking about how much they really want som tam for months, but it's extremely difficult to find green papayas where we live. I ended up deciding that it would be a great Christmas gift haha.Anyway, I wasn't sure it would arrive on time as I'd ordered it so last-minute (5 days before Christmas), but it was here two days later. I've never been so excited to give my partner a present and they were thrilled. Thanks Thai Food Direct! I'll definitely be ordering from here again.

records.title: Cannot fault their professionalism.
records.text: Cannot fault their professionalism.The order was speedily dispatched. Really well packaged, and with order paperwork.  The price of the goods was really keen, and they followed up with an easy to review webpage.I was a little hesitant at first placing an order with a non-mainstream retailer, but the whole experience was second to none. Well done. 5 star.

records.title: Great Service
records.text: Found the items I was looking for, as I can no longer  buy these from the major supermarkets. Delivery was quick and I was kept informed. Happy customer.

records.title: Great!
records.text: My dads mates wife is from Thailand and has gave my dad the tiffy tablets before when we was all full of coke so finding them to order was great and at a very reasonable price too! They work magic, better than any medicine I’ve tried in the uk, now living from my parents I am able to get these myself which is amazing, because I had one the other night, woke up feeling fresh as a daisy! Also fast delivery, standard delivery I chose however they came a little early!

records.title: Highly Recommend
records.text: Quality produce, well packaged, fast delivery. I will be using again. since moving we no longer have a local oriental supermarket, this is just as good, and similar pricing, delivered straight to your door.

records.title: Very quick shipping and good packaging…
records.text: Very quick shipping and good packaging for delicate items. However, there was a lack of communication from ParcelForce on delivery.

records.title: Will continue to recommend and use Thai Food Direct
records.text: Great range of products, great customer service. Would normally award 5 stars but on this occasion their courier (Parcel Force) let them down by delivering my order to the wrong address and advising me it was left with a neighbour, which it wasn't ! I will nevertheless continue to use and recommend Thai Food Direct.

records.title: delivery via Aberdeen
records.text: For some strange reason when I ordered online, the address I thought I had put in seemed to be adjusted somehow so my order destined for London went via Aberdeenshire!  But it was still in time for my mum to bring out to me in South Africa.  I have not tried the product yet, but cannot wait.    I will definitely use your company again if I am pleased with the Laksa paste which I am sure I will be.  Many thanks. Kt

records.title: Happy with price
records.text: Happy with price, communication & delivery, bought as gift so not yet used.

records.title: Unfortunately the jackfruit was somehow…
records.text: Unfortunately the jackfruit was somehow taste sour 😞

records.title: Reasonably priced & prompt delivery =…
records.text: Reasonably priced & prompt delivery = no qualms.

records.title: Very pleased with all items delivered
records.text: Very pleased with all items delivered. Well packed. However frozen food melted. So I have to leave in the fridge and all should be consumed within a few days.My suggestion is that you could get special Throwable  frozen  cubes ( instead of many frozen bottles of water) and special insulation plastic bags which should keep the food stay frozen)

records.title: Quick delivery, excellent packaging
records.text: My delivery was quickly despatched and arrived in perfect condition. They had really taken time to provide excellent packing… cannot be faulted. Only scored one down from “perfect” due to me having trouble using the search facility on the website. Maybe it’s because I was using a tablet rather than a PC??? But I couldn’t get the search button to work at all and so had to go through the menu system to find what I needed. Otherwise, great service and will definitely use again.

records.title: It would be useful for customers to be…
records.text: It would be useful for customers to be able to tell the delivery driver where to leave things if you are out and to know that you get a text notification of your delivery slot. I did not look out for a text message and therefore missed the delivery and had to go to a post office (not my nearest) about 8 miles away to collect.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. Great care is obviously taken in the packaging. Would have given 5 stars but some frozen product unfortunately showed signs of thawing which prevented me from storing item long term.Have used this company on three occasions and will definitely be ordering from them again.

records.title: I'm really happy with my order
records.text: I'm really happy with my order. Everything arrived, good value for money. I was pleased that the boxes they were packed in were reused, However I'd love to see less bubble wrap used. Not sure how else they can protect the glass jars and bottles but I'm sure there are more environmentally friendly options out there.

records.title: Food is good and the prices were ok
records.text: Food is good and the prices were ok, the website was a little hard to edit the shopping basket. Parcel force missed their delivery slot by 2 days which whilst not that serious was annoying when they’d texted me to tell me when they’d deliver and still missed it.

records.title: Good choice of quality products
records.text: Good choice of quality products & brands, some of which quite difficult to find elsewhere, Thai but also Japanese, a bonus! Prices are very reasonable.Delivery is fast, and very reasonably priced as well, even during this Covid-19 crisis.Very good!

records.title: Fast and Professional service from Thai…
records.text: Fast and Professional service from Thai Food Direct.Will I use them again ? Probably,My hesitation revolves around the "courier" they used.The courier arrived prior to the advised delivery time slot, fortunately I was at home at that time.I say "fortunately" becauseThere was a quiet knock on my door, I answered within a minute, but there was no sign of the "courier" , just a box left on my doorstep, a box that anyone could have picked up and walked away with.Not sure what "Thai Food Direct" would have said if I told them I never received my order.On a positive note, all items were as ordered and carefully packaged.

records.title: Great selection, fast delivery
records.text: Great selection of goods sold on the website, and fast delivery!Would give 5 stars except the noodles were placed at the bottom of my box, and were subsequently crushed by the cans on top of them. Thank you!

records.title: Great store - terrible shipping options
records.text: Great offer and service from the store but a terrible DHL delivery option for small parcels!!10 days passed since the order and the package made it only from the UK to Germany.... I hope it will not take another 10 to the final destination.

records.title: I still haven't received my order which…
records.text: I still haven't received my order which was placed on Saturday!!Sellar has been in contact and explained the delay and I have had a message today confirming delivery will be later made today

records.title: No refund on goods not received
records.text: No refund on goods not received, but two emails for a review. Here you go.Update: appears on its way-so upgraded to 3, would given 4 if mails would have been answered. Will try again, so see how things go.

records.title: Wide range of products but delivery late
records.text: Wide range of products. Pricing ok.More fresh vegetables would be even better.Unfortunately, my delivery was late , which is concerning if you order frozen foods.Hope that is just a one off.

records.title: Buying blind
records.text: It would be better if the ingredients were clearly described on the website.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service, the white peppercorns bag had burst, but I salvaged most of them.

records.title: Prompt setting up for the delivery but…
records.text: Prompt setting up for the delivery but poor company chose for that...

records.title: Paid for 48hr delivery it didn’t happen
records.text: Date of experience: 17 February 2021

records.title: Nice all us there
records.text: Date of experience: 06 March 2020

records.title: First time using this online shop
records.text: First time using this online shop. I put the correct address in online. Pic sent to Thai food direct. The wrong address has been put on the package and has been sent to an address 40 miles away ! Now having to pay an additional amount to have it sent to a post office to collect it.Not happy 😡My wife is Thai so she would have used them again but now she is seeing me very angry.

records.title: First delivery of frozen food did not…
records.text: First delivery of frozen food did not arrive. So , the delivery was recalled as it was all Thawed out. They cannot deliver anymore as they do not have the product in stock.

records.title: Paid £5.00 something for next day…
records.text: Paid £5.00 something for next day delivery as this was the only option, goods ordered Wednesday 1st June still not arrived. I appreciate there has been a bank holiday weekend but not even delivered Saturday or Monday. Asked for a review before the goods arrived also.

records.title: Ordered over two week ago still not…
records.text: Ordered over two week ago still not come. No tracking information given

records.title: Unable to deliver to our address
records.text: Unable to deliver to our address, not clear on their website was able to order sane product delivered next day by another company so their excuse was not valid they didn't even bother to try to get a price for delivery

records.title: appalling
records.text: appalling, made me wait for days and never had courtesy to email me that they were out of stock just cancelled my order without notifying me.You did not even contact me so do not ask me to change or remove the comment.

records.title: Order didn’t arrive and when I reached…
records.text: Order didn’t arrive and when I reached out to them for help they did not reply. I can see from the tracking that the item has now been delivered to an address in the wrong country.

records.title: Very disappointed
records.text: Very disappointed, order has never arrived.

records.title: Very good and packed very well
records.text: Date of experience: 29 June 2021

description:
Cake Box began its journey in 2008 with one small store. We now have 230+ stores with many more to come. 

It is a great honour to be a part of our customers’ most important celebrations and we pride ourselves in delivering delicious, personalised cakes on demand.


























 






Have any questions? Check out our FAQ! 
    Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? Contact us at info@cakebox.com or use our Store Locator to find the details of your local Cake Box store.

records.title: Delicious!
records.text: First visit to Cake Box today and certainly won’t be my last.  Lovely shop with plenty of deliciousness to choose from and served by a lovely lady.  The taste was beautiful and the cake itself so light I could quite easily have eaten both slices purchased myself 🐷 Very decent priced as well for the size of the slices.

records.title: I recently bought a birtyhday cake from…
records.text: I recently bought a birtyhday cake from the Preston Store and was served by the pleasant and lovely Aarthi.Highly recommend the store and the delicious cakes

records.title: Cheesecake
records.text: Cheesecake was amazing, will definitely be buying again as the chocolate was lovely, and the base tasted cakey too, different to the usual dry ones I get from other places, really liked it. Good quality fresh fruit on top too

records.title: Beautiful & delicious cake made for a…
records.text: Beautiful & delicious cake made for a birthday event. I was really really surprised at how quick they made it and everything was so fresh. Was ready in just over 2 hours as a last minute thing. Very good value for money. Would certainly order again. Highly highly recommended. Thank you so much! Lovely and helpful staff too.

records.title: Birthday cake
records.text: Got my mummy’s birthday cake out of here today, ordered yesterday and was available the morning after for collection.The cake was beautiful. Would highly recommend

records.title: Bithday Cake
records.text: Beautifully presented cake and ready on time.Really nice staff and cake tastes absolute delicious. My mother was absolutely thrilled with it.Thanks Cake Box West Road Newcastle.Keep up your great work !

records.title: Made well tasted great the colouring on…
