records.text: Made well tasted great the colouring on the cream was good. It can be hit and miss this time was ok and was a similar match to the picture adverised .

records.title: Very professional service
records.text: Very professional service , kept us informed when to collect, it was a most beautiful cake and enjoyed by many

records.title: I made a mistake but they put it right for me!
records.text: I attended the Hull store to collect my cake. Although I realised that I had got wrong day when I ordered and it was down to collect for tomorrow. The lady (called Sultana) was very accommodating and agreed straight away to prepare my cake today. After 15 minutes I had my cake and it's beautiful! Both Sultana and the man (sorry, I didn't get your name) were very lovely and understanding. Thank you!

records.title: Nori from Leyton branch was great
records.text: Nori from Leyton branch was great. I was in a rush to get a last minute vegan cake before closing on Christmas Eve and she went above and beyond to make it happen even when the odd were stacked against me. The cake tasted fantastic. Now my go to cake shop.

records.title: Christmas Sweet Treats
records.text: Ordered Christmas cupcakes and a couple of cheesecakes. Always impressed with the packaging which meant that storage of the items was good with no damages. The cupcakes were a great success. The Chocolate and orange cheesecake was delicious however the Christmas cheesecake looked fab but was a little bland. Overall delighted with the products.

records.title: great service from Daljit such a sweet…
records.text: great service from Daljit such a sweet person, awesome cakes they taste great and don't have eggs? Hard to believe but it's true! I would definitely go again :)

records.title: I ordered fan and chocolate cake (was…
records.text: I ordered fan and chocolate cake (was this the name?), the purchase process was easy from the start to the end, with enough information provided until the collection date. The cake was delicious, soft and not overly sweet. The only downside was checking the list of ingredients... hundreds! I never seen a list of ingredients so long in my entire life, that's why I give 4 stars instead of 5

records.title: Reliable and professional bakery
records.text: Great service from recipients local store - Peckham London. The feedback I got was as follows:Birthday cake was delicious. We wish you were here to help eat it as it’s huge (8 servings size) 😄 Pros - Very light and lemony, with lemon curd in between the layer which is nice. Very fresh and tasty. Also very handy delivery to front door! Improvements - would recommend to have more natural colours as the yellow is very bright!

records.title: Very reliable service, 1 drawback
records.text: Very reliable service, easy to order and collect. Very delicious cakes and well decorated. The only point that was negative is that the quantities on the website are not accurate. My cake was supposed to be for 70 people but it actually was for about 100 people. It was more expensive and heavier than it needed to be.

records.title: Lovely selection of cakes
records.text: Lovely selection of cakes. Would love to see them do some vegan ones too.

records.title: Cakes always brilliant
records.text: Cakes are always fresh there  unfortunately our picture didn't print but that's just one of those things  the otherwise it was a lovely cake what you made big thank u

records.title: Great design and experience but tasteless
records.text: Ordering and Pick up was easy and quick. The staff were friendly and professional. The cake was neatly presented executed well with precise writing and care. However, these cakes are sadly quite bland and made with artificial ingredients (Macphie frosting), with a dense sponge. It was quite a let down for eating and I didn’t eat the cake for this reason, but some family enjoyed it.

records.title: They miss spell writing on cakes sometimes
records.text: Would be better if they didn’t miss spell something on the cake every time I ordered one when you order make sure to make it clear to them what you want written and the spelling but over all the cakes always taste good

records.title: Cake was very good. A little retail disorganisation
records.text: Cake was very good. -1 star for a little disorganisation at the storefront as I had to wait about fifteen minutes for them to locate my order, write the name on the cake, etc. although I showed up within about 30 minutes of the scheduled pickup time.

records.title: Fab cakes great service pricey!
records.text: Staff in store helpful. Rang store several times and they responded & helped. Wanted to purchase online though as had discount code. Website was very awkward on my phone & wouldn't accept details so faffed deleting cookies and changing browser. I've bought 2 birthday cakes from them now & would use again. Do think they're expensive though too much for just any birthday but fabulous cakes to help celebrate the big ones!

records.title: PLEASE BE MINDFUL WHEN YOU DO LETTERING
records.text: The taste is excellent, I love it. It would be great to have another cake. I was disappointed with the name I requested on the cake. I asked ''Shatha'' and they gave me ''Shathan''..! which is not really nice.!Although the additional letter was removed, it had shovelling marks on it.

records.title: cake box's cake and what to know
records.text: It was really good, with a succulent soft texture and not too sweet icing. The chocolate was indulgent and kept making you want more!

records.title: Fresh cream cake with fruit and almonds
records.text: Ordered the cake a week before. The staff were very good. I accidentally forgot to add a message. Sent an email, no response, however when I called up they were more than accommodating. Collected the cake, the cake assembly was made in the store so had to wait for about 10 minutes but that was fine. Staff very attentive and lovely, polite and kind. Cnt wait to order another cake soon. The cake it self. Very light and fluffy sponge with delicious fresh cream and fruit. Beautiful (chefs kiss) 😘

records.title: Birthday cake
records.text: Great service. Cake looked beautiful. Was ready for collection early. Tasted delicious. The best birthday cake we've had yet. Will definitely buy from Cake Box again.

records.title: Not bad
records.text: Ordered a birthday cake from Cake Box for a friend who doesn't eat eggs. Good selection of flavours and sizes. Chose to collect due as the delivery fee is not exactly cheap. Got the red velvet which was very lovely, not very moist I would not call it dry.Four stars instead of five because I was told that I would receive a notification when my order was ready but never received any updates even after the selected collection time.

records.title: Birthday cake
records.text: The cake I ordered for my daughter’s birthday was really nice looking, well designed. Taste was okay but plain and nothing what I expected, as on the website is chocolaty, flaky, Ferrero Rochers….etc. No chocolate inside at all…only plain white whipped cream. Unsatisfying.

records.title: Disliked the food colouring on the cake…
records.text: Disliked the food colouring on the cake gave the cake  a bitter weird taste everyone scrapped it off and ate around the cake also the bing print was faded and smudge was better off not putting it on at all. Need to look in to better prints or have your own set clear bold colour kids character prints as for the hype of the shop.i was dissapointed

records.title: I have bought cake box celebration…
records.text: I have bought cake box celebration cakes from a couple of other branches and been much better look wise and correct colour chosen. Though cake was nice but didn't taste as fresh, I ordered baby blue and got a dark greyish blue colour and piping wasn't as nicely done. I'd order again but not from branch I ordered this cake from. When I went to collect cake communication was not good either collecting cake, no disrespects to lady who served me.

records.title: Peppa Pig Birthday Cake
records.text: The cake was lovely and well presented. Unfortunately I was not made aware that it needed to be kept in the fridge. After 2 days, we lifted the cake out of the box, and underneath the cake was a message to keep refrigerated. Perhaps it would be more helpful, on top of the box. The cake was fine on the day, but I'm sure it would have lasted longer if I was informed when I collected the cake. But satisfied overall and good value for money.

records.title: Excellent service but dry cake.
records.text: The service was excellent,the price is affordable, the cake was beautiful. The only thing that was disappointing is that the sponge cake was dry, not creamy, and the kids at the party didn't eat it after they tried it. Felt like an inside layer was missing.

records.title: Disappointed in service
records.text: I placed the order couple of days before my child’s birthday still the cake was not ready when I went to pick it up. They started decorating when I stepped into the shop. Disappointed in the service but taste was upto the standard.

records.title: The cake was absolutely delicious
records.text: The cake was absolutely delicious, deserving of a full 5 stars. However, I was very disappointed with the customer service. The staff member who served me was quite irresponsible. When I provided my order number, she only checked the cakes on the upper shelves and failed to look at the lower shelves where my cake was actually stored. This led to me wasting 20 minutes. She worked slowly, frequently laughing and chatting with her colleagues, showing a lack of urgency or awareness of the "first come, first served" rule. Overall, while the cake itself was perfect, the customer service left much to be desired.

records.title: Delicious cake
records.text: Delicious cake, perfectly done and ready for collection but spelt the name wrong :-( Quite how 'Happy 20th Birthday Lily' translates to 'Happy Birthday Lely', I don't know. To be fair, it was collected by my daughter's uni friend - I would have asked them straight away to rectify it but with it being delivered to the city where they live I was banking on the usual great service.

records.title: The cake is good
records.text: The cake texture is as good as usual. However, I won’t purchase that particular cake because of the icing colour. I had to take it all out due to the warming that came with it and it’s bitter. Please, don’t use it again or perhaps let warning icon pop up whenever it’s being clicked on. So, people can have awareness to what they are purchasing.

records.title: Mixed Feelings
records.text: Although my Pink and Purple Rosette cake tasted nice enough and looked pretty enough - it didn't look as good as the advertised image. (The colours were less vibrant and the piping was not as neat and defined). I suppose it depends on who is decorating the cake and so I wouldn't want to discourage anyone from using this company (the ordering process was great, and Nottingham shop staff were very friendly) - I'm just sharing my experience.

records.title: Although I'd ordered the cake 6 weeks…
records.text: Although I'd ordered the cake 6 weeks earlier, and arrived at the scheduled time to collect the cake, they did not have the cake ready, then after waiting informed me that they had baked the wrong sponge. I was very disappointed. I therefore took a different cake that was on display in the shop, and was given a couple of free slices of cake.In terms of the cake quality. The sponge was extremely light, but rather tasteless and  felt that there was too much cream. It was more of a gateau than a cake. What a shame!it was good to try Cake box, but I wont be purchasing from them again.

records.title: Unhappy with the color and placing of the cake
records.text: The cake tasted nice but here are the issue I encountered - it had too much color . I had to use a nail varnish remover as it wouldn’t go away and I had a tough time removing the stains from the carpet- the cake is not at the centre of the dias and easily slid of by the time we got it home - destroying the decoration on one side completely

records.title: Pretty but bland
records.text: For me the cakes look absolutely amazing but they are so bland , I was excited today to try our new store ,only spent 8 quid but ended up after 2 bites not eating the rest , there was no flavour at all , my daughter was the same she took 1 bite of hers and felt like she was eating nothing, can't believe looking at them that they would be so flavourless as the craft manship in the detail was stunning , I give 10 outta 10 in presentation but that's it unfortunately.Well at least I've tried it now , curiosity is cured, ill stick to my local bakery

records.title: Too much loading of cream
records.text: Cake base taste was good but too much usage of soft cream & icing on cake. You must reduce using too much cream topping layers and increase usage of real cake . We  ordered for our kids birthday but honestly I didnot feel like giving more than 1 byte of cake to kids considering too much cream on it which is unhealthy for kids to eat. When you are pricing £71 for cake we except quality and  not too much loading of cream. We felt like eating some cream rather than eating a cake .

records.title: Ordered a cake for a friend's birthday
records.text: Ordered a cake for a friend's birthday. Ordered from the cake box JUST because of the personalised text on the cake, as I am not a pastry chef, I don't know how to do that stuff with chocolate on cakes. Otherwise I could have JUST bought ANY cake at ASDA or whatever.  When I got to the shop to pick up the cake, the lettering was smudged very badly, as if it had been written, then something was probably corrected  and then re-written. It looked very sloppy...... no one offered to fix it, I was very upset and surprised..

records.title: My visit to Cake Box store, Hackney
records.text: I had the opportunity to visit the store in Lower Clapton Road, Hackney. The ladies that served me were fantastic and genuinely helpful. However, I simply could not comprehend the extortionate pricing! A 8” square cake had cost me £39 (including £3 extra charge for few extra fruits)! What planet are we living in? Or maybe the world had lost its head! Are you even remotely competitive with your rival companies?

records.title: Hair in cake!!!
records.text: They were good that they allowed me collect the cake earlier than the slot I'd initially booked but I found a hair in the cake while eating.

records.title: Very Dissapointed
records.text: Cake purchased was not what was received Was supposed to a naked chocolate cake with chocolate filling, when in reality the cake was covered in cream and filled with white cream.Despite complaining to the customer care team who suggested that Middlesbrough Cake Box would provide a ‘resolution’ (clearly a joke), the only reply from the store was to ‘thank me for my feedback, as this would help them improve going forward’First time (and sadly last time) customer

records.title: About online order
records.text: order was for Fri 22 nov collection at 3:30pm. When i ordered on previous day i called them and told to make STAR instead of dot on letter I they confirmed that. When i reached store to pick my order, lady was surprised that there is no such order upon showing payment confirmation they found out someone put this for next day then they prepared at a time i was already late and it took another half hour to get order.

records.title: Not a reliable company
records.text: I went to cake box to order a cake  for my mum’s 80th birthday , the lady in the shop was so rude , wasn’t interested in taking my order said I should do it online, which I did . When I went to collect it on the 26th November, the cake wasn’t even ready , had to wait an hour to get the cake . I would avoid Gravesend Cakebox like a plague.

records.title: Ordered a caramel rollo cake did not…
records.text: Ordered a caramel rollo cake did not receive what I brought instead got given a Maltese cake!

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Poor quality cakes with stingy amount of ingredients added to cake. You don’t get your money’s worth any more. Cakes use to one of the best in the area, now drastically dropped in quality. Prices going up daily but quality going down. Customer service full of clowns that only think one dimensionally! Try to cover cracks by backing up with stupid responses.VERY DISAPPOINTING!!!

records.title: Horrible cake it’s looks like not have…
records.text: Horrible cake it’s looks like not have been cooked right, so hard to cut to the next day it becomes like one stone so much sweet, buy the vegan one bcoz my little man have allergy to egg and milk ordered it one week early need to put it bin.

records.title: Firstly, the cake itself was perfect!
records.text: Firstly, the cake itself was perfect.However, the lower rating is due to us having placed an order for collection at midday.  We came to the shop at 1230 and the cake was not ready.  We were asked to return in 30 mins but had a number of other errands to run and couldn't come back until 1730.  It resulted in us having to change other elements of our day around unnecessarily.  If the time could not be kept to - this should be imparted to us via a telephone call or text.  The company was happy to confirm the order via text so they did have our number.

description: Order delicious Eggless Cakes available in various flavors. Order cakes online and  Find Our cakes bakes branches near High Street North, Barking Road,High Street, Romford Road

records.title: Today I went to purchase a cake for the…
records.text: Today I went to purchase a cake for the new year eve to the Layton brunch located on Bakers Arms.The staff was extremely polite and smiling.I filled that they are very knowledgeable about the products and very helpful to find the right cake for the purpose.I would like to say big thank you to the staff for the help.I will comeback as customer and will recommend it to friends and family.

records.title: The cake was really yummy and moist
records.text: The cake was really yummy and moist. It was simple but very beautiful. I bought from Cakes & Bakes for the first time, but will definitely use again in the future!

records.title: Cake lovely arrived when they said they…
records.text: Cake lovely arrived when they said they would , yes I would order from them again

records.title: Excellent Cakes
records.text: It was my husband's birthday and to celebrate I had to place a an order and wanted to collect a little late as I got of work and I wanted to suprise my husband. The people at the Ruislip store closed Thier store late than usual just so I was able to pick up my cake I was extremely grateful for that and highly appreciated it.

records.title: very good cupcakes and very kind and…
records.text: very good cupcakes and very kind and helpful workers

records.title: Had difficulty with payment
records.text: Had difficulty with payment, they helped me through by following up and delivered effortlessly. I will recommend cakes and bakes to everyone. The cake tasted really good too.

records.title: Swift service
records.text: Swift service. Super amazing staff. So friendly and excellent customer service.

records.title: Today i met varnitha
records.text: Today i met varnitha. Iam very pleased with her kind behaviour. Very helpful with packing make it possible in every way. Friendly atmosphere. Recommended.Variety of cakes.

records.title: Great Customer Service & Cakes
records.text: Called over the phone to the Ruislip manor store and I am very happy with my experience the customer service was spectacular. They helped me with all my requirements and all my questions which I really appreciate and even when trying the cake it was very soft and delicate

records.title: Samreen just an amazing and friendly…
records.text: Samreen just an amazing and friendly staff very understanding and very welcoming

records.title: Very nice service
records.text: Very nice service. The WhatsApp individual communicated well with me. There are no problems at all on their site. On-time delivery. Professional and kind. I would buy it again. Just wished they could write my message on the cake. Nonetheless, I reckon it would've taken away from the natural beauty of the design of the cake.

records.title: Absolutely beautiful cake for our…
records.text: Absolutely beautiful cake for our daughter’s 21st birthday, light vanilla sponge with jam and fresh cream, delicious 😋 we all loved it…..

records.title: 14" Blue Vanilla…
records.text: I ordered a large 14" Blue Vanilla round cake online, late on the evening before I wanted to collect it.  Order process was good, collection was easy and the cake was ready earlier than my chosen collection time.  Brilliant.  However ...... the piped writing wasn't very neat and looked awful and the white drip on the cake was a mirror glaze which was very sticky and not nice.  Just a suggestion:  this would be better if it was a white chocolate drip or the option to have aa chocolate drip just around the top edge of the cake leaving the top area free for the addition of customers own decorations.  I added fondant items which soaked up the wet moisture from the mirror glaze which made them go soft and sticky.  Don't use mirror glaze unless your customer requests it, it isn't very nice to eat and makes cutting the cake a very messy affair.

records.title: Great but Late
records.text: Once again the cake was great with lots of options, like cream and Jam also eggs or not, we also made some small styling changes, payment was smoother than the first time as well. The only disappointment was that we had a delivery window of 9 -3 on a specific date for a birthday, which I feel is quite a large window. It did arrive but 2 hours after the latest time. I was becoming anxious as we had plans for an early evening event

records.title: 21st birthday cake for my daughter
records.text: I was in a bind for my daughters 21st birthday as I was let down by another bakery. Cakes and Bakes popped up on my Facebook.I got in touch and spoke with a young man called Jamie who helped me and provided me with a beautiful Vanilla number cake. Everyone loved it and my daughter was definitely happy.The cake was delivered to my house as well which was a relief and very helpful.Thank you Jamie and thank you Cakes and Bakes.

records.title: Beautiful tasting Cakes
records.text: The taste of the cakes are gorgeous! (both sponge & cream) hence ordering from them for a second time. However, as much as I’m a cream lover, the layers of cream particularly the outside coating/decoration is too thick. So I would suggest either more sponge or less cream to make the combination absolutely perfect.Also, I found the jam filling not spread evenly & was more in clumps which wasn’t ideal.

records.title: Which occasion?
records.text: Easy online experience with searching for product and ordering.They do an eggless option which I was extremely happy with as not many companies off this. Cake was delivered with careThe only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is because the writing on the cake had slightly smudged and was melting. Maybe travel van/car should have extra air conditioning to keep caked cooler.Overall I would recommend and I will be ordering from them again in the near future.

records.title: Cakes and Bakes review
records.text: Good company to use for personalised cakes. I've used them several times over the years to make birthday cakes for relatives. The only slight issue that I've experienced is that the tend to send substitute items in replace of the original, for example birthday balloons, sparklers without confirming whether or not you'd like the item. Generally speaking a very good company to use. Product is always well made and lovely to eat.

records.title: Tiramisu halal
records.text: The cake was awesome and the ordering process was simple enoughOnly docking a star bc delivery is more expensive than the average so I had to go collect it (about 20 mins drive)And also because I wasnt informed that the collection time was changed on the day due to delivery truck breakdown, ended up being approximately 2 hrs delayedAnd finally the happy birthday writing was on the silver plate but was unclean under the writing with chocolate smears/smudges - showed this to the chap at the shop tooOtherwise very happy

records.title: Delicious cake but too much cream…
records.text: Your cakes are delicious and your customer service is good.  My only issue is you put too much cream in your cakes which makes it difficult to actually enjoy the cake. You need to reduce the cream, or at least have a section on your order page for customers to let you know if they do not want too much cream or jam in their cakes.

records.title: Cake is great, WILL arrive late
records.text: I've ordered from Cakes & Bakes twice now and they are certainly some of the best in making delicious cakes at volume. Gorgeously fresh tasting cakes, that remain moist, sweet and just as edible (literally) days later. Their decorative flowers made of fresh cream icing are also showstoppers, the entire look will make your audience gasp in amazement.My only negative is both times the cake never arrived within their promised delivery window. It arrived around 2 hours late, to two different locations in London. So take that into consideration when ordering with them.

records.title: Chocolate heart cake for my wedding…
records.text: Chocolate heart cake for my wedding looked lovely.  Great price and so easy to book online. Very very light sponge inside,  had expected the shiny chocolate glaze to be set but was unexpectedly soft and gooey. Tasted good though.

records.title: Beautiful cake
records.text: Beautiful cake, made as instructed and delivered on time. Tasted fantastic too all the guests loved it. Only reason not 5 stars is because on delivery small section of the cake got smudged with the box. Fortunately we was able to cover it up with icing so it wasn't too noticebale.

records.title: Positive:Cake was good and everyone…
records.text: Positive:Cake was good and everyone appreciated the taste. Attention required:Delivery was delayed for 4 hours since I had a buffer time I was able to accept the delay. Observation: Too much of cream layer and the color of the creams are stick to fingers even after a wash.

records.title: Service was super slow, cake was decent
records.text: Service was super slow, even tho they said cake was ready at a certain time. I didn't check name on cake, they spelt it wrong. You would have thought whoever iced the name on the cake had parkinsons, which than wouldn't bother me. My fault for not checking before I leftCakes taste good tho.

records.title: Not worth the price and not as expected
records.text: Cake was not what I expected. The decoration was quite gross despite my specific instruction to make it more subtle.The mango was just on the top as a large portion but the cake itself although soft, did not have a mango taste.Too expensive considering the website had mango cakes at almost half the price but I was told this cake was bespoke hence was charged £46.99-not worth the price.

records.title: Cheesecake
records.text: Cheesecake I have order the cheesecake a few times. It is lovely, however I do feel the biscuit at the bottom is limited, too thin and crumbly. Lots of cream not enough biscuit.

records.title: Nice looking cake but bland.
records.text: Nice looking cake and arrived on time, but bland and tasteless. Also had difficulty in not being able to secure the "discount" offer they sent me. It's the second  time I've used them and am a bit disappointed.

records.title: The cake is great, comms - not so much
records.text: The cake is delicious. However, communication with the company was not great. I didn't receive any notification that my order had been accepted and that I could expect it on the day I had chosen. It turned up, but the delivery chap went to the wrong address. I was also a little perturbed at the packaging. Due to the way the topper was placed, the box was packaged so that the cake was exposed to the elements which made me question the sanitary method of transporting it to my house.

records.title: Beautiful cake delivered by midday
records.text: Beautiful cake delivered by midday. However not what was ordered, I requested a vanilla cream filling however the cake sent was chocolate cream filling - too sickly for my family. Sent email and photo but got no response- disappointing when I paid £50. Also the happy birthday message was sellotaped on the box not piped  on the cake!

records.title: The cake was good in taste
records.text: The cake was good in taste. Delivery driver didn’t deliver to our house, my husband had to a different street to someone else’s house. The strawberry’s started rotting and were moldy in 3 days. The frosting or something more like a glaze started turning greeen. We kept it in the fridge and just it went bad real fast. I reached out to the company via email with no response.

records.title: Very helpful but average cake
records.text: Very responsive and made it easy to arrange the order itself which made it fairly stressfree, except when the delivery time was updated on the system incorrectly. The cake didn't look as pictured and the taste was pretty average. I have used cake box many times before and thought this would be better. The cake was disappointing, wouldn't use them again.

records.title: Great cake…bad service
records.text: The cake was amazing….when it came! No fault on the cake it was the best carrot cake I’ve ever tasted but I ordered to collect for 1pm. I was called just before 1 asking what time I was coming I said I’d be there in 5 minutes and was told to come at 4. 4.10 I saw told to come at 5. Luckily the cake was just for family so it didn’t matter about the delay but it was very inconvenient and if the order could not of been fulfilled I should have been notified about this prior. I ordered online so maybe have a cut off time to place orders or use a courier service that will deliver the sponges early in the day. The manager at the shop was apologetic but it didn’t make the situation any better. I was also told there was no refunds either so I had to accept the cake regardless when it came.

records.title: Lovely. But don’t get personalisation.
records.text: I love cakes and bakes. They truly have the best tasting cakes and they’re beautifully presented. However, the written personalisation is just so messy and ruins the cake. When I said I didn’t like it, they said that they can’t fix it because of the type of cake. It would be better if the staff were better trained in piping or the message was typed on a chocolate disc. Really disappointing.

records.title: The cake was amazing but awful service
records.text: The cake was absolutely amazing it looked great and tasted amazing. The only problem we had was the delivery came before our time slot and the driver said if no one is home he will cancel the order and won't deliver even though it was 2 hours before our arranged time slot. Alongside this the balloons we ordered came half inflated so the next day when it was the birthday it looked awful. Overall the service was very bad and I was very disappointed.

records.title: Vegan birthday cake
records.text: It was a bit difficult to find the public entrance however once inside, very friendly service. The cake was smaller than I expected for the price I paid. Personal message service at the counter is an excellent idea. I ordered a vegan cake. It would be good to have a label outlining the ingredients. The whole family found the cake very sweet so maybe the chef could consider reducing the sugar content. Overall, an okay experience.

records.title: Not what we expected.
records.text: The cake overall was really nice and tasty. But we had asked for chocolate icing but instead we got vanilla icing - which I thought was a bit unprofessional seeing that options were provided to customise but once chosen you weren’t able to provide what was promised. It was a surprise birthday cake and the receiver was quite disappointed.

records.title: First time ordering from CAKESANDBAKES
records.text: First time we have ordered anything from cakesandbakes.co.ukThe cake ordered was delivered 21st evening within the suggested timeframe so this was a good point.However, cake did not look anything much like the photo and we had to offer an apology to the recipient explaining and sending her a photo of what it should have looked like - that was not a good point.The recipient informed us that the cake tasted very nice so that was a good point and saved the day somewhat.

records.title: The cake was sloppy
records.text: The cake was sloppy, not very attractive. Nothing special with the taste. Location is terrible with no parking. Place was not so clean. Employees not very friendly and welcoming. Called before pick up for further addition to cake, was guaranteed will do but much disappointment nothing was done. Expensive and cake not worth the price.

records.title: Poor delivery of work
records.text: After placing my order, i was contacted to ask what it was i wanted on my cake which was already explained through text but i explained again. Then When i got to the shop to collect i was waiting a while. When the cupcakes finally came it had photographs on it of a person i didn’t know or asked for. I explained again what i wanted and had to wait again thinking ok it was going to be shorted. It finally came again looking extremely tacky. I was in a rush so i took it and left and went home to do the rest myself after buying a few ingredients. I was not pleased.

records.title: Disappointing service
records.text: Disappointing service The cake was not ready for 11;30.  they still had to do the piping and when the cake was shown to me, it did not resemble what was in the photo - they had to go back and fill in the gaps in between the cherries.

records.title: very disappointed
records.text: On our conversation about the cake and the delivery, we were told that delivery would take place from 9am-3pm and it would be free of charge - none of these happened. I was charged for almost £13 pounds for delivery and the cake arrived almost at 7pm.I have called multiple times the whatsApp number, customer number to ask for the cake and later I was given the drivers contact number - who said was unaware of the delivery times.Later I have contacted you about on WhatsApp about issue and you have replied that someone was going to call me (this was on the 14th of October) and nothing happened yet.

records.title: terrible delivery
records.text: terrible delivery, didn’t even ring the doorbell and just left it outside the wrong building in the rain left for anyone to take! A kind stranger had to ring my doorbell and tell me it had arrived. Cake itself was ok considering it had been left in the rain

records.title: We go often but yesterdays experience…
records.text: We go often but yesterdays experience was not acceptable. Ordered chicken drumsticks with s sauce and chips. The chicken was minced and knonone liked or ate it. When i discussed with serving staff i was told "oh ok". No other option was given and i got the full bill. This happens again to any other order i.ll refuse to pay the bill. Very dissapointing and arrogant behaviour.

records.title: Looks good but tastes average.
records.text: They have lots of designs and interesting flavours of cakes. But sadly the cake sponge is dry and doesn't live upto the expectation and price. I have bought two different birthday cakes at separate instances, the icing and cream was ok, just the cake sponge is very dry. First time it was a last minute celebration and I picked up a cake readily available in store, the cake was very dry, but the I thought it could be due to the cake already made and sitting in display for 1 or 2 days. But next time I ordered a customized cake through their website and sadly this time too the sponge was dry.

records.title: Inappropriate display
records.text: Cake had inappropriate display in the centre. I reached out and was abruptly put on hold and given the run around. Also, make sure you understand the order being received. Lack of such caused significant damage. Customer support can be improved alot. Show you have empathy and see how you can resolve the issue.

records.title: Very disappointing Pistachio Fusion Cake
records.text: The cake I ordered was a Pistachio fusion serving 12. We only ordered the cake an evening before so arranged to collect at 3pm, next day.Although the service was great, the cake looked different to the image and tasted really awful. I would say the dairy had soured and the ganache was disgusting. The base seemed to have a fluid soaked into the cake. I do love pistachios but I could only taste green dye and soured cream. There was not a hint of nuttiness.I spent £43 so expected so much more. This put a dampener on my birthday and since I just recovered a year ago from breast cancer. My family were polite but this ruined the day, Nonetheless we got on with the evening but I suspect the cake will get thrown into the bin.I would suggest you taste the cake and ingredients before selling and be aware of the standard you are selling. Finally look carefully at the cake’s image, and, is it an accurate interpretation of what you are advertising on your website?My partner (initials Mr M. S.) has the order number - the branch was in Bromley, collection at 3pm. You should be able to trace the order. I would ask for a refund because this was the most important part of a birthday.

records.title: Not what I expected
records.text: Communication was okay, but the quality of the cake isn’t great. Stale tasting sponge and odd tasting icing.

description:
We sell superb artisan cheeses from Wales' best independent cheesemakers. We specialise in gift boxes, hampers and carefully curated cheeseboards. 
We stock over 60 of the very best Welsh cheeses, and work with 15 fantastic producers. 
Established in 2017, the business has gone from strength to strength, but we've never strayed from our core purpose, which is to champion Welsh cheese to our customers all over the UK.

records.title: This Company is superb in…
records.text: This Company is superb in PRODUCT/EFFICIENCY AND FRIENDLINESS.Just out of hospital and struggling with Christmas shopping, I turned to the Welsh Cheese Company for help and was not disappointed. Mistakes I personally made, were quickly rectified and the recipients were full of praise for their gifts..Once I'm back on my feet I will come to the shop in TaffsWell to thank you in person. I'm epecially grateful to Georgia for her patience and help.Diolch o Galon. Theda Williams

records.title: Good selection of Strong cheddars
records.text: Good selection of Strong cheddars, Pickle power wow!Strong tasty cheeses are my favourite, but always willing to try the soft plain and blue versions.Placed a Christmas order with this company for several years and gradually going through the choices on offer. New cheeses introduced frequently. Also sampled their biscuits and preserves all very tasty.You can select your preferred delivery date and cheese comes in an insulated box with ice packs to keep them cool. Give them a try you won't be disappointed.

records.title: Great packaging to present as a gift
records.text: Great packaging to present as a gift. Wonderful selection of different cheeses. Really made our Christmas dinner stroke dessert perfect as well as the five days after.

records.title: This purchase was a gift for a friend…
records.text: This purchase was a gift for a friend when she rang to thank me she was over the moon with her present living some distant from each other in England  it's great to be able to arrange to give a Welsh gift thank you

records.title: Order received on day booked.
records.text: Order received on day booked.Excellent packaging Beautiful cheese.Bought as a Christmas present for an elderly relative living in Yorkshire. He loved it.

records.title: A truly excellent company
records.text: A truly excellent company, the cheeses  were first class with delicious accompaniments. Hampers delivered in time for Christmas to various UK addresses despite being last minute orders. Very impressed. Diolch yn fawr.

records.title: Great cheeses
records.text: Great cheeses. Quick delivery. Very well packaged. I will certainly order again as it makes a wonderful change from the choice in supermarkets!!

records.title: Gorgeous Welsh Cheeses
records.text: The cheeses are delicious, and they arrived on time and in good condition.  Diolch yn fawr, Siop Caws Cymru  (Thank you very much, Welsh Cheese Company).

records.title: Great cheese, great company
records.text: Last minute decision to order as a Christmas present, the hamper turned up on time, in beautiful condition and everything tasted wonderful. Would definitely recommend, will be using again!

records.title: Good range of produce
records.text: Good range of produce; good website; and friendly service in store and good delivery options if you buy online.

records.title: Beautiful hamper in wicker basket
records.text: Beautiful hamper in wicker basket. Arrived on time as requested.  Unfortunately one item was missing ( Welshman’s Caviar) and there was no alternative for it in the hamper.  Hopefully on receiving this review this item can be sent separately

records.title: Advent calendar …
records.text: I purchased several  advent calendars with a selection of six cheeses as presents. I and recipients were pleased with the selection & information about other cheeses too. I would purchase again.The downside was the extent of the packaging . Although the boxes were not too heavy … this resulted in additional costs for me to send on as gifts.

records.title: Cheeses were fantastic
records.text: Cheeses were fantastic, tasted absolutely delicious, a great variety, but obviously on the expensive side. The crackers, whilst they tasted lovely, were completely smashed up. Obviously a bit too delicate for transporting.

records.title: Gorgeous Produce
records.text: The cheese and chutney are both gorgeous.  We were given a gift box of vegetarian cheeses for Christmas, and enjoyed it so much we bought another one as a joint Valentine's present to each other.  However, one of the 5 cheeses was not there - the Angiddy Brie was missing.  I didn't say anything at the time, as I can't prove it, but it is the reason I have given 4 stars instead of 5.

records.title: Lovely selection of cheese!!
records.text: The selection of cheese was very good and delicious.My only negative experience was with the courier used for delivery. They completely missed the time slot specified, by over an hour and the delivery driver was rather rude when I pointed this out. However, "The Welsh Cheese Company", did refund my delivery charge on request.

records.title: I got the wrong cheese!
records.text: I got the wrong cheese!Update:  I would like to say that even though I got the wrong cheese, their customer service is excellent and I have received an email offering me two options to rectify the situation.  Mistakes happen but they have been wonderful!

records.title: Product excellent but slightly overpriced.
records.text: I received a pack as a present in February and have subsequently sent packs in May and June to three friends as birthday presents and had positive feedback.  The packaging is excellent and the delivery information informative.  I would have given 5 stars but do feel the product is overpriced especially with the added postage and packing charge.

records.title: Brilliant products
records.text: Brilliant products as always. Very tasty, and well presented. I found the courier service with DHL frustrating - I was given a 10 hour delivery window on my chosen delivery day, which the courier was still late for

records.title: Brought this Cheese set as a gift for my parents for Christmas
records.text: Brought this Cheese set as a gift for my parents for Christmas. They said it gave well presented and loved the variety of cheeses. Only minor issue was DHL delivered it 2 days later than expected but that the Christmas postal service fault.

records.title: up-dating my previous review
records.text: Having been disappointed with the delivery delay I have been very happy with the apology and response from The Welsh Cheese Company and appreciate it was not their fault but due to Courier Company.I would like to thank them for offering a replacement / refund. These things happen but disappointment is lessened when one receives good customer service.Thank you

records.title: The cheese was fantastic
records.text: The cheese was fantastic, however  the box that they arrived in was a bit battered. This resulted in some of the cheese being squashed.

records.title: I was looking for a Welsh cheese monger…
records.text: I was looking for a Welsh cheese monger that I could order for my son. Your website was easy to use.As I live in Ireland, it was great to organise a present for him in this way. I look forward to hear what he thinks of your cheeses!!

records.title: Ordered at last minute for delivery on…
records.text: Ordered at last minute for delivery on 21st Dec and you delivered. My niece was delighted. Will most certainly be ordering from you in the future. Thank you so much.

records.title: The pack was sent as a birthday present…
records.text: The pack was sent as a birthday present and the recipient, my daughter-in-law was pleased.  As she was coming to stay with us and had not eaten all the cheese she brought some for us to share.  It was good but seriously overpriced.  I realise that packing etc. adds expense but I will not be purchasing again unless prices fall.  I could put together specialist cheese, extra items, insulated packing for considerably less.  Sorry!

records.title: Not so good
records.text: Unfortunately after having stored my Perl Las in the recommended way in the fridge for about 3 weeks, I was alarmingly I'll after eating a modest portion. I can't prove it was the cheese, but a similar attack a few days later after eating it again makes me very suspicious about the cheese. I suffered severe dizziness and faint for many bouts of about 3 seconds duration. A day later I'm much better. The cheese had no unusual flavour and I have eaten it many times over the years.

records.title: I've given 3 stars not because of your…
records.text: I've given 3 stars not because of your company directly (as always very good service and the cheese is lovely), but because of the courier you use, DHL.  Once again they did not knock the door, but left it outside in full view with the gate open on a main road.

records.title: Would Normally Give Five Stars
records.text: Well I would normally give the The Welsh Cheese Company Five Stars but on this occasion I was disappointed. I placed and order and all was in stock. I received the order but a cheese that I had ordered was replaced but no notification was given prior to dispatch from the warehouse, just discovered it on opening. It would have been nice to have been aware of this. In their defence they did send two cheeses as replacements, one which was acceptable the other was not (tasted like over processed cheese not an artisan one). However this hasn't disheartened me and I will be back.

records.title: Package arrived too late
records.text: Package arrived too late. TWCC did make contact unprompted to apolouise so all credit to them for this which appeared to be a rare oversight.Otherwise excellent .

records.title: A great gift
records.text: A great gift, however, it took several attempts before the item was delivered by DHL, by which time 3/4 days had passed which eould impact the freshness of the contents.

records.title: Cheese isn't a problem but the delivery…
records.text: Cheese isn't a problem but the delivery company you use are ! They left my £60 parcel of cheese on my neighbours doorstep today when its 20 c plus outside in the sun , didn't knock or anything.  Luckily someone spotted it and informed my neighbours for me who had agreed to take the parcel in but I think something needs to be on outside of parcel that its chilled !

records.title: DHL Nearly Ruined It All For The Welsh Cheese Company
records.text: The cheese was packed very well as always and sent on the due date, all well from The Welsh Cheese Company but the failing was with the DHL Parcel Delivery Service. The parcel clearly states contents are perishable and refrigerate on receipt. DHL left the parcel on the doorstep in direct sunshine. The parcel was not personally handed over nor signed for. This could have resulted in a whole shipment being ruined and the Welsh Cheese Company having to replace all the contents plus the event this is for would have potentially been ruined.as well..

records.title: I have given 3 stars because the…
records.text: I have given 3 stars because the package was late. I know this is not really your fault, but it arrived on Monday 16th.instead of Friday 13th. This delay was the fault of the courier but I have to bring it to your attention because your cheese is usually delivered so promptly.

records.title: Cheese ok but very expensive for what…
records.text: Cheese ok but very expensive for what it was

records.title: Not a great deal of delivery slots
records.text: Not a great deal of delivery slots The parcel wasn’t delivered to my house but to a local shop, no attempt was made to find my house or to contact me One of the products was mouldy so really not great

records.title: Check best before dates
records.text: Delivery was as booked on time. One of the cheese we purchased had a best before date the day after the delivery. Very disappointed. The rest had at least a month left.

records.title: DHL..its in the sorting office..iv…
records.text: DHL..its in the sorting office..iv tracked the parcel..not even in transit..its early evening now...that should have been deliverd this morning or afternoon.

records.title: Note worth the money for what I paid if…
records.text: Note worth the money for what I paid if I brought it all separately it would of been half the price

records.title: Very small amount of cheese for the…
records.text: Very small amount of cheese for the price paid.The quality of the cheese was good.

records.title: Excellent choice and value for money
records.text: Excellent choice and value for money. Beautifully packaged as always. Thank you.

records.title: The parcel was not delivered as per…poor service
records.text: The parcel was not delivered as per instructions,but left outside the building in full sun,as the delivery picture shows,and not brought into the building,to the flat door.I shall not be ordering again,if this is the way delivery is carried out.The parcel was warm,and the ice packs were melted…Most disappointed.

description:
Shop Cakes 
 Shop Cupcakes 
 Shop Wedding Cakes 
 Shop Brownies 
 Shop Lola's by Post 
 Contact Us 

Lola's Cupcakes began back in 2006 when two friends, Victoria Jossel and Romy Lewis, started things the good old fashioned way. 

In each of our stores, from Chancery Lane Station to Canary Wharf and even Bicester Village, our cupcake specialists are on hand to advise and to give you a taste of our classic flavours as well as our seasonal new discoveries.

Our sponges rise with the sunrise and our bakers and decorators handcraft our cakes and cupcakes using only the finest ingredients.  Fresh every day, always, Lola’s Cupcakes brings a smile of sweetness to people every single day.

records.title: Amazing Harry Potter Cake!
records.text: I ordered a Harry Potter-themed cake for my birthday online, and it exceeded all expectations! Not only did it look absolutely stunning, with every detail perfectly crafted, but it also tasted amazing. The cake was incredibly moist and stayed fresh for several days after. It arrived right on time, and the packaging was excellent, ensuring the cake was in perfect condition when I unboxed it. I couldn’t be happier with the service and quality, I’ll definitely be ordering again in the future! Highly recommend!

records.title: The cake was beautiful and tasty
records.text: The cake was beautiful and tasted amazing! Delivery was very efficient! Will definitely be ordering again in the future! Thank you Lola’s cupcakes you really made my daughters 1st birthday special

records.title: I ordered a gluten-free berry cake
records.text: I ordered a gluten-free berry cakeIt was moist the sugar was balanced and overall it was deliciousMy family, Who generally consider gluten-free food to be substandard were quite impressed by this gluten-free cake and all had a sliceThey would have been none the wiser if I had not told them that it was gluten-free

records.title: Delicious GF and DF Cake
records.text: Easy instructions to follow to collect etc. Got the cake for my boyfriend who is gluten free and dairy free. We opted for the dark chocolate and raspberry flavour. It was lovely! Nice to have options for all dietary requirements.

records.title: Delicious cakes
records.text: Delicious cake. The chocolate was rich and thick and the raspberries were lovely. The sponge was very light and a nice flavour. Everyone was surprised that it was suitable for vegans and gluten free. I would absolutely recommend Lola’s Cupcakes

records.title: Fresh Berry Cake
records.text: Bought this cake for my husband birthday and he loves vanilla and fresh fruits, so it was the perfect choice. I LOVE the chocolate sponge and butter cream from Lola and not a fan of the vanilla, not that is not nice far from it it's only me. This time when I ate it, I loved the vanilla, it is a very fresh, light cake I really recommended it. As always I am a fan of Lola's as soon as I can I buy a cake and actually will happen soon we have my daughter in law birthday coming in 2 weeks. I ordered it online easy straight forward... to pick it up from westfield stratford nice and easy and they keep you updated and the staff is professional, kind, efficient, lovely. THANK YOU SO MUCH

records.title: Amazing!!
records.text: Amazing - everything was excellent, the packaging was extremely professional and the cakes were delicious and beautifully crafted! They were for my mums 80th birthday and she was over the moon! Thankyou!

records.title: A one off family treat became a passion!
records.text: We discovered Lola’s cupcakes by accident and really enjoyed the cupcakes. So we tried a small cake for Easter this year with some brownies and cupcakes added on the side too and then went full on with a medium sized chocolate & raspberry cake for Christmas and we’re not one bit disappointed. Ordered online to pick up at the local Lola’s and it all came through as promised, smoothly, quickly annd without any issues. And the cake was outstanding. Wedges, not slices, were cut by everyone and the cake was well and truly gone by 26th Dec. Delicious, tasty, fresh, chocolatey and the burst of raspberry was perfect. We all loved it and will definitely carry on buying Lola’s for all special occasions.

records.title: Lola’s customer service has always been…
records.text: Lola’s customer service has always been amazing, especially in difficult circumstances. I ordered couple of birthday cakes week in advance for the party but due to unforeseen circumstances I had to cancel the party and I called them a day before the delivery. They were so accommodating, cancelled my order without any back and forth and refunded full payment. This is not the first time they have helped. I always prefer to go to them for any occasion because of their customer service. Keep up the good work!

records.title: We went with a 40 person red velvet…
records.text: We went with a 40 person red velvet cake for our wedding, rather than the wedding cake options. Cake was superb - everyone loved it. Decorations were great as customer service was brilliant.

records.title: This was my 1st time using this service…
records.text: This was my 1st time using this service and I love the concept of ordering the birthday cake for daughter’s 18th. I was glad they had the flavour my daughter wanted (although she didn’t know about me ordering a cake) every to me organising the party and ordering the cake the day before was simple only I could not do it online for some reason and so instead I call customer service and I was lucky there was space in the vending boxes for my order to go through. I was so happy with my order and I was so pleased I could pick it up once I got my code. I will definitely use this service again, you were so efficient and the staff was so helpful and it workout so well. Thank you so much!

records.title: Easy online ordering and collection
records.text: The online ordering process was straightforward. I was able to select my preferred flavour, choose a size, the wording on the cake, my collection date and location. Picking up the cake from my specified location was also seamless. Friendly customer service and also a preview of the cake to ensure I was collecting the right one. The cake was tasty, but just a tad bit drier then I would have preferred. I ordered a large birthday cake. On hindsight, I should have chosen a medium as there was more than enough for my 15 guests, especially since some didn’t eat any cake. Overall, I am happy with this purchase.

records.title: I ordered a box of 6 cupcakes for a…
records.text: I ordered a box of 6 cupcakes for a friend and the process was easy and straightforward. I chose to have them delivered in a refrigerated van at an extra cost. I was updated on the delivery and notified with a picture on the drop off as I’d given specific instructions. Overall, very pleased!

records.title: Fresh sponge!!
records.text: Fresh sponge cupcakes which were personalised and seamless click and collect process.  The website needs to make it clear that photos online can't be chosen due to copyright which delayed ordering from my end and besides not like the icing with the personalised photo, my daughters enjoyed their birthday cupcakes.

records.title: Cake was delicious and delivery process…
records.text: Cake was delicious and delivery process very good plus extra marks for taking back packaging.Cake is small though for price.

records.title: As described
records.text: Ordered online. Cake arrived on time, with excellent communication and tracking info. Very well packaged. Cake looked just as in image and was tasty and moist. Only dropped a star off as I feel the cost for the size would probably stop me ordering again on a tight budget.

records.title: Delicious cake
records.text: The cake was absolutely delicious. The reason I'm unhappy is because when I collected my order from Selfridges in London, they had no big bags. I had to carry my mums cake all the way to West Norwood in my hands. The Young man was not very helpful.You need to make sure that you have bags for customers so that they can carry their cakes with ease.

records.title: Tasty and lovely cake desigbs
records.text: Occasionally use Lola cakes, they never disappoint from there cupcakes to birthday cakes. This time around, I ordered the childrens car cake, it was lovely,  beautiful design. My 4 year old loved it, and other parents complimented on the design, well done design team. The downside from this particular order was the cake crumbling. When the cake was cut, the middle part was crumbling and not standing firm. It’s a tall cake but usually cake would have better hold. Missing one star because of this.

records.title: When I open the box
records.text: When I open the box, the cake a bit small , I was worried whether would be enough. Also it look so untidy on the top of the cake. I was a bit disappointed.

records.title: The cake was special for Christmas
records.text: The cake was special for Christmas. It did have some issues a small whole and loads of the beads had fallen off.

records.title: It tasted very moorish and delicious
records.text: It tasted very moorish and delicious. It was dekivered as per time set. Would have given it 5* but for the price incl delivery the slice shoukd have been bigger.

records.title: Christmas cake
records.text: Brought the Christmas cake from Lola’s for the Christmas dinner with the girls. Everyone loved it! Hopefully they will have vegan option next year 🤷🏻‍♀️

records.title: Good presentation and design
records.text: Good presentation and design. Looked even better in person. Tasted delicious.Convenient location.

records.title: Cause when I got for someone the next…
records.text: Cause when I got for someone the next day the came was flipped no enough packing that led to the cake been damaged and was unable to give it out other than that it a very good cake

records.title: Delivery was on time and cake design…
records.text: Delivery was on time and cake design was good but overall cake was bit dry….It could have been more moist and that would have enhanced the flavour

records.title: I was very dissapointed the cake I…
records.text: I was very dissapointed the cake I ordered,was Banoffiee cake.It was my daughters 21st year bday cake and I received carrot cake inside with cinnamon.I have complained and they only gave £15 gift card as a  goodwill gesture.She doesnt like carrot cake and on her bday she didnt even eat her bday cake.Discription says totally different ingreediens.They have to improve that.I paid £45 for the cake.Not happy!!

records.title: I love Lola’s cupcake
records.text: I love Lola’s cupcake, I always get them. I was very excited for my Harry Potter special edition cake, it tasted yummy, proper moist but why didn’t you guys put the proper effort in making it look exactly like the real one, it doesn’t match, the icing should have been added on to the cake like it was in the movie.

records.title: Minimal choice for older girls vanilla…
records.text: Minimal choice for older girls vanilla cakes, I opted for this one because it was the closest to what the Birthday girl would like but I Greatly regret it the quality of the cake was sub standard.

records.title: The cakes were delicious
records.text: The cakes were delicious.  My daughter  and her friends thoroughly enjoyed them.  However there had been no attempt to deliver them to her house and they were taken straight to a newsagent a mile and a half away.  She had to walk 40mins in the dark to get them which lost the meaning of the gift.

records.title: Velvet cupcake are certainly better…
records.text: Velvet cupcake are certainly better than the cake version of it. Cake felt dry and not enough cream

records.title: Chocolate cake
records.text: Delivery was a few hours later than expected. Cake was well presented but some raspberries had fallen off and the icing was slightly messy. Taste was pretty good.Prices have gone up a lot since I last ordered.

records.title: Unfortunately not as good as was hoping…
records.text: Unfortunately not as good as was hoping not my 1st order with Lola their cakes in the past were very good but not this time cake was not fresh and tasted on nothing

records.title: Birthday Gift
records.text: It was a birthday gift for my other half.Unfortunately when we went to collect the cake, the locker would not open to release the cake.

records.title: Birthday cupcakes with no card !
records.text: I ordered some cupcakes for my nieces birthday with a personalised birthday card to be sent to her on her birthday ! She  received the cakes without the card ! I was so disappointed in this experience and being a very loyal customer to Lola’s this  really disheartened me. my niece was phoning around asking who sent her the cupcakes !!! As a birthday surprise without a card I really just felt like I wasted  my money and effort in trying to make her special day special ! I contacted customer service and the card had to be sent out again! They offered me a gift card as an apology only after I asked them that sending the card three days late was not what I had paid for and I was unhappy and what they would do to compensate this . I feel the customer service was not satisfactory on this occasion.

records.title: We enjoyed the taste of the cake…
records.text: We enjoyed the taste of the cake however, we were disappointed on how small the size was for an 8 inch cake compared to other franchised cake companies. It should honestly be a lot bigger or taller for that kind of cake. This was in fact an 8 inch cake that i have selected online, it did not say 5 inch cake.

records.title: The cake was nice but I wasn't sure…
records.text: The cake was nice but I wasn't sure about the buttercream icing. Having ordered at least 4 birthday cakes per year it was different.Plus, the idea that a 9" cake can feed 40 is laughable. Getting quite disappointed at the Cost vs Size. My cake cost £65 plus delivery of 7.99I had 21 friends, the max I could possibly feed without cutting my fingers would be 26 - VERY short of the claim of 40 persons.

records.title: We ordered a cake for my daughter’s…
records.text: We ordered a cake for my daughter’s 10th birthday and the handwritten message was awful! It was not at all like the beautifully scripted words on cupcakes we see in their stands but just so terribly written, that my daughter’s name appeared misspelt. I don’t know how this passed quality control and/or they could assign this role to someone who clearly cannot write with an icing tool. Whilst many of us would laugh this off, my ten year old didn’t find it so funny. They offered a gift voucher for this, but this only allows us to purchase cupcakes at a store.

records.title: Served the wrong cupcake
records.text: The cupcake are nice but I was given a different flavour from what I ordered, which I only discovered when I came home and opened the box.

records.title: Really bad opera cake :(
records.text: Not going to lie, the cake was terrible! I love Lola's cupcakes and cakes so I ordered a cake for my sisters birthday (coffee opera one) and it was truly horrible. The cake itself tasted stale and the buttercream came off in chunks, so everytime you took a fork of it all the layers would separate. The buttercream had a strange taste - almost like gone off greek yogurt? It was dissapointing as its a £45 cake and definitely not worth the money, and sadly because I loved Lola's :(

records.title: We buy cakes all the time from here…
records.text: We buy cakes all the time from here they where all amazing but now the glazing wasn't as much as it was before... not even between the layers

records.title: Should not be categorised as food
records.text: So full of chemicals that is becomes not edible. Check ingredients before you buy, the list is endless. We had it only for decoration purposes, for bd pictures, so can't comment on taste. We cut it after, gave portions to kids to take home for their parents to decide if they let kids eat that or not. Service and shopping experience is good though.

records.title: The delivery van broke down on the day…
records.text: The delivery van broke down on the day of the of delivery too the store which meant that I was not able to collect the cake on time so we’re continued with our their lunch without the celebrate cake. Very disappointing.

records.title: Not the quality I expected
records.text: This isn't the first time I've shipped with Lola's so I trusted everything to be great. I bought one main cake, 12 mini muffins and 6 regular muffins.While the muffins were perfect the banoffee cake went mouldy on the outside within a day, it was delivered late on the 6th and was mouldy by the morning of the 8th. Very disappointed as I've bought several great cakes before, I can only assume the ingredients were not as fresh as they could have been.

records.title: Lola’s has always been my go to for…
records.text: Lola’s has always been my go to for cakes for every occasion but unfortunately I was disappointed this time round. I ordered the edible photo cupcakes but two of the cupcakes the icing was very messy and I was a little embarrassed as these were a gift for a friend but nevertheless she was very happy with them. Shame this happened on this occasion as I’ve never really had any issues before this.

records.title: Some Cakes had fallen out of the holder…
records.text: Some Cakes had fallen out of the holder and didn't look great. Portion size for value wasn't worth it especially after paying delivery as the click amd collect option was fully booked!

records.title: Terrible cake quality!
records.text: Terrible cake quality!The quality of Lolas cupcakes has detoriated beyond words in the past couple of years! Also- please may i request you to stop unnecessarily innovating and focus on the core flavors! Ordered the red velvet cake and have to say the worst red velvet cake!

records.title: The lion cake
records.text: The cake looked more like a dog not like a lion. The colour combination was very strange especially the strong orange colour on a lion. It looked like it was made ages ago and piped cream didn't have smooth ages, the nose and the tongue looked liked a stuck up bubble gum. It was very dry and lacked any taste. If l didn't have a party, l would have returned it.i was so disappointed because we had one cake from Lola before which was amazing. I guess it depends with the area you book from.

description: We can't wait to share our amazing range of cheese with you, delivered straight to your door, no fuss, no problem, on a day to suit you.

records.title: Great service and quality (as always).
records.text: Great service and quality (as always).We always trust L'Affinage with our seasonal cheese order, and love discovering new and interesting varieties through their website.Very highly recommended.

records.title: So delicious!
records.text: Not only was the cheese delicious and a crowd pleaser, but the customer service is amazing!!! Thank you for your help and especially thank you for the cheese!

records.title: First class product delivered quickly…
records.text: First class product delivered quickly on time

records.title: Superb cheeses and excellent service
records.text: Excellent quality cheeses and great customer service. There was a mix up with my order and Leo very helpfully sorted it out immediately. Can't praise l'affinage enough.

records.title: The gift voucher I ordered was…
records.text: The gift voucher I ordered was delivered in time and updates were accurate.Recipient very happy, especially as he didn’t have to spend it all in one go.

records.title: Good service, great cheese
records.text: I ordered a charcuterie box as a gift for a family member, it arrived on the selected day and the recipient said it was delicious. Had a query about the order and the team got back to me very quickly and were super helpful. Would definitely recommend!

records.title: Yet another box of sheer delight
records.text: Yet another box of sheer delight delivered on time.Each cheese paired well with the recommended tipple and brought different tastes to the palate.Can't fault Leo, Louise and the team for their professionalism from selection to delivery.

records.title: This company is amazing.
records.text: This company is amazing.   If you like cheese you will be very happy....delivery is quick and prices are excellent...customer service second to none....would not hesitate to recommend them...

records.title: A good selection of lovely cheeses…
records.text: A good selection of lovely cheeses regularly delivered well packed and with tasting notes - couldn’t be better!

records.title: Fantastic cheese
records.text: This is our first order and can't say how happy we are with the quick delivery, cheese selection and most of all the quality of the cheese supplied. It was so well packaged, the taste of the cheese is fantastic and will be ordering more.

records.title: Great cheese always delivered on time
records.text: Great cheese always delivered on time. Could do with the ability to buy cheeses outside the monthly plan without having to go for huge quantities and a separate delivery.

records.title: Fabulous birthday gift
records.text: This was a birthday gift and the recipient was delighted with it. I was thrilled that the hard work of choosing the items had been done for me and, knowing the shop and the amazing products it sells, I had every confidence in the products. The only reason I haven’t awarded 5* is that, despite ordering a couple of days in advance of the date I wanted it delivered (and that date not being the first available one) the parcel wasn't delivered until the day after.

records.title: Mrs Kirkhams Lancashire
records.text: Mrs Kirkhams Lancashire was growing mould within a day. It usually keeps better than that. Otherwise the cheese was excellent.I had a very prompt response from L'Affinage with a generous resolution to the problem. Lovely people who take all responses seriously.The other cheeses in the parcel are delicious. Can really recommend the Cirone if you like a firm, almost crunchy and tasty bite.

records.title: Advance notice of cheeses please!
records.text: The cheese is, as always, excellent. However on this occasion we didn’t get advance email information on what this months cheeses would be, we only found out when we opened the box on arrival. This was a great shame as anticipation is half the pleasure. And it’s good to be able to plan meals to suit the cheese we expect.

records.title: Still lovely
records.text: It's the second time I've placed an order  this time I added charcuterie  along with cheese. Unfortunately the salamis I ordered  had a packaging problem so they sent a couple of alternatives which as this was a gift  the recipient didn't know it wasn't the original order. It was still lovely but I would have preferred to have know prior to delivery rather than an apology note in the box hence 4 stars instead of 5

records.title: Gorgeous cheese, communication not so good
records.text: The cheese is always great! But the overall experience is slightly spoiled by lack of communication. It would be nice to know a little in advance what sorts of cheese we will be getting each month. And it is really annoying not having slightly more notice of when it will be delivered - an email a few days ahead would be nice.

records.title: The cheeses are absolutely wonderful
records.text: The cheeses are absolutely wonderful, and their packaging care exemplary. However, I have one dietary suggestion regarding your supplied Cradoc's Oat Crackers. According to their ingredient list, a major constituent is, in fact, Wheat, which renders them inedible to me. I know it is my fault for assuming "Oat" was primarily what they were made from. I would suggest it might be helpful to point this out on your very helpful site.

records.title: Good but could be better
records.text: Cheeses were good although one of them was oozing from its wrapping.More tasting notes with each cheese would have made it an even better experience

records.title: Tell what cheeses I will be getting!
records.text: The cheese is lovely but please can you let us know in advance what we will be getting? Then we can plan for it and look forward to it as well. You sent me three separate emails telling me that my payment had gone through and my cheese was on it’s way, but not one of them told what cheeses there would be. I now gather I can find out what I’m getting if I look at the sub box page on the L’Affinage website...that’s great, perhaps you could consider including a link in the email?

records.title: The service was excellent
records.text: The service was excellent. The cheese arrived well wrapped and it was very good. I was disappointed with the sausage however. It was not  spicy at  all in my opinion. It was quite ordinary.

records.title: Christmas order
records.text: Delivery was quite difficult over the Xmas period, postal strikes & increased workload on other forms of delivery, but we were informed of delay & alternative method.Compromise made

records.title: Still pretty good
records.text: Very nice, perhaps a slightly more pedestrian selection of cheese than usual...

records.title: Website clear and easy to use
records.text: Website clear and easy to use. Products arrived on time and in an appropriately sized box and packaging. There was advice on how to keep the cheeses and when to take them out of the fridge for maximum taste. Only thing missing was the addition of tasting notes to remind me what I'm eating but I can easily obtain these from the website. Will definitely use again.

records.title: Bought this for my husband's birthday
records.text: Bought this for my husband's birthdayHe gives the cheese 4 stars because he never gives anything 5 unless unbelievably good and amazing value....But he loves the cheese and I think it's very good value.I ordered for my sister in law and she also loves it.Great variety and really lovely choices.

records.title: Cheese was ok crackers where broken…
records.text: Cheese was ok crackers where broken order delayed came after Christmas even after ordering it a month in advance possibly delivery companys fault I didn't think it was anything spectacular had high hopes for this place aswell and it's the only place over Christmas that let me down

records.title: Good quality but not great value
records.text: The cheeses were lovely, as were the accompaniments, but overall I thought it was somewhat overpriced

records.title: The cheese wasn’t delivered on the…
records.text: The cheese wasn’t delivered on the correct dayI expected it to be delivered last Tuesday 10/9, and it wasn’t delivered until the Wednesday Very disappointing as it was a birthday Present

records.title: the 'Wensleydale' version you sent was…
records.text: the 'Wensleydale' version you sent was too rubbery and the Lancashire had far less taste than the usual Lancashire I have.

records.title: Unfortunately most of the large…
records.text: Unfortunately most of the large selection of cheeses I chose were disappointing. Parmesan good, but Conte, gruyère, pecorino- this was soft not hard as any other we've ever had, berkswell and one other were very mild and some were even tasteless. We love our cheese so we know what were talking about.

records.title: Bought for a treat it has an odd flavour
records.text: Bought for a treat it has an odd flavour,  mint ? I foraee lots of cheesy sauces and toasties.

records.title: Ordered cheese for Christmas
records.text: Ordered cheese for Christmas, I had a phone call to say it would not come until after Christmas due to DHL , then on 28th when it was supposed to be delivered I had a message from DHL saying they could not find my address and it had been destroyed. None of this is the company’s fault but very disappointed. So will not use again. They have immediately refunded me. Perhaps they should look at a different delivery service.

records.title: The service was excellent
records.text: The service was excellent. But I didn’t enjoy the cheese and I felt it was way overpriced.

records.title: Never received our delivery
records.text: Never received our delivery - bought by my sister as a gift. A small typo in postcode meant the courier destroyed the delivery without warning. L'affinage shrugged and told us to pay another £50.I appreciate the typo was our error, but L'affinage admitted that this is a regular problem (second time that day), presumably linked to the online ordering system which doesn't use the standard postcode finder / checker.
