It is also their decision to use DPD, who don't contact the recipient when this happens and who also insist on destroying the package after 1 failed attempt (unlike both DHL and the Post Office). Given these risk (and how many very good alternative providers there are of this sort of product), I would recommend using Neals Yard / Paxton & Whitfield etc where proper systems don't create the risk of you being significantly out of pocket.

records.title: The order has not been received
records.text: Date of experience: 05 November 2020

records.title: order incomplete
records.text: Date of experience: 15 June 2022

description: Ever since our inception in 1985, our ovens have tirelessly churned out freshly baked cookies, day in and day out. Presently, we boast a network of more than 40 stores across the UK, each offering a diverse array of delectable cookie creations, all crafted with the cherished expertise of Millie's and served up by our warm and welcoming team.

records.title: Birthday cookie
records.text: Placed my order online and I personalised it how I wanted. It came fresh and exactly how I wanted it on the date I had selected. Tasted good and looked beautiful. I will definitely be ordering again.

records.title: Great Experience
records.text: Easy to order on website. Quick delivery & delivery partner kept me updated down to when my delivery was the next stop. Cookie enjoyed by all, will definitely order again!

records.title: Quite and easy to order through website…
records.text: Quite and easy to order through website and good communication. Pick up also quick and easy. Cookie amazing as always, highly recommend

records.title: I ordered two cookies online
records.text: I ordered two cookies online. Easy to order pick your own colours personalisePick pickup date and time to suit They were both exactly as I expected and 2 grandsons were extremely pleased

records.title: Very Happy
records.text: Our Cookie arrived in good time for our Daughters Birthday despite being over the Christmas period. Cookie looked great, tasted delicious and we were very happy overall and would recommend.

records.title: Delicious birthday double cookie…
records.text: Delicious birthday double cookie promised for my grandsons 11th birthday! Hoping the other 2 won't ask for a one as it was very expensive at £29

records.title: We love Millie’s cookies in this family…
records.text: We love Millie’s cookies in this family so what better going away gift from a cheeky elf than a massive cookie with our name on it! Great taste as always & looked great.

records.title: Tasty, easy to order online
records.text: Easy to order online, pick up for collection and choose a time slot. Prompt easy hassle free collection at my selected time slot. Tasty. Love these cookies. My nephew was thrilled with his gift.

records.title: Ordered the giant cookie cake as a…
records.text: Ordered the giant cookie cake as a Christmas present and wasn’t sure it would arrive in time and in one piece for Christmas. Millie’s Cookies and DHL got my order to me on time and in one piece so was very pleased with the service. My son was over the moon with his cookie cake too 👍

records.title: Amazing and scrummy, as always
records.text: I buy the giant cookie for my son at Christmas and on his birthday. They are always excellent. Personalisation looked perfect too. Thank you

records.title: Cookie is great but need work on timings
records.text: Cookie is great as always but customer service can be better. Booked a time slot and when I turned up at the end of it I was told it wasn’t ready and hadn’t been starting yet despite it not being busy.  Was over an hour late and no explanation to why and apology

records.title: Icing looks flat
records.text: I've been buying Millies birthday cookies from Glasgow Fort for years. Recently, the quality of piping  (writing and border) on the cookies have been "flat" and not Millies usual standard.It may be that there's a new member of staff learning the ropes, high heat, different icing head etc but its worth noting.Mind you, the staff are all lovely and the cookies are delicious despite above!!!

records.title: A brilliant idea ordering and collect…
records.text: A brilliant idea ordering and collect was so easy to use the cookies were very nice the only issue I had was some of the cookies looked like someone had had a bite out of them.Will use this service again.

records.title: Cookie is really good
records.text: Cookie is really good! Package left outside in rain unfortunately and the box was beyond repair

records.title: Lovely green dinosaur for my son
records.text: Lovely green dinosaur for my son. Delivered on time. My only recommendation to Millie's is that they do a tighter cardboard surround, because it's head arrived detached from the body.

records.title: The family enjoyed it
records.text: The family enjoyed it.   Shame the delivery driver didn’t read the box Fragile.   Hold flat.!!    🙄.   Or just tipped on its side.

records.title: .90p for a paper carrier bag
records.text: .90p for a paper carrier bag, should be included in priceI will not buy again from you because of this

records.title: It was well packaged
records.text: It was well packaged, a complete surprise and tasted delicious.

records.title: Cookie nice but didn’t like the big red…
records.text: Cookie nice but didn’t like the big red icing bit in the middle!

records.title: Good cookie but could improve pick up service
records.text: The cookie was really nice and looked exactly how I designed it on the website. Pick up was really simple, however I wasn’t impressed at being charged for a bag to take it away in. They give you the cookie in a pizza-like box and when I order it for collection, I expect it to be packed and bagged up for me to take. After paying £30 for a giant cookie I just thought it’s cheeky to charge for a bag.

records.title: The product was lovely but delivered on the wrong date
records.text: The product was lovely but it wasnt delivered on the nominated delivery date which meant it had a shorted expiry date by the time my sons birthday arrived.

records.title: Just one niggle …
records.text: Throw it in free postage if someone spends over £100, and the experience would have been five star.

records.title: Cookie was good only downfall was…
records.text: Cookie was good only downfall was collection, no bag to put it in so trying to carry shopping with a big flimsy box was hard work.

records.title: Cookie tastes lovely
records.text: Cookie tastes lovely, however, it was damaged on arrival looked like it was damaged when made not in transit

records.title: Prob just my houses opinion
records.text: Got 1 2 weeks ago for my sons birthday and got the choc chip one and was amazing.Ordered another one last week and got the white choc chip one and it didnt go down aswell as the 1st one. Still nicw but not as good as the choc chip one

records.title: Nicely decorated, icing in between layers spoiled the taste of the cookie.
records.text: The giant cookie was nicely decorated however we opted for the double layer cookie and the icing in the middle (which was green?) had an overpowering taste. Unfortunately it spoiled the taste of the cookie layers. We wouldn’t get the double layer again. Cookie was pink/white icing for my daughter birthday so aesthetically the green icing spoiled the look also. Disappointing!

records.title: The cookie cake was great
records.text: The cookie cake was great. The only let down was the damage caused by the delivery driver not holding it 'upright' as stated on the box. Contacted Millies and they have sent a good will jesture. Hopefully they choose a more careful delivery company in the near future.

records.title: Delicious cookie if not overpriced
records.text: Ordered birthday cookie online for collection a few days later. Cookie ready for collection at specified time. Outrageous that after spending almost £30 on a cookie they then have the audacity to ask if you want a bag to carry it in for £1! Cookies itself was delicious!

records.title: Poor decoration, good taste
records.text: The design looked like it had been really rushed and was difficult to read and almost looked spelt wrong because it was joined up and scruffy. Disappointed as this was our table centre for the family christmas.Cookie tasted great though.

records.title: Delayed delivery
records.text: Unfortunately my order was not delivered when I ordered it for and had to chase. The recipient did not receive it until 2 days after their birthday. I tried to chase DHL but was unable to find out why tge package was left at the dispatch hub for 2 days before it was delivered. The staff at Millies have been really helpful and promised a new cookie would be delivered or I could have had a refund.

records.title: Great cookie delivery small problems
records.text: Cookie was great no problem with it my only problem was I asked it to be delivered on the 23 and came on the 21 as it was birthday gift for 24th I had to give it to  them it early so they they have it longer to eat fresh x

records.title: Birthday ruined due to late delivery
records.text: The actual cookie was what we ordered and looked and tasted great. The problem was with the delivery. It should have come next-day delivery, the day before my daughter's birthday. This was so she could take it to school to share with her class. It didn't turn up and I had no notifications at all. The day of her birthday came, and off she went without her cookie. It turned up just before she returned home. As it is fresh food, surely there should be a guarantee of when the item will arrive. I understand companies are busy at Christmas time, but that is no excuse for not delivering food items on time.

records.title: Nice cookies
records.text: Great cookies, but were crunchier than anticipated and went stale very quickly.

records.title: Amazing cookie sadly was broken when it…
records.text: Amazing cookie sadly was broken when it arrived. The delivery driver was holding it on its side under his arm despite the package clearly saying fragile and this way up.

records.title: Double Birthday Cookie - Dissapointed
records.text: Top of double birthday looked great, exactly what I ordered. Blue and chocolate writing and border for my sons birthday. What spoilt the cookie (have one every year) was the pink icing in the middle to keep the two cookies together. If my choices were blue and chocolate and it said 'Happy Birthday Liam', why use pink? It looked really odd and very noticeable, never had this before. Spoilt the overall look of the cookie. Also, I know it's nearly Christmas so for people with December birthdays an ordinary box would have been preferred rather than a Christmas box. Cookie tasted great but not impressed with look and presentation.

records.title: Not as good as they used to be…
records.text: Cookies was smaller than previous ones and was dry. The flavour was not as good as other years. The double cookie icing to sandwich the cookie together was also very stiff and dry. We have been buying Milllies cookies for many years but after this one I’m not sure we will purchase again.

records.title: Ruined sons birthday
records.text: Booked weeks in advance and paid for Saturday delivery.  It didn't turn up on the paid date, ruining my sons birthday surprise that was his birthday 'cake' this left me having to rush to get something for him with money I didn't have. When it did arrive, it looked good but honestly doesn't taste anything special. I won't use them again.

records.title: It was delivered to my path!
records.text: It was delivered to my door, I was in, the driver left it outside on the path, Standing up in its side against the wall!  A part of it was broken (I did shout out to him when I opened the door and said  I hope this isn’t damaged, as it’s says KEEP FLAT he said why??? I then explained. (Caught him before he got back in his van)  your delivery company needs to pay attention.

records.title: The only saving grace was the swirls of…
records.text: The only saving grace was the swirls of icing apart from that disappointing as I have always ordered your cookies

records.title: The cookie itself was great, delivery could be improved
records.text: The cookie itself was great, but was a bit disappointed with the lack of care for the delivery. I assumed the cookie will be baked and delivered on the day I ordered it for by Millie's. But instead I found out it's getting delivered by DHL. So not only was it made the night before, but also spent an entire night in a warehouse and then a full day rocking about in a van with a bunch of other deliveries. And delivered at 6:30pm. Not ideal since I was gifting it to someone

records.title: Not the best experience
records.text: Cookie was squashed. DHL left it outside in the rain on its side when it stated to lay flat. Come on Sunday when it wasn’t supposed to come until Monday

records.title: Always love a Millie’s cookie but this…
records.text: Always love a Millie’s cookie but this time the sandwich double cookie had barely any icing in middle so cookie fell apart. Shame

records.title: Didn't arrive on the day that I had…
records.text: Didn't arrive on the day that I had chosen. Was collected 3 days early and then delivered the next day. Luckily it stayed fresh

records.title: Average
records.text: Looked good, not too expensive but the taste was average. Icing between the cookies didn't stick it together so it fell apart easily.

records.title: Disappointing…
records.text: The cookie looked the part but was extremely thin based so just fell apart when cut so very disappointing. For the cost of it, it wasn't worth it and I buy cookies for my daughters birthdays every year so it was a shame.

records.title: Sadly the giant version just isn't as good
records.text: Unfortunately wasn't impressed with how the giant cookie tasted compared to when you buy the singles/smaller cookies. Too doughie and not as chewie. Also £19.99 for a cookie (plus delivery as extra), no matter how big, is very expensive. Sadly, won't order again.

records.title: Let down
records.text: I ordered the offically nice cookie from the film that Christmas and was expecting it to come in the that Christmas cookie box however it just came in a normalMillie’s cookie box which I was let down by. Definitely not worth the money at all.

records.title: Never order online!!
records.text: I ordered 2 cookies in advance for my sons birthday. Specified a certain delivery day (the day before his birthday) so they would be fresh. I had an email 4 days before delivery day to say the cookies had been made and the following day had an email to say cookies were in transit, they arrived the following day, this was 3 days before the specified delivery date I had selected. So the cookies were already 3/4 days old, by the time my sons birthday arrived they would of been 6 days post bake day, on the website its states the cookies are best eaten on day of purchase. I opened the cookies, and instead of 2 birthday ones I had 1 birthday and 1 Xmas one. I emailed to complain, they refunded me for the incorrect cookie I was sent however they ignored the fact the cookies would not be able to be used for the purpose of my sons birthday as they would of been (and were) stale. I had to order 2 more to collect the day before my sons birthday to ensure they were fresh and we were able to use them as my son doesn’t like cake. So what should of been a nice easy process turned into an expensive and stressful mistake. Never again will I order online. Seriously lacking in customer service.

records.title: Order arrived fine but the cookie…
records.text: Order arrived fine but the cookie itself was already very dried out. Also not enough icing to combat the dryness. Really disappointed. Won't be ordering the Xmas 'nice' cookie again.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Got the officially nice Christmas cookie cake, super disappointed not as nice as the normal cookie cakes tasted too sweet and sickly no one liked it! Everyone said even the cookie was not good! The brownie cookies were bought aswell as an extra for autistic kiddo that just likes them they said they tasted salty and didn’t eat them so overall totally disappointed

records.title: Cookies all broken
records.text: The cookies were put into the box hot. Which resulted in the box being weak and the cookies all broken except the bottom ones.

records.title: Normally the cookies are fresh even…
records.text: Normally the cookies are fresh even though delivered . This time they were quite stale and appeared to have been baked many days before delivery

records.title: Designated delvery pointless
records.text: Paid £5 for delivery on specific date. Ordered to be delivered on Monday 16th December but got delivered two days early on Saturday 14th. I’m guessing it was baked then on 13th. If I wanted 4 days old cookie, I would of gone to supermarket. Also, early delivery also ruined the birthday surprise. Not happy!

records.title: Not what I've come to expect from them.  Not sure if I'd ever buy again.
records.text: Millies cookies are usually really nice but this time we ordered  them, instead of just popping by the store to buy some.  Most were under baked and still doughy.  Others were half cookies, meaning they weren't all the same size.  Most were half the size of the others. And they were all just shoved in a box loosely.  Was not very presentable.   Not pleased with them at all.

records.title: The cookies came late and the customer…
records.text: The cookies came late and the customer service agent was not friendly or helpful at all. Missed my friend’s birthday and quite a poor experience, unfortunately.

description: We're a world-famous Tea Rooms in Yorkshire, England, sending parcels of pure spirit-lifting deliciousness from our Craft Bakery to homes across the world.

records.title: We received this box as a Christmas…
records.text: We received this box as a Christmas gift. We were so pleased with the box we ended up sending these out to many people in our family. What a memorable way to share Betty’s treats with so many people at Christmas. The international delivery service was also exceptional.

records.title: Careful, friendly service
records.text: After placing my Christmas order extremely late, I was happy with the assurance that the gift token would be delivered just after the big day. However, I was thrilled to hear that it had actually arrived on Christmas eve! Thank you for going above and beyond, and thank you,  too, to the friendly, helpful call handler.

records.title: Where else would one want to shop f
records.text: I ordered some biscuits very late for Christmas,  I received an email to say they would arrive on 27th December,  This was fine with me as I had ordered so late.  Imagine  my delight  when they arrived on Christmas Eve in time for the tea I had originally planned for Boxing Day.  A small purchase but treated      with efficient service.

records.title: Christmas Joy
records.text: Bought goodies for Christmas. Speciality mince pies, stollen bites, fondant fancies and the chocolate steam train. As you'd expect from Betty's everything was top notch, beautifully wrapped and thoroughly enjoyed by all the family. All items arrived safely as they were carefully packaged and delivered by DPD.Think next year I'll double up my order and give to family and friends as presents.

records.title: I placed an order for my elderly aunt…
records.text: I placed an order for my elderly aunt this Christmas . DPD didn’t deliver because the post code was wrong . The parcel didn’t arrive in time for Christmas . When I spoke to. Bettys a really lovely young lady sorted out the problem  a very kind young lady. She arranged for another cake to be delivered a few days late but I am a very satisfied customer. Thank you .

records.title: I ordered the Brilliantly Betty’s…
records.text: I ordered the Brilliantly Betty’s Collection and a box of Stollen Bites for Christmas as a special treat because the Christmas food in the supermarkets looked very unappealing.We were not disappointed. The Betty’s chocolates, chocolate cake and stollen bites were delicious. We haven’t tried the jam or Yorkshire shortbread yet. We’re still enjoying the ground coffee.

records.title: Vouchers for Christmas
records.text: I live overseas and I've ordered Betty's vouchers for the past few years as a Christmas gift for 2 special friends who live in the UK.  They love visiting the cafes in Northallerton and Harrogate.  The ordering process is easy and the vouchers are delivered promptly in plenty of time for Christmas.  I highly recommend the website.

records.title: Mince pies and Xmas pudding were…
records.text: Mince pies and Xmas pudding were excellent. I had asked for Xmas Eve delivery and they arrived the day before but I understand the risk of not sending them earlier, however  as a result the mince pies had a use before date 26th Dec, which meant of course they had to be eaten immediately 😆

records.title: Christmas Luxury
records.text: Betty’s you did not let us down. Our order arrived exactly when expected. We were so excited opening the box of goodies. The fat rascals were consumed by family almost immediately and tasted amazing (one between two ) to make them last! The Christmas design fondant fancies were out of this world delicious, soft and sweet and just yum!!! The star of the show was the royal icing christmas cake, which was full of fruit, rich and moist. We managed to make it last until the 28th of December. We haven’t ordered from Betty’s before but after a lovely visit to Harrogate in November, we thought we would try it. It will now become our Christmas tradition. Happy New Year from Edinburgh .

records.title: Very tasty and beautifully packaged
records.text: We ordered mince pies, fondant cakes and special blend tea. As well as all tasting wonderful they arrived beautifully packaged, looking great and on time.

records.title: Luxury quality at what price.
records.text: Great quality as is usual.We are particular fans of the original Fat Rascals ❤️.Betty’s are becoming very expensive on all products. The size of some of the products is noticeable shrinking as well.The postage is too expensive.For the first time in 28 years we are questioning value for money on this luxury brand we love. Shame really.

records.title: Mum and Dad were delighted
records.text: Mum and Dad were delighted. The basket of goodies was received well and the first to arrive of all the hampers I ordered, and I was kept informed at every step, which was welcome as it was being gifted from overseas.

records.title: Delivered too early
records.text: Ordered mince pies for Christmas. Paid a premium (quite a bit) for them to be delivered on 23rd as they are supposed to be eaten within 3 days. They were actually delivered a day early, which slightly defeated the point. The pies themselves (Speciality Mince Pies) were nice enough but a bit "too much" - very buttery, very almondy, very citrussy.

records.title: Delivery was quick
records.text: Delivery was quick. I purchased items for Xmas and some of the items purchased had a really short date on them eg 2 days after delivery and I'm not sure if that is usual? Items purchased were delicious though so thanks

records.title: Great Christmas treats
records.text: Good communication about the order and delivery process. Very nice quality cake and marzipan fruits. The items were much smaller than I had imagined them to be. Photos of products shown on the internet appear to look much more impressive than they are in reality.The tin of the Christmas cake had been dented during transit. It was quite a heavy item and it had probably moved about while the box was being handled.

records.title: A gift box you put together yourself is…
records.text: A gift box you put together yourself is a great idea. The recipients loved theirs. Like all Betty’s offerings, they are on the pricey side, hence one star deducted.

records.title: Too expensive for what it was
records.text: Gift Hamper. Choose 4 items which was recommended by Bettys came in a lovely large box and wrapped well, but needed more items in it as lots of space left. Bit disappointed.Too expensive £13.50 for such a tiny box of chocolates. Cost £46 including box & postage.

records.title: Everything delicious
records.text: Everything delicious.  The brownie bites were exceptional.  Our guests devoured them.was the Yorkshire tea bread I ordered really the Yorkshire tea cake you sent?  I remembered it as rather more bread.With best wishes, Arlene Polonsky

records.title: Good pleasant customer service
records.text: Good pleasant customer serviceRecipients happy with their surprises Except one parcel didn’t include my Xmas 🎄 message to them That’s disappointing I chose Betty’s as my niece had a delivery to me whilst on holiday in UK

records.title: Good but…
records.text: I’ve wanted one of your Christmas cakes for years but they are expensive to get sent here…and it’s very hot here this time of year (Queensland) so what condition would the cake be in when it arrived? The icing and marzipan were wonderful but the fruit cake was a bit dry. Was it a little dry when it was topped or just the weather here? Don’t know 🤔

records.title: A lovely Christmas gift
records.text: I ordered the china mug, tea, Christmas cake and chocolates in a gift box for my mum for Christmas. It arrived in good time with a separate list of use by dates which I thought was a useful attention to detail. It also came with a lovely card. The only slight downside was the box had become slightly crushed on a corner in transit. My mum was thrilled with the gift. Thank you Betty’s.

records.title: I ordered a box of fancies for a…
records.text: I ordered a box of fancies for a Christmas present as my in-laws loved the time they spent in York at the tea room. It was special because they won't be able to go back because of terminal illness.  They absolutely loved them a real special treat.  However I had a problem with delivery.  You don't deliver north of Aberdeen.  Inverness is not outer space. Ended up getting them delivered to a friend in Glasgow and arranged for someone to collect them. Because of this the date we got them they were out of date in 4 days which was disappointing.  However they were absolutely gorgeous and a wonderful surprise and devoured.

records.title: Small problem encountered when ordering…
records.text: Small problem encountered when ordering online so had to phone. My address wasn't accepted online even though I'd ordered from you before. But resolved by placing phone order. Order arrived on time and well packaged. However the orange and chocolate fancies box was crushed slight but minimal impact on the cakes.

records.title: Unfortunately disappointing
records.text: Unfortunately disappointing.  Sticky toffee pudding supposed to be portions for 3-4 - not generous for 2! Similar with other products purchased. In defence - tasted delicious!   Panforte very disappointing- would have preferred a bar of fruit and nut. Sloe gin fruit cake - tasted great but didn’t cut well - plate full of crumbs.

records.title: Great box but gift message omitted
records.text: The gift  box itself was happily received and enjoyed. However, despite having completed a gift message when ordering, this wasn't executed and so the recipient had no idea who it was from. Only by chance, did they discover it was from us. Perhaps consider inserting a final check of the message before payment, to ensure this doesn't happen? It really soured our experience.

records.title: Unfortunate that Betty’s charge postage for gift vouchers when an e version would be more appropriate.
records.text: I think charging for the card and postage, irrelevant of the amount of the gift voucher does not leave a good feeling. A more economic way would be to offer what most organisations do - an emailed version to be printed by the purchaser. Although there is an e-gift voucher I am fairly certain it can’t be used in Cafe Tea Rooms.

records.title: I am only able to give 3 stars for this…Order never got delivered by Royal Mail
records.text: I am only able to give 3 stars for this review of the Betty’s box of 6 festive fondant fancies.Bettys have done an amazing job of sending the order out but unfortunately Royal Mail never delivered the order to a very dear friend who needed cheering up.I contact customer services who were so sorry and immediately refunded me. As of the date of this review the order has still never been delivered so where it is would be anyone’s guess.I would however highly recommend Bettys as they do amazing cakes .

records.title: Wrong gift message enclosed.
records.text: I sent a gift to a friend.  The gift note with message enclosed WAS NOT THE CORRECT ONE. Clearly, it had been carelessly muddled with someone else's. This was not the experience I expected from Betty's.   More careful attention is needed when packing.

records.title: I placed a large order for Christmas…
records.text: I placed a large order for Christmas and have to say I was disappointed. The sticky toffee pudding was nice but incredibly small and definitely not worth £12. Overall the quality was not there for the price paid and unfortunately will not be ordering again 😒

records.title: Delivery not as expected
records.text: Ordered two gift different t boxes to be delivered to me for Christmas gifts. Payed extra for them to br delivered on a Friday when I would be in to receive them. Both came in one package and was delivered on the Thursday when I was out. Nothing that thursday specific delivery would have been cheaper. Neither box was labelled so I had to open them (opening the seal) to see which was which.  Fed this back to customer services who fobbed me off. I was expecting better service. Hopefully the products are up to the standard I expect.

records.title: PURCHASING THE GOODS WAS NO PROBLEM BUT…
records.text: PURCHASING THE GOODS WAS NO PROBLEM BUT UNFORTUNATELY BETTY'S CHOICE OF DELIVERY AGENT (DPD UK) WAS A PROBLEM, AS THEY LOST THE GOODS.THE £450 WORTH OF CHRISTMAS GIFTS I HAD ORDERED NEVER ARRIVED FOR CHRISTMAS. BETTY'S SHOULD CHECK THAT DELIVERY AGENT HAD DELIVERED THEIR GOODS BY THE DUE  DELIVERY DATE.

records.title: I used your website in…
records.text: I used your website in November/December 2023 to purchase Christmas presents for family members. I was so impressed with the service I used you during the year for treats as I no longer live in Yorkshire. I had 3 orders to be delivered just before Christmas 2024 two were delivered with no problems at all. The one to my daughter left a lot to be desired. The delivery was due on Friday 20th December going to my daughter’s address in Cambridge. I let her know the day and approximate time (when ordering I had asked for 22nd Dec. Knowing that it was likely to be earlier than that.). On the Saturday my daughter who had waited in on the Friday, said that the delivery had not arrived and a card had not been put through the door. I checked the delivery email and the tracking details to find a photo. I did not recognise the wall in the photo, forwarded it to my daughter. She was on her way to meet with relatives in the south so asked a neighbour to kindly look for the parcel. It had been thrown over a side gate and the photo taken by holding the phone over the gate, it had been in the raining for over 12 hours by the time the parcel was recovered from the garden.The parcel was now very wet and water was seeping into wrapping. Fortunately that exterior wrapping of the individual boxes saved the day and the products were not damaged.I paid extra for the delivery to be close to Christmas and the delivery co. did not even knock the door, or respect the contents of the parcel. My daughter has a dog who would have let her know someone was around had they not bypassed the front door.

records.title: Not very on-line ordering savvy.
records.text: Not very on-line ordering savvy.However I got so far filling in the required sections.  They would not come together and give me an onward arrow.  I made a phone call and the lady I spoke to was cheery, friendly and helpful and LOCAL.Placed the order and it duly arrived well packed.

records.title: I love Bettys but why ?
records.text: I love Bettys but the Christmas stollen has got about 3 inches smaller which is perplexing and of course price increase

records.title: sadly we didnt get our order but once…
records.text: sadly we didnt get our order but once notified bettys were very quick to refund us as our order was received by someone else but not bettys fault but delivery company dpd bettys mince pies are lovely so hopefully next year well get them

records.title: I always love my Betty’s order at…

description:
Just Bee Vitamin Honey. Delicious Pure Honey Supercharged with Vitamins. 

Looking for a daily immune boost?

Our Vitamin Honey is supercharged with Vitamins D, C, B6, B12 and Echinacea.

Each teaspoon contains 25% of your recommended daily allowance of these vitamins which help support your immune system. And you'll love the mellow and sweet flavour.

Just Bee was inspired by co-founder Joe's family, who have a long history in beekeeping. Joe’s dad is a beekeeper in Lancashire and his grandad was a beekeeper before him in Ireland. Back in 2014, we started with a very simple idea – to create great tasting and healthy products using honey and to save the bees. This is still true today and now we work with beekeepers across the UK, Europe and New Zealand to source the highest quality honey. 

It’s really important that our products help save the bees. did you know one in every three mouthfuls of food we eat relies on plants being pollinated by bees? And over the past few years there has been a global decline in bee populations, including here in the UK.

Well, we’re determined to do something about it and we need your help!

All our honey orders come with a free packet of bee saving flower seeds.

records.title: I tried the Just Bee Sleeptime honey

But through online research I found that valerian has that 'side effect' on some. My concern is that Just Bee does not give any sort of caution of this possibility. If you are one of the lucky ones who is not affected in this way, Sleeptime could be helpful. But I also read that scientific advice is that you should not use valerian as a long-term treatment for chronic sleep disorder.

description:
At Milk & More, we are passionate about encouraging people to eat well and live sustainably. We do this by championing smaller suppliers who we trust to provide the very best products for us to deliver to your doorstep.

Our mission is to deliver a positive impact on local communities, the environment and ultimately you.

Deeply rooted as a British icon, we strive to continue both the milkman legacy and its expansion. We now conveniently deliver over 200 exceptional products  ordered via our website and app to doorsteps around the country before 7am.

Find out more about our wonderful suppliers, our dedicated farmers and our investment into their future, as well as how we are becoming even more environmentally friendly.
 VISIT OUR WEBSITE

records.text: Love, love, LOVE Milk and More!  Their prices are good and they provide an excellent service.  I can’t understand why everyone doesn’t have a Milk and More delivery…. They’re happy to help Absolutely behind them. 100% plus their products taste amazing.

records.title: Thank you Milk and More!! 🎉
records.text: Customer service experience is excellent as instant email communication means no delays in knowing exactly what's happening with my regular or newly placed orders. When opening the door if anything has not been delivered I have already had an email to say why not and payment refunded. I always get such good service but equally appreciate that nothing is perfect so accept that things are sometimes outside of your company's control. I love receiving my glass bottles of milk on a regular basis and recommend it to everyone. This year I especially loved receiving my Milk and More thermal hessian bag!! 😍Thanks so much to all your milkman and those behind the scenes making such a great effort to deliver us our milk. "Please keep going Milk and More!!" 👏👏👏 Happy 2025! 🎊🎊🎊

records.title: Very reliable service in my area
records.text: Very reliable service in my area, and the website is easy to use when I want to change my order.  Like the glass bottles, less plastic going in my recycling, I mainly buy milk but it’s convenient to add other items when needed.

records.title: So dependable, so valuable
records.text: So dependable - a no-fuss delivery of a vital item in our diet! I consider the price good value, after all, if I don't pay that bit extra now, our children and grandchildren will continue to pay the climate cost in increasing measure, won't they?

records.title: Always a great selection and great service…
records.text: Always a great selection and great service. Been a customer throughout, from Unigat, through Dairy Crest, and now Milk&More....better than ever.

records.title: Love using Milk & More
records.text: I love using Milk & More as they are reliable and I feel I am helping save the planet by using glass bottles instead of plastic. I gave you my code and that would have led you straight to my front door. I’ve given M&M four stars instead of five as the semi-skimmed milk goes off quite quickly. It’s impossible to read the use by date on the foil top and I throw milk away quicker than I would like. No problems with the oat milk. I am thinking if switching to cartons for the cows milk but wanted to check that they are recyclable

records.text: My milkman, Damien, is very reliable. It’s quite difficult to remove only one item from the order, however. It’s great to still have reusable glass bottles.

records.title: Always reliable and really good products.
records.text: Always reliable but not always in the right location; but I always find my milk in the end. I have clearly said where I want the milk to be left; and it is usually there but sometimes they either forget or they haven't read the instruction!I do like the choice of products Milk and More offer and I especially like it when they have special offers.

records.text: 9 times out of 10 things go well and everything is delivered as requested. Occasionally there are hiccups - particularly on the website but nothing too drastic.  It's a shame that we don't get to meet our delivery manbut he comes too early for us!

records.title: Always deliver when they say & advise…
records.text: Always deliver when they say & advise of Bank holidayschedules. Only once been disappointed, when they ran out of an offer before I received mine.

records.title: Milk delivery is good, questionable fruit and veg
records.text: Milk delivery is good. Always on time no problems. Milk definitely tastes better than what we’ve bought in supermarket previously. The major reason we did this was actually to move away from plastic and reduce shopping trips mid week. We tried the veg box delivery £16 for a few weeks over the autumn. Good mix of fruit and veg and always something to keep you guessing which is great. Unfortunately the quality of veg was getting questionable. Carrots soft and bendy. Cabbage with mould on it. Potatoes soft. Apples went out of date quickly. Bananas were bruised. Not really premium organic. We decided to cancel veg and move on.

records.title: I always get fresh milk delivered to my…
records.text: I always get fresh milk delivered to my doorstep. As others have said, it is more costly but I prefer to have my milk in recyclable glass bottles, it is much more environmentally friendly. It would have been a five star review but on 19.07.2024, I called customer service to report that a bottle top seal had been ripped by a glass splinter from another bottle. I threw the milk away as I couldn't tell if there were any more glass shards in the milk. Customer services issued me with a case number, to report this, I also added photographic evidence but sadly never heard back from Milk and More and did not receive a refund. Apart from that, I have no other issues.

records.text: I would really like to be able to leave a handwritten note for the milkman.  And sometimes in warm weather the milk goes off quite quickly even if I bring it in early. That's why I cancel my order for  the summer months.

records.text: Your website is really poor:1. Recently Monday milk order cancelled by you 2. Took for ever to get coffee milk added to regular order3. Pause ‘selection for holidays does not allow for more than 1 week a time 4. A contact number is difficult/not obvious on your website

records.title: We are regular customers of Milk and…
records.text: We are regular customers of Milk and More and have been for over 37 years, starting from their predecessors in the local diary, conveniently located up the road from our home.  We have found their deliveries reliable and they are flexible with account management online.The carry a wide range of commodities and we can vary them quite simply via our Customer Account on the website.  We are supportive of our local businesses and count Milk and More as one of them, despite them being a national company.  If we have an issue with a particular delivery, we can contact them via a web form and they will respond promptly with a solution.  They charge weekly and knowing the costs of our orders, means we can budget monthly for their costs, some of which might appear higher than a supermarket, but are repaid by regular, reliable deliveries, saving trips to a supermarket or a local store, where similar items will not have the fresh items in stock.  Overall we rate them, currently as four stars, verging on five, but discounted for a couple of recent hiccups, which have been sorted

records.title: Particularly good at online ordering…
records.text: Particularly good at online ordering /cancelling/refunding and generally keeping our account accurate.We have recently switched from bottles to cartons which have mostly been fine. However there have occasionally been issues with milk not keeping well and going sour before it's sell by date. Milk & More have been very quick to apologise and refund when necessary.

records.title: I love my milk and all things I have…
records.text: I love my milk and all things I have ordered from M&M and on the whole deliveries are usually very very good, only very occasionally do we have a slip up, customer service team could do with a little more attention to detail, and service with a sounding smiley face, 😀 just a little more effort would go a long way toMake it 5star, as said there’s always room for improvement whatever we are doing. 😘

records.title: A most valued service.
records.text: The delivery drivers are very reliable and efficient, and we have high respect for them working SO early every morning. Having the Milk & More home delivery service is a godsend, particularly for many 'senior' customers.  Sadly the only negative that we have experienced, is that if you ever have reason to send an online 'contact form', containing either an observation or complaint, Milk and More admin never have the courtesy to provide a reply/apology etc. and it's only for that reason that we have given a 4 star review.

records.title: Received no reply due to the two items…
records.text: Received no reply due to the two items of Yoghurts I received instead of 5 yogurts , needed 3 as their was three people living here and no bottle of orange juice with second order. I wish they would reply been a week, that's why three stars

records.title: First order came minus an item
records.text: First order came minus an item, no explanation. I emailed and was refunded 50p difference for a substitute which I NEVER received. Two further emails went unanswered. More expensive than supermarkets, but I wanted bovaer free so was willing to pay a bit more. This first experience is quite disappointing, so will be looking around for alternative “safe” suppliers.

records.title: Deliveries are too early - 1am ish
records.text: I am completing this for my partially sighted 91 year old mother. She can't use a computer so I have to manage this. No problem with the milk deliveries except they arrive around 1am so in the summer they often go off in a day, which is very difficult for her to deal with.

records.title: No delivery Christmas Eve and no…
records.text: No delivery Christmas Eve and no explanation although we were refunded.  We had to buy milk from a shop. Usually good service though.

records.title: Reliable service and my milkman is…
records.text: Reliable service and my milkman is great. However, there has been a problem in recent months with the life of your bottled milk: It's either off as soon as it's opened or lasts only a day in the fridge, despite having a use by date of several more days. This problem has been ongoing since the summer and it really needs resolving.      On a positive note I've switched to your milk in cardboard cartons, which is not only cheaper but stays nice and fresh like your bottled milk used to do.

records.title: Milk delivery is good
records.text: Milk delivery is good, but anytime we order from the food items from the website, they are not available.

records.title: The milkman is really good
records.text: The milkman is really good, but I am very unhappy about the milk. Non-homogenised milk is a healthier option than homogenised but you now no longer supply it. My daughters in London still have non-homogenised from Milk and More. Why can’t I?

records.title: The regular delivery is excellent but…
records.text: The regular delivery is excellent but several things are not as good as the could be.Frequent shortage of items, be it crumpets, eggs, bananas in particular.  The crumpets are surprising as you added these to the menu about a month ago but only once have they been delivered.It's also annoying that you see fit to bill for items that are not in stock; and it takes a few days before refund.  Please bill only when you know what you are able to deliver.Bananas have often been green and under-ripe.  Better more recently.

records.title: Good products and range, poor service
records.text: Good products and range, convenient, but after several years of using them I’ve now stopped due to poor customer service. An order was delivered incomplete and for the first time, no refund was issued. I accept mistakes happen, I would not have stopped using them over one mistake, but on requesting a refund I was first treated with suspicion then when I shared proof I was ignored. I persevered and ultimately got the refund I was due, but won't be returning based on the poor service.

records.title: Why don't they tell you when they can't complete a delivery?
records.text: Items are generally delivered as planned, but every now and again, I find there's no milk on my doorstep, check everywhere, the website says my order has been completed.So I contact customer services who then apologise and say there was a problem with the delivery and it couldn't be completed. That's fine, but why is it marked as completed then? Why can't you be honest and mark the delivery as incomplete and issue a refund automatically?Why do I have to faff about complaining and asking for a refund?  Are you just chancing it that customers can't be bothered to complain and will just accept the loss and you get to keep the money?

records.title: Shelf life an issue…
records.text: We have been customers for a couple of years and value the fact that we are able to cut back on plastic waste. However in the past few weeks we are finding the milk to have little or no 'shelf life'. This is both semi skim and full fat. We have raised this with the company and been refunded and left a note for our milkman. Still a bit hit-and-miss. Something needs to be done about stock control/refrigeration as we don't want to cancel our regular order.

records.title: Not as fresh as it used to be
records.text: Generally I've been really happy with this company for many years. But recently we've noticed the milk has gone off quickly. I don't know if it's being sourced or stored differently?But we've had to pour some down the sink about once every other week. This is inconvenient and expensive. Please go back to delivery of fresh milk with a good storage life

records.title: Hard to amend order…
records.text: I can only get six pints a week as not milk is delivered about 12:30 am and only three times a week . I only have a two pint caddy and foxes get any additional bottles. I tried to amend my order today to less full cream and more semi skimmed as my son is away. I couldn’t change full cream to semi do in the end I just cancelled . Not good business. Want to keep having milk delivered but ..,

records.title: Quality of milk not acceptable.
records.text: I rarely complain on line because its effect can be so  disproportionally destructive, but I am on the site today to see if any one else is complaining about the quality of  the milk being delivered in recent weeks. Unsurprisingly, I find the experiences that I would have reported already up there. I am throwing out all three bottles of milk delivered on Wednesday and did the same last week. I can't even use it in cooking because it separates to become water and a sticky deposit that coats the pan (and which is very  hard to remove.) Moreover, even with a magnifying  glass I can't decipher the dates on the bottle tops. The delivery service is great, the glass bottles are great but I will be closing my 20+ year account if the quality of the milk doesn't improve.

records.title: Not customer focused
records.text: Whilst on the whole Milk & More is good.  I had an issue where I was left half a litre instead of a litre of milk.  I asked for the relevant refund via customer services.  Got a code sent through so it had registered and I never heard from them about it nor received a refund.  Completely unacceptable customer service.  Dont ask for reviews when you don’t deliver!  You are lucky that generally you service is acceptable else it would have been lower!

records.title: Occasionally at weekends the order is…
records.text: Occasionally at weekends the order is incorrect. Last weekend my skimmed milk was not organic which I pay extra for. This has happened a few times but I get fed up of complaining.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: I ordered a signed book as a Christmas gift for my brother in law. Milk and More did not deliver it and I have sent two emails without a response. The call handler I spoke to said he would ensure it would be delivered two days after the due date but I never heard a word. On top of that I ordered 2 Christmas deliveries which failed to arrive. The same happened last Christmas. If it wasn’t for the fact that my milkman is excellent and would stop using this company, awful customer service.

records.title: Gentleman came to my door asking me to…
records.text: Gentleman came to my door asking me to join milk n more. I had consedred this previously anyway as it is delivered and my work shifts sometimes make it difficult to get to shops in time. I have had six deliverys now on A weekly pre order so the company know what I want every time and same day. Out of the six weeks only twice have they left me the full order. I'm not sure if the delivery driver dos'nt read the order properly sometimes or they just don't have the stock. The way I see it is as a pre agreed weekly order that is the same every time that they should make sure the stock is available except on extreme curcumstances. I have persavired and given them benefit of doubt but if it happens next week I will be canceling my account. It is pointless if I have to go to the shop anyway to buy what they don't deliver. Also bombarded with e mails to buy extra items for christmas. As if I would take a chance on that if they can't deliver A normal pre ordered weekly shop. Uxbridge area

records.title: M&M used to be very reliable (Brasted
records.text: M&M used to be very reliable (Brasted, Kent) but since driver changes in our area, the service has been really poor, very hit & miss & we don't know if milk will be there in the morning . It's become so bad that we feel it's just not the same anymore & now thinking of leaving M&M altogether & going back to buying our own milk

records.title: First time ordering we ordered apple…
records.text: First time ordering we ordered apple juice, orange juice, milk, mince pies, milk shakes and milk for santa for the kids.  We didn't receive no mince pies and milk for santa on delivery. Phoned up at 7:00 am only to be told they're out of stock. Why take orders that can't be full filled and no communication to let us know.Won't  be using them again.

records.title: Willing Milk & More to be better
records.text: There are some aspects that really spoil Milk & More for me:- the communication is awful. If anything goes wrong (e.g. require a refund) you either don’t get a reply or you get an unsatisfactory one.- the milkman appears passive aggressive. He will sometimes refuse to take bottles (e.g. if he feels there are too many, or if he doesn’t think they are part of the return & refill scheme). I have left online notes, paper notes, contacted the office when he would continuously replace an out of stock product with something not like for like…and then be left with a product we don’t want and be charged for it….repeatedly.- Milk & More used to have green credentials and a unique selling point; reusable bottles, organic products, and refillable pantry items.  Many of those items have now gone, to be replaced with common, overpriced items you can get cheaper in the supermarket.

records.title: Milk is just not as good now
records.text: We've been customers for years, but in the last year or so the quality has dropped dramatically. The milk goes off far too quickly. This morning we opened a bottle from Monday (48 hours old) and it was already sour. We've given up and cancelled our orders, but will come back if the quality is returned.

records.title: I really value my milkman but…
records.text: I really value my milkman.  However the change in the range of products this year is for the worse not better.  I wouldn’t buy those brands in the supermarket so wouldn’t by them from Milk &More either

records.title: Not convinced about M&M
records.text: Not been with M&M for long. The milk is so far ok, sick of the free oat milk with every delivery! No wonder it's free as it comes off. You can clearly see the milk separated. Half milk how water. The premium organic fruit box for £15?? You are having a laugh. 3 nananas (3 only) brown and mouldy. 2 easy peelers are so dry I can hang as a christmas Dec's, 6 pears and 2 apples (half rotten). The only thing that looks decent is the mango but didn't cut into it. Honestly the worst fruit box I've ever seen. Premium quality?? Yea right. Also milkman comes after midnight, noisy as hell, starts reorganising his van outside houses. Obviously not aware of the time and the noise he makes!!!Would expect more

records.title: Milk has no shelf life
records.text: We have been a loyal customer for a good 10 yrs plus but now really fed-up with sour tasting milk ,it started in summer with solid lumps in the top of bottle. this has now settled to ruined tea by sour off tasting milk.considering the cost we are thinking of cancelling our orders

records.title: Well here we go again !
records.text: Well here we go again !! I should have had 4 extra bottles of milk this morning only to find yet again they haven’t been delivered!!! You took the money out my account either send me the goods or refund me !! Very poor service !!! Now it’s a trip to the supermarket AGAIN !!!!!

description:
Tradewinds Oriental Shop is a family run business specialising in providing the finest food and drinks, furniture, and kitchenware from Asia. Established in 1984, we first commenced trading at our local market in Scunthorpe selling a small selection of basic Chinese cooking ingredients and a variety of Oriental Arts and Crafts.

After 2 years there was sufficient demand to open a small shop on Mary Street, Scunthorpe. Demand soon dictated a move to larger premises and in 1991 we moved to our current premises on Cole Street, Scunthorpe.

Tradewinds Oriental Shop has continued to grow and in 2008 we launched our online website offering consumers within the UK and Europe the opportunity to purchase our products at the click of a button.

Demand for Asian food and drink has continued to grow in popularity over the years which have led to the expansion of our current shop and warehouse premises in recent years. We now stock over 5000 products from across Asia. Our inventory will continue to grow with new lines becoming available both online and in our shop on a weekly basis. 

We remain passionate and great effort goes into sourcing and finding the best authentic ingredients and providing these to all our customers within the UK and around the World.

records.text: Delivery very late . It took 1 wk to come.

records.title: First time ordering and missed the…
records.text: First time ordering and missed the delivery from Fedex as the delivery notification cane through after they tried to deliver!Today I have sent a third Email to the supplier after many attempts to contact yhe courier. Still no reply from either?

records.title: Defective item, can't exchange
records.text: Bought an item here that I realised after purchase was defective. It was a wok and I was specifically told that those can't be exchanged. It was a flat bottom wok, specifically for used with flat stove tops like electric ones, but it wouldn't sit flat because of the weight of the handle so most of the flat bottom didn't even contact the hob.Despite the no exchange policy I decided to take the item back and see whether they would be able to do anything for me about the clearly defective item. I even offered to do a £20 shop there if they will exchange the item for me. (the wok cost only £10, but it's a matter of principle.)Staff member who I spoke with wouldn't budge though and even tried to tell me that the wok is supposed to be used on a burner hob. I've done enough research to know that the only reason for the flat bottom woks to be produced is for hobs like the electric one. I'm not sure if they weren't aware of this because they never had the need to use a flat bottom wok or if they were just lying to me to make me think I'm in the wrong and that's the reason they can't help me.

description:
Award-winning frozen meals and puddings, hand-prepared by our chefs. Named ‘Best overall meal delivery service 2022’ by BBC Good Food. Or discover your local COOK shop!


About COOK
 
COOK was founded in 1997 by Ed and Dale, two big-hearted entrepreneurs. Their founding statement was: to COOK using the same ingredients and techniques a good cook would use at home, so everything looks and tastes homemade. Much has changed since then but that principle remains: we COOK so you don’t have to.  

  
COOK meals and puddings have picked up scores of Great Taste Awards and are still prepared by hand in our three kitchens. You can find COOK shops on 95 high streets nationwide and our meals are stocked in 900+ independent retailers.

 
Over the years, we’ve set out to become a better kind of company. One that cares as much about doing what’s right for people and planet as about making a profit. It’s why we run carbon neutral kitchens and support people into work after prison, homelessness or mental health challenges through our RAW Talent scheme. In 2013 we became one of the UK’s first B Corps, independently certified as using our business as a force for good.


How to find COOK
 
- Nationwide Home Delivery
 
- Free Click & Collect
 
- 95 COOK shops nationwide
 
- Stocked in 900+ independent retailers across the UK

records.title: Delivery first class .
records.text: Delivery first class .The actual recipes and food are outstanding .This is the first Christmas I have ever let someone els do the cooking .Fantastic turkey and a lovely Christmas cake .We are having tonight for supper the chicken and leek pie and it looks amazing without being cooked yet .Mince pies lovely .Every thing I ordered have been beautifully made .The next family gathering I shall certainly go on line or even visit Cook shop in Salisbury .Happy New Year .Jacqueline.

records.title: Excellent quality & reliable delivery
records.text: I had tried a couple of dishes from Cook in the past, bought fm my local co-op but had never ordered on-line for home delivery b4.I was expecting a vegan for Xmas day & wanted to get her something tasty & easy...I was v impressed with the selection of dishes. l placed a Xmas order which arrived on time, well packaged & with simple instructions.My order included a Butternut squash Galette which was incredibly tasty, one of the best vegan mains I have ever tasted, I still have some items in the freezer to try & if they are as good I will be super impressed but based on the galette alone I will re-order.Thank you

records.title: A delicious shepherd’s pie
records.text: A delicious shepherd’s pie, with equally good creamed spinach, washed down with champagne (not from Cook!) and followed by lemon tarts with vanilla ice cream … cue some very satisfied lunch guests!

records.title: Great service, quality and value for money
records.text: Great communication and updates. Charming delivery person.  Timely reminders about treatment of product and, fantastic tasty food which was great value for money. A stressless Christmas dinner, what is not to like.  Oh yeah, the company has a great ethos too.

records.title: Hassle free Christmas
records.text: The food was tasty delivery and communication was very good. I've used cook three times at Christmas and will use again. I wasn't keen on the mince pie pastry but that doesn't deserve losing a star.

records.title: These meals are so easy to obtain and prepare.
records.text: I have been very impressed with your products and the customer service I have received.  I have been using the products increasingly over the past few months and have every intention of continuing to do so. This may have something to do with my age (am in my ninties) and not able to get about quite so easily now, by using Cook's products I can continue to care for myself and still have the quality I am used to.I have always cooked for myself and this is the next best thing without all the effort required

records.title: Best shop bought ready meal I've ever…
records.text: Best shop bought ready meal I've ever eaten, I decided on the confit duck for my Christmas dinner and it was absolutely amazing, I also had there sticky toffee pudding for dessert which was also wonderful.Will definitely be trying more of there puducts in the future 👍

records.title: FABULOUS describes the wonderful meal…
records.text: FABULOUS describes the wonderful meal we cooked and ate today. No stress, easy instructions, wonderful flavours, variety of colours and textures.I trained as a Domestic Science Teacher in the 1970’s so am more than capable of providing good wholesome meals. It was such a delight for your company to give me a break, well done to all who contributed. I shall certainly look up where to buy your products, M&S will be put on the back burner l think !Kind RegardsCatherine Harrison (Malton)

records.title: Highly recommended!
records.text: I have been using COOK for many years. The food is always excellent -tasty and always of a high standard. Deliveries are totally reliable which is important if you are catering for a large party . I have no hesitation in recommending COOK

records.title: Keep some Cook foods in your freezer…
records.text: Keep some Cook foods in your freezer for unexpected guests, nights when you are too busy or too tired.  Always tastes good, big variety and easily purchased.  Friendly helpful staff, such as help.

records.title: Christmas dinner
records.text: For the 3rd year running an incredible Christmas dinner bundle from cook, made even better by the company’s ethos in RAW talent project. The turkey and every side was delicious and there was far more than needed to serve our 8 guests; and the step by step timing Itinerary for dinner prep was a give benefit!  My only recommendation for improvement is that the parsnips were woody and cut too thickly. Otherwise, fantastic !! I plan to do it again next year!

records.title: It would have been 5 stars.
records.text: It would have been 5 stars if the Turkey gravy had not been missed out of our Christmas lunch.  However the  assistants were very apologetic next time I went into the shop and refunded the cost.

records.title: Christmas lunch for two in a box was…
records.text: Christmas lunch for two in a box was great! The portions were generous, the turkey tender, roast potatoes and gravy all excellent. The instructions were user friendly, accurate - so helpful. The only minus was the carrots - while the parsnips were cooked to perfection, the carrots remained hard. Cut into smaller pieces for next time? Small problem for a delicious meal! Thank you! Coming back next year.

records.title: Lovely food and easy to cook.
records.text: Ordering, collection and cooking were easy. The food was excellent and delicious. The only thing was that in the parsnip tray we just had one huge hunk of parsnip and one tiny one!!  This wouldn’t make any difference to my ordering again in the future it was just unfortunate. Excellent food.

records.title: Roast potato fails…
records.text: This was our third year of Christmas dinner from Cook. We were disappointed in the roast potatoes,  they were mash in potato shapes not real roasties.  The rest of the dinner was delicious and the instructions were easy to follow and TWells staff were very helpful.

records.title: A cheerful greeting
records.text: A cheerful greeting, food delivered promptly within the time slot, very tasty main course and dessert. The starter-filo parcels- was also nice, but with 3 of them, the plum sauce leaked out and burnt tightly to the baking tray, so was lost. It may have been my fault, not checking them in time, but I did note the timings and it was a pity not to enjoy that flavour as well as the others.

records.title: Easy to order but undecided whether easier over all
records.text: Amazing service to order a whole Christmas lunch to the door! The Turkey, stuffing, sausages, pie were fabulpus but we were very underwhelmed by the roast potatoes & veggies which were not good despite us following the cooking instructions to the letter! The parsnips were chewy, the potatoes wouldn’t crisp up & carots & sprouts v average. Undecided whetherit was easier & tastier than doing the whole thing from scratch as it still involved a lot of juggling. It might’ve been easier if a few things were microwavable, including the carrots?

records.title: Always order xmas dinner from cook
records.text: Always order xmas dinner from cook, as always excellent but sad not to have choice of chicken crown we've had last two years, only turkey crown available this year and it wasn't as nice, please being back chicken for 2025! Otherwise all wonderful as usual, thank you

records.title: Close but no cigar
records.text: I no longer do home deliveries after the courier fiasco a few years ago (which the team at Cook's handled superbly).   I now order and collect from my local (25 miles away) store in Glasgow. Usual high quality unfortunately upon getting home and opening up the pre packed parcel I have been provided with a slightly incorrect order as the two chicken dishes provided are portions for one person and not a two person portion as was ordered.  A trip to M&S recquired to bulk up the meal.

records.title: love the variety and convenience
records.text: love the variety and convenience, and the food is great, but worth always checking the cooking times - my 1025g boned turkey leg said 2 1/2 hours cooking time - totally wrong, over double what it should be - boned poultry - 20mins per 500g plus 20mins = 60mins!

records.title: Late delivery
records.text: Food is great as always but waited in all afternoon for a delivery that never arrived.A telephone call would have been appreciated.I'd even left a voicemessage on their answer machine and no one had even contacted me the next morning. I had to call THEM again to ask if my delivery would be turning up.

records.title: Service at Loughton was great
records.text: Service at Loughton was great. Friendly team that gave lots of advice. Enjoyed the stuffed turkey thighs, sausage rolls, sprouts and potato dauphinois. The roasties weren’t great though. And the Thai fish cake and lemongrass chicken canapés were a bit too salty.

records.title: Easy Christms catering…
records.text: Ordering and delivery were great and the turkey dinner was very tasty and easy to cook. My only criticism is that there was more stuffing than turkey.The puddings were delicious.

records.title: Delicious food and well priced
records.text: We were very pleased with everything we ordered but would recommend improving the containers (not reusable) and packaging. For example the rhubarb desert package was inadequate and leaked and we couldn’t present it attractively once cooked.

records.title: Can’t fault the service or quality of…
records.text: Can’t fault the service or quality of food. My only reason for giving a 4 instead of 5 is the quantity of sugar in the food. There are no organic options either.

records.title: Missing items of the Xmas dinner order
records.text: I ordered our family’s Christmas meal at the end of November however, on collection day (the 23rd of Dec), some of the dishes were not available. Whilst Cook did substitute the missing items, it left me with too many potatoes and still having to rush around supermarkets at the last minute. Exactly what I’d hoped to avoid this year. Other than the frustration of an incomplete order, the meal was lively and the food was all of very good quality.

records.title: Not bad but not the best.
records.text: Vegetables with my Christmas dinner, apart from the roast potatoes, were disappointing. In future I will make the effort to cook fresh vegs. The Turkey crown had too much stuffing both in and on top of it and the amount of bacon on it was for me a little excessive.

records.title: Christmas dinner 2024
records.text: I was disappointed this year compared with last year.  I’ve always followed your instructions but found the roast potatoes hard and didn’t crisp up at all.  The carrots and parsnips were too small this year.  They burnt around the edges. Otherwise it was tasty just not perfect.

records.title: Disappointing Christmas mesl
records.text: We had the Christmas meal for 12 snd sadly I was rather disappointed in it. The meat was very good, but the vegetables were very disappointing -particularly the sprouts/leeks combination. I wish I had done my  own vegetable dishes.  I am a great fan of Cook meals but I am afraid I will not be ordering the Christmas meal again.

records.title: Great Christmas food
records.text: Great Christmas food, but was called the day before delivery as some items had not been sent from the "warehouse". Local store most apologetic, but could have been a disaster had I not had alternatives in place.

records.title: The beef wellington we had fot…
records.text: The beef wellington we had for Christmas lunch was disappointing. Some of the meat was very chewy with sinew.  We have had beef wellington for several years from you and it has been brilliant but very disappointed with the one we had this year.

records.title: Stuffed turkey very disappointing
records.text: Stuffed turkey very disappointing.  Had a lot of pepper and far too much herbs in the stuffing.  I had served it for annual Christmas family meal so was very disappointed.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Disappointed with late delivery time.  Delivered at 9.45pm at night. No update to say going to be late.  Turkey, pigs in blankets, stuffing & gravy all excellent. Had meal for 12.  Impossible to cook potatoes in single layer as so many. Never crisped up.  Same with other vegetables.  Needed an industrial oven. Carrots and parsnips never softened to be edible. Would buy Turkey again. But not complete meal package.

records.title: Flavour good oven temperatures/time v poor. …
records.text: The quality and flavour of all products is good. However having recently bought both your party food and your Christmas lunch for four I am very disappointed with the preparation and cooking times. The variety of oven temperatures and cooking times clearly need several oven appliances to be available. Not every household has these.

records.title: Christmas dinner
records.text: Ordering in shop wa s easy pleasant staff.delivery on time helpful driver.Instructions for prep and cooking clear.Overall  Christmas lunch for ,2 good value however we had the impression there was  less turkey and more stuffing in Turkey breast than previous years. First time of using Christmas pudding  .tasty but a little dry.

records.title: Christmas Dinner for 2
records.text: Christmas Dinner for 2There was enough pigs in blankets, veg and gravy to have 2 meals (4 portions) but the turkey breast was tiny. So small, I didn't think there was enough for 2 people and ended up buying a turkey crown elsewhere, which was a bit of a nuisance. Luckily I had time to do this as it was delivered on the 22nd. The veg was good and the roast potatoes were excellent but I was really disappointed with the turkey so can only give 3 stars. I regularly use Cook and portion sizes are normally spot on so was a bit surprised with this.

records.title: The turkey
records.text: The turkey, roast potatoes,bread  sauce and gravy we found very good indeed but unfortunately we felt the vegetables let it down, I think next time would just order turkey bread sauce and gravy but definitely not order vegetables

records.title: Christmas  Meal
records.text: Hi. The meal was very nice especially the prepared veg and gravy but the Turkey was disappointing. We will mix and match next Xmas and get a fresh turkey somewhere else.  Portion size was very good.

records.title: We had the vegetarian Xmas dinner last…
records.text: We had the vegetarian Xmas dinner last year and it was superb, so ordered it again this year.Sadly this year we were disappointed with the carrots and parsnips. When cooked exactly to the guidelines the carrots were spongy and the parsnips undercooked. It was almost like they had partially thawed out at some stage and been refrozen.

records.title: We bought the Xmas meal for 2 on the…
records.text: We bought the Xmas meal for 2 on the recommendation of a friend and also having had Cook food previously and enjoyed it. However, we were somewhat underwhelmed by our Xmas meal. We followed the instructions religiously but found the carrots and parsnips to still be on the wrong side of firm and looking as if they'd been boiled and not roasted. After leaving in the oven for a further 10-15 minutes they were still too hard and had to be finished off in the microwave to make them edible. Additionally, I appreciate that the ad and the list of contents on box states the use of thyme, but both my partner & I felt it far too strong and overpowered the whole meal. Overall, a rather disappointing Xmas lunch. Turkey, sausages & roasties were fine.

records.title: My first time ordering Cook for…
records.text: My first time ordering Cook for Christmas. I decided to get Click and Collect. Had phone call in morning to notify me that two items were out of stock, parsnip side dish and stuffing. I collected the food but when I was putting it in freezer realised more items, sprouts/leek side dish, missing so had to phone store.  No timings for cooking food in bag with food either. I asked when I collected the food for timing info but was told they would be in bag.The store gave us a free pudding and found the missing sprouts/leeks and cooking time instructions, which husband had to go into town and collect, but the whole point of using Cook was to make it a stress free experience and it wasn’t.

records.title: Glad I didn't have guests to dinner....
records.text: We ordered Cook's stuffed turkey thigh, which we have had more than once before. This time, it was a grave disappointment. The stuffing was leaking out of the thigh even before it was thawed, there was a lot of shrinkage during cooking and the turkey itself was both tough and tasteless. I certainly will not buy this again.

records.title: Our COD Mornay dish which we had as our…
records.text: Our COD Mornay dish which we had as our main meal on Christmas Day was most disappointing. The sauce was tasteless and we couldn’t taste the mustard gratin for anything. We will not be returning to this shop to buy further meals again.

records.title: Normally love COOK, but not the Christmas dinner
records.text: So I normally absolutely love COOK meals. We’ve had lots of them for dinner with my infant son, but I didn’t like the Christmas dinner at all. It was an experiment for us, that I don’t think I’ll repeat, however they are usually brilliant and their other food is delicious. The sprouts were strange, as was the turkey and the sausage meat, and the gravy was average. It was also a little bit too complicated for the purpose we bought it for - which was to eat some nice turkey on Xmas day having had no sleep. But to emphasise again, their other food is completely delicious.

records.title: Some of my food order was missing
records.text: Some of my food order was missing. Very disappointed.  Contacted customer services and got no response and it has been almost a week.Update - same excuses, different companies...  Ignoring emails and website messages until you give up and post on a public forum. Forwarded on my previous correspondence to them. Will update IF they acknowledge my existence and respond.

records.title: We had the salmon asparagus gratin
records.text: We had the salmon asparagus gratin. We’ve had this several times before and always enjoyed it. I’ve not bought it for over a year and this time it was not nice. It was tasteless and the asparagus was so woody it was inedible. Hoping it’s a one off batch.

records.title: Late notice !
records.text: Normally excellent, but left it until Christmas Eve to tell us we would not be getting parsnips !!

records.title: I was disappointed this Christmas I…
records.text: I was disappointed this Christmas I didn’t feel the food had the taste I have had previously sorry but dissatisfied this Christmas Denise  Biggs

records.text: Cooking times from frozen do not work. I had to increase the times significantly to avoid food which was hardly cooked through. The Teriyaki Salmon Noodles contained rock hard vegetables and there was so little Teriyaki it was lucky I bought a jar of it from M&S to top the meal up. Over-rated.We also had the ThaiSteamed Sea Bass. Shrivelled up fish with no flavour and very 'aldente-d' vegetables in an insipid watery curry.

records.title: Poor quality
records.text: We have bought a Pad Thai which was awful rice was very dry and not tasteless. Also bought Lamb Moussaka which also tasteless. My wife and I very disappointed and not venture any where near a Cook Shop ever again.
