records.title: Product just as described and good…
records.text: Product just as described and good quality, great communication and prompt delivery. Can’t ask for more than that!

records.title: Damaged order
records.text: Part of my order got damaged in transit. I emailed the customer service and they quickly got it sorted and sent me out my original order. In the process the damaged order got delivered and they quickly made arrangements to have it picked up.

records.title: I was looking for fondant/sugar paste…
records.text: I was looking for fondant/sugar paste for a nut allergy grandchild.Not used yet but looking forward to having a go.

records.title: Quick delivery
records.text: Quick delivery. I was notified after receiving the package that one item wasn't actually in stock, but was refunded the money for it promptly.

records.title: Bought 'ghosts' and dinosaurs for…
records.text: Bought 'ghosts' and dinosaurs for grandsons cake. Only 6 of each but one of ghosts was damaged. Had moved in its box and must have been squashed during postage. Shame because all others were brilliant. Perhaps fix more securely?

records.title: Always a great source for baking items
records.text: Always a great source for baking itemsI order from cake decorating co regularly for everything between cutters and moulds to boxes and ingredients. The only thing that puts me off lately is that the shipping has gone up quite a large bit, making it less likely to justify smaller purchases

records.title: A very good hazelnut extract
records.text: I am very happy with the hazelnut extract that I bought. Giving it four stars as I have not tried others for the purpose I am using it for, so feel like there is the potential for better products to be available. The postage was also very steep at around £8. I feel like that is unnecessary for posting a small, plastic bottle that could easily fit through a letterbox. Not sure there is a need to use DHL when posting to N. Ireland. Approximately £3 with Royal Mail would have sufficed.

records.title: Products and service are always great…
records.text: Products and service are always great from The Cake Decorating Co.  but delivery by Hermes is always terrible, this time a damaged, ripped box I could actually hear the driver throwing boxes around in the back of the truck to hunt for my order, thankfully my cakes boards weren’t damaged.

records.title: It was ok
records.text: Items received as ordered. Good priced products but various items that I wanted out of stock

records.title: Arrived really quickly
records.text: Arrived really quickly and packaged well. Bought 4 tubs of frosting, all great for piping and decorating my sons birthday cake. Only knocked one star off due to need to stir/whisk before at a piping consistency (I’m a novice so not sure if this normal) and the red colouring staining my fingers for a few days. But looked and tasted great!

records.title: Just the job!
records.text: The quality of the print was impressive, with plenty of contrast. The A4 size lookedreally good on a plain Costco party cake.The delivery was very fast.There are just 3 issues that stopped a 5* review.Your picture has to be sent by a seperate email, instead of uploading along with the order.The delivery of our A4 print was inside a relatively massive box which was left on the doorstep without ringing the doorbell (this seems to happen with the delivery company used).Also, there could have been a 'do and don't' sheet with the print (they absorb moisture from the cake and can wrinkle if left etc)

records.title: Love the sparkle dusts!!
records.text: Delivery was fast, and everything well packaged.The sparkle dusts were amazing, easy to use and coloured the fondant perfectly, but, the Jelly Diamonds were hard to get out of the packaging and dulled when touched and were extremely sticky so won't be using those again!

records.title: Good products overall
records.text: Easy website to navigate. Products arrived well packaged and on time.Corrugated boxes excellent quality.Cardboard boxes with clear windows less successful. Boxes difficult to construct and some sections misaligned. Lids fitted well once box constructed.I’d still recommend despite this minor fault.

records.title: Not so good this time

Black Friday sales could have added to the delay but if you can’t cope with the qty of orders then don’t have a sale.

records.title: I was very pleased with the items I…

description:
McQueens are Bringing it home every time, with our doorstep delivery of milk, eggs, juice, all arriving fresh from our dairy before 7AM.

We provide easy sign-up milk delivery service, alongside a range of complimentary products including non-dairy milk alternatives and cream. Milk is available in reusable, recyclable glass bottles and non-dairy alternatives including oat, soya, coconut, and lactose-free milks are also available.

Founded in 1995, McQueens Dairies are a third-generation family business with over 25 years of delivering the freshest dairy to your door. All the milk from McQueens own dairy is delivered by local drivers, serving and supporting local communities all across the UK, serving over a quarter of a million households!

 Get your milk delivered 🥛

Socials/Key links 🤳🏻

records.title: Great milk, great deliveries, great customer service, could improve online system
records.text: We subscribed by getting a door to door seller and surprisingly they fixed a problem we were having which is having to buy milk regularly and running out. We didn’t realise how convenient a regular  delivery would be until now. I thought I would just trial and cancel if it didn’t work but it works. We don’t use dairy ourselves but our son the toddler is a dairy monster. We love the milk and it’s always been on time (subscribed since July 24) and never had an issue with McQueen dairies.The reason I am writing a review now is due to the Christmas season being a little confused about the planning of delivery of milk. It wasn’t very clear we wouldn’t get our delivery on the Friday after Boxing Day and I had to contact customer services. So a couple of points as to why I am giving 4 stars.- From day 1 I had issues registering my profile via the text I got and gave up after multiple days trying. Today I had an issue and wanted to log-in and kept trying and after failing quite a bit again I finally succeeded- When customer services were supposed to be open the message said hold on to speak to customer services it hung up automatically, which happened three times. I then waited longer and finally got through to someone quite quickly. I think communications and possibly the system used could use some improvements but overall it’s a good company which delivers on time and good quality. They are a Scottish company and customer services are Scottish too, which to me means quality. At last I am finally logged on and I now know how to make amends for future holidays etc.

records.title: Good items, cowboy company
records.text: I first, like probably most heard about this company within a freebies site. Was not aware at the time it was a “family” owned company. There was £13 to be able to have free for a delivery. Sweet, won’t turn down a freebie. On proceeds my delivery date, different areas have different dates and I had an email saying that the order was cancelled due to voucher code misuse. Fair enough I said to myself. Anyway, that afternoon (Remember, I live im a block of flats) I had a phone call from a STRONG and I mean strong, Scottish accent with a gentlemen on the phone asking me if I’d received the delivery and if I wanted to continue. Shocked, I said no and was told if I wanted to cancel, I would have to ring back up. Went outside where I’d picked a spot for safe delivery and to my surprise, my order has arrived. Ok? Cancelled that moment and wouldn’t have heard anymore. Fast forward to today, 2nd January and the company are asking for payment of £10.54… after reading previous reviews and seeing boycott groups on social media I realised my order was probably a big mistake. May this be a warning that, if things seem too good to be true, they usually are. I’m giving two stars because, well the items were actually pretty good but I would avoid. note to McQueens: no other delivery has been made and there will be no payment made to you for the “supposedly” £10.54 that is overdue. Thank you.

description:
The Chuckling Cheese Company | Great British Artisan Cheese
A family-run artisan cheese company based in Skegness, Lincolnshire UK - The business was started in 2012 by husband & wife, Stuart & Emma Colclough. It was later incorporated as The Chuckling Cheese Company Ltd in 2015
The husband and wife duo, Emma and Stuart Colclough set out on their cheesy adventure hosting market stalls at local events around the United Kingdom. During this time is when the cheese team began to grow and soon become notorious for Flavoured Cheddar and our widely developed range of unique flavoured cheese. Offering over 40 different flavours.

We’re not just a cheese company, we also have a wide range selection of chilli jams, craft beers, vodkas, coffee syrups, fudge bars, sweet meringues, and lots more. In 2016 we opened our first Chuckling Cheese Shop in the Skegness Hildred's Centre, then in the next two years, we opened two other stores. One in Doncaster Frenchgate Shopping Centre and another in Middlesbrough Hill Street Shopping Centre. In 2020, we grew the company further by opening two more shops, in Merry Hill Shopping Centre in Brierley Hill near Birmingham and one in Metrocentre in Gateshead near Newcastle. At our shops, you will find an extensive product offering, such as baked goods, cheese sampling, and a freshly baked cheese toastie. 
Visit a shop near you and meet our company mascot, Munchie Mouse.

To this date, we still remain a family-run business that has a wide range of quality products to offer our day-to-day customers as well as Trade and Wholesale Customers, alongside offering a range of  Corporate Gifting options. 
Visit our website!

records.title: Poor communication and customer service
records.text: My order took a week to be despatched, and was sent to the wrong postcode. I rang and spoke to someone who was very helpful and advised that they would send a replacement order and it will be prioritised for Christmas delivery. Unfortunately, that is where the helpful customer service ended. I had no notification of the order being despatched. I tried ringing over four days, ringing multiple times (approximately 30times!) I left voicemails and couldn’t get through to anyone. I also emailed and all I had was a blunt, rude and vague response from someone called Stacie. As there was such a lack of information, I asked further questions and had literally the same previous email copied and pasted back. It was very rude and frustrating. My order arrived on 28th Dec. I appreciate it will be their busiest time of year and had I been told it would have been arriving after Christmas, it wouldn’t have been a problem. I just wanted to know what was going on with my order. It was the false information, being completely unable to get through to them and the poor customer service that I found so disappointing. Will not use them again after this.
