records.text: I have made two orders with the Village butchers, so far. I discovered them just before Christmas. All of my orders have arrived on time and in perfect condition! The correspondence has been great, offering any help and support a customer may require. I can highly recommend them and will be placing another order soon. The Tomahawk steak is excellent!! Great work chaps, 🙏 Thank you!

records.title: Delivery Issues
records.text: Whilst not really their fault the delivery was not made on the correct day so I to buy more as it was ordered for a weekend

records.title: Nice order, delivery not so good
records.text: Nice order, ribs a bit mean on the meat! Bacon very good. Ordered on Friday, expected delivery on the following day as was told in my order confirmation email, had to chase the delivery, and the order finally arrived on the following Tuesday! Hence the 4 stars.

records.title: Delicious pheasant
records.text: Next-day delivery didn’t work - but to be fair, it was just after Christmas. It was a stock problem, not the delivery service. However, communication was good and the meat when it arrived was great. Will use again.

records.title: First time customer. 2 out of 3 steaks excellent, great service.
records.text: First time customer. Website is clearly laid out and easy to navigate.  I ordered 3 large steaks and they were well packed and arrived exactly as requested.  Loss of one star in my rating as one of the steaks was significantly less meaty than the other 2 the extra weight being made up in bone.

records.title: Great customer support. Pork chops... not like the picture.
records.text: I ordered a few pork chops as they were the only ones I could find on the internet that seemed to have the whole bone on them. However what I received was not how it looked in the pictures. No bone to be found (first time I get catfished by a butcher shop). Anyway when I contacted them they offered to repeat my order so I got another batch of pork chops. This time only a couple of them had the bone on them but I won't complain as now I have too much meat in my freezer. Also their meat was really tasty even if it wasn't exactly what I wanted so all in all.. 4 stars.

records.title: New customer communication issue but otherwise very good.
records.text: First time purchase and would have liked to receive more communication that order had been successfully placed. Instead of that an email simply confirmed we’d signed up to the newsletter. Chased for confirmation of order a couple of days later and was pleased to receive swift confirmation via WhatsApp that everything was good. Meat supplied was very good, well packed and well delivered. Will certainly order again.

records.title: The meat is lovely
records.text: The meat is lovely, everything was well packaged and freezer packs were still frozen.The only problem was the delivery. The driver left the parcel on my doorstep didn't wait to see if I was in, zlthoughbI had given a neighbours address if this happened.

records.title: Very good meat
records.text: Very good meat. High quality. Quick deliver. However I order tomahawk steak should be 1-1.5kg and was 920g so a bit disappointing when you pay for so expensive meat. Otherwise great product especially lamb.

records.title: I cant fault that
records.text: Placed order & it arrived with one item missing, I rang them & a replacement parcel turned up this morning Can't argue with that. I always say it's not the mistakes it's how they are dealt with & that one was dealt with promptly & I'm now a happy bunny

records.title: Delivered at unsafe temperatures
records.text: **Edit 26/08/2023** - Next order arrived with significantly more cooling packs and none of the products were above 4c this time. Hopefully this was a one off, but always check your products!**EDIT 25/08/2023** - The order was refunded by TVB, and I have placed another order to see whether this one arrives under temp. Will update review again once received and checked.I have to raise serious concerns about the food safety aspect of this company.When I received the box, all the meat inside was well above 16c which included chicken, beef burgers and beef mince which is over double the Food Standard Agency guidelines of 8c maximum.I ended up having to throw all the meat from my 2nd delivery since it was for guests and I did not want to risk it, which was a complete waste of money.The meat quality from my 1st delivery was good, but I can't risk future deliveries being dangerously over temperature.

records.title: Lovely marbled sirloin steaks
records.text: Cooked six steaks for guests who all thoroughly enjoyed them.I will certainly order from the Village Butcher again, although probably fillet steak as I prefer much leaner steak.My guests however loved the sirloin!

records.title: Would have got 5stars except for a bit…
records.text: Would have got 5stars except for a bit of miscommunication

records.title: Error quickly rectified
records.text: Ordered Côte de Boeuf but rolled turkey breast arrived instead. Error was quickly rectified by sending out correct order the next day. We had the rolled Turkey Christmas Day and are hoping to order for next year. The Côte de Boeuf was lovely. Portion size was perfect for my husband and I. Both boxes arrived well packed and chilled

records.title: High standard meat and very reasonable
records.text: So far we have had the free range chicken which was absolutely delicious, no waste at all. The pork belly we will be having on the weekend. As for the rib of beef and turkey  they are in the freezer for Christmas.

records.title: Usually top drawer.
records.text: Top drawer.Knocked off 1 star because I was sent rump steaks instead of rib-eye steaks.I contacted customer services twice and no one got back to me. Having read some of the reviews on here I’m not surprised, not sure what’s going on?Would use again.

records.title: Generally good but a risk for specific cuts
records.text: Bought some steak and couldn't fault the product or service. Then spent £50 on some beef fillet to be used for a Beef wellington (it was advertised as to be used for a wellington), unfortunately the shape of the meat was completely inappropriate to be used for a wellington (L shaped and thin at both ends), I was told this was not a problem as "there is nothing wrong with it".So generally they're OK, pretty good even, but if you need to buy something for a specific use like a beef wellington, do not buy online, it's just not worth the risk. It's far better to buy in person instead so you can see what you're paying for and ensure it's actually what you need.

records.title: Slow response to issue, but resolved
records.text: Have ordered a couple of times without issue. On my recent order the chicken upon opening smelt strongly of rotten eggs and had to be binned. This was in date and refrigerated upon receipt. Issues such as this can happen, but it is how the company responds that matters, and sadly I am disappointed by the lack of response in this case. Have tried contacting via phone, whatsapp and repeated emails but no reply. Update…. Eventually after further chasing received an email to apologise and refund for the item. Still disappointing in the amount of chasing required to get a response, but have updated rating accordingly.

records.title: A forgettable experience
records.text: Meat was reasonable quality and fairly priced. Bacon was average but seemed to be full of water when cooked. Disappointingly I got unsmoked bacon having ordered smoked. I dropped them an email, purely customer feedback and not looking for anything except an apology. Five days later I’ve not heard a word. On the whole a forgettable experience.

records.title: Half Price Ribs good value
records.text: The ribs on the bone were great value at an advertised half-price and the quality looks very good as well. Quite a lot of bone was left on, which will need trimming before cooking to help carving, but as these were not sold by weight it did not apparently adversely affect the price being charged! The also-ordered 1kg of rump steak was unimpressive with poor marbling and not very prettily carved. Just about OK for the price.

records.title: Not the most organised
records.text: We received a large order that wasn’t ours, so we called up to inform them. It took multiple phone calls but eventually they answered and arranged for it to be collected the same day and were very grateful for our honesty.In our order, one packet of ribs arrived open and smelling. The gentleman on the phone promised that they would return the following day, first thing in the morning, to swap the ribs for a new pack. Unfortunately they did not honor this, so our meal ended up being a rack of ribs short.

records.title: Bit dissapointing
records.text: Ordered 2 x 6kg brisket for my brother in laws wedding, I intended to smoke these, so was hoping for a nice pair of packer brisket.What I received was 1 brisket as expected and 1 that had been trimmed beyond recognition, no fat cap or anything to protect it during a smoke.  I immediately tried to contact village butchers by phone, but couldn't get through after 3 attempts on a Friday afternoon. I then emailed their sales helpline and responded to their default email, that they must send out after each order has been fulfilled. I asked for a replacement brisket. I got an email back, and they offered their apologies and then presented me with 15% off of my next order... With all due respect, all they have managed to demonstrate to me is that 50% of their briskets are not fit for purpose, i.e. smoking on a bbq, so I have been left feeling rather let down.Would only use a phone order in future to explain my requirements, as I don't think online is a safe option. Bit dissapointing

records.title: Pretty good, but not great.
records.text: I received the below for a bbq last weekend (shame about the rain on Sat).The chicken was good, but to be honest, for the money I was disappointed with both the brisket and pork ribs.The ribs were barely 2kg (advertised 2.5kg) and had thick layers of fat which meant that the ribs were juicy, but nowhere near meaty enough. The brisket wasn't flat (one end much thicker than the other) which meant that a low smoke was impossible to get a consistent cook temp through the meat.

records.title: I’ve placed two orders so far with the…
records.text: I’ve placed two orders so far with the village butchers and both have come with complications unfortunately. The produce is very good but the customer service is really lacking care and attention. Needs improvement 🙁

records.title: Postage cost
records.text: My only issue with this company is the postage cost, I was going to buy some lamb shanks for about £12.00 but the postage was £11.00 thus making the lamb shanks expensive.Obviously not their fault, just a difficult predicament

records.title: Great quality meat
records.text: Great quality meat, could do a lot better on customer service and responding to emails/WhatsApp/phone calls when checking to confirm delivery time which was critical. Arrived just in time, but I sense only because I kept chasing and checking up...

records.title: Was an ok, but won't use again.
records.text: First time ordering from here I normally use another online butcher for meat. I ordered some chicken wings, smash burger mince and some pork belly burnt ends. When I received the package 2 of the cold packs had split leaving gunk everywhere luckily the meat was not affected not a massive deal, but I was worried that the meat wouldn't have been cooled properly due to the packs being ripped. I can't fault the chicken wings they were lovely. The smash burger mince tasted good, however I always weigh out each ball of mince and in the past when I have ordered the same type of mince from other sellers when I smash them the they are always bigger than the bun but with this mince it shrinked massively to a point it looked embarrassing when sitting in the bun. The worst part were the burnt ends advertised as 'expertly chopped'  I was expecting it to come in nice cubes ideally around 1.5inches with good fat/meat ratio like how burnt ends supposed to be. It looked like some one had cut it up with a blunt pair of scissors. There were just about no cubes at all, just flat bit of torn up pork. Had bits that were 2inches big, bits that were 2cm, some had fat on and some had no fat on. Don't advertise them as burnt ends if your not going to cut them properly.

records.title: Goods arrived really promptly just a…
records.text: Goods arrived really promptly just a shame they were the wrong things and not had a response from the email address provided

records.title: Excellent Order and delivery
records.text: Excellent Order and deliveryCalves liver best everRib eye joint. Touchest ribeye ever.Ended up giving it to the dog.Sorry

records.title: Meat ok
records.text: Meat ok a little bit smellyDelivery outrageously expensive for local farm

records.title: Too busy to be good.
records.text: The product is very good - when it arrives. I’ve placed a few orders with this butcher and am generally impressed with the product. Not so with the service. The first issue was being supplied late. My order was times with an event and didn’t arrive when scheduled. I called up and was told it was because items were out of stock. I did make the point that it is more usual for a business to contact the customer, rather than just leave it but was told they were too busy. The second issue came when they supplied me with out of date meat. They didn’t say, but I’m guessing they were too busy to check use by dates. My latest delivery came with one item short. I called and was abruptly told to email a photo of their invoice. I followed up with another phone call and was told that they were ‘probably’ out of stock and too busy to let me know. They agreed to refund - obviously as long as they aren’t too busy to do so I’m assuming. It has left me wondering if I’m too busy to be bothered with the lax attitude to customers.

records.title: Poor quality chicken …
records.text: Recently ordered large pack chicken fillet breasts and I am extremely disappointed in quality of meat which I have found to be tough. I would go as far as to say some of the meat has been inedible. Previous couple of orders had been satisfactory

records.title: Previously been happy with Village…
records.text: Previously been happy with Village butcher however, I recently purchased a boneless leg at 50% off which seemed a good deal at a cost of £ 20.88.When the joint arrived it was clearly marked for sale at £34.99 so a shortfall of just over £6When I questioned this I was told it was a labelling error. I was always under the impression that the price show on the label is the binding amount, labelling error or not.Very disappointed in the service this time and the brush off I received, I shall be checking amounts closely should I ever order again

records.title: Ordered a brisket advertised as ideal…
records.text: Ordered a brisket advertised as ideal for smoking. Brisket had no fat cap and so was useless for low and slow smoking. Secondly website states orders are dispatched for an AM delivery. This is not the case as delivered using an all day DPD service. Checked with DPD directly and they confirmed the AM service was not used. False delivery information on their website

records.title: Late delivery and no response
records.text: Order arrived 3 days late with no warning.Asked for an update (via email and WhatsApp) after first day late. No response. Then get a dispatch note 2 days later (no explanation, no “sorry”).I then received emails asking whether everything had arrived so I replied to this asking if it was normal for dispatch to be late. No response. Disappointing as meat itself was nice. I wouldn’t be able to trust this would arrive on time in future and customer service has been sadly non existent!

records.title: missing item
records.text: have used this company several times in the past. unfortunately this time i have bought some pastrami cure and beef cheeks to make pastrami. requested delivery 3-4 days later. upon the day of delivery to my surprise there was just a box of meat and no cure. when i contacted them about this i was just told 'so stock' and refunded the cure cost. leaving me with just the meat and no way of curing it. if i was notified upon ordering i could have either cancelled the order or at least have been given time to source the cure elsewhere while i waited for the meat to arrive. but instead waa, left to me to chase where the missing item was

records.title: Ordered a cote de boeuf for my husbands…
records.text: Ordered a cote de boeuf for my husbands birthday, unfortunately I noticed straight away that the bone was only a tiny sliver but i thought OK benefit of the doubt, anyway cooked it medium rare as always do but was full of gristle around the ends and just not great. Ended up giving lots to the dog. Very disappointed

records.title: Had quite a sizeable order with the…
records.text: Had quite a sizeable order with the joint of sirloin being required for this coronation weekend and a birthday celebration.  It was ok but not quite what I expected, not much flavour and not as "moorish" as I had hoped.The only other item I've used so far was the lamb shanks and I have to say these were the toughest I've ever had, so much so it was difficult to carve and i had to discard.  A pity really as I've cooked lamb shanks for years and never experienced such tough meat.  I hope the rest of my order will be ok.

records.title: Meat is good, but find someone more reliable
records.text: Meat is good quality, but fulfilment and customer service is terrible.  I purchased meat for an event 4 days prior and on the day before the due date they call me, and I missed the call at work.  Tried calling back no response until the next day, when I was told one item was out of stock and that I wouldn't get the meat until the day after I needed it.  I asked to cancel but they wouldn't let me and claimed they have a 48hour window for delivery stipulated in their T&Cs and their email, which is not true.  It says 2 day processing time, which I ordered well in advance of, and there there are no T&Cs on their site and their email only states a specific delivery date. I know it's not a huge business, but not only did they miss my delivery date, they tried to put it on me and lied about their T&Cs rather than just saying sorry we missed the deadline which left a sour taste in my mouth.  If they had cancelled I would have come back and bought more working with a longer lead time, but here we are writing a review.

records.title: Poor quality cuts and below par delivery
records.text: Poorly packaged delivery with broken box, and left in direct sunlight, contrary to delivery instructions. The ribeye steaks were of poor quality, unevenly cut with a thick vein of gristle running through them. Will not be using them again.

description: The Cornish Company sells the finest goods from all across Cornwall. From fresh cream teas to pasties by post, become a part of the growing movement of those who simply love Cornwall now!

records.title: Best Cornish Cream Teas
records.text: My Late Husband and I used to go to Cornwall every year and we always had a cream tea which was wonderful,so when I signed up to  The Cornish Company and ordered one Cream Tea for my Son,s 40th Birthday it was like evening back in Cornwall all over again. I have ordered a few over the last couple of years so I will be looking to see what I can get next time .Well done all of you for making it special for everyone  Kathy Blanch

records.title: Festive pasties and scones were amazing
records.text: I ordered the festive pasties and scones for myself and my partner as a Christmas eve treat- they were absolutely beautiful- pasties full of proper meat and tasted lovely, the scones were so fresh! we had the last two after 5 days and they were still just as nice! will be ordering again

records.title: Christmas Gift Experience
records.text: I live in Scotland and ordered two hampers to be delivered on certain dates. The hampers both arrived on the dates promised and were in excellent condition. They were packed in lovely Christmas boxes and both the hampers were well received by our friends. I will be using The Cornish Company again throughout the year for gifts as I felt that the service was very personal

records.title: THE BEST hamper company I found in…
records.text: THE BEST hamper company I found in 2024. Everyone who I sent hampers to absolutely loved them. I have since ordered one for a Jan birthday and next year will be ordering all my Christmas hampers from here. The products are AMAZING, I love what the business is about and the delivery (YES IT'S FREE) was spot on. Well done team, you have bagged yourself a new loyal returning customer

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: I ordered two cream teas for Christmas delivery to two separate addresses on different days. For the first time ever, one order failed to arrive (the courier's fault) and therefore the order was scrapped by The Cornish Company, who were most apologetic and immediately refunded me. The second hamper arrived spot on time and was enjoyed by the recipients. Jam first on the scones, of course! I've used The Cornish Company on several occasions and will continue to do so.

records.title: Christmas Hamper
records.text: Hi Tom and James, I just wanted to say how absolutely delighted my parents were to receive their Christmas hamper (I sent as a present, I live in Tenby area of Wales my parents live in Hull, Yorkshire) If it was as good in the flesh as it was on the picture I can understand their delight. They are both in their early 90's so I had a blow by blow account of each section eaten and how good it tasted. So I would like to thank you and your staff for a great present

records.title: We ordered an afternoon tea hamper…
records.text: We ordered an afternoon tea hamper (wicker basket inc) for our friends in Ireland, they'd never had a cream tea and were over the moon with this, they did have the debate jam or cream first with us. All arrived on time as requested.

records.title: What a great company
records.text: Over the last year I have sent a number of Cornish Company gift hampers and all the recipients have been delighted. At Christmas I was lucky enough to receive one myself as a gift which was great. Scones were fresh and delicious. I shall be ordering more over this next year from this wonderful company, who are doing a great job in delighting customers, supporting other local companies and charities and providing employment for local people. Excellent job!

records.title: Its not often that what you read is…
records.text: Its not often that what you read is really true! But in the case of The Cornish Company this is most definitely the case! Scrumptious scones, tasty tea, cream to die for and spot on packaging, presentation and delivery! A must recommendation to family and friends!

records.title: Christmas Pasty & Ale Hamper and Cream…
records.text: Christmas Pasty & Ale Hamper and Cream tea Cornish Hampers were very well received as Christmas presents. The feedback from family and friends was very positive. Hamper's presentation was excellent and the contents were of very good quality. The feedback on the Cornish pies was very good and I myself enjoyed one of the Cornish cream hampers...lovely scones!The 3 hampers were delivered to London as promised in time. I can honestly recommend The Cornish Company to anyone who wants to offer something different as a present.

records.title: Great cream tea but disappointed with late delivery …
records.text: I ordered a gluten-free hamper for my sister and husband on 25th Nov for their anniversary on 30th.   When I received the order confirmation it said it would be delivered on the date I requested (which was actually the 29th).  It finally arrived on the 4th Dec.  They did enjoy their cream tea, but I was rather disappointed it didn’t arrive on their 45th anniversary!

records.title: Order of a hamper for 90th Birthday 2nd…
records.text: Order of a hamper for 90th Birthday 2nd Dec for 3rd Dec which did not arrive. Yodel apparently destroy perishable if not able to deliver!! Their tracking info disappeared so many phone calls and e mails later a new upgraded hamper was delivered on the 8th Dec. Thankyou The Cornish Company.

records.title: Very enjoyable
records.text: A wee bit disappointed as this was a present for a couple who were going on holiday so  I mentioned a particular date for delivery.  Unfortunately it was 2 days late but arrived before they went away.  They were both delighted with their cream tea so I will definitely be ordering again..

records.title: This was a present for my sister and…
records.text: This was a present for my sister and her husband.I received good communication to begin with and chose a specific date for delivery, for a reason.The gift did not arrive so I tracked it.The gift was still in Plymouth. I received a reply from Tom at the Cornish Company. Apparently they are reliant on Royal Mail.The present arrived a day late, but was of good quality and fresh.I advise anyone to send it a day ahead of when you want it to arrive.

records.title: Easy to order on line nice range at…
records.text: Easy to order on line nice range at fair prices. Lost a star because it was impossible to contact customer service post order and pre delivery. I called  (several times) and e mailed once as I wanted to change the delivery date (with a weeks notice) didn’t get any reply so was unable to change it

records.title: Very impressive customer support,
records.text: Unfortunately our hamper did not arrive on the right day due to a problem with the delivery company.Customer service were excellent and very helpful and a new parcel was sent out due to the contents needing to be fresh.An excellent idea for a surprise gift. Lovely choice of hampers. Would use again.

records.title: It was really easy & quick to order
records.text: It was really easy & quick to order. Paid extra to deliver on a designated day. The package was dented, I'm hoping the items were in good condition to receiving person.

records.title: Tasty hamper
records.text: Ordering was very easy. Good value.The hamper we sent our friend arrived on time. She really enjoyed the goodies.Just one small thing, I was disappointed she didn't get the Christmas tree shaped scones as advertised.I will definitely order again.

records.title: The package was well received and…
records.text: The package was well received and enjoyed very much. Just a pity that the delivery company did not update the delivery, making me think it had not been delivered until the next day

records.title: Marred by the delivery agent
records.text: The food is very good and I would have given five stars, but the experience was marred by the delivery. Although I was in the house, the only notification given was an email, which I spotted after an hour in which my parcel had been outside in the rain. Not your fault, but spoiled my enjoyment.

records.title: Birthday treat
records.text: This order was for a friends birthday which was delivered as requested.  They thoroughly enjoyed the surprise.  Thank you very much

records.title: Loved our Cornish pasty and cream tea.
records.text: Loved our Cornish pasty and cream tea hamper.  It wasn't our first and won't be our last.  The pasties are massive but the pastry is so easy to eat they're not over-facing and the scones are fluffy and gorgeous with plenty of jam and cream.  My only concern is the time of delivery.  We'd ordered the package to come on Saturday as we needed it for Monday and I worry things will be late.  It arrived on the expected day but if we had ordered it for Monday, arriving at 5pm would have been too late to have it for afternoon tea.  I know the site says 'next day delivery' but I think it would be helpful to state this could arrive late afternoon or evening to ensure people can plan to avoid disappointment if they are expecting it to arrive in time for lunch or afternoon tea. If you do order a day early, the items are really fresh and sealed so they didn't suffer at all having to wait from Saturday to Monday. Can't recommend enough, just order a day early.

records.title: Whilst the hamper is fab and was loved…
records.text: Whilst the hamper is fab and was loved by the recipient the experience with customer services wasn't great! Placed the order, paid and received order confirmation immediately. Every time I checked on the order status it said order received. Emailed more than once chasing and never received any response! Eventually it was delivered (about a week later) and was devoured!!!!

records.title: Good easy to use website.
records.text: Good easy to use website.Product selection good .Delivered on time however, Royal Mail has poor tracking and are not the best. Would recommend another courier if possible.

records.title: Was a gift and they loved it but when…
records.text: Was a gift and they loved it but when ordering I tried to add a message but was unable to so the recipient didn’t know who it was from - if you can add a message maybe it needs to be clearer on how to do soWould have been 5 stars if I had been able to add a message

records.title: No message in box to say who the box…
records.text: No message in box to say who the box was from and I know I typed one out. I asked the recipients how they liked the contents after they had asked other people if they had sent the box!!!!!!! No the greatest start and then they said the scones were OK but no particular flavour and they had, had better ones. So not really happy.IF no message was in box why would you not inform the sender first before actually sending the product. Not great people skills really?

records.title: Disappointed …
records.text: Bought the Christmas cheese delight hamper for my mum for Christmas! Can honestly say I was disappointed with what was inside the box! £30 for 2 cheeses and a jar of chutney and  crackers Will probably make my own next time .

records.title: My friends loved their gift so unique
records.text: My friends loved their gift so unique. What let you down was your delivery ,it wasn’t delivered on the date requested & trying to contact yourselves & yodel really difficult , would need to think again before ordering again, product itself was fabulous

records.title: Ordered the Beer “hamper” as a…
records.text: Ordered the Beer “hamper” as a Christmas present on the 8th, selected delivery date of the 10th it didn’t arrive. After numerous attempts to phone I emailed. Apparently my order was a failed delivery while I was in all day waiting for it. The customer service agent/ bot ordered me a new box and it came today, the box was battered and bottles were all over the place, I haven’t checked them for damage as yet.As for calling the items I ordered a beer “hamper” I don’t call a battered cardboard box a hamper. Would have been cheaper and easier to go to Asda and purchase. I would definitely consider changing your delivery company.

records.title: Not up to usual standard
records.text: Unfortunately this latest order didn't go well.The order was placed on Wednesday for Saturday delivery. On Friday the tracking system indicated the parcel was waiting for collection. That message stayed the same all weekend. I contacted the Cornish Company on Monday to say that my delivery had not arrived (tracking now said there was an error). An alternative package was promised for next day delivery (Tuesday) which was achieved, but the scones in particular tasted dry and stale. Not the best experience for a birthday present.

records.title: 1 small problem
records.text: 1 small problem, the parcel was not delivered until 2 days after my brothers birthday.I do understand it was an office error, it happens.Just a little disappointing for my brother.However when the parcel did arrive he was happy with it.

records.title: Not what we expected..
records.text: We purchased one of the Christmas hampers.  Scones were lovely and fluffy, really good.  The pasty was supposed to be turkey, ham and cranberry?  Not quite sure what we received but it was quite mushy and tasted of stuffing, which itself was nice and again the pastry was excellent, however I had one piece of turkey and a piece which was gristly and my husband had none at all, no sign of ham or cranberry to be seen, so a bit disappointed.  Shame as I was really looking forward to it.

records.title: Purchased for a birthday present
records.text: Purchased for a birthday present, notified delivered on correct day, had not been delivered, arrived next day. Asked if product would be safe, told shelf life a few days but didn't know where had been stored overnight. Recipient said product was cold to touch. They enjoyed. I was obviously unhappy with delivery and customer service.

records.title: Whilst the contents of the cream tea…
records.text: Whilst the contents of the cream tea hamper were fantastic we specifically ordered this to be delivered on a 70th birthday- however when we asked the person if they had received it they said no and it spoilt the surprise Also imagine my shock to receive an email saying you were preparing the order on the day it was to be delivered

records.title: The order for 2 cornish teas were…
records.text: The order for 2 cornish teas were ordered. When it arrived the cornish cream and biscuits were missing. I emailed and was sent voucher no to reorder. But did spoil the experience as without cream its nothing.

records.title: Always give 5 star review as love your…
records.text: Always give 5 star review as love your boxes but the last one came broken so had to throw the jam away which spoilt the whole experience.

records.title: Delivery issue
records.text: These were for a gift so I chose the delivery date carefully so I could deliver them later that day.  But,  they were delivered after 8pm that evening!! which was not acceptable for the event and completely spoilt the reason for ordering. The contents however were excellent.

records.title: The item ordered was for a gift and was…
records.text: The item ordered was for a gift and was by all accounts lovely. However, the delivery was terrible, was told it would arrive between 4pm-6pm, I told the people it was a gift when it was arriving, they postponed there plans until 6pm, the item did not arrive until after 7pm thus making them even later for their evening out!!

records.title: A great surprise gift for my mum but I…
records.text: A great surprise gift for my mum but I didn’t realise the scones were Christmas type and she prefers plain ones so she gave them to me - delicious !

records.title: Day late delivery
records.text: Contents were great but parcel delivered a day late and missed a special anniversary surprise.delivery was a bit irrelevant in the end and a waste of time and money.a shame as it was a fun idea

records.title: Undelivered order
records.text: Unfortunately I didn't get to try my order from TCC it wasn't delivered. This was down to the delivery company but I'll certainly  be giving them another go . The customer service was exceptional and very apologetic and offered to resend it again, but as it was for a birthday afternoon tea I had to decline the offer and ask for a refund which was done straight away.

records.title: Tasty but squashed
records.text: On a positive, the gift arrived on time, the packaging and contents were visually appealing and tasted delicious. On a negative, part of the box and 2 of the scones were squashed, one almost completely flat. I suspect that this was due to the flimsy cardboard box being mis handled by the courier, and placed under much heavier items.

records.title: I highly recommend the Cornish Company
records.text: I highly recommend the Cornish Company. I've placed a few orders for friends and family, and all have been delighted with their Cornish scones cream tea's. The cream tea has been carefully packaged and has always arrived fresh and in good condition. Delivery has been fabulous and items have always arrived on time. The only thing I would say is when completing the purchase form, make sure that the delivery address hasn't defaulted to the payment address. Otherwise the cream tea maybe delivered to you rather than where you intended it to go. If you contact the company direct they are very helpful.

records.title: I have used this company before and…
records.text: I have used this company before and they were great. This time round - sadly - it went pear-shaped. A cream tea ordered in good time for a friend's birthday, to be delivered on 14 December, did not turn up. After a complaint, a replacement, promised to be delivered on 21 December, has also failed to materialise. I suspect they cannot cope with the volume of orders at this time of they year - perhaps a victim of their own success? A second complaint has resulted in more apologies, a full refund and a gift voucher. This company's business model does not work - you cannot have lengthy delays in delivery when dispatching edible/perishable gifts. Either fix the delivery part of your business or you will fail! And that would be such a shame - the product is amazing.

records.title: Unfortunately despite ordering 3 weeks…
records.text: Unfortunately despite ordering 3 weeks before needed to be delivered for a birthday present, it did not arrive. I emailed the company, who did respond and apologised, but couldn't do anything more. Birthday present arrived a day late, when recipients were out all day. No response received from The Cornish Company when I complained about this. Very disappointed,  love using businesses like this, but will not be using again.

records.title: The delivery did not arrive on the date…
records.text: The delivery did not arrive on the date required. Customer service never apologised when I called. The first person cut me off, the second seemed totally disinterested and unbothered. Shame as this isn’t my first order but will now be my last!

records.title: Ordered three hampers
records.text: Ordered three hampers, one of which was gluten free.All intended as separate gifts.All came in unmarked patterned boxes, so I had no idea which was the gluten free one, without opening and thereby spoiling the gift.My only solution was to give one hamper to one recipient and two hampers to one of the other two recipients, meaning I have to find another to replace the one intended for the gluten free recipient. That's not financially ideal for someone relying on a pension income.I was so disappointed.

records.title: Afternoon tea hamper
records.text: Ordered for my parents who were not impressed with the quality. They said the pastry wasn’t nice and pasty was mainly potato Unfortunately won’t be ordering again

records.title: Turkey pasties weren't great
records.text: Turkey pasties weren't great, to be honest. Also unfortunately there was yeast extract in them too which I can't eat.The ginger biscuits were nice and the scones ok.

records.title: Disappointed with delivery.
records.text: The item I ordered was a gift for a special birthday which sadly didn't arrive until the day after it should have been delivered, so had to rush out to purchase another gift. The issue has since been dealt with amicably.

records.title: Not the best customer service
records.text: Not the best customer service, I was asked for my date of birth,and for my wife so they could send out offers for our birthday, both birthdays gone,not heard anything. I wouldn't buy from them again.

records.title: Late delivery missing my aunts 90th…
records.text: Late delivery missing my aunts 90th birthday party with her friends despite having  selected the date weeks before . Blamed Royal Mail however if they don’t receive the package in time they can’t deliver on time . In the reply to my complaint they pointed out in the VERY small print the date cannot be guaranteed which I did not see and had I seen that I would not have risked my aunts disappointment. The products themselves when they arrived were good quality hence the 2 stars . Needless to say I would not risk another order to save future  disappointment .

records.title: Failed delivery & poor customer service
records.text: 1) Failed to deliver last Saturday due to an issue with YodelYou can forgive that if the recovery is good. 2) Rescheduled for delivery on the Tuesday. Our message was not included so friends didn't know who it was from. 3) Friends phoned 4 times unable to get through & unable to discover who send it. In fairness, I emailed to explain my experience rather than just leave a bad review. Being in marketing, I appreciate it is important to understand why you lose customers. At this stage they could have looked to woo me back but their response was only to open the door & say bye. Hence the loss of a customer & a negative review. Not for the product but for being unreliable & not rescuing the situation well, not once but twice. As a result I have not sent a cream tea to my cousin but a M&S tea time box instead. That I know will arrive.

description:
The Vanilla Valley prides itself in providing a complete range of cake decorating supplies and baking equipment for bakers of all abilities from hobby bakers to professionals. Since our establishment in 2008 as a manufacturer of acrylic cupcake stands, we have grown our ever-increasing catalogue to encompass all things cake and baking, and pride ourselves on being one of the UK's leading cake decorating retailers. 

Whether you need essentials such as cake drums, cake boxes, baking tins, sugar paste and food colouring, or tools for the latest cake trends, you should find it all at The Vanilla Valley at a competitive price. We stock from all of the leading brands including Renshaw, PME, Saracino, and more.

Shop online or in our Cardiff store today!

records.title: Perfect
records.text: Although I was missing an item in my delivery vanilla valley still dealt with it all, I ordered on Christmas Eve and by 28th I had my order. I would recommend vanilla valley to anyone who is in the baking business

records.title: Great quality products
records.text: Great quality products  available to collect very quickly after ordering. But packaging needs to be reviewed. The cardboard box my order was in was completely out of proportion for the items in it.

records.title: Great range of products  at very good…
records.text: Great range of products  at very good prices.If any help or advice is needed nothing is too much trouble. Highly recommend, definitely my go to company.

records.title: Strong cake box for a wedding cake
records.text: Container needed to transport a wedding cake. Easy to order, speedy delivery and extremely well packaged. The 10 x10 x 12 corrugated, strong cake box did an excellent job.I like the way the box opened up on reaching the venue to ensure a smooth transition to the wedding cake stand.

records.title: Order arrived on time
records.text: Order arrived on time, always reliable! Products are packed well

records.title: Excellent service & delivery
records.text: This is my 1st time to use this company. Everything arrived undamaged as the items were packed correctly to orevent damage. Very positive & will definitely use again.

records.title: Great company to buy from …
records.text: Always have a good experience  when ordering  from vanilla valley,on the rare occasion  I do have a problem it's dealt with quickly and easily.

records.title: great service
records.text: My no 1 go to store for value and great service on items that are generally always well stocked.Lovely surprise free Christmas gift was cherry on the top. Thank you!

records.title: Great experience
records.text: The website is easy to navigate, it has lovely products at reasonable prices. My order cam to about 18 pounds with delivery. Delivery was fairly quick, the packaging was some of the best I've seen and the products are good quality. Will order again.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: The Vanilla Valley have a good choice of stock and generally I find what I want. The prices are reasonable too. There was recently a small error in one of my orders and they responded to my query very quickly and resolved it promptly. Excellent customer service.

records.title: Great products delivered
records.text: Great products delivered. Exactly what I needed. Would have been five start if the next day delivery paid for was met. Unfortunately arrived a day later but still in time for Xmas.

records.title: Delivery is quick and the items were…
records.text: Delivery is quick and the items were well-packaged.

records.title: Complaint Resolution
records.text: After more than a week, parcel come with damage products inside.The damage items problem  was promptly resolved by the Sales Team at Vanilla Valley. Many thanks!

records.title: Good service
records.text: Took longer than normal to pack and send but probably had a lot to do with time of year and the storms we are getting. Once sent arrived very quickly. Goods were well wrapped as always and all in good order. I would certainly recommend Vanilla Valley.

records.title: Nice company
records.text: Had a delivery, and a damaged item, which looked like it had been used or it had been laying about somewhere, abit annoying as wanted 2, gave me a refund rather than sending out another. Customer service was good as an item was out of stock at the time after id ordered, had a call to say this, but luckily they had a delivery just before my order  was being sent. everything else i ordered was great.

records.title: Product ordered arrived very quick
records.text: Product ordered arrived very quick, well packed and they provide very good customer communication. Louisa been great.

records.title: Product very good
records.text: Product very good. Quite a long time between ordering and delivery.

records.title: Always helpful staff
records.text: Always helpful staff. When products out of stock, an email request for stock arrival into shop very welcome. Stock levels low on regularly used items ( sugar pastes), however this is out of their control given currant stock situation, I'm sure.

records.title: Good company
records.text: I like that I can order online & the prices are good. I was eligible for free postage because I spent the amount to allow this. I have ordered from this company before & the goods have arrived fairly quickly so this was another reason for my re ordering. The reason I have given 4 stars is because my order was despatched with an item short & I'm currently waiting for a reply.

records.title: Although I didn’t receive the correct…
records.text: Although I didn’t receive the correct colour cake board that I ordered the board that came would a good quality board. My email informing of the error was dealt with quickly and politely and refund issued, so won’t put me off using them again in the future.

records.title: Great quality products and good…
records.text: Great quality products and good delivery time. Easy ordering on the website. Only minor gripe is there is no back page & if you use the browser back arrow it takes you all the way back to the main menu.

records.title: Happy that my order came within a few…
records.text: Happy that my order came within a few days .But unfortunately they had run out of purple fondant, which , to their credit,I was informed & refunded for that item straight away. I was a bit disappointed that the 7kg tub of bridal white Massa Ticino had only 5 months BB date on it . Probably,in future I should order the smaller packs, so maybe that's my fault, as I'm a hobby baker and might not use it up quick enough. I wouldn't use any other brand , because this is wonderful to work with and guaranteed to present a beautifully covered cake.

records.title: Would of been 5 stars but this my first…
records.text: Would of been 5 stars but this my first order and something was missed from order it was sorted quickly and sent next day but not a good start

records.title: Happy with The Vanilla Valley
records.text: Ordering was easy and I was glad that I could choose to convert to US currency on your site so as to not be shocked with the rate conversion.  My order was fulfilled promptly and appears to have left the UK in about 3 days. Knowing that it was international shipping, I knew it would take a while to receive. Boy was I right. Unfortunately my package went from Royal Mail to USPS and took 10 days in the US to be moved around to areas of the country far from me and then back again. The box was a smashed mess. Nothing escaped the shipping container thank goodness and I attribute NONE of the bad shipping issues (lack of care in handling, delay in delivery) to Vanilla Valley. Maybe  UPS or FedEx could be a future shipping option. Thank you for working with those of us internationally to attain reasonable prices on products to improve our product.

records.title: Very quick delivery
records.text: Very quick deliveryBox could have been bigger as large cake boxes did get squashed

records.title: Delivery was too long and too late for…
records.text: Delivery was too long and too late for Xmas presents. Very disappointed

records.title: Import duties
records.text: I purchased edible ink pens which are good but a lot smaller than I expected…. I was also contacted by customs to pay import duties which were nearly €5. So worked out expensive for what they were!

records.title: Easy ordering and prompt delivery but one item was incorrect, only discovered when I needed to use it and too late to return and get a replacement - partly my fault for not checking thoroughly.
records.text: Easy ordering and orompt

records.title: The only thing I was not happy with is…
records.text: The only thing I was not happy with is that on delivery the driver ignored the door bell, even as someone was in, then left the package outside in the rain so all my stuff got soaked.

records.title: Tried placing order several times sadly…misl
records.text: Tried placing order several times sadly it seems a Mitch match of my orders 🤷‍♀️

records.title: For someone in their eighties.
records.text: For someone in their eighties your web sight was very very difficult to work through. Your check out was even more difficult which resulted in an order not going through. When phoning up to see if it went through was not really helpful and when asked to be able to phone an order I was told NO. I was eventually able to get an order through.

records.title: What is a set?
records.text: We have used Vanilla Valley fir many years, but feel that some of their advert descriptions are misleading. They need to make clear what a set is, especially when their main description states 10 sets (which I see as maybe 1 of 2 components), but they see as 10 mixed. After telephoning then to complain, basically I was told where to go and that I couldn't return the items. We have since found another supplier.

records.title: Poor packaging
records.text: All of my order was in the box but im not sure how. The sides of the boxes were all split and the damage was large enough for the smaller items to fall out. The products are fine and exactly what was ordered its the delivery which gives me issues.

records.title: Incorrect item was sent and not replaced or refunded
records.text: Incorrect item was sent. Replacement was apparently sent out. I was asked to check external premises which I did. I'm still waiting for missing item that I have paid for and no reply to communication weeks ago.I was sent proof of delivery which was a photo of my parcel sitting in a bunch of leaves with surrounding which don't match my garden.Nothing had been resolved. ***Company has resolved issue since writing this review. Therefore changed review to 3 stars not 1

records.title: Lacked attention to detail as order was incorrect.
records.text: Got my order wrong but replied to my email straight away to rectify the wrong item they had sent me. It took from my delivery last Friday until today Tuesday to receive the correct item. I had expected it to have been sooner as it was a packing mistake. It was needed for a project for the Sunday so it delayed and inconvenienced me. Anyway the order has been corrected so Thank you. But for this reason I felt I could only give a 3* review.

records.title: Delivery
records.text: All my items were eventually delivered fairly speedy, but I had no email saying it was being delivered that day. I had email on the 3rd saying been shipped, but that was the last I heard anything.  Apparently it was delivered on the 5th to my neighbour instead of my 'safe' place. They brought it around begrudgingly the next day wondering why I hadn't been to collect.  I had nothing pushed through the door saying it had been left next door or even that it had been delivered.  Assuming not Vanilla valley fault but delivery courier They use.

records.title: Paid for next day delivery and the…
records.text: Paid for next day deluvery and the courier who said he would be with me that day when i tracked him suddenly decided he wadnt delivering till the following day. When asked the driver he said he ran out of him whereas the company said the van broke down so not sure who to believe

records.title: Double checks needed
records.text: So I recently purchased a mixed bag of items all of which were of high quality. More than satisfied.My problem is payment.I opted for 3 interest free payments  the 1st being around 28th October. That's fine. But then you've also taken the full payment of £55.04 so I'm paying twice for one order! I'd be very grateful for some assistance in getting the refund for the £55.04 please.

records.title: Not delivered as requested
records.text: Parcel came apart.  Delivery company did not deliver as requested. What is the point of stipulating delivery instructions if no one takes any notice of them.  This is the second time and again had to buy extra from local shops at a higher price to make cake.  Not happy.

records.title: Unfortunately a poor delivery company used
records.text: Unfortunately the next day delivery didn't work out and my parcel didn't arrive in time. I did get a delivery refund but I still had to drive quite a distance to get what I wanted in the end, so the refund didn't help much. Maybe they should use a better delivery service.

records.title: I ordered 2 sponge cakes a 8” and a 6”…
records.text: I ordered 2 sponge cakes a 8” and a 6” the 8” inch. Had a good date on it but the 6” had the best before date before I even had it I did get a refund for it and I was quite excited to start using your company as I follow u on Facebook but I am a bit wary know

records.title: The packaging wasn't great, the products were good
records.text: The products we received are all great however the packaging was not great. The box was squashed and therefore some of the product (Cake lace mix) leaked out into the parcel. Fortunately the book had a thin protective wrap so it was not damaged. The cake lace dis leak out into the package and the container was dmaged so it is now not properly sealed.

records.title: Although delivery times were excellent…
records.text: Although delivery times were excellent considering the issues everyone seemed to be experiencing due to Christmas unfortunately 3 out of 4 of the pots of icing were so badly damaged that I was unable to use them due to small shards of plastic. Maybe you need to rethink your packaging, I believe if they had been in a smaller box then they would have had the opportunity to smash around inside

records.title: Seriously contemplating using another…
records.text: Seriously contemplating using another online cake store as vanilla vally no longer give you the option of using DPD  the only option I had was to have my stuff delivered by evri which is hermes under a different name who are renowned for being days late and stealing peoples parcels vanilla vally seriously need to bring back DPD or I will take my business elsewhere

records.title: I visit the shop every couple of months…
records.text: I visit the shop every couple of months and also shop on line, usually the girls are very helpful. This time I have to say the girl who served me didn’t seem bothered. I asked a few questions about certain items and she answered me but it seemed a chore. She would not come from behind the counter to show me alternatives or where items were. I was disappointed with her attitude but I will still visit the shop and hopefully someone else will serve me.

records.title: I ordered a bouquet box and ask to…
records.text: I ordered a bouquet box and ask to cancel the order but they told me it was already packaged for delivery and so I could only return it for a refund. I awaited for my delivery which came but did not receive it and asked them to return to you. I got an email from the delivery company saying they had delivered back to VV, I sent an email to VV to finally ask for a refund but they still haven't replied to my email nor sent an email to say that the package had been successfully returned. Quiet disappointing, I am still waiting for a response

records.title: You need a new courier contract
records.text: You were excellent until the point of delivery. I paid extra for next day delivery. Evri failed to even attempt delivery. There was no way of making contact with them, all contact details were turned off. I paid for next day delivery using your courier, there were no alternatives available. At the very least delivery costs should have been refunded.

records.title: I ordered 2 black cake drums and one…
records.text: I ordered 2 black cake drums and one arrived scuffed on the edges.The board was needed for a celebration cake and I am unable to use it as it certainly doesn’t look professional. Always a problem when you cannot pick the items yourself and have to rely on online purchases.

records.title: Expired edible items!!!
records.text: Not quite happy that I got sent an edible item that had expired by the time it got to me. Okay, I placed the order on 29th August ( online), but  Vanilla Valley knew I would not receive it until September, so I would have expected Vanilla Valley to at least have communicated that they could not be able to fulfill my order (I am assuming they were out of stock), if they had not included the nearly expired item.

records.title: DISAPPOINTED SERVICE
records.text: I placed  my order before 3pm on a Friday  and was advised as next day delivery as I spented over £35. I know the weekend was upon us so expected my delivery the fowarding  Mon or Tues. The iteams ordered we're for a customer cake order on the Friday.DISAPPOINTED ONLY ARRIVED ON THE SATURDAY.Had to go out and source the material else we're. Wasting both my time and money and petrol.the box even had a next delivery sticker on it. My contract is with yrself not the delivery people. Will think twice if I was to reorder again which may be unlikely.

records.title: Will think twice…
records.text: Everything was easy to order and was delivered on time etc no probs there but the mid coloured blue icing was so hard it wouldn’t roll out it just broke up and was unusable so at that late stage I had to bin it and buy elsewhere so I’m approx £7 out of pocket, after having spoke to Steve at vanilla valley it transpired I had indeed bought the wrong product without realising so the review I have given is unfair as the error was my fault not theirs x

description:
Patisserie Valerie is one of the most loved cake shops in the UK, now with nationwide cake delivery available we are offering the ultimate luxury cake experience at home. 
Using only the freshest ingredients and traditional baking methods, all our cakes are lovingly handmade by our team of expert Bakers. From traditional flavours to exciting new designs there is a wide range of cakes for all celebrations. In addition to this we also offer wedding cakes, cake selection boxes and afternoon tea.
All of our online range is available for pre- order and next day delivery, and can be personalised with an inscription or cake topper. You can also find a variety of cakes at selected Sainsbury’s superstores.  From chocolate cakes to something fruity, find a birthday cake near you!

records.title: Beautiful cakes and excellent service
records.text: Ordered two cakes for anniversaries on the same day, both were well packaged and delivered in the time frame. Both parties were thrilled with their own individual cakes and said they were the best they had ever had. Have now ordered another one for my parents anniversary at the end of December and am looking forward to receiving that one. Very happy customer indeed. Thank you

records.title: Red velvet heaven!!!
records.text: So simple to order.Good price for the cake.Arrived beautifully packed.Wonderful flavour and taste. Exactly how it was described.My choice was red velvet cake, just lovely will definitely buy again!!!

records.title: So sad to see Nottinghams Patisserie…
records.text: So sad to see Nottinghams Patisserie Valerie has had to close due to the landlord putting up the rent. When visiting Nottingham we would always pop there good food and drinks especially afternoon tea . Will be so missed it will soon come that there us nothing worth going to cities or towns for they will end up being just ghost towns

records.title: ALL GOOD
records.text: Beautiful fresh cream cake.Arrived on time and packaged extremely well, the frozen in dry ice works really well and keeps the cake nice and fresh.Have used this company on several occasions in the past for special occasions and always been completely satisfied and never let down.Was kept well informed on delivery by their courier company DPD.All good.

records.title: Fabulous cake!
records.text: I ordered the four layer chocolate cake for a celebration and it didn't disappoint. The cake arrived in perfect condition, looked amazing and was absolutely delicious! Would highly recommend the service and products - will definitely be ordering again!

records.title: Decided  to order a cake for my mum’s…
records.text: Decided  to order a cake for my mum’s 60th birthday party, Never done this before, so I wasn’t sure what to expect with this company based on reviews and wow wasn’t disappointed.Absolutely delicious cake probably the best I’ve ever had and guests agreed to.Delivered with care no problems, Taste wonderful, look beautiful Just perfect, thank you so much.Will be using them for my son’s First birthday in August. ;-)

records.title: Decadent Chocolate Drip Cake
records.text: Ordered the Decadent Chocolate Drip Cake for a 17th Birthday and we're absolutely delighted with the cake.  Easy to order and arrived well packaged and in pristine condition.  Wonderful cake, thoroughly recommend Patisserie Valerie and will use again in the future.

records.title: Amazing cake and fabulous service …
records.text: Amazing cake and posted and received perfectly.  Was I daunted at the prospect of a frozen cake coming through the post? Yes I was.  Was I hopefully encouraged by the great reviews? Yea indeed.  Was I delighted with the overall end result? We really were.  It was delicious, fresh, beautifully decorated and I’d certainly recommend.

records.title: I should not have been concerned at all.....
records.text: I have to be honest I was concerned about ordering a cake for such an important event to be delivered from London to rural Shropshire. Well I should not have worried. It arrived in perfect condition, completely protected and still frozen. I ordered it to be delivered the day before I needed it to allow it to defrost. Followed the instructions.  It was perfect, it looked beautiful and tasted wonderful. The perfect end to a birthday meal. Thank you

records.title: Excellent customer services.I was worried that after getting…
records.text: I was worried that after getting Pattiserie Valerie gift vouchers for Christmas, I was unable to use them as the Canterbury shop had closed down(really upset as I loved that shop)I would not be able to use vouchers. Your customer services helped me so much, and now I can order online and redeem my vouchers. Thank you.

records.title: I've been enjoying Patisserie Valerie…
records.text: I've been enjoying Patisserie Valerie cakes for a few years now, as they are such a delicious treat, way better than typical shop-bought cakes. The only thing that let's them down is the poor delivery service. We've had cake boxes left outside in the rain, stood upside down, or sideways, and the drivers don't even wait to make sure you are there to take them in, they just ring the door bell then immediately drive off again. One point removed Patisserie Valerie as a poor delivery experience is spoiling an otherwise enjoyable treat!

records.title: After 2 attempts, Got it right!
records.text: I do like PV. We did experience another issue but I prefer to give people a chance. After a couple of orders that have gone wrong, they actually got the replacement bang on correct to exactly what we ordered (which is what it should be)No one answered the phone but they responded quickly on emails.Thank you for saving Mother’s day and delivering tasty cakes!

records.title: Impressive celebration cake
records.text: Cake was well packaged and delivered frozen the day before needed so it had plenty of time to defrost. Also tasted extremely good. The sponge was extremely light, not too sweet and the cream not sickly. The fountain candles gave an amazing display. Courier however left box on its side despite there being a ‘this way up’ sticker on it. Luckily we picked it immediately. Hence the four stars.

records.title: Delivered on time and good selection
records.text: The items were delivered on time and well packaged.The afternoon tea for 4 had a good selection of items and looked pretty, so pleased with that.The only downside would be that the sides of the cakes were a little dry - we had them delivered on Friday for a Sunday event so once defrosted they sat in the fridge for a while and in cardboard boxes they dried out a little.  Note for others - maybe put the boxes into a bag, or wrap in clingfilm before putting in the fridge to prevent drying out.I think that maybe it should be clearer when ordering, that the items will arrive frozen so will need time to defrost.Otherwise a good purchse.

records.title: Cannot fault the cake
records.text: Cannot fault the cake, it is absolutely fabulous! However you may need to speak with the delivery company/drivers or make it more obvious on the packaging of the contents or which way it needs to stored as our delivery driver left it on it’s side and the cake has slid.Luckily it is salvageable and was packaged so good.5 stars for the promp delivery and the amazing cake, but marked slighty due to the delivery.

records.title: The cake was absolutely delicious!
records.text: The cake was absolutely delicious and great value, the only issue was it had been a little damaged during the delivery process, all of the piped flowers were squashed and the cake was off centre on the gold cardboard plate stand. But it still looked fairly decent and the taste made up for the presentation!

records.title: Verry happy with purchase
records.text: Verry happy with purchase. However I could not remove the thought that a fresh ( Not defrosted ) cake would have been much much tastier. But we still enjoyed it and going to order again in a future. This time cake decorations stayed intact. Previous times cake decorations would have been a bit destroyed, this time it was 100% perfect.

records.title: Great experience, delicious cake
records.text: Easy selection process when ordering the cake. Kept informed of delivery progress.Cake was delivered on time.However, Brogan who delivered the cake did not ring the ring doorbell and the cake was left on our front porch. the cake itself was beautifully decorated and tasted delicious, just the right level of sweetness.

records.title: Delicious 🤤 cake 🎂
records.text: Delicious 🤤 cake 🎂, only problem was it was delivered upside down! Bigger arrows needed for the delivery driver, ! But it actually didn’t make any difference to the cake as it was frozen 🥶 solid at the time, but didn’t do my nerves any good, as I was worried that the cake was ruined x

records.title: Fast and fancy!
records.text: Left it very late to order, so was relieved to find a next-day service offered! Cake turned up in very good condition and everybody was very impressed - feedback was that it was 'very fancy'! Have knocked off one star, as disposing of the dry ice was a little more complicated than necessary (although did appreciate the cake needed to be kept cold, of course).

records.title: The cake was absolutely delicious.
records.text: The cake was absolutely delicious! My granddaughter has allergies to both egg and dairy so the biscotti cake was ideal and family favourite flavour.The only downside was that the cake was slightly battered due to careless delivery,I found the box by the doorstep in a puddle in the rain!

records.title: This was a gift to a friend for her…
records.text: This was a gift to a friend for her birthday.She thought the cake itself was delicious but the problem for her was the mother of pears sprinkled on the cake that got stuck in someone's teeth so she has taken off a mark because of that incident.Other than that the cake was absolutely delicious,

records.title: Delivery VERY early
records.text: Good service except DPD emailed me at 6:25 to tell me the delivery was coming at 7.40. I appreciate that the driver has to start early but an email the evening before would have been helpful. Having said that the package was not delivered to my door ( I live in an apartment with its own front door), it was left in a communal area which was not secure. The package was a little crushed out of shape which unfortunately was for a gift. So 4 stars.

records.title: Fantastic cake, good service.
records.text: Cake was delivered in the timeframe mentioned, however, delivery from dpd was poor - having given an hour slot they delivered 2 hours early without telling us and left it on the doorstep in the pouring ran. Cake look fantastic apart from a macaron that was squashed - something to expect when having a cake delivered I assume. Cake tastes fantastic and was such value for money. I had been let down at the last minute by a local Cake maker and to be able to go online at short notice, have plenty to choose from, have the options of personalising and have it delivered in time for a party was brilliant. I would recommend.

records.title: Birthday Cake
records.text: Arrived on time but not personalised as paid for.

records.title: Ordered a birthday cake for my dauughter but unfortunately  the butterflies were broken when we took the cake out of the box. The cake however tasted nice.
records.text: Although the cake was very well packaged on delivery, unfortunately, the cake was a little damaged.

records.title: Disappointed - customer service lacking
records.text: Bit disappointed in their service really. Ordered my wedding cake and a few bits and bobs for our wedding from Patisserie Valerie. This included a cake topper for an additional cost of £6.95. The order turned up with no cake topper. I enquired about this on via live chat and later via email too and both times they said I hadn’t ordered it, despite it clearly being on the order confirmation. I wasn’t expecting them to re-send out another as the wedding was too close, but a refund would have been nice. Not the best service I’ve ever received to be honest and definitely left a sour taste in my mouth.

records.title: When ordering online
records.text: When ordering online, wouldn’t keep the delivery address the same as payment address. Ended up with delivery address being wrong. I emailed immediately and called 7 times to constant ringing and no response. However, the email was answered and finally delivered to correct address. Noted in t&c’s, it says ‘needs more than one day notice if change of delivery address is needed or no refund’.! Thankfully I had purchased in sufficient time.

records.title: Very poor and thoughtless delivery service
records.text: I have already stated my complaint online, and today received a reply. Delivery of your fabulous cake was awful: the box left outside our property, by our bins on the side of our electric gates. It was lucky I spotted the package when leaving the property by car, as it was raining and the ground very wet. Also any passerby could have taken it…..Otherwise the cake looks wonderful and our daughter and friends will certainly very much enjoy it tonight !

records.title: Order the cookies & cream ice cream…
records.text: Order the cookies & cream ice cream cake. The delivery driver left it outside my building, anyone could’ve taken it & ruined the party. I also included on my order some minced pies but I didn’t receive them. The cake itself tasted really good though! I would definitely order it again for another occasion.

records.title: Nothing special
records.text: Nothing special. Having tried multiple patisserie cakes in the past, wanted to give this new one a try, which fell below my expectations. The sour taste was overpowering the sweetness and the cream in between didn't really compliment the cake. However, the cake was moist and soft barring the icing, jam and cream. The presentation and delivery was nice as usual.

records.title: Great delivery, average product
records.text: The delivery was great and the packing was well done. However, I was dissapointed in the Black forest cake I ordered, expecting higher quality and better taste, giving the price I paid. Also the defrosting didn’t go well as even that I received the cake at @12:30, took the dry ice away from the box and left the cake uncovered at room temperature until 9pm when I served it, the middle of the cake was still frozen. Overall average product, expected better.

records.title: Disappointed to say the least
records.text: The cake that arrived did not have the same wow factor of the image on the website. It appeared shorter in height and amateur in its decoration. The personalised decoration was almost thrown away as it was tucked into the side of the box and not on the cake which it didn’t match or fit onto anyway. The flowers on top were quite flat and the whole thing lacked definition. For the price I was very disappointed. The cake was obviously quickly decorated on a production line. The taste was far too sugary, teeth grating so and was left uneaten by the guests. I will not be ordering again from Patisserie Valerie.

records.title: Afternoon Tea Experience.
records.text: Kept well informed about the delivery of the goods, which came within the alloted time, packaged very well. The products looked amazing, and as advised were refridgerated, and as they came mid afternoon, we tried them after defrosting the next day. Apon trying the products 24 hours after delivery, they were still pretty much frozen, with the scones being solid with no flavour, apart from the cream and jam, provided by different product providers. We gave the cakes more time to defrost at room temperature, but they did not taste too great, being honest. For the price, I wouldn't order again.

records.title: Tasty shame about lack of instructions
records.text: The cakes were delivered on the date but there was no indication that they were frozen nor any information that it needed defrosting! No idea 🤷 By chance when opening the package it was frozen luckily I had to call a shop to find out the time needed to defrost & be ready to eat & luckily we had just about 4 hours for it to be defrosted!! At least there should be big note re the defrosting process!

records.title: Mini cake box
records.text: Received a gift voucher after receiving a faulty birthday cake in October (blue candy stripe gateau which tasted very nice). I used it to buy the mini cake box over Christmas. Some cakes were better than others but overall they were far too sweet.

records.title: Cake was delicious and looked amazing…
records.text: Cake was delicious and looked amazing apart from some of the roses were damaged during transit. But despite this everyone said it tasted great tod looked lovely. Delivery was on date request just not handed very well by the courier.

records.title: The afternoon tea was amazing…but organisation not
records.text: The afternoon tea was amazing unfortunately the staff training was not 😟 one member of staff advised us to find a table, we did and then another member of staff told us it was taken and asked us to queue at till and wait for table! Then the gentleman by till said we do find a table ourselves! I think a training issue here and manager needs to know what’s going on!

records.title: We haven't tasted the cake yet
