I just knocked down the star rating a bit because it was special for my 65th and a lot of the berries had fallen off and some of the chocolate biscuit surround was broken, The cake we'd had once before came perfectly it was in one piece.

records.title: We have been going to the Basingstoke…
records.text: We have been going to the Basingstoke Patisserie Valerie since we moved to the area. Lovely tea room with great customer service. Was very disappointed  in the October half term we were made aware they have stopped doing children’s menu. My son throughly enjoys the kids menu and it’s great value for parents. He doesn’t want to go there anymore as he prefers the kids options. Surely the kids menu should be available in all tea rooms?

records.title: I hadn’t realized the cake was frozen…
records.text: I hadn’t realized the cake was frozen but luckily it came early enough to defrost before the evening celebration. The personalized Happy Birthday message was separate from the cake and didn’t really fit the smallest cake so was a bit disappointing. The cake did taste good but too rich for the children. All in all poor value for money

The cake size is good however the texture of the cake was not the same standard of previous cakes I have ordered from Patti Valerie. Heavy fillings has made the  middle part inside of cake soggy. Took a long time to defrost in room temperature the finish overall on the cake design and spreading of buttercream on the whole cake could have been done with better care for presentation.

records.title: Shambolic
records.text: The Mall Bristol. Shambolic, we ordered 2 coffees and two meals the coffees arrived relatively quickly. After a 20 minute wait one meal arrived and a further 10 minutes for the second.  The food was cool and my Croque  was soggy underneath and the French fries were cold and scrappy.  The couple next to us had ordered before us and were still waiting when we left.  Fully understand that Christmas is a busy time, but it really was awful.

records.title: Lacking in cherry filling…
records.text: We have had your Black Forest gateaux before but this one was distinctly lacking in cherries. I bought it as a birthday cake for a Black Forest lover and this really failed to hit the mark this time, more like a chocolate cake due to the lack the advertised dark cherry filling. I may as well have bought something from the Tesco freezer department than spend this on something that did not deliver.

records.title: Damaged and broken cake.
records.text: Damaged and broken cake.Ordered a chocolate forest fantasy cake for my daughters 18th. Arrived the day before with all the decorations smashed. They tried to blame dpd, but the broken parts weren't even in the box so it was decorated like it before dispatch. Extremely disappointed and upset and have to find a replacement on the day of my daughters birthday

records.title: Gone to pot try others

records.title: Sadly a disappointing birthday treat
records.text: Went for an afternoon tea which was bought on an offer Service was good but disappointed in the offering of sandwiches which had very dry chicken chunks, and almost no cheese spread on cheese and cucumber fingers. Egg Mayo slapped on a small bun which had to be scooped up with a spoon   Scones were rock hard.  Cakes were ok. I would have complained but my companion who bought the voucher for me as a birthday treat would have been even more embarrassedThe choice of fillings on offer could have been  advised and would have been helpful  The scones had been over reheated Unacceptable

records.title: Disappointing birthday treat
records.text: order for several cakes costing £80 arrived on time, seurely packed and able to be frozen. Unpacked, they looked impressive but proved a huge disappointment when eaten. Far too sweet, texture of sponge stodgy, piping synthetic and totally lacking in flavour. Shall not order from Patisserie Valerie again.Stella Nicholls Milford Haven

records.title: Disappointing.
records.text: I have emailed my disappointment.Cake didn't taste of any of the flavours described.Delivery good and it looked amazing ....but no taste . Such a disappointment on a special day .Also was expecting helium balloons as depicted but that may well be my error.I have had a response saying sorry and something about taste being subjective. Very poor considering the cost of the cake and that four people eating it all thought the same . Would expect a little more ..who knows I could actually be correct . Has anybody else had the espresso martini cake ?

records.title: Disappointed and dry
records.text: Ordering was easy. I paid £32 + £7 delivery fee for a biscof 6 serving cake for my son’s 21st birthday. So much so we needed custard to moisten the biscof cake as no time to arrange a different cake. Huge disappointment meant for a very special occasion. I

description:
Based in Manchester, Delivering Nationwide
Nationwide Cupcake Delivery
We now have an online shop specialising in cupcake delivery, so everyone in the UK can have a treat from Candy's Cupcakes.
Using our cupcake delivery service your order will arrive intact, beautifully packaged, ready to eat and will last up to 1 week. We also include a free gift tag for you to leave a personal message.
Simply place your order online before 3pm and have your cupcakes delivered the next day by our specialist fragile courier. 
Local Cupcakes & Cakes
Wanting something more bespoke? We create amazing cupcakes, wedding cakes and birthday cakes, delivering throughout Greater Manchester and Cheshire. Our cupcakes and cakes are made to order and can cater to your imagination.
Candy's Cupcakes caters for:
- Weddings
- Corporate events
- Birthdays
- Christenings / Baptisms
- Special occasions
Whether you want a five-tier wedding cake for your special day, branded cupcakes for a corporate event, a unique birthday cake for a one to one hundred year old, or you just fancy some cupcakes for the weekend. Candy's Cupcakes can create something special and memorable just for you.

records.title: Great cakes and consistent service
records.text: Ordered some cupcakes for relatives ahead of arriving for Christmas and they were delivered perfectly intact, on time, and were delicious. We've used Candy's Cupcakes on two occasions for ourselves and each time has been a doddle, and the cakes were also delicious. Will no doubt be ordering again.

records.title: Many occasions
records.text: Have ordered birthday, Halloween cup cakes this year then the Christmas cake absolutely lovely they are , will continue to order and always delivered on time

records.title: First time buyer and I have to say…
records.text: First time buyer and I have to say these cupcakes were yummy! Definitely be ordering from these again in the future ❤️

records.title: All Good
records.text: Slight problem with content on delivery but again delivered on the day and the time so will order again.

records.title: The cakes were amazing they were…
records.text: The cakes were amazing they were demolished straight away. DELICIOUS! Thank you I will be ordering again next month.

records.title: Absolutely brilliant 🤩
records.text: Absolutely brilliant 🤩 I wanted some gluten free cupcakes as a present for a friend and Candys Cupcakes delivered in every way - they were absolutely delighted with them, so much so they didn’t want to eat them because they were so pretty to look at 😂 Will definitely be purchasing from you again! Thankyou so much!

records.title: Lovely treat boxes
records.text: Lovely treat box for a vegan me and a celiac Mum, we usually we never have good home made type treats or this kind and miss out. The boxes are lovely with decent amount and hit the spot. Would recommend and will buy again - happy customer thank you 😌

records.title: Worth every penny!
records.text: I order from Candy’s Cupcakes several times a year, and it’s always top quality cupcakes. Always delicious, always great looking. I’ll order some more soon. Worth every penny.

records.title: Used them several times **Excellent
records.text: Used them several times - always amazing cupcakes delivered on time and in perfect condition

records.title: Perfect, delicious, great value and amazing service 😀
records.text: What can I say, amazing service,  the most delicious cakes, and I can not wait to order from the fantastic Candy's Cupcakes again.

records.title: Good product not good delivery
records.text: The cupcakes were lovely but I ordered on the 17th for delivery on 19th and they arrived on 21st. It was for a 50th birthday on 20th so really disappointed they missed the date. I thought requesting delivery a day early would be sufficient, it should be made clearer that delivery times are very approximate.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, reasonable prices. Varied menu. I had a selection of 4 flavours carrot, chocolate, red velvet and lemon. Out of the four the Lemon was simply divine, moist not sweetly over powering. The other three were slightly on the dry side and the butter icing on the red velvet was too sweet. Despite these issues, I would still recommend this company

records.title: Amazing and delicious
records.text: My daughter took these to school to celebrate her birthday with her friends. Everyone said they looked amazing and tasted delicious. My only small issue is the handling during delivery. I witnessed the driver holding the box under his arm so maybe 4 of the cupcakes had lost some toppings. The box was labelled but he didn’t know they were cakes so probably didn’t handle with care.

records.title: Cake tasted amazing but…
records.text: Cake tasted amazing but the cake topper was all ripped so I had to remove it and buy a new one.

records.title: Cupcakes tasted great & arrived really…
records.text: Cupcakes tasted great & arrived really quickly! Unfortunately the background colour on the logo topper was off, it was far too light making it difficult to see the business logo clearly which affected the overall impact, unsure if this was an issue with the image provided or the printing, but they did taste very good.

records.title: Lovely cakes
records.text: Had several orders from Candys and they are always lovely and fresh. I had photo uploaded ones this time and the only thing I would say on this occasion is the photo itself was a little bit pale and not very bright. Otherwise very tasty 😋

records.title: Tasty cupcakes but terrible delivery service from DPD
records.text: The only thing that stopped me from giving 5 stars is the delivery service.  DPD did not deliver on Friday as expected and lied about not getting an answer when they rang.  They never came to the door as I was home, waiting for the parcel. I called their customer service & they promised they would re-attempt the delivery - never happened. My hubby (the recipient of what was meant as a surprise) ended up having to pick them up from the post office on Saturday.Once we got them, they were tasty and hubby enjoyed them but the whole delivery saga really put a damper on the experience.

records.title: My husband is Gluton free
records.text: My husband is Gluton free, i have found with Candy's cup cakes i can order delicious cakes beautifully made and presented and very carefully packed, they keep fresh for a number of days, but actually , they never last very long!Thank you Candy's cupcakes !Sandie

records.title: Overall great experience!
records.text: All cupcakes looked great, were personalised to how we requested, and were delivered on time. Thank you for your prompt action!My one bit of feedback would be that sometimes it was difficult to getting touch - often I would call and I would hear a voicemail saying the mailbox was full, and email reply rates could have been a bit faster for such a short deadline.Regardless, the purchase of these cupcakes was successful, and the plan was well executed.

records.title: Online ordering needs tweaking...
records.text: I ordered the cupcakes as a thankyou to some friends who'd really helped us out during a medical emergency. Having typed in the recipients name and address, the payment section insisted on having the same billing address as the recipient for the credit card I was trying to use. I got around this by using Paypal but ever since then the company thinks I am both the buyer and the receiver.  Annoying. I gather the cupcakes were nice but a picture of them would have been nice, so that I could see what was sent.

records.title: cupcakes were delicious but got squashed
records.text: The cupcakes were delicious and the booking process and emails from the company were excellent. (I’d booked wrong day originally and swapped no problem) I ordered two boxes of six which were delivered in a box packed on top of each other. The bottom 6 vegan roses were completely crushed. Would order again but just one box of six at a time.

records.title: Cupcakes ok, but packaging to be improved
records.text: Found what I needed and ordering was straightforward. I was a bit disappointed with the packaging though, as my cupcakes arrived squashed and that ruined their appeal. There are shipping boxes that allow for the shape of cupcakes to be protected, so not sure why the company uses paper to cushion them instead. The taste was not great either, but that is to be expected with free-from everything food...

records.title: Wonderful cupcakes
records.text: Wonderful cupcakes, the pastry was deliciously most and flavourful, the little battenberg slices - amazing. I'd say I wasn't too keen on the frosting, I guess buttercream isn't for me.

records.title: Cupcakes were amazing (esp chocolate…
records.text: Cupcakes were amazing (esp chocolate sponge)! Not a five star as however out of Candy’s Cupcakes control (courier company) cupcakes arrived a day later than requested. Luckily I gave an extra day incase so had them in time for the event!

records.title: Cakes were lovely and greatly…
records.text: Cakes were lovely and greatly enjoyed-great cakes However experience ruined by courier probkemCourier delivery was rubbish-delayed when needed for guests then delivered to another house and road -which i had to track  down while feeling unwell so spoilt the experience

records.title: Purchased cakes as gifts x 2
records.text: Purchased cakes as gifts x 2,  unfortunately the details of an offer used was labelled on the boxes,(ie 2 free cookies with 6 muffins)…made the experience disappointing (for both sender and recipient).Contacted the company who stated that is what they do (easier packing) and this has not been raised by customers before….i would suggest that’s perhaps because customers don’t know! (recipients of gifts may not wish to wish to embarrass them). Certainly wouldn’t send as gifts again.  (Other online companies remove prices/offers from gifts).

records.title: Unfortunately didn't arrive on time…
records.text: Unfortunately didn't arrive on time despite booking delivery for the day before the event date.  Arrived pretty late in the afternoon of the actual day event.  I didn't see them as I'd had to leave the event before arrival.

records.title: Got 6 Valentine cupcakes and they were…
records.text: Got 6 Valentine cupcakes and they were beautifully presented and packaged and delivered on time but was disappointed by the cakes flavour. They were fresh but not tasty, there was no filling just dry cakes and the topping was more like icing than buttercream. Maybe my expectations were too high but l thought they would be absolutely delicious.

records.title: Disappointed this time
records.text: Disappointed this time.  Had cake/cupcakes previously & been delighted hence why I ordered again.  This time not delivered on the date requested, some cupcakes weren’t sat in the holders as they should have been, icing messy & cases peeling away from cakes.  Taste was good but presentation was poor.  Appreciate some of this may be down to delivery company but Candy’s choose to use Parcelforce who held it at there depot for over 24hrs.

records.title: Food ok, service could be improved
records.text: Cupcake's icing were a little smooshed when they arrived, but tasted good. The response time for service wasn't great, hence the lower score. Making changes immediately after order was 'not possible' and caused great inconvenience to me. The response from the company below is disappointing and does not accurately reflect the situation. They did not bother responding to me until the later next day, which is what my service score is about. Clearly, if you give an honest review they get nasty.

records.title: Cupcakes not delivered
records.text: Ordered the cupcakes well in advance of my daughter’s birthday to make sure they arrived in time. US student studying in the UK so I really want them to arrive on the correct day. Received an email on the delivery day saying the could not be delivered. The cakes were eventually delivered but not on the day requested.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Arrived on time. Disappointed in packaging of the actual cupcakes, they need to be securely in place and they weren't.  Felt they looked a bit tacky, to be honest. Red Valentine rose cupcakes - didn't really resemble a rose and combined with the brightness of the red icing, they just looked cheap.

records.title: Mother’s Day offer
records.text: I ordered the Mother’s Day cupcakes with cake in a box. The cakes are lovely however I ordered these items within a timescales where my order was eligible for the 2 cookie pies. My order was updated and I received the email confirmation. On delivery day I received my order successfully however no cookie pies. Feel duped! I messaged via Instagram and email and no response or apology.

records.title: Ok but could have been better.I was very pleased to find a cupcake…
records.text: I was very pleased to find a cupcake supplier who could cater for both dairy and gluten free. The icing was delicious, the cake maybe a little dry. The main problem was that the delivery driver did not wait for us to answer the door which would have taken all of an extra minute. He then dumped the box on its side - despite it being clearly marked with this way up arrows and fragile. Several of the cakes fell out of their slots and the icing was smudged, spoiling their appearance. As they were ordered for a special family birthday party I was disappointed.

records.title: Perfect Cupcakes - Not great cake
records.text: The cupcakes were perfect and delicious. The slab cake was quite dry (we ate it within 4 hrs of delivery and kept it boxed until we cut it up). The box was also quite wet from the ice pack which meant the box had collapsed and squashed the top of the cake a bit. Probably needed more care in the delivery and a better solution for the cooling element that a wet ice pack.

records.title: Order the 4 cakes in a box 2 chocolate…
records.text: Order the 4 cakes in a box 2 chocolate 2 red velvet.Chocolate and buttercream on both were amazing I didn’t find the red velvet had any flavour to it, was okay just didn’t taste of red velvet to me.I will buy again just not red velvet.I will say as well I found them through TikTok and just said on one video I’d ordered and was excited to try and even though I said three times I don’t watch lives was told 4 times to let them know on  a live what I thought within the space of 10 minutes was annoying so I did just unfollow and delete the comment so they would stop telling my the times they were live and to tell them what I thought by watching their live.That and the red velvet having no taste was why 3 stars given

records.title: Chocolate cupcakes topped with vanilla cream and M&M
records.text: The service has always been top notch.I ordered chocolate cupcakes topped with vanilla cream and M&M candies. Cream on top of cupcakes was delicious. Chocolate  cake part could have been a tad less bitter to be enjoyable.

records.title: Product was excellent.Very Tasty
records.text: Product was excellent.Very Tasty. Photos were re created and very funny. However delivery was messy and more instruction and information for the driver maybe should be considered. Parcelforce let you down.

records.title: Didn't arrive on the day requested
records.text: Didn't arrive on the day requested, was ordered for a special occasion, jars were a lot smaller than the ones I have previously ordered, cake was dry and not as good as it used to be, will not be ordering again

records.title: The website is deceitful
records.text: The website is deceitful. All the way through the purchase it shows one price however after they have taken payment an additional £12 is charged for postage. At no point was this clear until payment had been taken. £13 for 4 bits of cake was pricey anyway but I had though this included postage,  but then an additional £12 on top totally unannounced was deceitful.After submitting this review I get an email from Candy’s cupcakes saying my review was malicious. It wasn’t, it was my experience.

records.title: AVOID
records.text: If you ever receive your cakes and they are what you ordered they taste delicious. However, if they don’t arrive or the order is incorrect (which is likely) don’t expect any help or compensation from Candice. Terrible customer service with no pride in delivering exactly what customer ordered and paid crazy money for.

records.title: Arrived on time but broken
records.text: The cupcakes we ordered arrived on time but were completely smashed up, not ideal to give out at a children’s party. Perhaps they need to be packaged differently? Such a shame as it was great to find somewhere doing good-looking dairy- and egg- free cakes for those with allergies. The cakes also weren’t enjoyed much by the children I’m afraid. However the children with allergies very happy to be catered for.

records.title: Looked better than they tasted
records.text: The cakes arrived on time and looked stunning however they were so dry . I did contact the company the next day as they are fairly expensive and I really was not happy . I did give them the opportunity to offer a refund or simply a gesture but sadly not . At £5 a cupcake I expect excellent quality not a cake that tasted a few days old .sadly the company offered nothing other than a sorry

records.title: Arrived late and dry.
records.text: I ordered some doughnuts through Candy’s Cupcakes for my partners 30th. It was supposed to arrive on Fri 29th Sept and I received a text saying it was going to arrive that afternoon. The package did not arrive as I have a ring door bell. It did however get delivered today and sadly they aren’t fresh even though stating fresh for a week. Sadly won’t be ordering from here again as I’d messaged them and had no reply. Would not recommend.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Was very disappointed as the order was for a special birthday and arrived a day late as sent to wrong depot.  When I questioned it only then I received an apology and told the order would stay fresh for 5-7 days and that unexpected delays happen from time to time! Disappointing customer service and wouldn’t use again.

records.title: The butter cream is way to sweet and…
records.text: The butter cream is way to sweet and sickly,thick fresh cream would have been a perfect combination,i understand that it would have a shorter best before date,but I  would have eaten it all.I will have to throw mine away as like I said above its way to sweet

records.title: A few things didn’t meet expectations
records.text: A few things didn’t meet expectations.  Unfortunately I found the cake sponge quite dry and crumbly. I have had the cup cakes before and they were lovely but was disappointed that the cake wasn’t as good, especially as it was a special birthday. The candle that came with the cake was stuck in the icing and when you removed it some of the gold coating came off and was stuck in the cake. Not great as it isn’t edible and then you have a candle that is only half gold. The butter cream was lovely though.

records.title: Someone else's order delivered
records.text: I put an order in to be delivered next day, on my daughter's leap day birthday, with a personal message from us. She did receive cakes but it was not my order. The message was for someone else and from someone else, also they were not the correct cakes. I tried to use the online chat but it turned out to be out of hours and it said that an email would be sent with my message on. When I didn't get a reply the next day I emailed them directly to try and get a solution. They responded with no apology to say that another lot would be sent. She did receive the correct cakes 2 days later and without our message.

description:
At SaveCo our mission is to become the region's foremost online delivery service of the freshest groceries, HMC-certified halal meat and everyday household items. With over 30 years experience in our field, we endeavour to achieve this through impeccable customer service, uncompromising quality and an unwavering commitment to the most important people to us - YOU the customer.

SaveCo Online is the e-commerce arm of SaveCo Group - a third generation independent family business within the retail and wholesale food distribution sectors.

SaveCo supply both household and retail customers with the finest, freshest and most cost effective produce, spices, ingredients and staple products within the world foods market as well as HMC-certified halal meats through it's subsidiary The Meat Company Bradford.

The company serves both retail and trade customers in a competitive marketplace and is well renowned for high levels of quality and service.

records.title: Services at saveco

records.title: Saveco Shopping Experience in November 2024

records.title: Excellent Service.

The shop as a whole is very clean and hygienic. Also, the customer service is excellent every time especially the cashier Shabnam.

records.title: Been coming to saveco for 5 yrs and…
records.text: Been coming to saveco for 5 yrs and love doing big shops for meat and pulses . Fresh fruits and veggies its like a one stop shop for groceries..  an find all the Pakistani snacks .. so highly recommend. Recently started doing online deliveries aswell.. can’t recommend enough. All this coming from a loyal customer. Shabnam has been absolutely fantastic serving me every visit.

records.title: Absolutely great service, friendly and respectful staff and clean environment
records.text: I go to saveco nearly every week as their meat/chicken is so clean and fresh. The staff at the meat counter are always really respectful and helpful!I have been served thrice by Shabnam at the main tills and she is honestly the most helpful person. I am heavily pregnant and the first time she packed my bags for me before I even realised she was doing so, the second time she offered as I was holding my toddler but I was happy to pack myself. So she instead entertained my toddler through lovely conversations.

records.title: Great Customer employee service
records.text: Great Customer employee service. I was happy to find approachable and friendly customer support when in need. Would recommend the Bradford branch Shabnam and Mahejbin as well as the security guard were very nice :)) sorry Lose a star for sus parking

records.title: Very good customer service after an initial bad one.
records.text: 21/12/2024 - After posting my original review, the company got in touch with me to apologise and explained that the person I had been emailing was on annual leave. That explains why they were not replying back. However, an out of office would have prevented this misunderstanding in the first place.It took a few calls with the company representative to explain what had happened and how they can make things right, with quite a bit of back and forth. In the end, they sent me a larger pack of the missing item as way to remedy things. This interaction has made things right for me and I would be now be satisfied to order from them again.27/11/2024 - (original review) Order delivered with missing items. They are not replying to emails regarding this. Have tried contacting them many times.

records.title: Lovely meat counter
records.text: Good for different types of products, not always the most competitive prices though. Nice meat counter clean meat Brilliant service from shabnam at the tills served my mum and me

records.title: Overall great experience and adding so much value to my monthly grocery shopping.

records.title: Simple and convenient!

I found his tone dismissive, and he seemed even more annoyed when the gift card I presented was not immediately recognised by the system. I know it's busy, and staff are under pressure, but courtesy costs nothing, and very much affects the way people feel about their visit. I feel disappointed, and will not be hurrying back.

The current replacements are ok but don’t seem to know their wines or recommend or do anything with flair. Luckily, I know what I want. The days of Johnny ringing me to tell me of a bin-end of good claret, reasonably priced, are long gone, so I fear is the magic of Majestic (since the Naked Wines disaster) - now no different from Waitrose Cellars or Sainsburys

The downside is very limited parking and if the handful of spaces are full there is nowhere else to park so you turn round and go home.I’ve ordered for home delivery before but the last time there was a problem with payment meaning my card was blocked. The account  section of the website is very poor and having just had another go have decided to leave it.Have you thought about using Shopify which is brilliant. records.title: They don’t offer tastings when you go in of already opened wine when you are spending.
records.text: The sales experts have Good knowledge. I spend a fair amount of money ordering 6-12 bottles a time. But i notice when i go in. I never get offered what they have for tasting. After all how do they expect to sell new wine if they can’t offer an already opened bottle for a taste…

records.title: A new Majestic outlet in Crouch End
records.text: A new Majestic outlet in Crouch End! Walking distance from home and an overdue replacement for the defunct Oddbins. The annoying locked door involving a “shall-we-let-this-person-in” procedure is I guess a symptom of the times, although it immediately makes you feel that you have to justify your presence, unlike say next door Waterstones where you can browse aimlessly.  Visually the store is a sensation - great lighting, cool on-trend colours, the ambience is spot on. It’s a destination! My gripe is not about the quality of wine, that seems pretty excellent but the quality of the sales assistants. Its 50-50 as to whether you are met by someone really helpful or someone who is arrogant and downright rude. In the latter case the attitude seems to be “I’m far too clever and overqualified to be here, wasting my time serving, I should not be dealing with someone who can’t even pronounce “Viognier” correctly - now get out”.On one occasion (not the Crouch End branch) I ordered six bottles of white plus a 20-year-old port, the assistant proceeded to cut a hole in the top of the wine box and ram in the upside-down bottle of port like it was a nail.I do not like the “do we have your profile” question (euphemism for your sales history). Why can’t they just say “your details”. As the postcode is typed in you can sense them sneering at the paucity of orders on the largely blank screen. No further eye contact with you Sir!Maybe I should get out less, decouple myself from the retail experience and order online.

records.title: Great store, terrible delivery
records.text: Love the store and the wine. However as they were out of stock for the wine I wanted I ordered online and chose “nominated day delivery” for Monday. Yodel finally delivered on Thursday…This is really not good enough.

records.title: Alluria Pinot Grigio Terre Siciliana in…
records.text: Alluria Pinot Grigio Terre Siciliana in a box - tastes wrong and not at all pleasant. Will try to use it for cooking.

records.title: Staff are helpful
records.text: Staff are helpful; but I resent them pestering me for name and address when I buy wine. Majestic sell me wine- I give them money. That’s the deal.

records.title: Some issues with staff at Tenterden branch which spoilt experience
records.text: I used Majestic Wine Tenterden for my wedding earlier this month and on the whole we had decent service. Good wines, an excellent tasting session in the Brighton branch, free delivery and free glass hire. Things to mention is that they do not pick the glasses up and they need to be returned clean - this can make for quite a stressful day after the wedding.The main reason they lost stars however was one rude employee when dropping the glasses back. It's a £1 per glass deposit which you should get back when you return them clean - for the number of glasses required for a wedding that is a lot of money and a big task for the next day but we did it in a timely manner. This employee tried to give us grief due to water damage to the extremely poor quality cardboard boxes that the glasses came in and refused to return £50 of our deposit due to that damage even though the glasses had been returned clean. Basically charging £12 per damaged box saying they could not use the glasses that were in them - although they were happy to keep all those glasses anyway. This was clearly ridiculous - she was rude and unreasonable and we just went round in circles with the argument so I left.On emailing the branch a more reasonable member of staff refunded us the money so it was all resolved pretty quickly which I appreciate. However, it did add an unnecessary amount of stress to what was already a busy and stressful day when we were desperately trying to hold onto some of the joy from the day before. And I needed to email and call them to organise the refund whilst on honeymoon. When planning a wedding I cannot emphasise enough the importance of good communication and smoothness of the providers - people being kind, understanding and reasonable goes a huge way when you're dealing with so many providers for such a big event. Unfortunately, even though the service was provided, some of that smoothness and communication was lacking and for that reason I probably wouldn't recommend them for use at a wedding or large, stressful event. I hope that they can provide some training to their staff to ensure that they treat their customers better and that they are better representatives of Majestic Wines.

records.title: Dementing Website.
records.text: The real live experience would be a 5+ but the website experience is most definitely a minus, hence my miserable mark. Don't waste a MOMENT on the website, would be my advice - it's just awful unless you are ordering to your own home and never want to send a present or to anywhere else.  Even the poor staff on the telephone can't get the brute of a site to work properly - by the time you've grappled with the system, you'll need enough booze to anaethetise you and I can only imagine that this is the intention.  Great staff, great selection, THE WORST website.

records.title: Great value wine and fizz, but…

And so we went elsewhere. Such a shame when the order was guaranteed if the wine tasted ok. Hopefully this comment will be taken as constructive criticism and a way to move forward with the business.

records.title: Poor online ordering experience
records.text: I've been a Majestic customer for many years. I lost my local one and now do occasional orders over the internet for delivery. I ordered some items on the website on Wednesday for Christmas.The first issue I noticed during the ordering process was a default selection on an "accept substitutions". I certainly didn't want any for my wine and I missed unticking the default of yes the first time I was preparing my order. That needs to either be more clear or have a default of no. I can see other people ordering some beer for an unimportant event might want this, but I don't. I think some sites offer per product substitution.The order acknowledgement email appeared with a vague delivery date range of 1st to 6th. I thought checking my account on the website would help narrow this down but that gave and still gives "We're sorry, an unexpected error occurred" if I view my order.I phoned the shop once and they said it was due to go out on Friday. It's Friday and I haven't received any emails or SMS to tell me to expect a delivery. I called them again (Friday 3pm) just to check it was on its way - it is so I just had to wait around at home.Just after 5pm the delivery turned up. The delivery guy had already spotted one bottle was missing, fortunately. Unfortunately, I've now go to hang around for another day for the missing bottle.I like Majestic but this isn't a great ordering/delivery experience. This low standard might have been common 30 years ago but it isn't acceptable anymore, more so for a high value delivery. I like that I can phone them and speak to someone quickly but it's not always efficient and it would be nice if the website just worked so I didn't need to do that. If there were delivery notifications the day before and on the day that would be useful.There were also 2 out of stock bottles on a mix-six offer. It would have been good to have some way to efficiently order those as part of my order. All of this is a cue to try elsewhere next time.

records.text: I ordered 2 cases of wine: the 15 bottle Australian Reds mix and Argentinian Malbec mix.In both instances the case that arrived was substantially different from that advertised.The Australian case should have included 2 bottles each of Black Duck Durif and McPherson Full Fifteen and 3 bottles of another wine that I could not identify from the brochure picture - none of these were included. Instead there was an extra bottle of Black Stump and 3 bottles each of Shot in the Dark and Red Heads Good Shiraz.After ringing customer services I was sent 3 bottles of Full Fifteen which apparently had come back into stock.The Argentina Malbec case should have included 3 bottles of The Waxed Bat but instead I received an extra bottle of Arquero and 2 extra bottles of the J Opi wine - making 5 in all.While I can understand the need to occasionally substitute one wine out of a case, such wholesale changes to both cases without and explanation or compensation seems to me to indicate a rather cavalier approach to customers.

description: You Pick We Mix deliver the nations favourite sweets straight to your door

records.title: Yummy!
records.text: I love their sweets they are always fresh and squishy! The packaging is luxurious, they do take a while to arrive so order in advance.

records.title: Advent calendar..kids loved it.
records.text: Excellent fast delivery and great calendar thanks

records.title: I recently ordered 2x 1kg bags of pick…
records.text: I recently ordered 2x 1kg bags of pick ’n’ mix. Not only are the sweets really lovely and totally delicious but your service was VERY quick. I received them the day after ordering which blew me away. Thank you for offering such a fab service and so easy to do. Your website is brilliant, so easy to navigate (I’m a web designer) 🤩Will defo be orferinv again 🐽

records.title: Best pick n mix!
records.text: I don’t know if it’s even possible but this is literally the best and freshest tasting pick n mix I think I have actually ever had! Great packaging too, but the variety and quality of the sweets were amazing, thank you

records.title: If you are looking for the best
records.text: If you are looking for the best, you have come to the right place. The sweet were lovely & so fresh 😍.Good product, arrived earlier than promised . Will definitely buy again.

records.title: Pretty darn great, but...
records.text: Ordered two scoops of yellow bellied gummy snakes (among other selections) and only got two snakes in the bag... But otherwise no complaints whatsoever! Chocolate jazzies are great and the gummy worms are a new favourite 🤤 delivery was prompt and sweets are pretty good value for money

records.title: Super tasty,quality sweets to your door...the pick and mix of the future
records.text: Very yummy gummy sweets....super fast delivery,packaging recyclable and ordering system a doddle.Purchased for gifts a few times now and also for myself and my husband to take to the cinema instead of getting pick and mix as the quality and freshness of the sweets is by far better and the price is good too.Would definitely recommend and will be a return customer 👍

records.title: Superb
records.text: From the point of ordrering right through to delivery the service was exeptional. Then the sweets, well what can i say. Best pick and mix, so fresh only trouble is we couldnt stop once starting. Superb 100 %

records.title: Bought one of the £13.99 bags that you…
records.text: Bought one of the £13.99 bags that you pick yourself end of January and reached out to them after not receiving anything. Responded very quickly via email and I had replacement in days. In touch with Bose regarding similar issue with headphones and they could learn a thing or two about customer care from this small company.

records.title: Great sweets at reasonable price
records.text: All the sweets that I ordered came and the packaging was realy good as they came in glass jars and bottles and they went down a treat with the boys

records.title: Good sweets good mix pay for what you…
records.text: Good sweets good mix pay for what you get arrived on time

records.title: Made a great first impression.
records.text: Being the first time I've ever used this company I have to admit I'm very impressed, the delivery was really fast and the products are great. Not only did my selection arrive in a sealed packet, it's re-sealable and recyclable.I would have given five stars but the box my sweets arrived in had been a little squashed in transit and the padding was just some brown paper that didn't offer any real protection. Not that it impacted the quality or taste of the sweets, they were awesome, just a little misshaped.

records.title: I got these from the very me app…
records.text: I got these from the vodaphone app as a discount otherwise I feel it is quite expensive to pay. They are tasty but quite sweet and one was gelatine which didn't realise for vegetarians so that is a shame.

records.title: Sweets are really nice
records.text: Sweets are really nice! Delivered super quick, and the size of the bag was much bigger than I thought, very generous with the amount of sweets and taste really good! Only thing that disappointed me was that the sweets were layered in the pack rather than mixed so all cola bottles were at the bottom, the all strawberries, then bonbons so could reach to different sweets. Apart from that they are great sweets!

records.title: Alternatives I didn't like.
records.text: Any alternatives should have been chosen from items I'd only ordered one of, rather than one I hadn't chosen at all. At least it could be assumed that I liked what I'd ordered. It could also be assumed that perhaps I didn't like items that I hadn't ordered.

records.title: Honest feedback, 3.5 ☆ , 1Kg bag.
records.text: Honest feedback - 3.5 stars.5/5 for communication and updates, I knew exactly when the parcel was coming, really helpful.5/5 for ease of use. I knew exactly what I was getting and how much I was being charged and the site is very easy to use.3/5 for mix. The product had just been put into the bag in the order i picked in, there was no real "mix" to it..had to put it into a separate container and mix it myself which is kinda disappointing when other companies who offer the same thing seem to actually mix your selection before bagging it up. 3/5 for taste. I had about 13 varieties of sweets and unfortunately a fair few of them are the "cheap" tasting versions. The fizzy cherries and dummies for example weren't like the classic haribo versions at all.  The rest however were very pleasant and there was a large amount of each sweet. Also, review aside, 1KG is *a lot* of sweets, like, I dont think you realise how much. Be 100% certain you'll eat them all otherwise its a waste. :')

records.title: Came quickly and almost correct
records.text: Came quickly and almost correct. However there were wine gums in it which I hadn't selected and I think fizzy raspberry sticks were missing.

records.title: I'm constantly craving the sweetness of…
records.text: I'm constantly craving the sweetness of the candies from this store. The variety of flavors available, from traditional favorites to exotic blends, keeps my taste buds delighted.

records.title: Really nice sweets
records.text: Really nice sweets, good delivery time, good quality

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: Despite an initial issue with the delivery, this was addressed quickly and the following customer service was very good.

records.title: Yummy
records.text: Kids very impressed with sweet selection; mumma trying to ignore the lure!

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Good experience order came correct and on time very good.

records.title: They were very yummy sweets,maybe put…
records.text: They were very yummy sweets,maybe put sugary ones at the bottom of pack

records.title: the experience of ordering and the…
records.text: the experience of ordering and the service (rapid dispatch for delivery) were absolutely satisfactory, no problems at all  - the one star less is for the quality of the actual product which was not the highest

records.title: Great sweets that the whole family have…
records.text: Great sweets that the whole family have enjoyed.

records.title: I love ''you pick we mix''
records.text: I love ''you pick we mix'', always fresh and the bag is full to the top. The only slight problem this time was I'd asked for 3 scoops of Halloween mix but there didn't really seem to be much variety or much of it. Like I say only a slight problem. I'd definately purchase again as the bag was still full so definately had extra of other scoops.

records.title: Yummy
records.text: Yummy delivery prompt quality good

records.title: Always my go-to Pick n Mix company but ...
records.text: Always my go-to Pick n Mix company, but the quality of the sweets themselves was a little disappointing this time, particularly some of the fizzy ones (cola bottles, pink and blue bottles, blue bottles). Still great variety, service and delivery :-)

records.title: One of the sweets looks nothing like the picture.
records.text: I’ve ordered from this company a couple of times and always been quite happy as the quality is good and they squeeze a decent amount into the bag. However I’m a bit disappointed with my latest order as one of the sweets I chose looks nothing like the picture on the website and is completely different, and others look discoloured and generally unpleasant. The discolouration is probably not their fault, it’s presumably the perils of shipping food but I’m really disappointed that I selected one thing and got something different. They change their selection all the time, which is fine because I get having stock issues, but at least update the photos of what the sweets are supposed to be.

records.title: 3rd order but disappointed this time
records.text: 3rd order but disappointed this time, quite a few of the sweets were very dry. Will still order again

records.title: Very quick delivery and delighted with…
records.text: Very quick delivery and delighted with the sweets

records.title: Nice sweets let down by delivery
records.text: Nice sweets let down by delivery. I ordered some sweets for the next weekend as family had a long drive, unfortunately it took over 7 days to arrive so missed when I wanted them for. Would of also been a nice touch if they refunded delivery cost when I emailed them to chase up order as delivery estimate wasn’t met.

records.title: Alright
records.text: Delivery and communication were fine. Sweets tasted a bit funny, almost a bit tasteless. Not the taste I expected from this particular sweet, which I have bought from other places many times and hadn’t tasted like this. I ordered a bag of one type of sweet and there were strays of other sweets in the bag.

records.title: Good selection and quick delivery, wrongly picked!
records.text: Good selection and quick delivery. However, I ordered a lot of things in my jar that were not there. I also had lots of sweets and chocolate that I didn’t select that took up around 40% of the jar! For the price you pay for the amount of sweets you would expect them to get the selection almost accurate. However, the sweet quality is very good and the ones actually selected were lovely.

records.title: The sweet are delicious & fresh however…
records.text: The sweet are delicious & fresh however the postman’s van must of have been very hot as my Bon Bons were completely melted all over the other sweet! So I would advise not to order these during warm weather 😆I would just like to update & to make sure my review is not seen as a bad review.  Obviously it couldn’t be help it’s very hot at the moment & I’am still enjoying my sweet very much thank you 😊

records.title: Sweets good, bad packing process
records.text: Sweets good. However bananas over packed . Also, when customers choose their sweets , like myself , we inevitably choose our favourites first and least last. However, this leads to the least favourite sweets at the top of the bag, and the favourite at the bottom. Maybe a bit fussy? However mine were so tightly packed I couldn’t get to the ones I most like at the bottom. Think it would be good to have them mixed up more .

records.title: I’ve shopped before and always been…
records.text: I’ve shopped before and always been happy with the quality of the product. However I ordered before Christmas, I ordered shrimps, they weren’t the normal kind I’ve had over the years. The giant strawberries weren’t the haribo I normally get. As I got these for Christmas I was hugely disappointed as one was for a present. I ended going elsewhere for the quality.

records.title: Hi to whom this may concern
records.text: Hi,I tend to order from you guys on a regular basis but the recent order I received I noticed when I ordered the cherry cola bottles they used to be bigger which I prefer rather than the small ones you sent me,but all in all the quality of the sweets are fantastic I can't fault them

records.title: I found your chocolate sweets fantastic…
records.text: I found your chocolate sweets fantastic 😋 but I really really don't like your fizzy sweets as it seems your using a nasty type jelly as soon as I try chew or bite the sweets they just get stuck to my teeth and fall apart taste is good but the jelly is a no no.

records.title: My first order was out of this world
records.text: My first order was out of this world. Could clearly see through the packet each of the layers of sweets that were chosen. However this time the were all mixed like they had been shaken pre sealing. Upon opening, I counted only 4 strawberry bonbons in the entire bag. I may of been unlucky with whoever picked them this time as my first order was totally different and jam packed full with a good selection of each individual sweet ordered. These sweets are of a good quality though and so fresh. It wouldn’t put me off ordering again.

records.title: Some of the sweets I didn’t ask for and…
records.text: Some of the sweets I didn’t ask for and I only got 3 bananas after asking for 2 portions. There needs to be somewhere we can write about a delivery note! This was sent last week only got in yesterday due to delivery problems.

records.title: They were out of stock of some items…
records.text: They were out of stock of some items and gave 0 notice of this and didn't contact so I could change my order. This is poor for the money you are paying to not receive any option to amend or cancel.

records.title: Great products but customer support not…
records.text: Great products but customer support not as good as should be. I ordered two packs and one was stolen in transit. Not their fault but weren't as helpful as expected when trying to get a new pack.Ordered again and accidentally chose wrong delivery, asked to change and didn't get a response.

records.title: Cheap tasting sweets
records.text: Was so excited to receive my order.Ordered extra milk bottles and milkshakes as they’re my favourite. Unfortunately both were the worst I’ve ever had. Nothing like the originals, more like cheap and wet. Gave the bag to my son after eating a small handful. Very disappointed

records.title: I ordered a kilo of pick n mix sweets…
records.text: I ordered a kilo of pick n mix sweets which took 4 weeks to arrive after emails back and forth. When the sweets arrived they were poor quality. The chocolate nice were far too hard, a lot of the sweets were melted together and all this at a price that wasn't even all that competitive. I think I'll try another site next time

records.title: Didn’t order sweets with sugar on as diabetic but when I received my Punic they were covered in sugar so couldn’t eat most of them
records.text: I ordered Pikmix with out any sugar in my order as I am diabetic when I opened them they were covered in sugar so most of them weren’t eatable for me very disappointed

records.title: First order I placed was correct second bad
records.text: First order I placed was correct This order however the bag was split so some of the sweets were already going hard Out of my chosen sweet I requested 4 scoops of those I reckon I had 2 scoops maximum

records.title: I just think the ratio of sweets didn’t…
records.text: I just think the ratio of sweets didn’t look like what I chose. Also the quality of the sweets has massively decreased since last year. I just don’t think the overall experience was worth it for the cost.

records.title: This was the 4th order I’ve placed…
records.text: This was the 4th order I’ve placed which has always been excellent. However, the quality of the sweets this time was very different.  Completely different, not at all the same, very disappointing. Not worth the hefty price. Usually excellent - this time very poor.

records.title: Didn’t receive what I ordered
records.text: I ordered gummy bears and you didn’t give me gummy bears.I was quite disappointed as the pick and mixes are already quite expensive.However I wasn’t interested in returning the bag because it still had sweets which I wanted.What are you going to do about it?

records.title: This order the sweets tasted really…
records.text: This order the sweets tasted really funny I had to bin  them. As soon as you opened the bag they smelled horrible ? the odour was coming from the plastic of the bag they were in and all the sweets were tainted with that smell.  Don’t think I will order again

description: Serving the first specialty grade Robusta beans on the market, Black Sheep Coffee are proud to be innovators in the coffee industry. With cafes, kiosks and cocktail bars across the globe, come and soak up the vibe and enjoy the perfect cup.

records.title: I ordered a reusable cup as a stocking…
records.text: I ordered a reusable cup as a stocking filler a couple of days before Christmas and had no expectation of it getting here on time due to the late order. It was delivered within a couple of days of ordering and in time for Christmas. It is also very good quality.

records.title: I was served by Aliyah and my drink was…
records.text: I was served by Aliyah and my drink was made perfect and quick with great care to attention and customer service.Thank you!

records.title: My coffee went to my old address and…
records.text: My coffee went to my old address and when I called to enquire, very promptly it was issued to my new address. I was really impressed with the services

records.title: My sister and I visited the station…
records.text: My sister and I visited the station approach Manchester Piccadilly branch today on Sunday 22nd of December.The staff were all warm, friendly, attentive and professional. There was an issue with my Lloyds Bank Gourmet Society 25% discount card and a lovely gentleman named Felix saved the day and said not to worry and he was so kind and gave us the discount. I wanted to buy my sister who was visiting from London over the festive period a coffee and mentioned I get a discount there so we headed to black sheep. Funnily enough I don’t drink coffee but do buy the delicious sandwiches. Felix and your two AMAZING colleagues - THANK YOU BRILLIANT SERVICE WITH A SMILE - HAVE A WONDERFUL FESTIVE BREAK WITH YOUR LOVED ONES!Mr AM

records.title: Loving my Black Sheep Coffee…
records.text: Loving my Black Sheep Coffee subscription.The service is excellent as is the coffee. Also easy to miss a month when we are on vacation.

records.title: Edgware road branch
records.text: So happy you opened on Edgware Road. The staff are great especially RK who is very helpful. The coffee and teas are amazing. The cakes and sandwiches are delicious. Wonderful atmosphere. Thank you !! God bless you.

records.title: Excellent Service
records.text: I visit the Woking branch 4 or five times a week after a walk along the Basingstoke Canal.  Their coffee is excellent (I normally drink tea) and their service is friendly and very efficient.

records.title: My first visit to any coffee shop
records.text: My first visit to any coffee shop, I wanted to buy fresh coffee beans for my De”Longhi machine at home. What an amazing service, coffee beans explained from taste to strength, and even better a free coffee with my purchase. I’ll find it hard to reach this standard. The Robusta Revival is definitely a high quality coffee bean. Thanks to Ary and his team @ Paddington Coffee shop. Lord Declan McAndrew

records.title: Tastes Amazing
records.text: Fantastic tasting coffee.  Always fresh and quick delivery.  Would highly recommend

records.title: Excellent service from Aleks who made…
records.text: Excellent service from Aleks who made sure my mornings are amazing. Great coffee and customer sevice. Would recommend for anyone as choices are great.

records.title: Great coffee on the go!
records.text: This review is solely for the King's Cross Square branch, just by King's Cross station, as i've not visited any other Black Sheep Coffee outlets. The service is always very quick, the the staff are friendly. Good selection of coffee, and they usually have some interesting 'monthly blend' in. Price is a but high, but coffees in London are approaching £5 now just about everywhere! Still I keep coming back, so they are doing something right!

records.title: TALK TO ME! Don't push the screens!
records.text: Totally agree with other comments. I have being going to BS since they opened, their coffee is great, but WHY... when the shop is super quiet I have to use a McDonalds style smart screen to order my coffee? 3 people behind the desk, all waiting.... I literally asked for the coffee and was ushered to the smart screen. Don't we spend too long on screens already? BS, this is BS, make it personal, be different, that is why we seek our your shops over the impersonal competition. Please learn from your success!

records.title: Great new coffee shop in Peterborough
records.text: Visited the new Peterborough branch in the local shopping centre. Good quality coffee, a decent amount of options across hot and cold drinks as well as food, and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. Good to see a different brand out there rather than the typical other three.One thing to improve upon... My wife and I are early 40s and late 30s, respectively. We know how self-service tablets work. I've worked in IT before, she works in tech support. The young staff members seemed to presume because we're not in our teens or 20s we didn't know how they'd work. Was a little patronising, and even after I said we're fine doing it ourselves, I was asked a number of times if I was "okay" and "understood how to order". Other than this, very good and we'll be back.

records.title: Coffee is great
records.text: Coffee is great , if expensive as over £4 for a flat white in a paper cup ! £4.09 to be precise.My huge gripe is that you have to order via a screen with up selling at every opportunity.It took a while and I will not repeat the experience . Really tedious and you charge extra for a ceramic cup , really ? What about your eco credentials? Coffee was great but experience poor and cost extortionate. I won’t be back

records.title: Jubilee Place
records.text: Jubilee Place - favourite location. I actually miss some of the staff there - Bianca, Jenny, Mery, Elma, AJ, Mattia... These guys we magic!!! The coffee is still nice.

records.title: I bought an e-gift card and was…
records.text: I bought an e-gift card and was informed it was out of date hence won’t connect to new app. Was given codes for coffee, cake and food alternatively after contacting customer services. Rather odd when I wanted coffees. Why did you bring out a new app before sorting out the e-gift card situation. Very back to front and totally confusing. Still not fixed many weeks later. Also traded points for a coffee before app was upgraded and it did not transfer over. No reply on that matter to date. New app is very unimpressive.UPDATE:To be fair the problem has now been rectified and as an apology 3 free coffees were added. I’m happy with the conclusion as in my opinion Black Sheep along with Caffè Nero serve the best coffee.

records.title: Like buying coffee from Argos
records.text: Ok. Coffee can only be ordered over a touch screen which depersonalises the experience. It’s a bit like buying coffee from Argos. Coffee itself was nice

records.title: Good coffee bean
records.text: Good system for coffee bean purchases, the merchants can be received on schedule. The quality of coffee bean is good but the price is lower.

records.title: Blacksheep  THE LEGEND
records.text: The whole ambience, customer care service, the beverages and meals are on point.It can give Costa coffee a run from its money if ti decides to expand.

records.title: The quality of my sausage on a roll was…
records.text: The quality of my sausage on a roll was excellent,  tasted fantastic. Coffee piping hot and nice strong flavour. I was a bit unhappy with paying £9 for a medium coffee and small sausage roll but it's nice treat.

records.title: Fast free delivery
records.text: Fast free delivery, great tasting coffee with a serious caffeine kick.... makes the hefty price tag more palatable :)

records.title: Best Coffee Ever
records.text: Out of all the coffee I have tried (and I have tried many brands} I found the  Black Sheep Rebel Decaf the best for its smooth mild taste in a Flat White and on its own in a Lungo or espresso, so a good all round coffee and its decaffeinated as well.

records.title: A New Standard for Coffee
records.text: This coffee is perfectly roasted and the low acidity allows the flavor to come alive in your mouth.

records.title: Robusta Revival Coffee & subscription
records.text: I love the Robusta Revival Coffee & I’m pleased to see the subscription model is more flexible now in terms of number of weeks between deliveries.

records.title: Great coffee!
records.text: Baristas can be slow but the coffee is consistently very good compared to other chains

records.title: New!
records.text: Newly opened a cafe in Guildford. Warm atmosphere and great coffee.

records.title: Loud music being played off workers phone
records.text: Lovely coffee, friendly service but had to turn dining in to dining out as the loud playlist being played off the barista's phone made trying to work impossible.The cafe music was turned off and the loud awful playlist was turned on and blasted out.Had to leave.

records.title: St James Quarter in Edinburgh
records.text: St James Quarter in Edinburghdisappointing!  Very slow service although few customers.  I was not advised that there were differing sizes of flat whites or I would have ordered a smaller one.  Very expensive too.  And no atmosphere.  I would not return.

records.title: This is the one in Queensgate shopping…
records.text: This is the one in Queensgate shopping center Peterborough.The bacon roll is abysmal, wafer thin, anaemic looking slice of bacon and costs almost a fiver, very very bad, the suppliers are completely out of order, I complained and changed it for a salt beef bagel which was much better, the staff who helped me there on Saturday, a young man and two young ladies, were very calm, patient and understanding and did all they could to help, a real credit to the company.The Coffee ☕ is great, I love the coffee, and the cups are cute, my only criticism is the lack of filling in certain products.  Will definitely go again.

records.title: Bland drinks, tasty food
records.text: The coffee and hot chocolate we ordered were very bland. No taste at all. As this is a coffee shop, it was disappointing. The waffles we ordered were fresh and delicious.

records.title: I visited the bluewater branch…
records.text: I visited the bluewater branch yesterday, for the first time and not in any rush to visit again. Two of us ordered cappuccinos which were extremely small for the price and contained more froth than the coffee. One of us had a hot chocolate and although not unpleasant it weren’t what they were expecting. However my daughter had a black Americano which she said was fine!!Overall wouldn’t recommend too expensive for mediocre drinks and service

records.title: Nice coffee / staff not all great
records.text: Nice coffee - variable staff. In the Leeds branch I awaited my usual counter service - in vain - then tried to use the order boards. A faff. Staff rather reluctantly came over and said I’d have to order again. Such a shame as I’ve met some lovely people serving in the mornings which have added to the coffee excellence. I’m not sure if I’ll bother in future.

records.title: Relocated Oxford branch…
records.text: relocated Oxford branch…Except it’s the SLOWEST SERVICE EVER.Staff are not interested in anything happening going on inside the whole place. Customers clearing tables for them it seems.Please leave some wipes near the screens as they are foul.

records.title: Coffee great but iPad ordering impersonal
records.text: Love your coffee but ordering on an iPad is so impersonal. Too many clicks also. You are losing an opportunity to deliver a simple smile and deliver a great customer service by trying to be more efficient. It’s not efficient for the customer though as too much clicks! Shame as I probably choose not to use you if a good alternative close by.

records.title: Good product not so good customer service!
records.text: Visited new Aberdeen Coffee Shop in Union Sq to try it out, liked the idea of screen ordering but was met with one of the most unfriendly staff experiences I’ve came across! They all looked very cool and hip but customer service wasn’t their thing! No smiles, customer engagement when I queried my food been plated instead of takeaway met with a through me stare, no words uttered until she asked a fellow colleague to bag them! Still not a word muttered to me…Such a shame as it all tasted good but the unfriendliness of staff so off putting.

records.title: Beautiful coffee BUT
records.text: Beautiful coffee, visited several times and now have a subscription order to several beans. I do however have one big complaint. Loyalty and online account management is quite bad. Emailed CS over a week ago and have had no response. I would really appreciate someone getting back to me.

records.title: Good food and drink - service could be better.
records.text: My partner and I visited the Windsor branch.The coffee and the food were good quality, however the service could’ve been a lot better. The staff didn’t really acknowledge us as we entered and sort of stood around not saying anything - it wasn’t very clear whether we had to order via the self-service displays or whether we could order directly from the counter.When we received our food, it was served in takeaway packaging despite the fact we were sitting in and we were neither offered plates nor cutlery.There was nothing inherently bad about the experience here but the staff come off as indifferent and aloof.

records.title: Coffee took a week to get to me
records.text: Coffee took a week to get to me. Yes, 2 days of Royal Mail strikes impacted this, but I feel with the advanced warning, alternative arrangements could have been made. Coffee is OK; not very strong and no resemblance to the flavours when having it at an outlet. I know I don’t have a professional set up, but even the aromas are off.

records.title: Your coffee is fantastic but the…
records.text: Your coffee is fantastic but the shipment of cups had some issues. Out of 4 cups and saucers, two saucers came broken. I’m sure the long distance shipping and handlers were partially to blame however the wrapping inside on the larger saucer was minimal.

records.title: Black Sheet St Peter's Square Manchester
records.text: Coffee amazing and staff are lovely but the ordering system is a disaster.  You can pick what time you collect your drink  but it's hardly ever ready.  What's the point!!!  It's a city centre coffee shop right near a tram station....get more machines!

records.title: Lovely products but was quite surprised…
records.text: Lovely products but was quite surprised and disappointed in the fact that, although all correct information for sending to Southern Ireland and paid the appropriate postage. The surprise housewarming gift had an extra charge of over £11 which made the gift very expensive (was over £35) and even MORE embarrassing was the fact the recipient was informed of the extra customs charge/request. I contacted customer service to let them know about the extra charges and suggested that it might be good idea to re-look at postsge to Ireland. All customer services said was that it was beyond their control which I understand but felt it was such a brush off that it has put me off using the company again.

records.title: Coffee from this place is great but the…
records.text: Coffee from this place is great but the food is dismal, i ordered a coffee with a bacon balm and I've never been more disappointed with food from a place. 1 and ½ pieces of bacon on an extremely dry bun for £5! Would not recommend food from this place.

records.title: Soulless and over priced
records.text: You are met by machines to take your order  leaving the place soulless which is the opposite of what coffee shops should be. £3.39 for a regular cup of flavourless coffee. I was hoping for more than the regular high street branches going by their advertising on the shop itself but while leaving the herd behind ... you are left like every other sheep paying too much money for a soulless experience and poor coffee.

records.title: Poor experience from ordering to taste
records.text: First off the order screens, why make it so difficult just to buy a coffee? Then when the coffee came i was very underwhelmed. I ordered a black white and it reminded me of lattes from the local cafe 30 years ago frothy milk with very little coffee.

records.title: Coffee was perfect but service poor at…
records.text: Coffee was perfect but service poor at the Highbury Islington station coffee shop. Got charged twice on my card and had to recoup my charges through my bank as no one from black sheep offered to reimburse me

records.title: Poor customer services experience after…
records.text: Poor customer services experience after terrible in store experience. horrible on screen menu system with no staff to help. Wouldn’t go back there as coffee also wasn’t that good. They put a scalding hot americano in a paper thin cup which was terrible to hold. Clearly no consideration for customers!!

records.title: Disappointing-  Was looking so forward to this coffee…
records.text: Was looking so forward to this coffee spot opening in Guildford. What a disappointment - tables werent clean and weren't cleared for AGES and we were there early on Sunday; toilets not clean- broken seat and no toilet paper! Water jugs with old soggy “herbs” in that should've been refreshed surely? Such small things but that make a HUGE difference  - wont be back in a hurry

records.title: Lacking in many important areas.
records.text: Have constantly tried to give this company the benefit of the doubt, but they just do not address very basic issues and the same things keep happening on visits to their [Chelmsford] store. Things such as running out of certain milk, even first thing in the morning. Poor cleanliness. Slow service and just a general lack of drive for good customer service and experience. There are only so many chances you can give a company. This will no longer be my coffee shop of choice - back to Pret I go. 🤦‍♂️

records.title: Poor customer service.Takeaway clients go first
records.text: Black Sheep has been a favourite.  But Saturday 8 September 2023 it was awful. Placed order but even though only 6 customers in the cafe they kept serving takeaway orders. Place full of guys in helmets waiting for takeaways. Had to wait 25 minutes to be served. Appalling. Customers complaining about being pushed aside while takeaways produced. Guys get a grip. Treat your customers with respect.

records.title: Manchester Peter Square…
records.text: Visited the Manchester Peter Square branch. Coffee good, pastries good but ambiance zero, touch screens to order are awful, loads of staff why are the screens needed surely the whole point of a coffee shop is to feel welcome and enjoy a chat. We left feeling alienated and a bit angry....not the best business model!!

records.title: Good on app, bad in person (Battersea branch)
records.text: I order from here on Deliveroo and it’s great, if a little overpriced.  Visiting in person (Battersea branch) I like that it’s dog friendly, does puppucinos (cute) and had long opening hours.  However I waited 25 minutes and only a third of my order (of three items) was filled.  Thankfully they issue refunds faster than serve food and drink.  Also the music was extremely loud and they have a system where they shout your name to collect your order, which they have to do very loudly to be heard over the music, if at all, so it’s a grating and stressful environment. Even asking for a refund I had to get my face inches away from the barista to be heard.  There are a lot of other coffee shops in the area so they’ll have to improve customer experience and service to stand out.

description:
Beer52 is the UK's most popular craft beer club, based right in the historic heart of Edinburgh, where brewing has a long and rich tradition which we’re proud to be a part of.

 
Each month we send you out a carefully, curated case of the finest craft beers to enjoy - tailored to your tastes and sourced from the best independent microbreweries from around the world. 

 
In a nutshell, we’ve made it our mission to build and foster a community of people who’re just as passionate about craft beer as we are, we’re committed to finding the world’s best craft beers and broadening your beer horizons with some unique and exciting flavour profiles, straight to your door!

 
You’ll get to enjoy a few extra goodies each month too! Come behind the scenes at the world’s most exciting breweries each month with your included issue of Ferment magazine, join us as we travel the world, navigating the exciting world of craft beer, with some snacks for good measure.

 
 
For more information, see our FAQs: https://www.beer52.com/faq


Or if you need to get in touch then please reach out to us via https://www.beer52.com/help


 
Winner of SIBA: Best Independent Beer Retailer of the Year 2016, Winner of Business of the Year 2016 at Startups.co.uk. Winner of Buchanan Awards: Overall Business of the Year 2016 and Growth Business of the Year 2016

records.title: Friendly, relaxed and helpful service
records.text: The person I spoke to to cancel, Andrew, was really friendly and relaxed. He was up front about seeing if he could persuade me to stay but it was very non-pressured which I always appreciate, it makes me more open to hearing the offers. I've always had very good customer service from this company. They do offer really good deals but if you do want to cancel it's easy to do and they don't mess you around at all. (I've left and come back before).

records.title: Staying in the club
records.text: I chatted with Laurie from Wine52 as I thought about ceasing my subscription. Laurie was polite efficient, and crucially not too pushy! She succinctly provided me with the information I needed regarding available vouchers and discounts in order for me to make the decision to continue with the club. Thanks Laurie....good job!

records.title: Nice wine
records.text: Had a great experience of the introductory offer after purchasing an item from another website. I phoned though to cancel my second order as it is a bit expensive. The lady Gillian on the phone was amazing and explained everything to me. Loved her jokes aswell. She is a credit to the company. The wine was nice too

records.title: Discovering Great Beers Made Easy
records.text: I signed up for a beer subscription recently, and it’s been brilliant. The selection each month is a mix of craft beers from independent breweries, and I’ve discovered loads I wouldn’t have tried otherwise. The team was great at sorting everything out too – really helpful and quick to answer any questions. The beers always arrive well-packaged. It’s a bit pricier than buying from the shop, but the quality and variety make it worth it. A great way to explore new beers without any hassle. A big thanks to Daniel for helping me out.

records.title: Spoke to a lovely lady
records.text: Spoke to a lovely lady , had a bit of welcome banter 😊 . Absolutely zero issues with cancelling and no pressure to continue . If I was a drinker ( I stopped 2 years ago) I'd definitely give this friendly company my money

records.title: Beer52 subscription
records.text: Called to make amends to my beer52 subscription settings, after a short amount of time on hold I got through to Elliot.Elliot was great at quickly identifying my issue, helping me make the amends, and then explaining a little bit more about what next steps I need to take.Usually calling a helpdesk is a horrible experience, but talking to Elliot was great!

records.title: Great boxes and fantastic customer…
records.text: Great boxes and fantastic customer service. Ive called on two separate occasions regarding my account and both calls were so friendly and helpful. (Cant remember who I spoke to the first time but most recently was Zing and he was great) Really appreciate it, thank you!

records.title: Very polite, friendly and helpful
records.text: I didn't have to wait too long on the helpline for an answer. Nikesh was incredibly helpful, very friendly and not at all pushy. Though I was tempted to accept a 50% discount rather than cancelling my subscription. Thank you!

records.title: Great Customer Support
records.text: Phoned to manage some matters surrounding our subscription and spoke to Brad. Really helpful, sorted the issue out and also spotted another problem that had gone unnoticed at our end and fixed that into the bargain. Enjoyable light conversation along the way too, customer service done right.

records.title: Really good customer service..
