records.text: Really happy with not only with the quality and flavour of the contents of both of the Beer 52 and Wine 52 subscription boxes, but also how easy it was to speak with a member of the team to discuss my subscriptions, and amending them to have them work for me. I had the pleasure of speaking with Steven who was really lovely throughout our conversation and super helpful too.

records.title: Jilly was good!
records.text: I wasn’t happy with being conned online into a subscription and having to pay £27 without knowing. However, talking to Jilly on the phone made things a bit better. She was polite, charismatic and helpful. If it wasn’t for her amazing customer skills I would have been a lot more angry.

records.title: Dave was a nice guy who almost…
records.text: Dave was a nice guy who almost persuaded me to retain my membership, but I had to remain strong having had a couple of mild heart attacks and being under doctors orders to make some life changes.My only gripe would be that I had to hold the line for 10 minutes for my call to be answered.

records.title: Friendly but pricey
records.text: Friendly, non-pressing customer service chap. Dropped a point for the beer being more pricey than an equally nice selection in the local Waitrose, and that I couldn't cancel my subscription without phoning up which took ages to connect.

records.title: A pleasant and helpful adviser.
records.text: The adviser I spoke to was very pleasant and helpful.I was sorry that I was financially unable to keep my subscription but felt just a little pressured to continue as a subscriber.

records.title: Good experience …
records.text: Easy to mangage your account to change frequency of delivery. I changed from monthly to bi monthly. There is a good mix of beers although I wish there was an option to stipulate the max strength of beer on the order, as some were over 6% which is way too strong for me. The magazine is a great read and nibbles are obviously chosen for taste and quality.

records.title: Great Beer and Customer Service
records.text: Very pleased with this business, enjoyed a box of beer for myself, one for my family and sent one as a Christmas present! No problems with anything at all!One suggestion would be if customers/members would like to cancel their subscription, to do so on the website online, instead of having to wait on hold through calls! However the gentleman I spoke to “Finlay” was a lad, friendly, supportive and seems like a decent guy you’d have a few drinks with! Helped with my queries and solved my problems! Wish nothing but the best for this business and may come back to it one day!

records.title: I spoke with Fraser today to cancel my…
records.text: I spoke with Fraser today to cancel my membership. He was very polite and helpful. I cancelled because I have a backlog of too much beer. The beers I have had were very good.

records.title: Good service but beer just not to my…
records.text: Good service but beer just not to my taste. Appreciate the call with Ollie whilst cancelling, done his best but just not for me. Props to him.

records.title: Customer service
records.text: Called to look at cancelling and spoke to Hayley, very helpful and happy which makes a change when ringing businesses! Very good customer service. Only slight downside was wait time when calling.

records.title: I’m not continuing - but it’s a great product
records.text: I took 3 deliveries/cases. The literature was very informative and the company obviously care about their sourcing and product and I like their values. Some beers aren’t to my taste - but that’s partly the point of trying a variety case. The product is good, well priced and it’s all well managed. I just couldn’t manage getting through the beers and I’m cutting back on my alcohol more widely. Seems odd to recommend something I’ve stopped but I’m pleased with what I had - and if you like to try varied beers with a well organised, fairly priced and thoughtful set up, this beats more mainstream offers hands down.

records.title: Great for trying new beers
records.text: I did a trial pack and enjoyed tasting new beers from other parts of the world. Ferment magazine was great as well. In the end I did not continue my subscription, opting to focus more on traditional Germand and Belgian bottled beers, but I am very tempted to go back one of these days!

records.title: Premium beer and wine - good service mentality
records.text: This is a beer or wine club so it is a subscription and you end up having to call if you want to cancel they do some very good introductory offers and the quality of the product is very good.  Definitely a premium product but you get what you pay for.Although I called just after lunchtime and queued for a while Mia (who was great) made it very easy to cancel, just wanted a bit of quick feedback and I was more than happy to stay on their mailing lists, just wasn't the right deal for me right now.  The subscription is very flexible though.

records.title: Introductory box
records.text: I received an introductory box of 8 light craft beers with snacks as part of another online purchase, and I only had to pay for delivery (£6.95). The beers came quickly and are a great Christmas present. I only wanted this box and not the subscription, so went online to cancel, however you do need to call them to cancel. I think this could be streamlined a bit better, but I understand they are a small business and want to discuss this with you first. I spoke to Ceri and she was helpful, offered me another crate for £13 including delivery, which is half price, however it is still quite pricey so proceeded to cancel which she did with no issues.

records.title: Sterling customer service,  22 carat gold…
records.text: I Had to speak to Wine 52 customer service about an enquiry.  I was lucky enough to speak with Emma Currie who sorted my query out with a professional very friendly manner. She took the time to tell me about the wines I'd recicved in the box and about the company and her time spent with Wine52 it's clear to me she loves working there and is a grear asset to the company.  First Class Customer Service

records.title: Can’t fault the customer service once…
records.text: Can’t fault the customer service once you actually get through! Ceri was polite and helpful.I feel that I was a little duped into having a subscription but maybe I need to scrutinise thing more thoroughly

records.title: Very pleased with my treatment second…
records.text: Very pleased with my treatment second time around. Mark actually listened and engaged with the customer (it and Beer52 would have been 5 stars if I had spoken to Mark first). This caused me to increase the rating from what it was going to be as the person I spoke to before Mark just would not listen and was very pushy.

records.title: Good product but expensive for what it…
records.text: Good product but expensive for what it is without an offer. Ceri helpful on the phone but can’t cancel online and make you sit through 5 minutes of waffle before you can actually speak to someone

records.title: Great products but pricey & way too…
records.text: Great products but pricey & way too many offers make this the greatest hard sell I've ever encounteredIn reply to yours, I did not mean to imply that you are pushy though that is debateable but the deluge of offers was overwhelming

records.title: The beer is great but the cancellation…
records.text: The beer is great but the cancellation process sucks. The good: The Beer selection is great, the orders and the snacks are good. It's a service I enjoy and was pleased to pay for. What could be better: Pricing wise, it's a little steep so I was always having to weigh up if it was something that I could afford. I do believe the service represents value for money, it's just very much on the 'treat' scale for me. The cancellation process is a pain in the Bum. It's clearly designed to send you through several screens with the cancellation button designed to be the hardest option to click. At the end of that journey you are directed to call and speak to an agent, who then tries to persuade you to stay. The agent I spoke to was great, really helpful and quite understanding when I gave my feedback. However, the whole cancellation process took approx 20 mins, which would put me off ever returning, knowing that I have that many hoops to jump through.

records.title: Beware subscription cancelation
records.text: The subscription is a pain to end. Despite their website suggesting 24 hours before the subscription start date to cancel, when you call and eventually get through, the customer service team will tell you it takes 3 DAYS in advance to cancel and there is NO option of returning them for a refund. The drinks are nice and were a perfect Christmas present as the individuals can choose to subscribe themselves in the new year. Just be aware to cancel in advance...

records.title: Product ok, well discounted but hard to cancel
records.text: Bought subscription for Beer and Wine with a special offer. Pleased with the products I received. However thought I’d already cancelled but 2nd boxes turned up over Xmas. Put that down to experience but it’s pretty tricky to actually cancel as you cannot do it online. You have to call, wait in a queue and only between 0900 and 1700 Mon-Fri which is very inflexible. I have to say it feels deliberate to make it as difficult as possible to cancel. Lady was polite enough but kept trying to tell me all these things to keep me to stay but I just wanted to cancel!!! That’s annoying and disappointing customer service. Eventually she did as I asked but I would hesitate about getting involved with them again as a result. I’ll stick to Laithwaites where there’s no subscription and I can buy as much or as little as I want, when I want and with no pressure.

records.title: having to call to cancel subscription…
records.text: having to call to cancel subscription is frustrating would be easier done online. Once i got through to a sales rep Hayley was very helpful

records.title: Great value & service, but has deceptive patterns that may be hard for some
records.text: Beer52 provides a great quality & value craft beer service. While I don't drink myself, I'm told that their beer is really tasty and has a good variety. The snacks and magazine included in the subscription box are a really nice touch. I've purchased their subscription box a few times, and advent calendar - all of which were loved by their recipients.However, I do want to highlight some deceptive patterns around the process on their subscription box. They unfortunately, don't send emails before they charge your card and require three working days notice to cancel a shipment. If you're like me, and have difficulty remembering stuff this leads to multiple times having my card charged when I didn't intend on it. I often buy a box individually as a gift, and don't intend to keep a subscription. This problem is compounded as the only way to cancel is to call them. Additionally, they try to up-sell you when you purchase something or cancel.If the above doesn't bother you, then I can still highly recommend Beer52. Additionally, while their support was unable to help me with a refund on erroneous charges they're incredibly kind and easy to talk to. Whether that's because they have this upsell model (that they even try when they cancel you), or they're just kind people, I don't know - but they're kind either way.

records.title: Bit of a pain you’ve got to call to…
records.text: Bit of a pain you’ve got to call to cancel. Don’t have a huge amount of time during the day. Would be much more convenient if the cancellation could be processed online after the 5 can we tempt you to stay offers!

records.title: A little disappointed I cannot cancel…
records.text: A little disappointed I cannot cancel without calling. I am deaf and this doesn’t seem very inclusive

records.title: Good beers, dodgy sales tactics.
records.text: The beers were very good and from interesting sources. I took advantage of the free trial as I'm not a big beer drinker and couldn't justify the monthly expense. If you really like beer this might be worth it.However their free trial requires a credit card and they intentionally obfuscate a convenient way to cancel. They try to force you to call their sales team, which is only available during work hours. You can, however, cancel via the contact form if you do a general enquiry and request cancellation. If you choose "end subscription" in their contact form it will redirect you to their call centre number.For that reason alone I have to mark them down as it's a pretty duplicitous sales tactic, IMO.

records.title: Some interesting beers but pushy sales…
records.text: Some interesting beers but pushy sales tactic. They are happy to take your money and for you to sign up online but won't allow you to cancel online. Having dragged you through multiple web pages asking if you're sure you want to cancel and the reason why, you then get a message saying you have to call their call centre. So, I call the number, sit on hold for a bit, then have to go through the whole process again on the phone. But, instead of accepting my decision,the call handler tries to tell you why it's not a good idea, and when I stand firm that I want to cancel, continues to blather about 50% off if I stay. What should be a very easy process (unsurprisingly there wasn't all these hurdles to jump through to sign up) becomes a long, drawn out farce. It's coercive selling 101.

records.title: Difficult to cancel
records.text: You you can sign up online easily, but then it makes you call them if you want to cancel. I think we all know that this isn't necessary and simply a ploy to make it more difficult for you to cancel. I think this is quite distasteful because in their marketing they say that it's easy to cancel at any time which was not my experience. When you call them to cancel they will of course try try to make it very difficult for you to cancel. I spoke to someone called Kaye, she was very friendly and just doing her job and was the best part of an unpleasant experience.

records.title: Amazing supervisor, not a good website
records.text: The supervisor that helped me out, Ceri Sian was lovely and very helpful with me cancelling my subscription. The only thing that make the star rating lower for me is that there is no way to cancel the subscription online and you have to call up the company.

records.title: You cant cancel this online
records.text: You cant cancel this online - They FORCE you to ring up and sit on hold for 30 mins...... Via two departments. The staff are absolutely lovely once you get trough, but like I say you do need to call if you want to cancel. The box and service are lovely, so if you like beer hopefully you just wont cancel! :)

records.title: Beers are good, painful to cancel
records.text: Beers are good, sadly no low alcohol / alcohol free options so it will not work for me as long term subscription.a lot of friction to get to the point where I could finally cancel

records.title: Difficult to cancel
records.text: Beers were nice enough (according to my partner) but I did not realise I was joining a subscription service when I ordered the first item as a gift. I tried to cancel the subscription online today.  This was laborious - taken through various options, each offering further options until I reached the last page which asked if I would still like to cancel the subscription.  On reaching this page I was directed to call the company to cancel - not impressed at all.  Though the person I spoke to was friendly enough, I did not appreciate having to listen to further sales baloney whilst on hold.    There should be an option to cancel online.   Date of experience: 02 December 2024

records.title: Didn't realise it was a subscription…
records.text: Didn't realise it was a subscription and when I called to cancel I felt pressured into staying, so I used the excuse I'm moving to spain so the woman would shut up. Beer supposed to be nice though, still waiting on me first box which will be here in a few days. My advice is get your first box and cancel, then go back to moretti

records.title: Very easy to access
records.text: Very easy to access, lovely selection of beers but not that easy to cancel online, had to call and spoke to Kaye who was helpful in explaining my options.

records.title: Questionable
records.text: Bought as a gift after receiving an offer via Argos. Didn’t realise it was a subscription, as this isn’t made very clear. Went to cancel immediately online to be told I had to wait 24 hours. When I returned to cancel went through the rigmarole of upsells to find out you have to call. When I did call the upsells continued. I eventually spoke to a lady, who was nice at first and she continued to try and retain my custom. She told me if I cancel before my order was delivered they wouldn’t be able to replace it if it was lost in the post or arrived damaged which I thought was a strange tactic. When I could get a word in I told her I’d just like to cancel it, to which I received the frosty response ‘I’ve cancelled it for you then, bye’ and she hung up the phone. Left a sour taste.

records.title: As close to a legal scam as you can get.
records.text: Joined to try after buying something from Argos. Selection of beers was OK but probably only worth the 6£ish I paid so didn't want to continue. I would never have joined if I knew I'd have to phone to cancel a subscription; at the end of about 10 very misleading and complex 'are you sure' pages. Even the login page you have to specifically google for as not in the menu. I waited on hold for 10 minutes before asking for a callback, to be told it would be within 2 ***DAYS***. All very shady business practice tbh so won't recommend to others and makes the whole process feel scammy.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Got the free case deal through Argos, only had to pay postage but again it was made unclear about the subscription, was able to cancel fairly easily over the phone and I will give credit to the lady who helped me cancel as she was very polite and understanding. However, I did try the beers and they tasted rather strange almost like cold coffee and all very similar, one said it was a fruity stout, but there was no fruitiness about it what so ever. Very glad I didn't carry on with the subscription!

records.title: Beer52 is a scam
records.text: I got a reward for a free box of beer from another purchase I had made on a different site, I thought oh great another Christmas present for just the delivery fee. What I didn’t know was I had also signed up for a subscription which was not made clear when making the purchase of the free beer case. Naughty naughty. So I then had £27 taken out of my account for a case of beer I had no idea I was going to receive until it came. To unsubscribe you have to call the company. Luckily a nice young gentleman received my call and was happy to help with ending my subscription. He was more than helpful and very kind about it too, definitely deserves a raise because I can imagine he deals with a lot of angry customers cancelling subscriptions they had no idea they’d even signed up to in the first place.

records.title: Not happy
records.text: This, for us, had become bad value (beer 8 cans £32.00). We cancelled (you can only do this by phone!) in November. Last week we received another, unordered delivery. B52 said we can return it at a cost of £10. Had we seen the delivery man we would not have accepted delivery. We are not happy. Surely this is sharp practice.

records.title: Cancellation is a nightmare!
records.text: The beers are fine. The cancellation process is an absolute nightmare though! They say it's a "user-friendly portal" but it's anything but! It's clicking through 6 or 7 pages of offers and guilt tripping, only to be told you have to ring a number. I emailed a member of the team expressing my wish to cancel, and just now they have taken the next payment. Absolute joke!

records.title: Rang up to cancel and boy was it hard…
records.text: Rang up to cancel and boy was it hard work!! The fact they make you ring up to this is very tactical...how many times do I need to say I just want to cancel!!! Having tried the first 4 I'm not impressed,  might be personal taste but they're not for me. Nibbles are no better either straight in bin so just the wind to go...fingers crossed ! No i won't be ordering again!

records.title: Didn’t like how my cancellation was handled
records.text: Really didn’t like how my cancellation was handled. I originally ordered a set of beers- I’d emailed them about two weeks prior to the next set of beers being charged. Had no reply - was still charged. I rang up telling them I wanted to cancel and this should have been done weeks ago when I emailed. Wasn’t offered a refund or anything - charged twice for a second set of beers I don’t want. Poor to be honest. Decent beers, dodgy sales.

records.title: Cancel by phone
records.text: I support my local independent pub, who buy local beers, IPA and stouts/porters etc... So I don't really need a subscription to this. After having a couple of packs just sat there I decided to cancel my subscription, but I abject to having to call them to explain and have them try to make stay a member longer. You should be able to cancel online.

records.title: Subscription trap
records.text: Nothing wrong with the beer or delivery - quite enjoyed it. I decided to cancel purely as I'm not drinking much at the moment... but then the problems start. I really don't like a company who makes it difficult for you to cancel. Having to drill down through a maze of multiple website pages of questions and new offers, I finally found the page that told me I had to call to cancel. I called, waited on hold for 15 minutes and then had to bat away more questions, offers and new deals. I would have resubscribed in a couple of months if it wasn't for these daft subscription trap tactics. Makes it feel like a con. I'll never be back.

records.title: In order to cancel a subscription
records.text: In order to cancel a subscription - you have to phone. This isn’t a simple two second call; it’s waiting for 10 minutes and then being asked 1,000 times if you are really sure you want to cancel.It’s hate this form of customer service.

description:
Brewing bold beers from our hilltop in Hebden Bridge and pouring punchy pints from our very own taprooms. We’re resolutely in the business of setting standards, not following trends. We punch above our weight by putting good beer into good people’s fridges, never courting credibility we just let our hop forward, unapologetic beers do the talking. Our core collection is a constant to always come back to, while we show our creative flare through limited editions.

We put our heart and soul into every brew – it’s not life and death but it’s up there. We listen to our drinkers, we still make beer for us as much for as we do for them, and we still only brew beer we’re proud to put our name on. It’s still our Vocation.

records.title: Quick delivery and great tase
records.text: I purchased some Hop, Skip & Juice Hazy Pale Ale and some Life & Death IPA and I was impressed by both. Obviously everybody's taste is different, but this was recommended to me by my boss and I liked it very much and will be ordering more ( after dry January ). I also wasn't expecting my order before Christmas, but it arrived on Christmas eve, which was a nice surprise. Overall, a great experience.

records.title: Bought gift e-vouchers for a Christmas…
records.text: Bought gift e-vouchers for a Christmas gift.  Quick process in ordering and received email straight away with voucher code.  Recipient was delighted and has now put an order in to Vocation.

records.title: Brilliant chocolate stout
records.text: I got your chocolate stout reduced to clear in Waitrose.. didn't expect much, but by eck!I am a displaced Yorkshireman as you may be able to hear but this is, without bias, the best chocolate stout I've ever had.So much so that I made a small gift of it to another exiled Yorkshireman on the South Coast. A revelation to him too, I only hope you don't spread yourself too thinly with various brews. Though that sounds like the kind of thing I'd like to do, personally, if I had the equipment. So power to your elbow.

records.title: Superb beer swiftly delivered
records.text: Superb beer, swiftly delivered. Very easy to put together a mixed case on the website, hit the £50 mark and it's free delivery, even in the pre-Xmas madness it got from West Yorkshire to London in two days.

records.title: Very prompt delivery and well packaged
records.text: Very prompt delivery and well packaged. Good value and a lovely Christmas gift for recipient

records.title: It’s so easy to order Really good beers!
records.text: It’s so easy to order online and there’s so much choice! Delivery was quick too. Really good beers that are enjoyed at home or given as gifts. All round fabulous 🤩

records.title: Beer good
records.text: The beer is awesome with a great selection and arrived very quickly

records.title: Very quick delivery although it did…
records.text: Very quick delivery although it did arrive damaged, but that was not Vocations Fault. On contacting them they were very quick to refund for the damaged can so very good customer service.The beer's excellent as well.

records.title: Brilliant beers
records.text: Brilliant beers, well packed and arrived quickly and intact.Trackable delivery is always reliable. Bought for a gift and a few extras for me too. A good mix of styles and as well as regular beers, always some great seasonal and special brews.Some nice combinations in the gift packs which are great value.Will definitely buy again, it's all too good to have once.

records.title: Confirmation on delivery address …
records.text: Confirmation on delivery address  incorrect- sorted out after phone call from me. Apart from that no issues at all. Thank you

records.title: I love vocation beers
records.text: I love vocation beers. Especially life & death. Ordered the black Friday Xmas box deal. Upon arrival it's evident there's a puncture through the box and unfortunately pierced a couple of cans. Not vocations fault but the courier. Either way I'm still pleased with the deal I got

records.title: I think your beers are great but … I…
records.text: I think your beers are great but … I was a bit let down this time as this purchase was a present and a number of the cans were dented.

records.title: Cheers to good service.
records.text: Communication about order and delivery good. And can’t wait to start sampling the beers.

records.title: Excellent service from day one will use…
records.text: Excellent service from day one will use you again

records.title: Great beers and a top brewery
records.text: Great beers and a top brewery. Unfortunately the delivery wasn’t great. I’m not sure whether it was packed correctly but the can dividers were at the top of the box and the cans were rolling around at the bottom. As a result one can was damaged. This might not be Vocation’s fault if the delivery wasn’t carefully made.

records.title: Always been great with free local same…
records.text: Always been great with free local same day delivery. Now switched to free delivery only over £50 and not even next day.Shipstation delivery tracking platform does not provide any shipping links, order status shows as partial with no explanation, I don't have what I ordered or any visibility of it or when it might arrive.This couldn't have happened under worse circumstances that I won't share here but will when I contact vocation directly.There are many reasons to shop locally but this is one that vocation has lostEdit: after contacting vocation my faith has been restored and I thank them for there kindness

records.title: Great beer and delivered promptly
records.text: Great beer and delivered promptly. Would have been 5 star if DPD had advised me when it was arriving.

records.title: Some great beers again
records.text: Ordering process easy, deliveried in time and some great tasting beers again.This would have been a 5 star but the packaging wasn't great. I'm surprised none of the bottles were smashed.

records.title: First purchase
records.text: My first purchase and surprisingly came within a week just before Christmas. I wasn’t in but my box was ready for me to pick up from my local Morrisons the same day!The box itself is quite heavy but well made. The only downside was that a few of the cans were loose and moving around inside the box.Haven’t tasted yet but that’s the easy bit! I would order again no problem Thank you

records.title: Great beer, great service!
records.text: I’ve ordered from Vocation before and never had anything but good, reliable service/deliveries, and this time was no exception!Some great beers coming out of Vocation at the moment!!However, I had to drop a star! My order arrived in two packages, that’s fine. The ‘problem’ was that the second package was a single can in a full size box that would have fitted 24 in!!

records.title: Christmas Gift Set
records.text: Bought two gift sets - one unfortunately damaged in transit. The other for my son who was extremely pleased. Gift box was well presented in hard box with extra Christmas sleeve 🎄🎁. He loves their ales and had previously tried which I wasn't aware of so great choice! Wonderful designs. Update - damaged gift pack resolved with refund quickly by Vocation.

records.title: Ordered a craft beer gift set...
records.text: Ordered a craft beer gift set with glass for a Christmas present. It arrived looking fantastic and the beers and glass inside were beautifully presented. The only reason I haven't given 5 stars is the box the set was in was slightly damaged so as a gift it didn't look pristine. Could well have been the courier's fault, but maybe a bit of bubble wrap for an extra layer of protection would help! A minor quibble, overall very pleased with the experience.

records.title: Excellent products (as usual)
records.text: Excellent products (as usual) and straight forward ordering process.The only negative being that the parcel was delivered to the wrong address. There was someone in the property all day waiting, but the delivery was attempted at the wrong apartment and left with a random neighbour in a different block.

records.title: Delicious, decadent, different brews.
records.text: Amazing choice of tasty, high percentage beers! Delicious, decadent and different. Shame you can't get everything in taproom AND online, some beers are exclusive to one place or the other. Great delivery process too although over boxing day - NY, DPD really ruined this by holding onto the beer and not sending it out for a week later or something. Should have really been compensated for the inconvenience. Also, rewards for returning customers or a discount code would be better than just for new customers.

records.title: Tastes like beer should
records.text: I love the flavour of this beer, it tastes of beer, not grapefruit. Buying online, their service is brilliant, the delivery arrives within two days of ordering. Brilliant tasting beer and good service.

records.title: Order Frustration
records.text: I placed my order on Christmas eve knowing there would be a slight delay in receiving the beer due to the festive period. I received notification on Friday 27th December 2024 from Vocation Brewery that DPD had my parcel for next day delivery. It didn't arrive. Every time I tracked the parcel through DPD it stated they were waiting for the parcel to arrive. I rang Vocation Brewery on Monday 30th December 2024, but as no one answered the phone I left a message asking to be contacted for a delivery update. I didn't receive a call back. I received my package on Tuesday 31st December 2024 which was great, but the lack of transparency then communication with my order was pretty poor.

records.title: Could be better, could be worse.
records.text: I was disappointed to find one bottle of imperial stout to be missing from my order with no note to say it would be sent later or that I would be refunded the £10.50 cost. However, upon e-mailing my problem, I did receive an apology and advice that I would be refunded, which I have to say was promptly dealt with and the money soon back in my account. So that is why I have allocated a just above average 3 stars. Otherwise, no complaints.

records.title: Very expensive and didn't like either
records.text: Very expensive and didn't like either

records.title: Slightly disappointed
records.text: The 3 stars reflects every can in the box I received having a bash in it, the product is great but you could never give a bashed box of beer as a gift so kept it for myself.

records.title: I was very disappointed that there is…
records.text: I was very disappointed that there is hardly any coconut flavour in the coconut macaroon stout (try tonkoko if you want bounty in a can)  also with the mint cocoa stout just not minty or chocolatey enough. However I ordered 7 different drinks to try and the rest were nice and delivered on time.

records.title: Never had an issue before with…
records.text: Never had an issue before with delivery, it was as prompt as usual though half my order was missing. Should receive this week, but I’m certainly not used to this type of thing from Vocation usually. Just an oversight but, a bit irritating.

records.title: Unexpected delivery and presentation
records.text: Delivery was confusing. My order had one large box included but it came in two different boxes from different delivery drivers at different times. I bought a mixed case from the gifting section but it came and isn't really presentable as a gift. Some cans are damaged and I've had to put it all together and box and wrap it as a gift myself.

records.title: One of the 6 pack of Imperial Stout was…
records.text: One of the 6 pack of Imperial Stout was tainted and off, whereas the other 5 were fine. There was an orange sediment in the crown cap which suggested a rusty deposit - I reported the fault to Vocation who are reviewing my complaint

records.title: Packaging broke but got refunded for…
records.text: Packaging broke but got refunded for the cans lost, just a bit annoying really.

records.title: I love Vocation products but not DPD delivery
records.text: I love Vocation products. Unfortunately passing local delivery to DPD means a dropping of standards.Despite registering my alley door code with Vocation and DPD my last box was left on the street behind a bin. Had this been stolen I'd have lost it.So i have doubts now about ordering again. Previously Vocation delivered it (I'm local) and used the code.

records.title: Wrong order sent to me
records.text: Ordered a 48 fridge filler pack of 330ml cans and they sent a 440ml 48 pack which consists of different beers to the pack I ordered so I didn’t want to just accept the mistake.  I emailed them and they arranged to deliver the correct pack and pick up the wrong one via DPD. Decent service from them after I got in touch but can’t rate more than 3 stars due to their error.

records.title: We love the beers and service but…
records.text: We love the beers and service but unfortunately, just about every tin was dented. Mostly on the bottom some top and bottom indicating the case had either been dropped or crushed below another. Also, a small point but, we did get the Free Glass but not the can as promised. Its the 1st time we've had this from the Vocation team so it wont put us off future purchases but thought you would like to know.

records.title: Incorrect item delivered
records.text: Some delicious beers but stock levels vary and I struggled to order what I wanted. Then my order was delivered with the wrong item. The team apologised and issued a prompt refund but I'm a Christmas present down now and would have just preferred a replacement.

records.title: Great selection of beers and prompt…
records.text: Great selection of beers and prompt processing of order.  All let down by DPD who delivered to a shop TEN miles from my house on the other side of Manchester. Now I have no car and public transport isn’t direct or suitable for large boxes filled with delicious beer. Vocation gave me a partial refund but it took a favour from a friend and over an hour and a half of driving to collect my order. NOT Vocation’s fault but DPD are a bunch of fools.  Or the driver didn’t even bother to deliver, because someone was in ALL day and no one knocked on the door.

records.title: Picked and packed the wrong gift pack
records.text: Picked and packed the wrong gift pack. Calling the customer service option didn’t get me through but option 5 did? Whoever answered that line did help immediately which was great. New gift pack was damaged and clearly packed by someone in a huff. Overall very average service with the exception of the person on the phone

records.title: Poor Packaging and Customer Service
records.text: Ordered a Great Taste Mix Pack for a friend as a christmas gift who is really into Vocation. Box arrived with loose cans floating around and really poor and lack of packaging. All cans were dented in some way. Wrote an email to customer services over a week ago and not even had the decency to reply. Complained to the staff at Vocation Bar in Hebden Bridge when we took are guests out to lunch, was told the assistant manager would look into it, still nothing. Very disappointing experience from this company.

records.title: Delivery needs improving
records.text: I ordered a number of beers, the ones I specifically wanted were the maple imperial stouts. When the order arrived these were on the packing slip but missing from the delivery. When I contacted vocation I received a refund but no apology or explanation. Beer is great, service less so.

records.title: Packaging problems
records.text: Ordered 3 cases of beer - about 44 cans in total. The last case of 26 there were 5 damaged cans and one burst.  The company did refund for the burst can but not the damaged which looked bad when gifted. Would not mail order again.

records.title: Poor packaging
records.text: Poor packaging , as in , No packaging, resulted in all the cans being dented. Maybe send products out with some packaging around them , just a thought !!!!

records.title: The beer choice was excellent but the…
records.text: The beer choice was excellent but the delivery of the package was poor meaning that the Christmas packaging was ruined and I was unable to use it as a present for my father. I tried to complain to the delivery company but there was no way to do so. My complaint with Vocation has so far been ignored.

records.title: DPD disappointment
records.text: Not really vocations fault but DPD delivered to collection point, waited for pickup pass. Never arrived next thing i know it's being sent back. Not received a refund yet. I would suggest not using DPD

records.title: Poor service and communication
records.text: My delivery was advised for Monday 12th December via email. Waited in all day but delivery did not arrive. Contacted Vocation that evening asking what had gone wrong? Delivery was actually made on Tuesday 13th via DPD.Disappointed that in my correspondence with Vocation there was neither an apology nor an explanation as to what had gone wrong.Doubt if I’ll order direct from them again which is a shame as I enjoy their beer.

records.title: I ordered stout as a gift and twice…
records.text: I ordered stout as a gift and twice almost all cans were badly dented. This was caused by poor packaging and vocation refunded with no issue but I'd rather have had the beer for my dad's birthday. Cannot give him a load of dented cans!

records.title: First bad experience
records.text: Delay on dispatch, arrived pretty beat up (but with cans intact), no free glass. Pretty badly packed, doubtful the glass would have survived anyway.Pretty disappointing, have used them previously without issue.

records.title: I ordered a small delivery but half of…
records.text: I ordered a small delivery but half of it was missing. The delivery had taken 5 days to arrive. They reacted quickly and the rest of the order came 4 days later. I was hoping they might have put a free can of beer to try. This would have been a nice gesture and I would have given a Five Star award if they had done so. Need to rethink customer service. It's the little things!!!

description:
At Laithwaites we stop at nothing to bring you great wines!
For over 50 years, we've been a family-owned wine seller committed to bringing you the very best.
 Our award-winning customer service and our 100% guarantee reflect the same care and passion we pour into selecting our wines.

records.title: The speed from order to delivery was…
records.text: The speed from order to delivery was amazing more especially as it was just before Christmas. The helpful person I spoke with when I rang, as I wasn't sure exactly what I wanted, was really useful.Many thanks

records.title: I have been a customer for over twenty…
records.text: I have been a customer for over twenty years and have never been disappointed.  Tried some mini bottles for some variety and discovered some new gems. Excellent service,  great value and fantastic wines.

records.title: My brother was very pleased with order…
records.text: My brother was very pleased with order said wine and mince pies very good. The problem was with the delivery company the parcel was left next door in pouring rain where there wasn't a porch which I specified it could be left also post codes apply to more than one house.

records.title: Very reliable
records.text: I only ordered on the phone, about 4.15pm on 21st December ( the Saturday before Christmas)  - my own selection , not a Laithwaithes offer so having  been told that it would arrive in time for Christmas, I didn't expect it until Christmas Eve but it came on the morning of 23rd.I was out but the delivery person left it with a neighbour instead of just dumping it on the doorstep so extremely impressed. Delivery is always speedy but this was amazing so close to Christmas .Being disabled, I find having wine delivered  by Laithwaites a no brainer- good service &nice wine at an affordable price

records.title: Never had a bad wine
records.text: Wines are always excellent in quality, are usually at a decent price, arrived in a day or two. Have been using Laithwaites for a few years and have never had a bad bottle of wine. One bottle in that time arrived obviously corked. Informed Laithwaites and received a credit for another bottle of wine. I’ve had that wine since and was excellent as expected.

records.title: Really enjoy the wines
records.text: Really enjoy the wines, the wine advice from Scott, there is only one thing wrong ...... and that is the courier service that you use, Yodel !!!!!! they do not deliver to the house, do not follow the instructions and leave the box in all weathers at the bottom of our property in a field. This is not acceptable !!!!! 1

records.title: Southern French Reds
records.text: For a change, I thought I would try a case of the southern French wines. Some, I've had before as part of a mixed case - Rex Mundi, Charles Cros etc., - but there were some here I hadn't tried. And, I am very happy in selecting this Rich Reds of the South case. So far, the outstanding red wine has been Narbo Martius, a syrah, grenache, marselan by Gerard Bertrand. Excellent and highly recommended.

records.title: Service and good quality wines
records.text: Very good service with outstanding wines. My account manager, Tony Gallante is professional and friendly, he knows my preferences, and suggests wines from different vineyards within the same areas, broadening our knowledge and tastebuds.

records.title: Spot on Christmas delivery
records.text: I ordered 4 cases of wine to be delivered to 3 different addresses and all came at the required time requested and delivered by friendly, helpful chaps. Well done.

records.title: A positive ambassador 4 a positive company
records.text: I previously had help from Tony with a complicated order which enabled me to tailor it to my needs and at a very competitve price.This time, I was not able to activate a voucher I had received but when we spoke it was quickly apparent that I had misquoted the pin number. The problem was very quickly and uncomplainingly resolved - Tony is a cheerful, enthusiastic and helpful adviser, a credit to the company

records.title: Generally speaking the service is…good.
records.text: Generally speaking the service is great. However. I think the price increases over the year 2024. Have been a little more than I expected. Local supermarkets and competitors are offering similar wines for less. And good quality. Maybe time for me to rethink ?

records.title: Mix up now sorted and happy with the order. You have reacted quickly to my issues and now resolved. Thank you
records.text: Ordered the last chance Christmas mega deal. Arrived with half of the bottles being substitutes and no glasses.Phoned and the you agreed to give me a mussel pot which is a particular favourite of mine and also give me the senoria de barria which was the £28 fine wine and the missing glasses. Received the order yesterday and the senoria de barria was again substituted by a rioja baron de barbon which I believe is valued at £14 . Also no glasses.Not a happy customer!

records.title: The wine as usual was of good order.
records.text: The wine as usual was of good order.However, once again, the delivery was unsatisfactory.Despite emails and access to their website there were no updates. The delivery was hours late and then the driver left the box on the doorstep and ‘ran’. There was no knock or ring or even a card. It was left in full public view and could easily have been stolen.

records.title: Excellent ordering process
records.text: The ordering process was excellent. Any weakness is in the delivery process. My first case failed to arrive despite Yodel twice saying they were delivering. This problem was settled promptly by my wine advisor.

records.title: I cannot speak personally for all items…
records.text: I cannot speak personally for all items delivered in the Christmas pack as some were given as gifts. I have been told that the South African white wine was very good and the gin was much appreciated. As for the rest I am still working my way through and enjoying all so far. The packaging was good and delivery was exactly as predicted by Laithwaites

records.title: Great service, but not quite found the right wine yet!
records.text: The case of wine arrived in good time, chosen for us by the genial and thoughtful D. Whom we met in the sauna.The wines are more expensive than we would normally buy, but I don't think I have tasted anything that would make me take a note of it to drink again... although we have only had a couple of bottles so far. If things change I will update the review. We were encouraged to make a bigger saving by ordering double our original number... I think now that I should have stuck with six, till I found what I like!

records.title: Box of wine just dumped on doorstep in full view of passers by
records.text: Great customer service but delivery courtiers are letting you down.  Ignoring instructions where to leave package when not in. This is occurring to often.

records.title: Love the wines and great delivery…
records.text: Love the wines and great delivery service. My only gripe is the automatic subscription membership everytime you order wine. It should be highlighted more when contacting Laithwaites, especially relayed to the customer when they order. I had 3 memberships on the go at one time and wine automaticaly processed.

records.title: Easy ordering - shame about the delivery
records.text: Ordering the wine and champagne was easy. The delivery was very bad. The left the wine at the main entrance to the flats not even bothering to bring it up to my flat. Anyone could have taken the box and I would not have known. Luckily one of my honest neighbours moved it into the building and put it around the corner from the main entrance. This however could still have been taken by people who visit our building. Yodel were extremely poor in their delivery.

records.title: Only let down by the delivery driver
records.text: Only let down by the delivery driver. Again not left in a safe place. He left it in full view of the street, luckily it was still there when we arrived home

records.title: Always received good quality red wine…
records.text: Always received good quality red wine at reasonable prices. In the unlikely event that one of the wines is not to my liking it's good to know it can be returned and refunded.

records.title: As always helpful friendly and…
records.text: As always helpful friendly and efficient staff. Post covid prices seem to have gone up by as much as 25% in some cases , so not able to order as frequently as before. However no hard sell or locked in agreements with companies that are less than helpful if you wish to leave. Wines are still dependably delicious. A  christmas treat.

records.title: Order Review.
records.text: The choices on your website were wide and varied.  The wines seem to be of the ususl good quality.  On the downside, I found that the service provided by your courier company (Yodel) fell below the high standards normally promoted by Laithwaites.  Their service was intolerably slow.

records.title: Quick delivery as usual but two wines…
records.text: Quick delivery as usual but two wines were incorrect. Following an email and a return phone call correct wines sent so very happy now

records.title: Good quality wine
records.text: Good quality wine. Used them for a while and the quality and service is good. Helpful when emailing and will do as much as possible to facilitate. Dark reds are my favorites.

records.title: Very good telephone service though the…
records.text: Very good telephone service though the website would not accept my order for some reason?

records.title: Unfortunately you didn’t bring the 3…
records.text: Unfortunately you didn’t bring the 3 boxes up to my front door as promised. I am disabled and in a wheelchair so perhaps next time you will deliver to my flat. However the wine is delicious.

records.title: Buying multiple gifts
records.text: I was ordering gifts for my team and had problems writing the messages on each gift. I was contacted and helped by someone in customer services which I appreciated but the whole thing took a long time, spelling out each name and address.  My requested delivery date was not met and some of the team didn't get the messages that had taken so long to write, so they didn't know that the gift was from me.I like you as a company but the experience of buying multiple gifts has not been a great one.

records.title: Courier let Laithwaites down
records.text: I arranged a specific delivery day for my Pinot & friends case. I had notification from yodel that it would be received between 20:00 & 22:00 on that day and it never turned up. When I was finally able to use their tracking system I found out it had been returned to Laithwaites - no delivery was attempted, no explanation given. Laithwaites acted promptly to my email and replaced it, but it still meant I waited much longer than I should have. Yodel were incompetent and I would suggest not using them again. Laithwaites customer service were very proactive.

records.title: Regular customer poor service
records.text: Ordered 2 cases of Black Stump to get the price, received 18 bottles of above 5 bottles, of a similarly priced Rioja. Contacted Laithwaites was offered to collect and replace the stuffing box their words, as time of year I was agreeable to retain wine delivered and talk to my advisor in new year. Then received a £10 pound voucher to resolve. Feel they have fobbed me off.

records.title: I really like Laithwaites wines but their delivery service is crap
records.text: I really like Laithwaites wines and have signed up to quite a few of their Vineyard Partner plans. However, I am beyond frustrated with their delivery service. Deliveries sometimes arrive earlier than requested or advised, with little or no time to do anything about it and my cases are usually dumped on the doorstep (often when we're at home) rather than following instructions on the box. I've complained to Laithwaites on a couple of occasions with no change in service.

records.title: Ordered 24 bottles
records.text: I recently purchased 24 bottles of red wine (two cases of 12 each). While one case was excellent—rich, full-bodied, and exactly to my taste—the other case was disappointing. The wine from the second case was overly acidic, light, and lacked the depth I expected. This inconsistency in quality was unexpected and a bit frustrating.The good case deserves high marks, but the subpar case brings my overall rating down. I hope this feedback helps to address any quality control issues.

records.title: Happy but not happy......
records.text: Overall I'm happy with past and present experiences with Laithwaites. Easy web site, good wines with variety's of choice. I've marked down due to a poor delivery experience from their carrier of choice, in this case, Yodel. My delivery was lost with no updates from the Yodel app. My dismay was dealt with expertly and professionally by your staff and my replacement order arrived 2 days later. It's appreciated that December is the busy time of year but the lack of method to contact Yodel is frankly appalling and has let you down badly.

records.title: Some very poor red wines
records.text: Some very poor red wines, expected better from laithwaites. I see this as getting rid of wines you could not sell and I certainly would not do this again. Seen better quality in the mid range at the supermarket.

records.title: Let down by choosing Yodel as the delivery service
records.text: If you want repeat custom, hold to account the shoddy courier service you use. i.e.YODEL Wine ordered was left by the gate in full view of the street. I was in but indolence prevailed. I was way too much effort for the driver to walk up the path, never mind press the bell. The parcel was marked up as to be left hidden in the event we weren't in. Yodel are right up there as a front runner in the race to the bottom and and should do well at the 2024 Cowboy Courier Awards

records.title: Terrible delivery experience
records.text: Wines are invariably good but your delivery partner, Yodel were terrible. Failed to deliver for three consecutive days so I arranged pick up from the depot; was there for 1.5 hours whilst they looked for it. I’ll not order with you again if you are using Yodel.

records.title: I’m giving you 3stars in this instance
records.text: I’m giving you 3stars in this instance, not because of the wine Selection or your very great customer service. My irk is with your delivery service. I had to wait for almost 4 hours slippage of the promised ETA without any feedback of regret or apology. But also to compound this unacceptable level of service, all I got was my doorbell ring. By the time I got to the door all I was confronted with was my box of wine. The driver was already seated in his van, and drove away. Not a personal apology, not even a courteous personal face to face. I wasted well over half-a-day when I had so much other commitments that day. Delivery service 1 star in this instance.

records.title: Good Wines, Bad logistics Contract With Yodel
records.text: Ordered some champagne recently on promotion and no issue. Ordered more champagne stock for a Christmas party and opted for the more expensive named day service; however, champagne didn’t arrive and is still to be delivered whenever Yodel decides it has the time. I’ve never had good luck with Yodel, so please stop using them. I’m unsure I’d order again from here unfortunately now that I know they use Yodel. Good company, bad delivery partner.

records.title: Specific date delivery late
records.text: Specific date delivery a day late. As this was a birthday present it mattered & calling me to inform me on the day it should have been delivered didn’t help as it left me no time to do something else … not good enough Laithwaites, you all know you are going to be busy pre new year so plan ahead vs letting customers down.

records.title: Wrong address
records.text: Yodel were unable to deliver the parcel as the correct address had not been supplied on the label. This was Laithwaites error. The package had to go back to Laithwaites and then back out for a second delivery attempt. It all took too long.

records.title: Delivery was made at approx 8.40pm
records.text: Delivery was made at approx 8.40pm. Dumped outside the door,without knocking or ringing bell. Lights were on in the house. We had to lift the box into the porch, which was very difficult as my husband has had a stroke. No communication from Delivery company prior to receipt of goods. They didnt even follow instructions in case we were out which we haven't  been for 6 weeks.

records.title: Unreliable delivery on Christmas gifts
records.text: I ordered wine (weeks ago) to be delivered to a friend for Christmas (it was their Christmas present) on a named delivery day (which should have been this Saturday) . It did not arrive Saturday and we had an email from the courier to say it would now be Monday (today).  Why allow people to select a delivery day well in advance and not be able to do it? Now the parcel will then be 2 days late. The courier is yodel and we have had quite a few issues with them delivering our own wine. I emailed customer services over the weekend and got a reply this morning. This was just a ‘stock’ reply and looked like a copy and paste job apologising and saying they would feed back to the courier. The email feels disingenuous and has just been sent to tick it off the list to say it’s had a reply. I’m not very impressed and will consider if I use them in the future for gifts.

records.title: Disappointing ordering experience
records.text: Ordered a case of wine, not with my regular advisor who is evidently on leave. I pay the annual fee for free delivery and named delivery date. Previously everything has been perfect. However I asked the representative who I ordered with (she rang me and told me my regular advisor was on leave and and had asked her look after me until she returned) to ensure delivery was on Wednesday 11th Dec. The case of wine was delivered on Monday 9th Dec. Fortunately I was in to take the delivery. I also asked about which scotch whisky was available. After about five minutes during which the representative didn’t seem to be familiar with what was available I gave up on the whisky. Overall a most disappointing experience which was not to Laithwaite’s usual excellent standards.

records.title: Lacking in product knowledge!!!
records.text: Sold a VC champagne kit with reusable Ice buckets!!  I challenged this as they looked disposable to be told 100% not!!  BUT THEY ARE PAPER!! I will be sending back !

records.title: Different wine
records.text: We have been regular purchasers of cases for some years and the wines have been excellent. However this year the boxes we have ordered have been changed by the warehouse culminating in one of our recent boxes which had half the case different to what was ordered. There was no notification or warning on order that the wine we had ordered was in short supply. Very disappointed.

records.title: Worst web site going…
records.text: Try using this companies web site and you would better off chewing drawing pins, it’s less painful. Try using gift vouchers with the site it is painfully slow. Then it fails just when you add the last voucher with an error you’ve tried adding too many vouchers. Then you have to wait an hour to do it aaallllll over again. Then only if you’re lucky will it let you apply vouchers. It is sooooo slow. Payments often fail on the site. You cannot easily find the promotions they send you by post on the site. It really is absolutely shocking. Makes you wonder if they want your business. Well that’s it after being a customer for years, tonight is the last straw. Off to find another wine company.

records.title: Very bad goodwill
records.text: Very bad goodwillTried to order BLACK FRIDAY DEAL from my mobile whilst abroad but problem with websiteEmailed them and was told to contact them on my returnI did so and thought I’d ordered the deal . After I checked delivery it was only 12 bottles of wine not 13 and no free wine glassesI contacted them and was told the Black Friday offer had expired even though I had agreed earlierWhen I complained they only said that the offer had ended even though I have been a customer for several years

records.title: VERY DISAPPOINTING! 2nd TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE
records.text: Second time I have been badly let down by this company. I ordred some champagne and wine for delivery two days ago. I called to check on delivery date and was told 'we don't have the champagne in stock. Sorry you should have been told. It has delayed the whole order. We would probably (!) have let you know today'. Too late to re-arrange anything and now we have to make a 20 mile round trip to buy wine for Christmas. Base level incompetence. Absolutely cheesed off beyond believe.

description:
A Coffee Roastery Like No Other. 
Family run & proud to be the number 1 rated coffee company in the UK on Trustpilot!
Spilling the beans since 2008.
From our family run Artisan Roastery in Kent.


From humble beginnings in Lizzie’s garage at home in Kent, to being awarded the number 1 coffee roaster on Trustpilot in the UK. Lizzie and her family are proud to deliver a superb choice of delicious freshly roasted coffee from this season's finest crops.

For the last 14 years, we continue to pride ourselves on roasting some of the finest coffee available worldwide, we hand roast daily over flame and take great care to make sure all your delicious coffee is as fresh as possible.

You asked and we listened... 

All our new bags are now resealable, recyclable, and loveable which carry the theme of joy and delicious coffee at home, at work or on the go. We hope you all agree that now more than ever a bag of Coffee Bean Shop coffee, really has a 'little love in every cup'!

records.title: It is only recently that I have started…
records.text: It is only recently that I have started to get into coffee, but the experience buying from the Coffee Bean Shop has been second to none. The packaging and present was very cool and personal. I can't wait to order again to keep experiencing new coffees.

records.title: I have had 2 orders now
records.text: I have had 2 orders now , service is quick and easy - A little hand written note in each package , which is appreciated and beautiful coffee !! Love reading the Grind also - and feels like a real treat when my coffee arrives . AA blue mountain is delicious , however I am enjoying finding my go to fave by working through the different coffees !!

records.title: Lizzie and the team at the Coffee Bean…
records.text: Lizzie and the team at the Coffee Bean Shop have been great to deal with over the past year. Deliveries always on time, the prices are good and I get sent many offers which is very nice. We have had hand written notes in the packages which is a really nice personal touch. I buy green coffee beans but have had the freshly roasted beans and can't recommend highly enough. Keep up the good work guys

records.title: Rare coffee beans bundle
records.text: Ordered the rare coffee beans bundle gift wrapped, along with the Everest beans, as a Christmas gift for a person who has everything. Delivery was fast, particularly as ordered so close to Christmas, and packed beautifully, the gift was very well received and the coffee tastes amazing. The package had a lovely handwritten note inside for that personal touch that makes you realise this is a small business who really cares about their products and customers. Will definitely be ordering again, will try the everyday beans and likely put in a monthly order to replace our current supermarket beans.

records.title: Coffee review
records.text: Quick delivery and a great coffee!For those who hesitate, I recommend to try at least the cheaper single origin which is still much better than anyting you can buy in a shop and then go for something more expensive.

records.title: The coffee beans are excellent
records.text: The coffee beans are excellent. There is always a personal handwritten note in your order making you feel your order and you are important to them. I always recommend them when anyone asks me about coffee.

records.title: Very impressed
records.text: Coffee selection was excellent and very good value. Very quick delivery. Just about to order some more. Thank you :-)

records.title: Perfect brew
records.text: Amazing service, ordered before Christmas ,for my husband who loves his coffee, and delivered promptly. The coffee beans are great quality and it was a delight also to get a complimentary bag. Also included was some interesting information about the company, definitely will order again.

records.title: Fantastic
records.text: I ordered some special coffee for the other half. The order arrived quickly and contained a small free bag of coffee. The packaging is super cute and I appreciated the personal note that came with the order. Will place another order soon

records.title: Order despatched quickly
records.text: Order despatched quickly. Product was of a high standard, beans roasted to perfection and the taste was exceptional. Full bodied coffee

records.title: Don’t know how it tastes…..yet
records.text: 1 Star - This isn’t for the coffee as Royal Mail have had it for 5 days (on a tracked 24 service!) so I have no idea what conditions it has been transported and stored in while in their network being shuttled from wrong place to wrong place or what condition it may arrive in. I hope it tastes as it should but I won’t be able to give that review as I can’t be sure. I would suggest using someone else to deliver reliably. ——————————————————————-Update 28th Dec.Received my order and over the initial Royal  Mail delivery debacle this looks and smells amazing. Hopefully the coffee has been stored well on its long journey to me since ordering and it tastes as good as it looks. Love the personal note in the order as well, nice touch.

records.title: A tea drinker of 65 years being converted and loving it.
records.text: Excellent descriptions of the products on the the web page. It was a pleasure to sign onto their web site.It was and is a web site that was designed  and written by a true software professional.The products are described and photographed in a way that the viewer desires to try every coffee on the web page.You must try their coffee, all of them.I am working my way slowly.through them all.

records.title: Delicious, fresh coffee! I love your beans!
records.text: Always the coffee from you guys is delicious and freshly roasted. I love it and am always satisfied. The only problem is the delivery. If it really was £4.95 for a 24 hour delivery from dispatch to delivery it would be all great. However if the delivery goes despite no strike two days it should be called tracked48 and be a bit cheaper, other than that all great. Merry Christmas:)

records.title: I love your coffee.
records.text: I love your coffee.Thanks for getting back in touch and thank you for the great promotion discount you gave me for returning.The only reason for four stars is the price of the postage and packing considering it’s coming by Royal mail.In my experience, the post office Royal now are worse than useless, if the price of the postage and packing could be dropped or lowered. I would regularly order your coffee all year the postage just put the price up that little bit too much, hope you don’t mind me being honest, apart from that great Coffee, great staff, great company. Thanks, Liz.

records.title: When ordering I was distracted and…
records.text: When ordering I was distracted and opted for espresso ground coffee instead of whole beans.  My mistake, I know but may I suggest you use all caps for whole beans to differentiate between ground and non ground coffee, for the simpletons (moi) ? While the breakfast favourite is nice, I will reserve judgement for the freshly ground version.  Delivery arrived sooner than expected and I love the packaging.Karl

records.title: Monsoon Malabar
records.text: Monsoon Malabar has always been my favorite as I prefer my coffee with depth, body and strength yet a rounded flavour that is not bitter in any way. The packets could do to show bean name so when buying multi packs you can easily see which is which at a glance

records.title: As always great delivery service but I…
records.text: As always great delivery service but I have noticed the coffee(s) taste slightly different especially the old brown java - don't know if it's  new equipment or a new supplier.  The Colombian Bucaramanga tastes as if it has been oven-roasted.  Might need getting used to.

records.title: Consistently Good
records.text: Have ordered a few times and have been very happy with the seasonal packages. Would love to continue to be a loyal customer. It would be great if we can get discount codes for repeat orders.

records.title: Fresh roast flavour?
records.text: I decided to try the coffee because I had been told that coffee beans are at their best when bought raw and fresh, roasted as you need them and drunk at the time.  The suggestion being the flavour and taste is night and day to beans that get roasted a long time ago in ass and sit on a shelf.  This company appeared to provide that.  Roast and shipped with ink 24 hours.  I also like supporting British indépendant companies.  The coffee is nice but I can’t say in truth the taste is revolutionary given the expedience of roasting and shipping.  I would buy from them again because I like it.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery. I bought the seasonal 5 bag promotion pack to try. The coffees  are fine, nothing wrong, but not special either. Definitely not the best I have. This seasonal promotion packs happened to be in a weak side apart from old brown java. Next time I will try some other kind. I still give 4 stars is because I like the size of each bag 250 g. If I buy small bags from the other shop, it costs a lot more. I don't like big bags as it won't be fresh after few months.One last thing, the printing of the name of coffee is too small and too light,  we can't really read which coffee we are drinking. I suggest to use label.

records.title: It was fine once you got it right
records.text: It was fine once you got it right. You included something I had not ordered.   Refund on its way. I order coffee beans once a year for a relatives birthday

records.title: Love toast hate dry bread
records.text: Over and above any expectations for a welcome pack, from the outset everything is fabulous with substantial gifts then sampled JBM and instant dissapointment some improvement gained with careful ratio measurements but tastes undercooked to me.  I have never heard of topping up a roast but think I might try it just for sanity sake

records.title: Failed @ 1st hurdle
records.text: Failed @ 1st hurdle Defo as NOT next day delivery Eventually when it did arrive Was supposed to be 9.15-1.15Actually arrived 5..40pm. Royal Mail Other delivery carriers actually do what they say & deliver when & with time slot !!! Prob maybe be Roysl Mail but that is who Is being used by yourself !!!!!!! Although do far actual coffee I’ve tried is vg & packaging is vg also . Only problem was delivery S Maxwell

records.title: Coffee is excellent as usual
records.text: Coffee is excellent as usualThe delivery service has fallen apart,next day delivery doesn't existI haven't recieved my order yet its been a week so far bit I'm sure the Coffee will be  ok

records.title: Poor after sales but beans and shipping good
records.text: Asked for some basic information on the beans i was buying that wasnt displayed on the website. Basic stuff as a roaster i needed. However, no one got back to me. Quality of the beans, shipping and free gift was excellent though

records.title: It would be really handy to know if a…
records.text: It would be really handy to know if a bean lends itself to milky drinks or pour over etc. when you buy a bean it has all options of brew method. I’ve bought coffees before now and had lousy espresso from the bean. Tailoring the purchase would help decide whether to get a certain bean or not. 👍🏼

records.title: Asked to do a review, but order not yet dispatched
records.text: I've been asked by e-mail to do a review on my experience, but sadly I haven't received my order yet.  Apart from the 'front page' of the website where it states that no orders would be dispatched after 2pm Wednesday 20th December (which I missed), during the process of ordering I was still under the impression the beans would be dispatched and received within the 24 hour period they state.  I had already looked at the website previously and potentially earmarked a bundle to order as a Christmas Present for my son, but hadn't done so, as was looking at other options too.  When I decided to go back and order, I had absolutely no idea, until I received a confirmation e-mail, I would have to wait until January for his Christmas Present to be prepared and dispatched.  It would have been good if there was a note on the final payment page that my order wouldn't be available until the New Year. I know we all work hard and need a break, but did find it a bit strange they had closed shop 2 1/2 working days before the weekend of Christmas arrived. I have been toying with the idea of cancelling my order, but when I told my son, he was very keen to experience this coffee bundle.  Just a shame the company shut up shop mid week before Christmas.

records.title: Whilst the coffee beans in general are…
records.text: Whilst the coffee beans in general are good I am disappointed to advise that when receiving a20% discount on my next order and also a 10% discount within my order box delivered , when applying either the 20%, or indeed the 10% to my next order neither discounts would apply I advised coffee Bean of this but no help was given , although I have now ordered another batch of beans , slightly disappointed with lack of help re their offered next order discounts

records.title: Great coffee, too much plastic
records.text: I've always liked their coffee, but I am disappointed with the amount of packaging for the coffee bags. Does each one need to be individually wrapped? I also emailed asking if there was plastic in the coffee bags themselves but didn't get a response. Very sorry to give a less than great review since I do like this business and love that it's local.

records.title: Pity me!
records.text: I decided to treat myself to some Jamaica Blue Mountain from the Coffee Bean Shop because I had been finding coffee very boring. When it arrived, I ripped it open to breathe in the amazing aroma I love so much and…. nothing. Turns out my sense of smell has not returned properly since having Covid a few months ago. I can smell other things, just not coffee. No wonder I’ve been getting bored of it 😢😢😢

records.title: Excellent coffee to suit all tastes
records.text: Excellent coffee to suit all tastes. What I especially like is that I can put in an order today and it will be at my front door the next day.  Staff are also happy to discuss what they have in stock, and advise on choice & taste. They even have some taster packs.Would have scored then a 5, but during my last order they did not have our regular brand in stock. So they decided to replace those 5 packs with another variety, which we had not tasted before. Wish they had asked me first. We hope its a nice roast.

records.title: We weary of specials
records.text: So I thought I would sample various Coffee Beans coffees. Ordered sample pack, "mystery" sample taster and some roasters choice. It turns out that they are all the same at different prices. The coffee itself was fine, good but nothing particularly special.

records.title: Coffee is great but delivery is expensive
records.text: Coffee is always great. However delivery costs have increased since my last purchase and are now half the price of the actual coffee. When competitors are doing free delivery I think this will be a sticking point for future purchases. Shame, as they sell my favourite coffee :(

records.title: I'm struggling with the beans and my…
records.text: I'm struggling with the beans and my new coffee machine.  Probably not your fault I just haven't made a decent coffee yet.I would have left it without a review, but this is the second prompt I've received so I'm responding to that.

records.title: Worth a try
records.text: Delivery was fast.Coffee however was not preferable, to my taste, as other online suppliers offerings.Also disappointed that bags were not resealable (with interlocking plastic strip).I continue my search for that online coffee supplier I know will satiate my need.

records.title: Coffee was good but not measurably…
records.text: Coffee was good but not measurably better than my usual supplier and many times more expensive. I knew it was dear but bought it as a treat for Christmas thinking  it would blow my socks off but was left disappointed and feeling rather ripped off!

records.title: Change Delivery Courier
records.text: please change your courier, there is no point doing next day delivery for Royal Mail to let you down.  Non delivery means waiting picking up from a post office which only opens 9-5.30pm, useless if you work.  Suggest DPD

records.title: I am sampling the beans sent and will…
records.text: I am sampling the beans sent and will try different blends to compare with my existing favourit.Once assessed I shall be better able to comment on my findings, and from then, my requirements.George.

records.title: The monsoon Malabar beans were…
records.text: The monsoon Malabar beans were excellent and delivery was fast. Via Royal Mail.Unfortunately the postage / packing shipping costs are not really viable If this could be reduced it would be excellent.

records.title: Nice coffee but weak customer service.
records.text: Nice coffee with a great selection but very frustrating when the special deals only cover a small subset of the available products, with no indication of what is covered.

records.title: Excellent .
records.text: I tried the Santos Brazilian so Far and it is very nice and fresh .

records.title: Hello
records.text: Hello , you contacted me to say your coffee bean product had been shipped to me on the 12 th decAs of yet I have not received my orderYour quick delivery of the order was very goodBut ....... I assume not receiving my order is down to the postal strikesThis is a small stocking filler gift for a coffee lover in my familyI am keeping fingers crossed it arrives before ChristmasX

records.title: Nothing special
records.text: Nothing special, was under whelmed by taste and amount for price. Came with a nice note and mock newspaper about the coffee. As someone who recently visited Jamaica and tried blue mountain on the island, I didn’t feel this was worth the money at all. Paid for marketing hype in my opinion. Won’t be repurchasing.

records.title: Fast shipping, attentive roasting, bad/wrong coffee
