records.text: Fast shipping, good packaging and branding, personal attention was clearly given to the roasting and packaging. Handwritten name of the person who roasted the beans and everything.BUT, I ordered KONA coffee beans, wonderful and expensive Hawaiian coffee, while I received coffee beans that make undrinkable, horribly acidic coffee. Does not taste like Kona coffee at all. I have had my fair share of Kona coffee in my life. It has a full body and almost no acidity. What I received, labelled Kona, is either not really Kona coffee or perhaps something has happened to the beans in transit or before roasting. Either way, that's not what we expected when we paid through the nose for real Kona coffee. The other fancy coffee we ordered from these guys, Jamaica Blue mtn., was really tasty. We have no basis for comparison here since we never had it before.

records.title: How would I know ?
records.text: How would I know ?Ask the post office when they might get around to delivering the coffee !Tracking says it’s arrived at local depot then updates cease.

records.title: Do not recommend.
records.text: I ordered a coffee because of the incredibly positive opinions, unfortunately, after trying the coffee that I ordered - Seasonal 5 Bag Promotion Pack, I am very disappointed and I am surprised why such a huge number of positive opinions because the coffee is really average and does not differ in taste from the average coffee from the supermarket. Definitely a huge plus is very fast delivery and beautiful packaging.Another thing I don't like very much is getting involved in politics. Since the company does not support the war in Ukraine, it should not send coffee to all the countries that send weapons to Ukraine instead of trying to help these poor people achieve peace. Since when do you put out a fire by adding fuel to the fire?Unfortunately, I do not recommend.

records.title: The bean roast smelt amazing however…
records.text: The bean roast smelt amazing however disappointed with the taste of Blue Mountain. I found it weak in comparison to the coffee sold by the Marley brother which if half the price with lots of flavour.Unfortunately  I wouldnt purchase the coffee from Coffee Bean co again.

records.title: Great customer service, coffee-not so great
records.text: Customer service, speed, attention to customers is exceptional. New customer welcoming call was amazing. If only coffee was good too. Only one bag of 7 we got is drinkable. Guess there was some roasting or storing issue as we're familiar with most of the kinds of beans we've got and these tasted nothing like it. It tasted burnt. A little disappointing. We really wanted to like you.

records.title: We will find another supplier
records.text: Ours was not a small order and 2 of the packets broke in the post and were replaced immediately but it transpired that the bottoms of all of the bags were week and after having coffee beans everywhere we had to check and reseal all of the bags.Some of the varieties we bought roast unevenly - which is down to many things - but not the roaster as we have had great success with other suppliers.  Unevenly roasted beans clog up the grinder.Not a supplier we will use again

records.title: Reason I only gave 2 stars is purely…
records.text: Reason I only gave 2 stars is purely due to the terrible service of Royal Mail and nothing to do with your product in anyway. Not sure if this is due to level of price but the level of service received from Royal mail is awful, you a reputable company that delivers when promised, even during Covid pandemic. we actually use DPDand yes they deliver as promised.The coffee was awesome, hats off to Jenni who tried to help out, my intention was to purchase locally  in the grinder and the coffee rather than the likes of Amazon but it just did not work out that way.

description:
Flavourly collaborates with top craft brewers to bring you a selection of quality, great-tasting craft beers. These are brewed fresh, exclusively for the Flavourly community and delivered to you at unbeatable value.


Incredible selection
Award-winning breweries
FREE delivery (no minimum order)

records.title: My husband likes to try the real ales
records.text: My husband likes to try the real ales. He loves all the different IPA's. I can't always afford the big packs, so when a smaller, reasonably priced one comes along, I grab it. He gets really excited to see which ones are in the box. The delivery is always pretty quick too. Thank you

records.title: Flavourly obtain great beers from all…
records.text: Flavourly obtain great beers from all sorts of different brewers who clearly care about the products they produce as they are always top notch. Obviously, due to individual tastes there are likely to be some you prefer more than others but I know I am buying great beer that I can't necessarily obtain from my local shops.If you love beer then flavourly are definitely worth a try.

records.title: If you like ales you can’t go wrong
records.text: Love the flexibility of Flavourly as there’s no subscription, you just dip in when you need to. The beers are interesting and varied. You can go with Flavourly’s suggestions or build your own case and even with free delivery, it’s quick and efficient. Prices are keen and quality high so I can totally recommend.

records.title: Trust them.
records.text: I am a regular customer. Never had a problem other than some of the beers in the mixed cases were disappointing. Good value, good website, good delivery, discount offers even better value. I now have a full set of Flavourly lager glasses!!

records.title: Great service
records.text: Flavourly were very efficient: they reminded me about my due delivery, which arrived at the precise hour they stated. The selection looks excellent. The detailed tasting notes sent 5he day after are an interesting additional service. I also like the fact that I can use the members services to tailor my future choices.

records.title: I've been here many timesordered many times before
records.text: I’ve ordered many times before, but been absent for a while… Ordered a mixed case that has many citrus mixes that I enjoy in the summer months…

records.title: I’ve been a flavourly customer for…
records.text: I’ve been a flavourly customer for quite some time & I have no complaints about the service. Delivery is accurate & secure, the prices are brilliant. The range of beers I’m sent each month is great, a good spread of styles & tastes.The customer service is exceptional, I had a problem with a couple of deliveries a while back & Flavourly customer services sorted it out brilliantly, they even gave me some extra account credit as a courtesy.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Plenty of communication and delivery, considering the extra pressure on delivery companies due to the current postal strike, was very quick.  There is also a taste guide provided which will be very helpful.  The beers look very interesting and it is a great way to try out different ones.  Very pleased indeed.

records.title: 2023 Mystery box
records.text: Mystery box : Very pleasant surprise, some old favourites, like Murk Life Balance, and some real discoveries, Wild Card "Helter Skelter" wow. Good price and free delivery, what's not to like?

records.title: Good beers good service.
records.text: I have bought from Flavourly on 3 different occasions now and each time it has been a smooth and easy process. Everything I ordered arrived in good time and well packaged. Their website is very user friendly and informative about what you will get for your money.I will certainly use themagain in the future.

records.title: Great value for money
records.text: Great value for money, I have used flavourly since 2020 as I like to have a fridge full of beer and I don't like it all to be the same. From my research Flavourly is the best value out of it's competitors for beer subscriptions, and while it's not as experimental as some of its competitors, it is significantly cheaper. The main compromise is on delivery times, but that's part of getting the value.

records.title: Latest Box
records.text: Good selections plenty of variety Good value

records.title: Good beer, but unexpected delay for latest order
records.text: I like getting an occasional case of different beers from Flavourly and I can’t recall any I didn’t like, except maybe a floral beer that was just slightly too weird for me. The deliveries usually arrive in good time, but for some reason the latest one was very slow to arrive and there was no indication of why, or when it would be sent when I looked on the website. More info in such instances would be nice. Also, the snack was missing!

records.title: Why ask about my experience when it's not finished?
records.text: Original review: The ordering process was fine, but please do not send out questionnaires about the purchase before the delivery company has registered they have it. I may get the wrong order or a bag of bees. How can I tell until I get the box?Update:The beers arrived, and all was well, so I upgraded the review.

records.title: Flavourly always offer a good range of…
records.text: Flavourly always offer a good range of beers and this is the first case I have put together myself which I am looking forward to sharing with my family over the holidays

records.title: Craft beer, delivered, no subscription
records.text: Craft beer in the can delivered to you door. The big advantage of Flavourly is no subscription, buy only when you want. However expect a lot of emails suggesting further purchases. Yet to find out if the frequency of these can be reduced without having to totally disconnect from all mailings. Selection of IPAs seem good, and initial offer was good value.

records.title: A good range of beer/ales etc
records.text: A good range of beer/ales etc. Very quick delivery after order placed. Excellent prices for bulk ordering.

records.title: Very quick delivery and after having…
records.text: Very quick delivery and after having enjoyed my first can today i may well order again in the future,cheers😀🍻👍🏻

records.title: Slightly disappointed since I paid…
records.text: Slightly disappointed since I paid £1.29 per can and the next day email offers of £1.19 appeared. Sharp marketing???

records.title: Good deal at reasonable price
records.text: Managed to get a good deal through Money Saving Expert. Good selection of beers at a reasonable price

records.title: Great delivery
records.text: Great delivery, but my package did not have he snack item as advertised. A small item to mention, but not as stated.

records.title: Good selection of beers but no glass
records.text: The selection of beers was very good but part of the order was a beer glass and this was not in the parcel - with all the issues around the post before Christmas I didn't complain, just put it down to one of those things, I'd happily use Flavourly again.

records.title: Good variety of beers at a good price
records.text: Good variety of beers at a good price. Interesting to try new beers.

records.title: The beer eventually arrived intact…
records.text: The beer eventually arrived intact after being told previously the product was out of stock

records.title: Ok range of beers
records.text: Good packaging.  The range only has one stout, lots of pale ale & IPAs and several lagers, there's nothing in between.

records.title: Beer
records.text: Beer, once it arrived was it's usual tasty high standard, but the long delay after order was placed and paid for, was unacceptable, not for the delay as such, but the total lack of communication, with response to Twitter or my e-mails. Please improve your customer relationships, loyalty is key to successful businesses

records.title: Been a long time customer
records.text: Update to below…received timely responses from Flavourly holding hands up and apologising for delay & putting a small credit on account by way of a further apology…beer was eventually received about a week later, have updated from 2 to 3.Been a long time customer, beer selection is great, tried many different beers, usually good and service has pretty much always been first class. This time though still awaiting order after a week. Then discovered options to contact Flavourly aren't great, no phone number. Then tried Twitter as don't do Facebook but twitter no longer allow you to send a DM to anyone that doesn't follow you unless you subscribe to Twitter as as a verified user so that option is no pointless Flavourly unless you follow all your customers! So have left a message but it seems from the latest reviews I can expect to be kept waiting for a response and my beer? Was gonna put this in as a 3 meantime but given the increasing numbers seeming to be experiencing delays with little or no explanation I'll leave it at a 2 meantime and reconsider placing my beer orders elsewhere if things review wise continue to slide :(

records.title: Was good but price rising and service slipping
records.text: I have been buying from Flavourly for several years and have always been happy until this year. The range of beers is good and I like to try new beers, so I did find them great. Unfortunately the price has been going up (understandable with inflation) but the service has been declining at the same time. I used to get my deliveries within a couple of days but have been waiting 2 weeks lately. They have also become very slow in responding to queries.

records.title: Hopefully a blip from previous 5* performance
records.text: I've been an 'ad-hoc' customer for a year or so ordering crates now and then. The beer has all been excellent. However, I'm one of many who has experienced a long delay since an order in early June, but did receive my delivery today, over three weeks later. I will probably use them again, but the lack of Customer Service responses to emails from me and others is probably something of a worry. I appreciate 'blips' do happen, but better that a company is proactive then reactive in these situations. Posting here to reassure others primarily.

records.title: The product would have merited 5 stars…
records.text: The product would have merited 5 stars but for delivery issues. One problem was that one can must have been punctured leaving only a small residue of beer.

records.title: mystery box
records.text: Mixed box and mixed pointsDownsides - Delivery took a week despite stating 2-3 days when ordered.Only one can of stoutUpsides well packaged and all received in tactLooks a decent cross section of IPA'SAt £1-50 a can good price

records.title: The delivery of this item was very…
records.text: The delivery of this item was very good. I was not happy that I paid twice for postage,  once to wowcher 4.95 when I ordered it and then 5.99 to flavourly when i redeemed the voucher. How can this be right, there was nothing in the fine print. I complained to flavourly but have heard nothing. Not impressed.

records.title: I had trouble with the initial order…
records.text: I had trouble with the initial order wouldn’t except the delivery address. That was sorted but  I am still day 7 in and no signs of any significant delivery date by yodel. All I get is we are sorry we will deliver as soon as possible but don’t have the staff to deliver to our area. Really annoyed!

records.title: Normally really good service and quick…
records.text: Normally really good service and quick delivery, this time took 2 weeks to arrive . Still a good collection of beers .

records.title: Can’t really comment as still waiting…
records.text: Can’t really comment as still waiting delivery of the productUpdate - Parcel arrived on Xmas eve just in time for Christmas. Loving the beer selections, not had a bad one yet. Look forward to ordering another mixed box in the near future

records.title: This was not the easiest experience
records.text: This was not the easiest experience.  The initial order was not delivered in the timescale promised.  Only when I queried this was it detailed that it was not available.  I therefore reordered only to find the original order then arriving, followed by the new order.  I subsequently returned this.  Customer service was very supportive but it seems, as detailed in other comments, the delivery/supply system is letting Flavourly down.  The beer was good but a little too much hassle involved unfortunately.

records.title: Order took 8 days to arrive
records.text: Order took 8 days to arrive, your estimate is 2-3 days.

records.title: beers I like but delivery very slow…
records.text: beers I like but delivery very slow still  waiting a week later for mine to be delivered and still no sign.

records.title: Not Flavourly responsibility. Will try to use again.
records.text: I told the delivery service to leave the package with a neighbour, as we’ve had numerous parcels stolen from the doorstep. I received an email saying it was delivered on the doorstep around 13:30hrs and my partner and I finish work at 19:00hrs. Needless to say, the package was not there. I understand this is NOT Flavourly responsibility but I can not review what I don’t have. I spoke to the delivery company and they just kept telling me that it was delivered and their job is done.

records.title: What am I drinking?
records.text: In my last delivery of 48,  half of the cans have a sticky label covering the whole of the can.  On removing the sticky label, the original signage  on the can identifies a different beer, of different strength.I am now concerned about that which I am consuming and if the ABV is incorrect it may lead to serious consequences

records.title: I get it’s a clearance box, but…
records.text: I get it’s a clearance box, but 11/30 all from the same brewery felt like a bit much. Not much style variety either, ~1/3 is lager, almost all rest is pale ale. It’s good value, but I wouldn’t rush to buy again as a mixed product. Also a number of the cans are sticky/dirty - could have done with a little wipe while packing.

records.title: Now 13 days and no sign of beer.....
records.text: Ordered a batch of beer and paid £58.95 on 29th May and order was confirmed by e mail . Heard nothing since. Chat function on website doesn't work. No response to my e mail within 48 hours. No number to call. Account shows hasn't even been dispatched for delivery! Left in limbo and helpless basically with no beer, no contact and no delivery forecast.Ordered plenty of times but delivery getting worse and zero customer support when things go wrong.Update: order received 13th June after e mail response yesterday.

records.title: Slow Deliver
records.text: Order took about 2-3 weeks longer than it said it was going to arrive. Customer support was contacted to change the delivery address, they said they had, but when the delivery driver called, the address hadn't been changed. Product was good but the server was far slower than promised.

records.title: Very Poor Service
records.text: When ordering, should have been three working days delivery with a possible five working days. However it didn't arrive and it took two emails to get a response. Eventually it arrived fourteen working days later! No contact number for customer service on website is also poor. In addition Yodel left the parcel in a 'safe place' - directly outside the front door in full view of the street for anyone passing to steal. Overall a very negative experience and not one I intend to repeat.

records.title: Good product as always, but disappointing delivery on this occasion
records.text: Normally great experience with Flavourly, but the delivery process and communication was disappointing.Item was ordered on 12th June and delivered on 30th June. There was no reply to be initial email on 21 June to ask when item would be delivered. I only had a response on my second email a week later. I did get an apology email in the end and the parcel was received (it was a gift), but if there had been an issue with increased orders I would have welcomed an email within a few days of ordering to say it would be another couple of weeks (as I received lots of other marketing emails from you!).Thanks

records.title: Delivery issues
records.text: Delivery given as 1-2 working days.  It took 11 working days with no clear update on when to expect delivery.  Was for a birthday present so had to go out to buy something else. Very disappointed.

records.title: I still haven’t received my case
records.text: I still haven’t received my case. I ordered and paid for it (above the odds in my opinion) on 17/12/22.I haven’t received it as of 10 p.m. on 22/12/22Yodel said it would be delivered within 2-3 working days. Their tracking said it would be delivered yesterday. Now they say tracking is unavailable. In the meantime, I have seen far better deals in local supermarkets. I’m not happy!Update: my case finally arrived intact  on 31st December and compensation has been arranged by Flavourly for the inconvenience. This has allowed me to upgrade to two stars. Yodel have not impressed!

records.title: sharp marketing practice
records.text: I used to thoroughly recommend Flavourly but have been very disappointed over the last few months.Recently any reasonable offers have not been available although I responded immediately andinstead have been directed to much more expensive products.....it does seem that although offered there are no products to meet any demand and this is a marketing ploy.

records.title: Ordered a beer pack as a gift for a…
records.text: Ordered a beer pack as a gift for a friend who had just come out of hospital. Thought this would cheer him up. Unfortunately the gift card that I had requested was not included in the box and my friend had to spend hours trying to find out who had sent it. This spoiled what was meant to be a nice surprise. The response from customer service was not what I would have expected, luke warm to say the least with no satisfactory solution. I will not be ordering again and wont recommend.

records.title: No acknowledgement after 5 days.
records.text: I ordered on the 20th of January but have heard absolutely nothing so far, other then the fact that the money has gone off my account. How does it take this long to even acknowledge an order in this day and age? So far my first experience hasn't been a very pleasant one.

records.title: Usually 10/10 for the company
records.text: Usually 10/10 for the company, however on this instance the delivery took over two weeks from being ordered to being delivered. The issue was there was no ‘tracking’ on the personal account so had no idea when the delivery would arrive until the day before when a message received.

description: DrinkSupermarket is the one stop shop for all your drink needs, with over 9000 wines, beers, spirits and soft drinks for you to choose from and delivery ranging from a single bottle miniature to a mixed pallet we guarantee better convenience, selection and value for all our customers.

records.title: Great
records.text: Very prompt despatch. Arrived sooner than anticipated. Well packaged. Very pleased

records.title: Bought as a gift.
records.text: Bought as a gift.Looked lovely in the gift boxEasy to check outQuick delivery5* recommend

records.title: Good service from Drinks Supermarket
records.text: Ordering my beer was straightforward and easy, the delivery was on time as arranged.Will certainly order again. Thanks.

records.title: Kirsch de Cuisine online.
records.text: Kirsch de Cuisine hard to find in supermarkets so great to find it online.Delivered at a good price and on time by DrinkSupermarket.com

records.title: Slight problem quickly sorted
records.text: A slight problem with the delivery of my order was sorted straight away after my quick phone call to Drinks Supermarket.I have found them a very efficient company,orders are delivered quickly(3 days each time I have ordered),bottles are well packed(loads of bubble wrap and in a solid cardboard box).I never buy my alcohol anywhere else.

records.title: No complaints…
records.text: A bottle I've been trying to locate for ages, as supermarkets no longer stock. It arrived in good time and I was kept informed of delivery alterations.

records.title: Happy Customer
records.text: Found a bottle of Cypriot fortified wine on this company’s website, it was cheaper than on other sites and it was delivered very well packed and within the time frame arranged.  Very happy!

records.title: Really impressed by Drinks Supermarket
records.text: Really impressed by Drinks Supermarket. I made a gin advent calendar and needed 24 miniatures. The choice of different gins was huge and the prices really reasonable. They arrived really quickly and well packaged. I liked how you could set your budget on the website in the filters, so only miniatures at the right price would come up. I would definitely use this company again.

records.title: DrinksSupermarket really delivers!
records.text: I booked a next day delivery and it arrived on time as expected. I have used DrinkSupermarket before and it works! well done to all concerned.

records.title: A good experience and will use again
records.text: Ordering on line was straightforward and easy to follow. The follow up email giving information on shipping and delivery was clear and lastly the package arrived on time and no breakages.

records.title: MIs-leading Description Leads to Delays
records.text: [While the delivery of Cockspur Fine Rum was to Shropshire, the package was destined for Ireland.This has just arrived and accounts for my delay in responding to your request that I assess my experience.]Confusion initially arose as, on your website, you changed your description of the Cockspur Rum currently on offer, saying that what now was different to that previously sold.Telephone enquiries to Drinks Supermarket failed to get a satisfactory explanation. I was told that I could return any bottles that had not been opened.  [But how could I assess if the Cockspur was the same as previously sold without opening a bottle?]Thus, I ordered six bottles and not twelve as intended.The Cockspur supplied seems to be identical to that previously supplied - apart from the bottles being of a different design.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, found a bottle of wine I couldn't find anywhere else, quick delivery, well packaged. Paid through amazon account which worked well. Would use DrinksSupermarket again.

records.title: Happy with product and price was…
records.text: Happy with product and price was fantastic.My complaint would be with the delivery, but that's a Yodel issue and not the product.

records.title: Good price
records.text: Good price, easy to place an order and quick delivery in a securely packaged parcel. It was a present and my partner says it tastes good but I'm a little suspicious that unlike previous Lagavulins bought, this has no batch number or date on it,  though having searched the internet, this seems common for the 2022 distillers choice that's on sale elsewhere.

records.title: Given the time of year
records.text: Given the time of year, this delivery was very good.

records.title: As a diabetic bud zero is ideal for me…
records.text: As a diabetic bud zero is ideal for me as it has zero sugar and I can drive as it has zero alcohol but still retaining a good tasting larger

records.title: As a regular returning customer
records.text: As a regular returning customer, purchasing the same product, I was impressed as ever with ease accessing my account and reordering previous order. Lead time was fine and pricing good

records.title: Great product
records.text: Great product. Slight mix up with delivery which was sorted on the second time of asking

records.title: Great selection of miniature wines, but poor delivery courier
records.text: Great selection of miniature wines. Let down by the delivery company (Yodel) delivering to the wrong address.

records.title: This website had the widest range of…
records.text: This website had the widest range of liqueur and wine miniatures which was what I was particularly looking for. Delivery was expensive, but was prompt and the items were very well packaged.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Ordering was easy. Comunications about the progress of my order was very good. Staff were knowledgable and friendly.Only thing that prevents me giving 5 stars is that I was assured that I would receive a 2002 vintage wine but instead received a 2003 vintage.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service, reasonable prices but shipping costs are high for two or more cartons.

records.title: Better late than never
records.text: There was a few days delay in the delivery and I could not get in touch with the courier. I contacted the supplier who eventually got back to me and informed me there had been a breakage so another pack would be sent out. Finally got it about 1 week late. I believe the delivery firm was at fault not Drink Suoernsrket

records.title: Very disappointed stick with high street shops
records.text: **Update by 10am the order had been cancelled and fully refunded great customer service when open so updated ton4*Very disappointed I ordered this as it said I would receive delivery Saturday or Sunday, I need this order as a gift for Monday. I have had no dispatch notification to be able to track the order and there is no weekend customer service. I cannot find on the website if I can return the order (which I doubt very much) and am now going to have to go and spend £100 of my money on the gift I bought this for and keep this order myself, I don’t even really like rum!

records.title: Perfect other than WAY too much packaging.
records.text: Everything perfect thank you other than... the packaging - each case/ bottle wrapped in huge amounts of bubblewrap (albeit partially recycled material) in its robust box. Not experienced this with any other provider (several) I buy from. Is it really necessary?

records.title: Courier issues…
records.text: No problem with the company but using FedEx as courier a mistake. Tried to deliver on a different day than arranged without any notification.

records.title: Liz criticised Company is good they have a great range…Liz criticism
records.text: Company is good they have a great range of products but from my point of view greatly let down by FedEx who failed to deliver what Drink people promised

records.title: I thought the product was great but the…
records.text: I thought the product was great but the price of getting it out to me was a little pricey.

records.title: Didnt arrve as ordered
records.text: I ordered on thursday and paid nearly £7 to have it delivered next working day which was friday. I didnt get the order till monday so not cery happy with that

records.title: The drink tastes great But….!
records.text: The drink tastes great But….!The postage cost and delivery time let me down.Double check next day delivery small print as mine arrived 5 days later due to Bank holiday. No postage refund was offered as DrinkSupermarket refused.

records.title: Let down by disastrous delivery…
records.text: Let down by disastrous delivery experience!The wine ( which is great) finally arrived a week late mainly due to FedEx rubbish service. First case of wine apparently stolen from Fex Ex van and second attempt delayed 4 days longer than I was promised. I called DrinksSupermarket 3 times and while I don’t think the mistake was theirs, I do believe it that it was encumbrant on them to ensure their delivery partner is up to it. Shame - I paid extra for next day delivery but waited a week!!! Could be bothered to chase a refund of delivery cost!!

records.title: I paid for next day delivery but waited…
records.text: I paid for next day delivery but waited a few days ordered thur night received on the following Tuesday. Also bottles are coloured glass and have no wrapping around them as in the advertising . and were just delivered in an old cardboard box . These 6 rainbow procecco wine bottlers were for our 8 th wedding anniversary on Sunday my wife was so underwhelmed. Regards mr dadds

records.title: Need better delivery service.
records.text: Products OK and generally good service. HOWEVER, they need to review whether their delivery agents FedEx are up to the job. Claimed no-one in when they attempted delivery which was untrue. Suspect a 'hit-and-run' driver under pressure. Goods delivered eventually.

records.title: Registered complaint about non delivery
records.text: Courier sent message saying parcel delivered with what appeared to be a fake signature. They said they had delivered at 7.44am when my whole family was in the house. Registered complaint immediately but have had no response in 48 hours.UPDATE. The parcel arrived 5 days after the courier showed a proof of delivery. More to do with them th and the supplier I would think.

records.title: Appalling delivery service
records.text: I am  very happy with the product but it was massively let down by the delivery company. I wasted a whole day waiting for a delivery that didn’t come and then it looked like I would have to waste another day because all the tracking said was delivery by 18.00. NOT GOOD ENOUGH! I will probably not be purchasing anything else because of this experience

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: I placed an expensive order and when the order arrived an item in one of the giftBoxes was smashed.  I reported it and sent in evidence stating that the glass in the gift box was smashed.  The outcome was they would give me 1.14 for the damaged gift box and inconvenience.  This is a joke and will be my last order with this company treat customers badly.

records.title: Company very helpfull
records.text: Company very helpfull, easy to order. Courier  service. D H L not good. Parcel went from being delayed to being lost to being damaged in transit. Got refund.

records.title: An excellent product range at good prices
records.text: I really like Drink Supermarket. It has a great product range at good prices. I have ordered several times in the past.The reason for only 3 stars is because my package was held up. I contacted the courier directly who told me the problem was that the delivery label only had my town and postcode on. Therefore it was stuck in the depot. When the courier located my package they corrected the delivery label. Eventually I got my order, the missing parts of my address on the label had been written on by hand.

records.title: Could be better
records.text: Website super easy to use and extra discount if you add more, have ordered before and was a super seamless experience but I ordered on 30/11/24 and still haven’t received my parcel and it’s 16/12/24, delivery time was 3-5 working days.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: I was sent the wrong quantity of the correct item. I ordered 24x500ml cans but received 24x250ml bottles. Rather than sending more of the same or correcting the delivery they gave me a credit for the price difference which means my purchase works out at worse value. Also, this is a gift for an employee and so now I have to go and buy something else to make up the value. Their response, a 5% voucher for future orders. I paid 37.5% more for my purchase?

records.title: Good but..........
records.text: Very disappointed with the delivery service! Royal Mail service was very, very poor. I don't know if Drink supermarket only uses Royal mail but I advise anyone buying from Drink supermarket to ask for a different courier service. My experience buying from Drink supermarket was positive, obviously the delivery process I would rate 1 star. If I would recommend it? Yes! Just chose a different courier.

records.title: Late Delivery Extra cost
records.text: Ordered the stuff . Paid extra for Saturday delivery. Turned up following Tuesday or Wednesday . Waste of time and money.

records.title: Packaging not great but quick delivery
records.text: Packaging not great; one can slightly crushed small leak so flat. 7 out of 8 ain’t bad I suppose and bottle of rum safely secured

records.title: Stock control problems
records.text: Stock control problems. I ordered three items which were stated to be in stock but then they told me one was not. This is a trade account so we need reliable delivery for our business.

records.title: Delivery was 2 days late
records.text: Delivery was 2 days late, even after paying extra for a faster delivery. And no response from customer service. As a regular customer, I think this will be my last purchase.

records.title: Failed Delivery Times
records.text: Ordered a Bottle of Beluga Gold for our Anniversary well within the Time frame required for a next day delivery, it arrived three days laterThe Company uses a Service that they can not Guarantee or Control and, In our View they should warn Customers appropriately, We are disputing the excessive Delivery charges As on the website they QUOTED FREE for Orders over £99.00 in  3–5 days We paid for express @ £7.95 and received £2.01 refund unacceptable and incredibly poor business ethics.

records.title: Very disappointed
records.text: Very disappointed, my rather expensive Bira Blonde purchase has only 1 month to expiry. I had expected longer to enjoy 24 bottles, at least until the summer. I won’t be buying from this company again. I was sent a link to send them direct feedback but it didn’t  work and ‘contact us’ page just has FAQs which clearly say they are not interested if a short shelf live - maybe it’s a common occurrence!

records.title: Says out of stock but still showing as available
records.text: Placed an order and heard nothing until a week later to say they were out of stock of one particular specialist vodka.  They did not tell me until the day I was expecting delivery.  Even though they are still advertising this item online as being In Stock.  Really messed up my plans as I don't have time now to reorder from anywhere else.

description: For over a century, Thorntons has specialised in crafting high quality chocolate, sweets, toffee, fudge and other confectionery. Our rich heritage has seen us constantly create and improve new and favourite recipes to enhance your chocolate experience.

records.title: Excellent customer care from Tolulope
records.text: Excellent customer care from Tolulope; Thorntons consumer service advisor. I ordered 4 bags of coffee creams as a gift before Christmas. When they arrived they were in a Thorntons box so I did not open them, I just wrapped them up. On Christmas day when opened Coffee creams were no where to be seen, only Viennese Whirls. E-mailed Thorntons a few days after Christmas explaining the issue and within the week 4 bags of coffee creams arrived, superb.

records.title: Amazing goodwill gesture
records.text: I ordered some chocolates from Thorntons for Christmas, which turned up promptly within a few days. However I was surprised to see two boxes arrive rather than one (I was sure the items would have fit into one box). I opened the boxes to find my order had been sent twice! I checked my account to make sure I hadn't ordered twice by mistake and I hadn't, so I contacted Thorntons customer care and let them know. A few days later I had an email from Tolulope confirming that as a goodwill gesture I could keep the extra chocolates - as a chocolate lover that made my day! Thank you Tolulope and Thorntons :)

records.title: Great Experience…
records.text: I had an error with a wrong order being sent to me and I contacted customer services. Got through straight away and spoke to Chelsea who was very polite and friendly. She immediately dealt with my query and arranged for the correct items to be sent to me that same day, she even said i could keep the 6 bags of chocolate that were sent to me in error. Overall a great customer a service experience, I am very happy

records.title: Helpful support after poor quality chocolates
records.text: The bags of mint and coffee chocolates were poor with the mint chocolates there were broken up pieces in both bags. The coffee ones had damaged chocolates in the bags. Thortons should do better on quality control the standards are poor. Could do better.Update - with me contacting through email customer support Chelsea Customer Service Advisor replied with apologises and refund which helps me rethink of the Company's attitude towards its Customers. The one thing they need to improve on is Quality control of their products that there is no damaged chocolates going to its Customers.

records.title: Couldn't ask for more
records.text: Disappointing delivery experience (items ruined) so contacted Thornton's largely to make them aware so they could complain. Didn't expect them to be so very helpful and even resend the damaged items.  Could not ask for more

records.title: Ordered chocolates as a gift – put the…
records.text: Ordered chocolates as a gift – put the billing address as the delivery address and vice-versa. One of their consumer services advisors, Chelsea, was very helpful – advising me how best to rectify this and following up to make sure all had gone well.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Unfortunately, there was an issue with the chocolates. Chelsea in customer service completely understood the situation and could not have been more helpful. Thank you, Chelsea!

records.title: Great customer service ☺️
records.text: Had a slight mix up with my order, so phoned customer support and the nicest person ever answered the phone (Lewis) - they helped me out in a matter of minutes.  Lewis had the loveliest phone manner, and made everything seem like no trouble at all. I wouldn’t hesitate to order again, as who doesn’t love Thorntons chocolate?!

records.title: Outstanding Customer Service
records.text: I had some queries I called and spoke to the manager Lewis  , It was an excellent and easy conversation. Top Top service please keep doing what you excel at

records.title: Excellent customer service from Chelsea
records.text: I ordered a few things for gifts including toffee, my mum's absolute favourite. One of the items was out of stock. However I received a prompt email from Chelsea offering a replacement or refund. She was extremely helpful and the item actually became available again. She let me know and confirmed the complete order would be sent to me.

records.title: I ordered a few boxes of chocolates…
records.text: I ordered a few boxes of chocolates only to find one of them had all the security stickers broken. I contacted Thorntons and relayed the circumstances. After sending them a photo, I was sent a new box with no problems. Lisa was very helpful in resolving the problem promptly.Thank you.

records.title: Online order issues.
records.text: I ordered chocolates online to give as gifts for Christmas. When the order was delivered, three items didn't have the personalised message requested when ordering. I contacted Customer Support, and Chelsea responded. She was extremely helpful and arranged for the replacement items, complete with the messages, to be sent out straightaway. No quibbling, no questions asked , just an immediate satisfactory response. Very happy with Customer Srrvices at Thorntons. Thank you Chelsea.

records.title: Disappointed when order arrived
records.text: I ordered chocolates online to give as gifts for Christmas.  When the order was delivered, one item didn't have the personalised message I requested when ordering. I contacted Customer Support, spoke to Chelsea. She was extremely helpful and arranged for a replacement item, complete with the message I requested to be sent out straightaway. No quibbling, no questions asked , just an immediate satisfactory response.  Very happy with  Customer Srrvices at Thorntons. Thank you Chelsea.

records.title: I ordered 2 x boxes of chocolates via…
records.text: I ordered 2 x boxes of chocolates via Thornton’s web site. When my parcel arrived it only contained 1 box of chocolates. I telephoned customer service and Chelsea managed my complaint to my satisfaction.

records.title: Christmas Gifts
records.text: Thank you to Ashley from Thorntons who has addressed an issue that I had with an order. Replacements have been arranged. Thanks again.

records.title: Classic range great.
records.text: Classic range great.Would be better to replace strawberry with Viennese Truffels. So put all nuts, praline, toffee, caramel, fudge, truffles etc in one box. Put coffee, fruit flavours etc  in another box.

records.title: I ordered a larger Easter Egg hamper in…
records.text: I ordered a larger Easter Egg hamper in plenty of time for Easter, but like others never arrived. But have to give Thorntons a bit off credit and they've tried their best to rectify things by giving me a full refund and also delivering the Easter Egg hamper. I am off course disappointed my item didn't arrive in time for Easter, but appreciate the effort made to make things right, and they've gone about it all the right away.

records.title: My order still has not arrived MIA…
records.text: My order still has not arrived MIA since 4th jan, I have reached out to Thornton's 3 times via the stupid website form and they have not even acknowledged me, I cannot find an email or any methods to taks this further. Basically they have stolen my money, definitely do not recommend. Terrible service.0002978704How am I meant to phone you Karen???? Where is the phone numberEdit: while Karen was as much help as a chocolate teapot someone else got me the number and a lovely chap sorted all this out immediately so I've upgraded the review from a 1 to a 4. Would have been a 5 but Karen needs to try harder :)

records.title: Such a shame [updated]
records.text: I'm changing my original review because the chocolate did turn up in the end! And the chocolate is good. :)The website does seem to be a little buggy. Some things Thornton's might like to look at:1) Enforce the first line of the address. In my case  I did set it, but then it vanished and I didn't notice. Fortunately, I was eventually able to get through to a bot at Evri to correct it.2) Either don't have 'shipping address same as billing address' automatically ticked, or bring up an 'are you sure' dialog. Otherwise it's too easy to mistakenly leave it set, when a lot of people will be ordering for people at other addresses.3) The contact form doesn't see to work. I filled it out twice and submitted it, but nothing happened. I wrote to 'customercare' but never got an answer. I appreciate you were busy.

records.title: Personalised large egg for wedding
records.text: Personalised large egg for wedding. Came on time with plenty of protective packaging. The personalisation in icing was not too straight and the larger egg needs thicker icing to be more impactive. Overall pleased though.

records.title: Good and Bad unfortunately
records.text: Most of the items were lovely but the Champagne truffles have a bitter edge which was rather unpleasant. I was surprised as you have such a good reputation. I have had this product before, so perhaps you have changed the champagne to a cheaper version. I won't buy them again. Easter eggs were lovely.

records.title: i was happy to have Thornton's as a…
records.text: i was happy to have Thornton's as a choice for easter eggs for family and pleased with the delivery one day late as it said 3/5 working days so i gave 4 stars

records.title: Egg was really nice ….
records.text: Egg was really nice ….. shame it didn’t arrive until 5days later than expected

records.title: Great purchase of Easter eggs
records.text: Great purchase of Easter eggs, delivered when planned too. Yummy chocolate and a great choice too

records.title: Very quick service
records.text: Very quick service. Excellent chocolates. The only downside is the ordering. I have have an account with Thornton’s, but it no longer recognises my password. I press the reset button and it says a’code’ has been sent to my email which never arrives. This happens every time I buy their chocolates. I have complained and was told it would be sorted. Result - nothing.

records.title: Had to order not once, not twice but three times to get correct order
records.text: Recently ordered 2 personalised advent calendars, I like how the website says please ensure spelling is correct as they will copy it exactly.They arrived and my sons wasn’t correct, contacted customer service who were great and arranged a new one to be sent out asap, that one arrived and once again incorrect, had to contact customer service again and they did say they could refund or resend. I chose to have it resent and thankfully it was correct this time.Probably won’t bother ordering them again next year due to this.

records.title: Where is the U.K. in your required country drop down
records.text: Ordered my items no problem but omg the checkout the drop down country ID shambles, big clue either have everything in alphabetical order or at least put the most popular countries at the start of your list, please ask your board of directors to try checking out and find either GB or U.K. in the drop-down. I got to the point of cancelling my purchase.

records.title: Order melted and inedible
records.text: Ordered truffles for my partner’s birthday. When they arrived, both packets had melted at some point into solid inedible blocks. Contacted customer services and no response over a week later.Edit: Called customer services as advised and order was replaced and received next day.

records.title: Badly let down this time…
records.text: I paid for seven items and named day delivery, ready for a family get together. The parcel arrived four days late, with one item missing.  The chocolate is nice, but the service on this occasion was appalling.  I am waiting to hear back from Thorntons currently, after logging a complaint.

records.title: advent…
records.text: Have bought personalised advent calanders for 15 yrs either from instore or recently online. Why oh why have you this year decided to do separate personalised chocolate block ? Spoils the calander and I definately won't be buying them again.

records.title: Delicious chocolates but unfortunately a bit melted.
records.text: Very tasty as expected but the egg had melted into a lump, as had the chocolates accompanying the egg. As it was bought at reduced price after Easter I wasn't too upset, although I did notify Thorntons (not had a reply yet). The other chocolates were really super and in good condition, as is normal for Thorntons. In addition I have to say that the Gin flavoured chocolates were absolutely fabulous. I will order from them again, despite this little "blip".

records.title: Not sure how you rate an experience…
records.text: Not sure how you rate an experience where I fill in an order and you deliver it. It’s the minimum requirement. What is annoying is that when I send a gift to someone, you address me by their names after that instead of mine! It’s unnerving to be addressed as Dear Helen when my name is Derek! I think your system needs a tweak.

records.title: Once you got back on track the problem…
records.text: Once you got back on track the problem was resolved. Don’t understand why our basket wasn’t completely emptied at time of order?  Balance was eventually delivered.

records.title: When I made the order I was informed…
records.text: When I made the order I was informed that a confirmation email had been sent but none came. Thinking (wrongly) that the order had not been received, I made another order, only for the same thing to happen. Unfortunately a medical problem in the family distracted me and I was unable to ring the contact number. The first communication I received said that the order had been dispatched.It is dishonest to say that a confirmation email has been sent when it has not and Thorntons or its agents clearly knows this is the case.Potential customers need to be aware of this problem, which should be corrected by Thorntons.I am sure the chocolates will be as good as ever, though I see that the range of products is much smaller than it was a few months ago and I fear for the firm's future. The chocolates are among our family's favourites and I am sorry to see Thorntons unable to get their process right.

records.title: Check best before dates before ordering!
records.text: I ordered a Christmas hamper for my family and also four boxes of Champagne truffles as Christmas gifts for work colleagues. Arrived on time, beautifully packaged. Unfortunately all four boxes of truffles had a Best Before date of 8/12/22 so I am unable to give them as gifts. I spoke to a very pleasant customer services rep who pointed out that the best before dates are displayed on the website, which I hadn't noticed, so my own fault I guess. However, the truffles were in the section of the website that was headed for Christmas so is confusing and I am sure I am not the only one to miss that information - should maybe be made clearer. Just wanted to warn others to check dates before buying! I was told I could return the truffles (at my own expense) but I have decided to donate them to my local food bank and will buy something else for my colleagues (not Thorntons!). Hope this saves someone else from an expensive mistake!

records.title: Delivery awful from couriers u use
records.text: Your products fine shame the delivery man left them in the black wheelie bin with no note through door I have complained and no reply from you guys one dissapointed customer

records.title: Delivery fantastic continental…
records.text: Delivery fantastic continental chocolates were a gift for my mum she loved them Unfortunately the Easter egg was a disappointment the chocolate tasted like cheap cake decorating chocolate really disappointed 😔

records.title: Products are great but the delivery was…
records.text: Products are great but the delivery was rubbish. 10 days !!

records.title: Order WWW7714190  has not arrived
records.text: I did three orders recently and one as not arrived. It is order #WWW7714190. I had an email to say it was dispatched. I have clicked on the Tracking Number and it says that it arrived at the Delivery Depot on Friday 10/12/2021 but no updated since. This contained personlized models for my great nephews and I really want them to get it for Christmas. The other two parcels were delivered without issue. Can you look into this? Thanks

records.title: I have ordered from Thorntons online…
records.text: I have ordered from Thorntons online for some years and have always been delighted with the service, speed and quality of products.Recently the product I like always seem to be out of stock. The number of Thorntons shops has greatly declined and the business seems to be moving online more now, which is fine, but you do need to do something about you stocking issues.

records.title: The chocolates I ordered arrived ok. But!!
records.text: The chocolates I ordered arrived ok. Didn’t expect such a big box for a few bags of chocolate. It’s a shame I couldn’t order all the chocolates I needed as they were out of stock every time I tried to order so I have to assume they aren’t going to be made anymore. So the men in my family will have to go without the usual Rum truffles for Christmas, Easter and birthdays.

records.title: Very Disappointed
records.text: I always order my Advent Calendar from you, however the ones I purchased this year were disappointing. They were advertised as being reduced from £6 to £3.75. If I had paid the full amount for these I would have been angry. I would have had a better purchase from the Supermarket. I bought 10 but think this will be the last order at Christmas.

records.title: No longer premium
records.text: 40 years ago Thorntons was a premium brand.  The chocolates were luxurious.  I bought a continental pack for Christmas 2024 and... oh dear...  what a mistake.  They are just horrid low quality imitations of what they once were. Shame but they really are just bland, long-life industrial things.

records.title: Thorntons are passed their sell by
records.text: When in was 10 I asked Santa for a box of Thorntons Viennese truffles, they were seriously the best chocolates ever! Sadly the Thorntons today is nothing like the Thorntons of 30/40 years ago, they taste horrible, they sacrificed quality for quantity, mass production, cheaper unit prices. They started stocking them in regular supermarkets and closed their Thorntons shops. I’m not sure why they’re still trading. In the 70’s and 80's Thorntons chocolates matched their Belgian counterparts in quality and taste but by the end of the 90’s the fresh cream and alcohol was replaced with flavourings and today there is very little differentiation in the taste of each chocolate. If you want Swiss chocolate stick with Lindt, Thorntons are sadly passed their sell by date :-(

records.title: In decline?
records.text: Thornton's was once a well known name on our high streets. We have been trying to find bags of their fudge for an elderly neighbour and have scoured supermarkets and other establishments which are shown as stockists without success. We had no alternative other than to put together an order for their products of a value over £30 in order to avoid postage and packing charges. This was ok as the other items could be included as part of Christmas presents. However, today, a week as after placing the order we've received an email informing us that the fudge is unavailable at this time. We've cancelled the order and shall seek alternatives from another manufacturer!

records.title: Didn't get what I had expected!
records.text: Bought a so-called champagne chocolate "collection" which consisted of a box of champagne truffles and 2 mini bottles of bottega presecco as a gift for a freind. In the picture the chocolate box was stood upright on what I believed looked like some kind of gift box, which I assumed would be a Thorntons gift box. However, on arrival there was no gift box, the items were just separately wrapped up in manky looking scrunched up brown packaging paper and shoved in a big brown cardboard box for transporting. Also, the box of chocolates was unbelievably small, in fact it was absolutely tiny! To add insult to injury I could have bought these same items separately elsewhere at a lower price. But with the Thornton site stating the items were a "collection" I thought a "collection" would offer a classier finish.To be honest I was really disappointed. Thorntons obviously don't set the bar as high as they used to. They'res clearly no attention to detail anymore. Unfortunately I won't be purchasing from them again.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: I had written a birthday message to be put into the parcel. Unfortunately it was not put in with the parcel so when my 84 year old aunt received her chocolates & truffles she was very confused.This spoilt the surprise, this is the second time it has happened to me when sending chocolates so I’m not sure if I will be using Thornton again

records.title: Thornton advent calendar
records.text: Thornton advent calendar We purchased 2 of these along with another high end brand Whilst the other brand 24 dec chocolate was special Thornton was just there normal chocolate They had such a big area for the 24 th  but the chocolate was disappointing it had the same chocolate  That was in advent calendar days before for such a high brand and cost I felt robbed Will I be purchasing again definitely not Seems to me you produce a high end product charging high end cost but you could do something special for Xmas eve That’s not the way to keep customers

records.title: Personalised gift for Easter not…
records.text: Personalised gift for Easter not delivered on named delivery date 6/4/23 the same as everyone else Very difficult to find anyone to talk to as phone system down .I did however get through to someone at Ferrero who gave me another email address to use .I have received a response which offered a full refund including delivery cost and apparently my gift is being delivered this afternoon a week after it was meant to be there. Such a shame as I thought Thorntons was a reliable company .They have done the right thing by apologising and full refund plus goods being delivered it just seems pointless after the event has passed a voucher to choose something else may have been a better option

records.title: Hair in chocolate eggs!
records.text: I ordered 3 personalised easter eggs. Was very pleased with the price, delivery and presentation of the eggs! 2 were milk choc and the boys ate in seconds. However, my daughter had the white cholocate one and found 2 great big black hairs in the chocolate itself. I have photo evidence. I have tried to phone the customer service phone numbers and have been on hold for over 40 minutes each time. I also filled in their complaint form online but have heard nothing back....very disappointed and will not be ordering again.

records.title: The easter eggs weren't delivered till…
records.text: The easter eggs weren't delivered till Sat the 23rd of April I had ordered them and paid on the 14th. No reason given for the delay or that it would take 9 days to deliver. Let's hope the recipients  still got to enjoy them.

records.title: Ordered as usual and order went…
records.text: Ordered as usual and order went strangely missing after Hermes saying they were delivering within the hour heard nothing so had to ring up Thornton’s customer service who said best to pay extra to get parcel surely they should use a good company to deliver their items.Was sent out again with Royal Mail for next day delivery as needed it for a birthday present the next day.Then got an email saying that they would deliver Monday so I had to go and buy another gift and then it was delivered while I was at the party so too late gift not great service

description:
Welcome to Fortnum & Mason.

Since the first day they opened their doors back in 1707,  Fortnum & Mason  has been an essential destination for all in search of extraordinary food, unforgettable experiences  and joy-giving things. 

In the centuries since, they've perfected the art of  Afternoon Tea at The Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon, sent their iconic  wicker hampers to every corner of the globe, created all manner of wonderful things to eat and drink from our  Food Hall, and even found the time to write a Cook Book or two, filled with countless mouthwatering recipes from the restaurants at their London flagship store. 

Proud holders of  Royal Warrants for generations, Fortnum's commitment to delicious innovation continues apace, with new stores opening close to home and further afield, and the introduction of a new 3rd Floor at Piccadilly, complete with a stunning Food & Drink Studio, Cook Shop, and an in-house gin distillery.

records.title: Happy in Ohio, USA
records.text: We first learned of Fortnum & Mason from a YouTuber in London.  After a virtual tour of the store we decided to order a few items to enjoy at Christmas.  We ordered tea biscuits, plum pudding, marzipan fruits and a collectible ornament.  The order came quickly and was packed safely - and included a personalized Thank You.  A fun way to enjoy the holidays!

records.title: Only from F&M!
records.text: A subscription to receive a monthly package of the most delicious, most chocolatey, most perfectly textured biscuits we have ever eaten. Only from F&M. Perfect service, prompt delivery, precious cargo well wrapped. A glorious post Christmas / New Year lift!

records.title: Excellence, Time and Again!
records.text: First-rate products that are beautifully packaged and delivered promptly, as scheduled. What more could one ask? I’ve ordered from F&M before, and I’ve also been an F&M gift recipient before, and each time the experience was flawless. Thank you for doing so yet again!

records.title: pure joy
records.text: Really, Fortnum and Mason shipping to the US is just about the most wonderful thing I can think of. It is just magical to get the beautiful box delivered just a few days after the order, with everything inside carefully wrapped up like a precious gem! And of course everything is so delicious.... I just wish more different foods were able to be shipped! May be one day!

records.title: Highest quality and exactly as promised … F&M delivered their delicious Christmas…
records.text: F&M delivered their delicious Christmas goods exactly on time and in pristine condition as always. It is wonderful to be able to count on their quality and efficiency for these important gifts for loved ones who live far away.

records.title: Best beef Wellington on the planet
records.text: I have never in my entire life had such a tender and delicious beef Wellington.  Melt in your mouth and came with easy instructions as well which was super helpful.  I know it was terribly expensive but I guess you get what you pay for in life!

records.title: Everything was timely and done well
records.text: Everything was timely and done well. Catalogue arrived just at the right time. Zak the concierge was just right too! Efficient and pleasant. Emails nice too telling us when delivery coming etc. Delivery was good with plenty of notice.

records.title: Christmas gifting made easy!
records.text: I ordered 15 Christmas hampers this year, the ordering process is very easy, with plenty of choice to suit all recipients.  The hampers were delivered on time and everyone was delighted!  Especially me since it made my gifting very easy!

records.title: Faultless service
records.text: Faultless service - My daughter was delighted by your Hamper - An excellent Christmas present; don't know why I did'nt think of it ever before. Thank you.

records.title: Sharing holidays in the distance. This year our best friends can’t be…
records.text: This year our best friends can’t be with us, we know they love F&M and we would like share this holidays in the distance Thank you for send our present on time, we were conected Mexico & London

records.title: Thank goodness there's a concierge…
records.text: Thank goodness there's a concierge service available OTP and email, because every year there are a few glitches. This is a large office order so there's an increased chance something will go wrong - at least it's all sorted eventually, F&Ms customer service is good as you'd expect!

records.title: Deliveries were fine I was nervous…
records.text: Deliveries were fine I was nervous after reading reviews. It was a gift for someone They had to be told it was from me as my personalised note wasn’t included which for the quality and price I expected better, also a few of the boxes of food were bashed at the corners. After certain items had been tried by my friend the Turkish delight was very chewy not like it should be it tasted stale and also the hard boiled sweets were soft, so I probably won’t be purchasing again so disappointed

records.title: Great products as expected
records.text: Can't fault the items as always quality ingredients and products.Hamper was one day late which was cutting it fine as it was sent to my work address and required collecting on a set date but all worked out OK. Although a little worrying at the time.Will definitely order again.

records.title: Complete hassle-free experience
records.text: Complete hassle-free ordering and delivery receipt process which is excellent. Most of the fresh product were of the full calibre one expects from Fortnum - The turkey and the Christmas pie certainly were. Christmas Scotch eggs were not as beautiful as we have experienced before hence the 4 stars selected.

records.title: I hope to help.
records.text: To criticise. I have never been able to order on the internet the system has self generated complication. When the order is accepted and a date for delivery is given it is accepted as an 'on or before' date which I find disturbing.  To praise. A phone call operater is always helpful and patient. The quallity and range is mind blowing and much apreciated

records.title: I love Fortnum and Mason....... Just Ship more internationally please!
records.text: I have ordered from Fortnum and Mason many times a it is always great, it would just be better if you could ship more items to Canada. Every year I order there are less and less items that can be shipped to Canada and it really is too bad because I would definitely order more from the store if I could.

records.title: Great holiday gifts
records.text: Items were packaged well, shipping box is beautiful. 4 stars because it was delivered to the wrong address… I’m not sure if the label was incorrect or the delivery driver got it wrong. Our friends from the UK were disappointed with the Christmas biscuits as they had too much cinnamon flavor that took away from the shortbread.

records.title: Assurance about Delivery
records.text: The Hamper product was again of excellent quality, although there seemed less quantity this year than in previous years.The advice on delivery and the several responses were not as efficient as in previous years. The call back system took 24 hours in our case when attempting to clarify dates if delivery. We fully understand that there may have been a significant number of enquiries…. Which if itself may underline the need for more reliable assurance and clarification. In spite of this , We suspect we will purchase Hampers again in 2025.

records.title: Beautiful hamper full of lovely…
records.text: Beautiful hamper full of lovely goodies. Recipient loved it. Arrived on time. Only one minor criticism was that the message note was missing so they didn't know who it was from.

records.title: Great fulfillment. Website needs usability changes
records.text: It was a great experience. The website can become much better. Example, if I am shipping to US then only show things that can be shipped to US. Don’t take me to the last step and say that this item cannot be shipped to US. Similarly, allow the option to see things that are in stock. The items are as always very tasty. I don’t know if your cookies have trans fats or not.

records.title: Happy, but delivered late
records.text: The recipient was very happy with her gift.We were very disappointed that we paid extra for a named delivery date and it wasn't delivered on that day. It was delivered the next day, which is a day the recipient was to be going away - luckily, she was home due to a delay, otherwise she would not have received her gift until after Christmas. We received no apology, explanation or refund for this. A small detail, but one we felt needed mentioning as what's the point of paying for something to guarantee what you want and you don't get it.Thank you.

records.title: Excellent service despite a slight delay
records.text: There was a short delay in sending my order, but I received a profuse apology and a voucher. Once the order was despatched the communication was excellent. As ever, service standards above the rest of the field

records.title: Beautiful faultless products
records.text: Beautiful faultless products! I adore fortnum and mason! I appreciate its difficult to package food items and some appeared to have a few dents in on arrival which could be avoided but all in all fantastic products

records.title: Super great experience ordering a gift…
records.text: Super great experience ordering a gift for Christmas for my son. It's a very expensive gift and wish it had a little more to offer but it was well done.

records.title: Teeny, precious, but at what a price...
records.text: I have regularly purchased at Christmas time, a small box of chocolates for a friend on line, however this is the first time I have ever laid eyes on them, or watched them being unpacked. Whilst the external box was maybe 12" x 12" the box of chocolates inside was little bigger than a box of stamps. Coming in at around £30.00 (including postage) it is a real disappointment. Fortnums does present everything really well but at a price that is unrealistic for most of us hoi poloi.

records.title: Left feeling disappointed…..
records.text: Products and delivery service of my products was wonderful as ever.However a small (but important to me) part of my order was missed off and not sent.I contacted customer services and agreed an outcome of a voucher that I could spend at a later date.However, it never arrived as promised, I found this quite disappointing for such a great company that I’ve always held in such high regard :-(

records.title: 3 negative points to mention
records.text: 3 negative points to mention. First one, during the purchase process on the web I saw many advices that the amount was big enough to avoid delivery expenses, but at the end delivery charges were included. Second, nobody answered my comments regarding this issue; if you have a Clients service department I wonder what is it for... And third, I bought some cookies tins for 2024 Christmas presents, and at least two of them had "best before date" for January 2025; I consider this unacceptable.

records.title: Poor service
records.text: The produce was good but the customer service was poor. The system for tracking your account orders is not reliable or clear. An order that had to be chased up had clearly not been processed at the time and no apology was given for the mistake. The system of virtual assistant is inefficient - it says an agent will be with you shortly. Every time it was 25hrs later. In days gone by, as good PR, F&M would send something as an apology....now you don't even get the apology. Two Christmases have now been anxious times waiting to see if orders had arrived or trying to track them. Next Christmas I am going to use alternative options for gifts.

records.title: Beautiful products, broken item
records.text: I would have rated higher, as the products themselves taste great and come in beautiful packaging. Although one of the items we received (the truffle rarebit) did arrive broken. It was definitely in the delivery process, and the pot it came in was porcelaine so it was fragile and I understand that. Though because it has broken there were bits of porcelaine in the rarebit. I still managed to scoop out most of the product to enjoy, though the reusable pot and a good chunk of the product had to be thrown away. The rest of the order: the potted Stilton and a tin of biscuits were lovely and intact

records.title: Not as good as usual
records.text: Delivery dates were completely messed up this year.  I've used for a few years now to send multiple hampers and never had a problem and in fact always recommend F&M because of the ease of ordering and fantastic service.  I was very disappointed this year and hope that my faith is restored on my next hamper order.

records.title: Product was great but unable to connect to customer service
records.text: The overall product was great, however the hamper basket was slightly damaged (a few twigs were snapped).I tried reaching out to customer service via Whatsapp and never got a response (only the auto reply for an agent will be connected shortly)

records.title: Your products are great.  True!
records.text: Your products are great, but getting to your Customer Service from the States was a pain!  Why force customers to use What'sApp?  And, what phone number would I use anyway?  I needed to get to your customer service to change the delivery address of a good friend in London who loves your products and to whom we wanted to send some tea bags, but never could reach you.  Can you issue a credit to me for our order at WEB 010546794?  Even if you can't, we still love Fortnum's.

records.title: Not the best experience
records.text: Had to chase order as didn't receive by specified date; once order received, 1 bottle had no seal and the label/bottle was covered in red wine (must have been with a broken bottle previously); 1 bottle had a big sticker on it saying put back to warehouse, so this must've been a return also. Got in touch re the above and apologies we're given stating that the order should never have been sent out, and they could pick it up or I could keep it and receive a £25 gift voucher. Due to the proximity of Christmas and not being around, I chose to keep the order and receive a £25 gift voucher, thank you. No voucher was received so I got in touch, apologies again received and they would send the voucher asap. Voucher received for £10! So, all in all, not the best experience.

records.title: Lovely products, disappointing execution
records.text: I bought 4 individual bottles of champagne to be delivered to my team members. One had no gift card, two had each others and the fourth a completely random message from someone else. Always lovely to receive F&M at Christmas but this year the whole experience was a bit embarrassing for me the sender and awkward for the recipients.

records.title: Delivery was very disappointing
records.text: Delivery was very disappointing.  Should have arrived 23rd Dec was not delivered until 24th. I purchased the beef wellington to take early hours of 24th to a friend., as it didn't arrive in time had to buy other meat from marks and spencers. Expected better from yourselves

records.title: While the quality is always great .....
records.text: While the quality is always great, my order was fulfilled in several shipments (this was not made clear at the time) and one item was subsequently cancelled more than a week after the order was placed. I will continue to use F&M but this was a little disappointing.

records.title: Stick to the time slot!
records.text: Love this company and brand but specifically picked a date for fresh goods and came days earlier I know that doesn’t sound like a problem but items came before they where needed and couldn’t be used for a family get together ! Goods where fresh and tasted amazing as always! Just disappointed that they couldn’t be shared. With there early arrival!

records.title: Web site is a bit fussy
records.text: Web site is a bit fussy, too many images, unclear instructions.  After a while one learns but it should be simpler for occasional usersDifficult to get a response when one has a question

records.title: GF and alcohol Free Christmas Fruit Cake
records.text: My daughter was gifted a Fortnum and Mason Christmas hamper a few years ago, it contained a Gluten Free and alcohol free Christmas cake as she has coeliac disease, it’s the best Christmas cake I have ever eaten, so I treated myself to a fruit Christmas cake this year and I was really pleased that it arrived in time for the big day. However, I’m sorry to say it was not a patch on the GF cake, it didn’t look or taste the same and its texture was quite grainy. I was really quite disappointed. I’ve looked through your online catalogue and couldn’t locate a GF cake, I’m hoping this will change for next Christmas.

records.title: Unexpectedly poor experience
records.text: I was unimpressed with F&M's delay in delivery. I ordered on 4 December, and received an email (as I imagine many others did) on 12 Decemeber saying there'd be a delay, with a £10 e-gift card sooner after. However, when I phone asking about my order, and why it had taken so long in the first place, the lady originally tried to blame the courier company, even though she had already confirmed it was "Awaiting despatch". She then said it should arrived "tomorrow" (which would have been 13 December). However, it didn't arrive until Saturday 14 December.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service, they were responsive most of the time, some problems regarding shipping times and tracking of my parcels was sent too late which created many problems. The F&M staff were helpful to resolve it.

records.title: I ordered 2 hampers
