records.text: I ordered 2 hampers, one went perfectly well, the other was not delivered on the day by DPD and then 2 days late. I eventually got through to customer services after 2 days who tried to help to no avail and said they would issue a voucher which sadly I didn't receive. Appreciate the Christmas period is busy but I spent over £500 and not too happy about the experience ! Many thanks

records.title: Late Arrival: after Xmas
records.text: Even if I ordered largely in time to get the gift parcel arriving before Xmas ( I relied on the indication on your website for delivery in Spain). Therefor the ‘parcel of joy’ came too late. Painful in particular as the products I sent where all specific Xmas editions. And the shipping fee is quite expensive

records.title: Very disappointed in the service I…
records.text: Very disappointed in the service I received this Christmas. Took over 2 weeks to even process my order and didn’t arrive in time for Christmas. Would have expected much quicker service from such a renowned store. However when the items arrived they were excellent!

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Disappointed, items arrived in damaged box which was clearly taped with DPD tape to hold the box together. One item was leaking, one item was missing and 2 biscuit tins had dents in them. Would have been nice to receive items all in one go and not damaged as it was a gift.

records.title: Late delivery for Christmas
records.text: Ordered some special presents for Christmas at the very start of December. Delivery came late and as an apology I was offered £10 off a future order. Such a shame not to be offered something off of the affected order. Delivery on anything is £6-7 so a £10 voucher means very little.

records.title: One of the items in my order was incorrect
records.text: One of the items in my order was incorrect. I tried contacting online, but continued being given advice about delivery. Tried phoning but the wait was so long both times that pre-Christmas activities meant I could not wait forever on the phone.

records.title: Extremely disappointed
records.text: I ordered 3 hampers for 3 different people using separate orders. Paid extra for named delivery for all of them. Only 1 of the 3 were delivered on the date selected. 1 was a day late and the other over 5 days late. Extremely disappointed with the service provided from this store, and expected better.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Our parcel arrived very close to Christmas despite having ordered early. The box for the mini mince pies was marked and scuffed so could not be given as a Christmas gift. Also the coal box was squashed and we were also unable to give these as we had intended as a Christmas gift. Very unlike fortnum and mason as we have ordered from you before and had exemplary delivery and packaging.

records.title: Your opinion is certainly not valued by F&M
records.text: The tiny candle arrived in massive amounts of packaging and when my wife tried to complain about this via webchat she was met with backchat and sarcasm, certainly not taken seriously.

records.title: 19 days to deliver
records.text: I ordered in store in Piccadilly on 5th December. Delivery was arranged for 14th December. Parcel eventually arrived on 24th by which time I had had to buy replacements. I do not understand the delay.

description: Britains Biggest Beer Shop, with probably the best selection of beers, ciders and spirits in the world in store or online

records.title: Great selection of beers
records.text: Great selection of beers! Prices are reasonable if you are looking for something different. I Purchased from them recently, my shipment left them with DHL courier service and they were a problem in this transaction, delays and non-delivery, But when I called Beers of Europe to investigate they did, Mathew was great and helped me get my beers. Cheers Mathew!

records.title: BoE - great beers, great service
records.text: BoE have a great selection of beers, and let you pick your own selection of beer even if they are all different. They are well packed in strong boxes and have always been exactly what is ordered. Delivery is quick and their customer service is great (if you ask a question you get a quick response). Great small company, well worth supporting.

records.title: Another Great Delivery
records.text: Yet another great delivery from Beers of Europe. Looking forward to sampling this one as I’ve got a bit of a lucky dip this time. Hannen Alt was out of stock so I’m trying some other German beers alongside the British squaddie’s favourite, Herforder Pils!

records.title: Beers of Europe is a great way to buy…
records.text: Beers of Europe is a great way to buy all those wonderful and rare beers which are not usually available in the shops and other well-known web-site. Great to use for delivering gift-packs for friends and family. The packaging is robust and helps prevent breakage. No fuss, no bother in delivery. Sometimes, I get a little disappointed when I learn a beer I want is out of stock, but that's life. They are certainly without rival in their field.

records.title: Another great transaction (this is my…
records.text: Another great transaction (this is my fourth in the last couple of years).   Ordered on Monday afternoon and received just 2 days later - free standard (3-day) delivery for orders over £60.  DHL provided tracking detail and their driver rang the buzzer - no leaving it outside in the porch!  All good.

records.title: Brilliant Company
records.text: Ordered several individual bottles of lager/pilsners for a gift.  These were delivered in super fast time.  Kept up to date with delivery at every stage.  Have used Beers of Europe quite a few times now and will continue to do so as they have an excellent selection.  Well done.

records.title: All things good as all your staff are…
records.text: All things good as all your staff are very helpful and very experienced.

records.title: Absolutely brilliant service from the team
records.text: Absolutely brilliant service from the team after DHL managed to break multiple bottles in two separate shipments of the same order.I found the team to be ultra responsive and more than willing to do whatever it takes to get things right. Really they take pride in what they do and care about the customer!

records.title: I’ve been using Beers of Europe for…
records.text: I’ve been using Beers of Europe for years and can’t fault them at all really. Great selection of drinks, always managed to get what I wanted(mostly German imported Lagers) and delivery always very quick with DHL. All emails replied to very swiftly if I have any questions also. Wouldn’t go anywhere else.

records.title: Buying was easy
records.text: Buying 15 individual bottles was easyNo warning before checking out to have log in details to hand. Did not receive the second verification emailI forgot to use a gift voucher and matter sorted out next morning And the box arrived Saturday morning the 4th !!!

records.title: Great selection...should use different courier
records.text: Great selection of beers (mainly German & Belgian) but my only problem is they use DHL to deliver who are awful, next day delivery can be five days and then no idea of when they are actually being delivered.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: T am impressed with the speed and efficiency of Beers of Europe.  Also with their efforts to keep their customers informed. TBH, I have only bought EkU 28 (an excellent lager that seems to be available only through them) from them and that is one reason why I have given only 4 stars.  It is unfortunate that their supply of this excellent beer is erratic.

records.title: Overall very good
records.text: Decent range on the website but lots (and lots) of out of stock products. Website was quite fiddly to navigate with lots of scrolling to apply filters to narrow down options. Order was fulfilled quickly.

records.title: Small order everything just fine
records.text: Although just a small order, the beers I ordered arrived in good time well packaged and there were no nasty surprises. This service and company did everything it was supposed to so I have no reason for complaint. why only 4 stars? well you have to be exceptional to get five. Now even with a small order if there had been a nice little surprise in the box for a first time customer! that would have been 5 stars :-)

records.title: partly satisfied customer
records.text: Very good website. Very efficient with fast delivery.Unfortunately other items I wished to order were out of stock.Will keep looking.Thank you.

records.title: Love Beers of Europe
records.text: Love Beers of Europe. Good German beer availability most of the time. Decent delivery too. Great range of Oktoberfest beers. Will continue to be a returning customer

records.title: Good service and loyalty points a…
records.text: Good service and loyalty points a bonus. Always plenty of choice in stock but haven’t always got exactly everything I’m looking for.

records.title: A good selection of continenetal beers…
records.text: A good selection of continenetal beers but as may pages of 'out of stock' items as 'in stock.

records.title: Great company with an annoying flaw
records.text: Everything about the order and delivery speed is great. It’s about time BOE added a ‘show in stock only’ filter to reduce wasting the browser’s time. I’d estimate that 50-60% of advertised products are very rarely or never in stock. It’s been like that for years (when was Svyturys Ekstra last available for example?), a shame as the service is great otherwise.

records.title: Great variety
records.text: Great variety, quick delivery, and clear communication. Some constructive criticism goes to the website, which should allow you to finish refining your filters before auto-refreshing automatically every time you tick a box and to the number of 'out of stock' items which could be lower.

records.title: This was a repeat order
records.text: This was a repeat order for beer that I have enjoyed for many years. The ordering process and delivery were very good EXCEPT that the Sage payment system would not recognise my Mastercard debit card and I had to use Paypal instead. That needs to be sorted out

records.title: Satisfied customer!
records.text: This is the first time I have used this company. Communication was fantastic from ordering to delivery. Telephone conversation with a real person, who was informative and helpful. Product arrived and was well packaged. Beers very well received and enjoyed. Would definitely use this company in the future and recommend them. Thank you.

records.title: Decent selection, good service
records.text: Beers of Europe offer a decent range of beers from all over the world, including the UK. For some locations, such as Germany and Belgium, the choice is very good. For others, such as France, it's a bit disappointing.Service is very good, with delivery usually just a few days after placing an order. On the few occasions where I've ordered something where there isn't sufficient stock, I've received a phone call so that I could amend the order.A great place for beer explorers to go.

records.title: Good selection of beer
records.text: Good selection of beer. I ordered an Alt Bier and an Anchor Stout, which were both excellent. Delivery was reasonable but other beer merchants have cheaper and faster options. Website was easy enough to use. Particularly grateful for the sell by date warning of one of the beer options I was pursuing.

records.title: Still a wonderful selection
records.text: Still a wonderful selection, though I do miss some of the previously stocked Italian beers, which can seem expensive, but can be equally excellent.Beers well packaged but without being excessively wasteful. Delivery times are indeed a little longer as stated on the website, but IIRC it still arrived inside a week, so that's still very good.

records.title: Efficient service
records.text: It was very easy to find the items and wanted and the ordering process was efficient. Delivery was made on the date promised and the packaging ensured the bottles were received without any damage. The only thing stopping me giving the full 5 stars was the relatively short shelf life - received in May with a BBE of August. That said, I’ll be using them again.

records.title: Glad to see they got 4 plus points
records.text: Glad to see they got 4 plus points, thought I had been scammed for a moment. Said next day delivery and nothing arrived, ordered 15th for father's day. Not so great ehh but oh well, please just deliver soon as you can, order no 52933

records.title: My go to place for beers ,but hasn’t…
records.text: My go to place for beers ,but hasn’t been on point recently, without starting a different argument probably due to import paperwork etc

records.title: Box left on doorstep
records.text: Box left on doorstep, watched the guy walk of didn’t even bother to ring doorbell.

records.title: Very quick service
records.text: Very quick service , but there are often far too many beers out of stock.

records.title: Quick delivery but 'old' beers
records.text: Big choice, good prices, quick delivery and good packaging but some of the stock is very old.I'd hazard a guess they are not kept stored cold so several of them tasted very poor and one I just poured down the sink because you could tell by the smell it had been 'thermally abused' and was canned 03/08/2022Yes its inside BBE but if you keep stuff in a warm environment its going to taste like rubbish.Ok if you cant tell the difference I suppose.I'd only buy stuff like big stouts from them again which don't suffer from poor storage.

records.title: Lack ofcommunication
records.text: Did not hear anything for a couple of weeks and had to contact them to chase up my order, I was then informed that one of the brands I had ordered was now out of stock and I had until 2pm to make a change or a reimbursement would be made. I asked why I had not been informed sooner, too which the reply was they claimed to have sent 2 emails, funnily enough I never received those. Good selection but pretty poor service.

records.title: I placed my order on Thursday…
records.text: I placed my order on Thursday 16/06/2022, 03:26Today is the Monday 20/06/2022 it looks like my package was not dispatched until today This is very disappointing Tracking shows it will be delivered 21/06/2022

records.title: Good company, unsustainable packaging
records.text: This company has great products and provides an efficient service, but I’m giving it only 3 stars due to the awful polystyrene bubbles used to protect its products in transit - in our case, 24 aluminium cans of beer were packaged using what amounted to a whole bin bag full of polystyrene beads. I cannot think of a single other company that we buy from that still uses these.

records.title: Great products, great prices, disappointing service
records.text: Ordered some beers online as the prices are extremely competitive compared to other similar retailers online. Also a good range of beer on offer.My only complaint is that my order had not arrived on the Wednesday - virtually a week on from ordering it. I emailed on the Monday and they did not seem aware that the items were 'damaged by the courier'. Other than that service, I look forward to trying the products.

records.title: Pros and cons ...
records.text: On the plus side, all the beers were the correct ones ordered and arrived safe and sound. On the down side, several of the bottles were very dusty, I was disappointed that so many had expiry dates of February 21, they arrived later than expected and I would have preferred not to have collected them myself from a local store (it was the only way of getting them out of the DHL van as they claimed they couldn't find our address).

records.title: There was no phone call from the…
records.text: There was no phone call from the courier on the day of delivery. The box of beer was just left in the garage even though we were at home. I realise the actual delivery is outwith the control of Beers of Europe but if there are similar complaints from other customers you might consider a change of courier.

records.title: Delivery delays
records.text: The carrier took a while to give me a delivery date which they then changed on the day and changed again on the second day. After sending them a critical email my beer was delivered on the third specified day in a cardboard box which was so collapsed and sodden that I thought there had to be at least one broken bottle. The inside proved to be odourless so it was probably water.

records.title: DHL - Useless !
records.text: You need to change your courier!  DHL are woeful, my package was not delivered when promised and I had to track down the fact that it had been returned to you damaged!  Nobody contacted me to tell me what was happening, I had to go out of my way to find out!!  My consignment is still not here a week later and I'm getting thirsty!!! Unfortunately for you, the poor performance of your courier reflects badly on you.

records.title: An excellent company with competitive…
records.text: An excellent company with competitive prices but many other items were stocked out. However, the DHL delivery was a total shambles. The parcel tracking did not work from day one, DHL promised to deliver on a certain date but the parcel abruptly arrived two days late. I had to stay home for two days to ensure that I did not miss the delivery.

records.title: please remove items of the site when out of stock
records.text: I love special beers( Russian imperial stouts) and mostly i buy online.When you try to look for different beers on the site, at first it looks like there is a big assortment but almost  90% is out of stock!!I would appreciate if the beer is out of stock; it gets removed so you don't have to go to 10 pages and look hopeful before realising the beer is out of stock.

records.title: Wide range of beer styles
records.text: The website is laid out well with a good search facility. Processing & Delivery is very quick as are the communications.The weakness is that I had a list of beers and over 50% of them were listed as out of stock, I would have ordered many others and took advantage of the free delivery otherwise. Dates of potential delivery would have been useful.

records.title: Misleading dispatch info
records.text: Having ordered on a Saturday, I received dispatch info the following day (Sunday) saying that my beer would be delivered on the Monday. It never arrived, having waited in all day. Telephoned BoE to be told that I had simply received an auto e-mail & my beer would be delivered on Tuesday (ie the next day). So, although great choice of beer & delivered quickly, be aware of misleading dispatch info.

records.title: No problem with delivery and packaging, however....
records.text: No problem with delivery and packaging, both were excellent.  However, disappointed that out of date beers or close to being out of date beers were still full price, I even had one bottle that was 6 weeks out of date which wasn't highlighted on website and full price and my email to point this out was not even acknowledged.  As for the 24 beers, so far, two have gone straight down the drain as they were flat and acetic.

records.title: Your item is never in stock 🙄
records.text: It used to be such a good little site to get world beers. Now they rarely have anything in stock. Very disappointing...

records.title: Take your money with no explanation
records.text: I chose the option for Royal Mail for delivery despite the fact that they had a day of strikes coming up. I again chose the Royal Mail option on a following page. However, my parcel was delivered by dhl andI was charged extra. The strike was 1 day!!!!!!!!!Don’t think I will purchase here again!

records.title: Used to always use BOE
records.text: Used to always use BOE, but over the last few years their stock levels have been poor and they seem to take an age to get them back in stock.Other online retailers manage to get them in okay, so not sure if it's a strategic element to keep stocks lower than they used to be?In short, great if what you want is in stock.

records.title: Very slow
records.text: Very slow. It’s now a week since I placed my order I and I’m still waiting for the delivery. Other similar online beer retailers (such as Beer Sniffers) have much better service and deliver within about 2 days.

records.title: 30% Price Increases
records.text: Had multiple issues with orders in past, but prices were decent. Now with prices going up 30%+ since May it's just not worth it any more.

records.title: Order arrived in good time but 1 of the…
records.text: Order arrived in good time but 1 of the bottles was past best before date by 1 month and 3 more had short dates - not being a huge drinker I wouldn’t be quaffing them quickly and even if I was planning on downing them quickly would rather not have short dated beer – it was a small order and relatively low cost I felt it wasn’t worth pursuing with the company but likely won’t order again I’m afraid

records.title: Bad Delivery Experience
records.text: Products and order handling excellent.  However, experience ruined by poor delivery by DHL.  1 hour's notice of delivery time slot given - impossible to move commitments at such short notice.  Box left outside front door in full view of street - it might as well have had a large sign on it saying "Please help yourself!".  Luckily it wasn't taken but delivery confirmation stated that we had accepted the delivery.  Complaint to delivery company has been ignored.  Suggest to improve quality of offering Beers of Europe Ltd consider a different delivery provider.

records.title: Discriminatory delivery rip-off.
records.text: I have used this company for years, the range of beer (and spirits, too) is excellent. Only a 2 star rating though I'm afraid; I ordered some beer for my friend as a birthday treat only to discover that because she lives in the Highlands of Scotland the delivery price is twice what it should be - what an offensive rip-off! (One reason out of many, many reasons why this "United Kingdom" will soon be no more).

records.title: It is the delivery that is the problem
records.text: It is the delivery that is the problem. The courier APC contacted to say they would deliver on the 22 August with a 2 hour time slot. Not delivered.I emailed them to enquire why no delivery, no response. Rang on Saturday no answer. Finally a message yesterday 27 August they would deliver that day. Did arrive, but 5 days after they said they would. Poor.Maybe review your courier.

records.title: little bit disappointed
records.text: Ordered on the intent the positive feedback was true, but I haven’t heard a thing about my recent order nor have I got an email confirming anything but my money’s been taken for an order I probably won’t receive. Customer service number costs to call on the majority of phones so only way of contact it so email but they never reply?

description:
Artisan Coffee Co. is revolutionising the way we enjoy coffee. 

The freshest and tastiest coffee around, Artisan's six coffee characters have been created by an expert team including a world-renowned Michelin-starred chef, our shared passion for coffee led us to a clear mission: to deliver delicious coffee that everybody can enjoy.



We celebrate coffee in its purest and most delicious form, packed with individuality and full of character. Our mantra? Flavour first.



Whether you are used to brewing your coffee in a pod machine, cafetière, pour over or moka pot, Artisan has a blend perfectly suited to you and your every mood. All our coffee comes pre-portioned and in nitro-sealed packaging, meaning your coffee stays fresher and more flavourful for longer. This is coffee as you’ve never experienced or tasted it before.



Why we’re different: We take a fresh approach to coffee. Our blends have been created and perfected by some of the most prodigious experts in the industry. 

From a Michelin two-starred chef, to a team of the world’s best Q graders (the coffee industry’s equivalent to a sommelier), we’ve employed some of the best minds - and palates - in the business. You won’t find craftsmanship - or flavour - like this anywhere else.

records.title: Good service, value and quality…
records.text: Emailed them after ordering to request a change of delivery address. Even though it was a weekend they responded promptly to confirm my request. Coffee went down a treat for Christmas and was beautifully packaged and well received. We enjoyed it so much we’ve bought more and I have a feeling we’ll become regular customers!

records.title: Perfect gift for coffee lovers
records.text: Bought as a gift for someone, for Christmas, so I can't really comment on the taste. However, it was packaged really well and I thought it a good introduction to the coffees and chocolates you sell.

records.title: Superb customer service
records.text: There was some damage, by the shippers, to our order, which was meant as a gift. Artisan Coffee were superb in dealing with the issue and made us feel like we were a valued customer. We will be using them again.

records.title: Smell fresh, taste fresh. Delicious.
records.text: I just love everything about these coffee's.There's something for everyone's tastes. I use the coffee bags, I love the smell that hits my nose when I open one! So fresh! Always makes me go 'Mmmmmm.' The little complimentary chocolate disc with each box is a lovely treat too. I'm a coffee-a-holic and these just hit the spot!!

records.title: Easy to use Web site
records.text: Easy to use Web site . Order confirmation received. Details of dispatch received. Parcel arrived promptly and well packed.Bought for a present so can't comment on product.

records.title: Reasonable prices and a website I can travel around.
records.text: I was able to order some more coffee bagsand the process was reasonably easy, though I would have liked to try the new limited edition but it wasn't sold in coffee bags.Looking foward to the new year when I may, hopefully, be able to buy a 48 bag tasting box. Love being able to drink different coffees.Update. My coffee arrived this morning(12/10/24) which was very quick. It is well packed and came with a chocolate round, flavoured to match each of the coffee's I've ordered.

records.title: Coffee bags are really good
records.text: The coffee bags I've bought from them are really good and convenient for people who like good coffee but don't want to spend a lot of money on an espresso machine or cafetiere or French press.It's just like a tea bag, but coffee bag, just need to allow it a couple of minutes to develop the flavours, and you have a great cup of coffee.It's a must for me as I work as a healthcare assistant and need the boost in the morning, it's very quick to make.

records.title: Coffee with a diference
records.text: Great choice of coffees on website.  Easy to navigate and plenty of info on there. Order arrived within couple days of ordering. Well packed. They are gifts so can not rate coffee taste.

records.title: Convenient, delicious coffee at a good price.
records.text: I received a selection box of Artisan Coffee Co. coffee bags as a Birthday gift a colleague ordered through Amazon. Nicely presented, and soon became a very convenient way to make great coffee when I'm at work. Couldn't stand going back to microground instant coffee so I subscribed, which was an easy process using the QR code on the welcome leaflet. Chose a few of my favourite 'characters' to receive boxes monthly. The coffee smells and tastes delicious, and is excellent value. Even with postage, it only works out around £0.40 a cup. Much nicer and infinitely more cost effective than going for a Costa ;) The complimentary chocolate with each box is a lovely touch as well.

records.title: Great item.
records.text: All was well with my purchase and I am really pleased with the Advent Calendar.  My only gripe is that it could not be customised which meant that I had to make an extra purchase to allow both myself and my wife share the experience equally - roll on December!

records.title: Nicely packed and arrived quickly
records.text: Easy to use website and items arrived very quickly. Gift bag really smart with nice blue ribbon. Coffee and chocolates are Christmas presents for other people so I can't comment on the taste, but the free sample chocolate was lovely!

records.title: Lovely coffee.
records.text: Bought the box of mixed coffee bags & chocolates as a gift. Was slightly disappointed that there was not a chocolate allocated to every coffee bag, it was one co-ordinating chocolate per type of coffee instead….so caused a bit of a fight!

records.title: Artisan is my very favourite coffee…
records.text: Artisan is my very favourite coffee ever. The decaffeinated variety is the best I have ever tried of this variety.The only reason I gave 4 not 5 stars, is that if I need to adjust which style or quantity of coffee, month by month depending on my usage, it is not very obvious how to remove an item as well as add an item on my order page. A bin symbol, or add sign would be much easier to manage.A number of my Family or other visitors have remarked on how delicious it tastes, and agree it would be worth having an order themselves.Any problems I have had, the help line is excellent and promptly sorts out issues.However I would like to be able to manage this myself when ordering.

records.title: Very nice coffee
records.text: I discovered Artisan coffee at a Fuller's Inn recently, it was on the tray in our room. The coffee was really nice so I've ordered some! Looking forward to it arriving. Website jumped about a bit but that might be me or my rather ancient tablet.

records.title: I ordered two taster collections of…
records.text: I ordered two taster collections of coffee bags and chocolate discs. The order arrived quickly, the collections were well packaged, very nicely presented and the coffee delicious.I ordered in May ‘23 so was surprised that the ‘Best Before Date’ on both collections was 1/7/23. This is the only thing that stopped me giving 5 stars.

records.title: Ordered on line with ease
records.text: Ordered on line with ease, coffee parcel arrived within a couple of days. Job done, great service!

records.title: Love the different flavours of coffee…
records.text: Love the different flavours of coffee and as I work in different bases it's great to be able to take a smaller sachet of ground coffee or bag in my bag for when I want to make a cuppa. The flavour I wanted was out of stock other wise I'd have given it am extra star

records.title: Very good and quick service
records.text: Very good and quick service. I would have given 5* instead of 4* but we have a Nespresso coffee machine and we have found that the machine does not work as well with Artisan capsules compared to the Nesprrsso ones. The machine takes much longer to make the coffee, so we are using the pods hust for Expresso size.

records.title: Easy ordering, good delivery and product looks excellent but not yet tried.
records.text: The order process and the delivery were very good.  The reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is because the note was not enclosed so my friend had no idea who had sent the package and emailed everyone she could think of to find out.  That was disappointing im afraid.

records.title: Five stars pending
records.text: This might well be a five star once I actually try the coffee! but I stumbled on the site by accident got an amazing deal, delivered seamlessly in a really lovely box.The review request has come a bit too soon

records.title: Lovely great tasting coffee.
records.text: Lovely great tasting coffee.The best decaffeinated coffee I have tried since switching from normal coffee.I know a little on the expensive side compared to a lot of big named brands but you get what you pay for!

records.title: Best coffee I’ve ever tasted
records.text: I would have given five stars but I ordered filtered coffee instead of bags alongside my order.  The bags I have received are second to none and I will be ordering again.

records.title: The coffees received are all really…
records.text: The coffees received are all really good quality. I really wasn't sure how good they would be, as never heard of company before , I also took a risk as ordered 60 bags in the artisan set. I have to say I'm really pleased with them and will order again, the only reason I only gave 4 stars is that I really didn't want/need 10 decaff bags in set as I don't see the point of decaff, but this was obviously an oversight on my behalf as I couldn't have read the information properly, as I was not  expecting decaff. Also the bags need to brew for good 4 mins to get full tast anything less does not do the coffee justice.

records.title: professional service ! !
records.text: The team at Artisan provided a timely response to queries & on ordering a multi pack to test the coffee it arrived very quickly. No complaints in this area .

records.title: Love the coffee and taste options.
records.text: Love the coffee and taste options.Very confusing trying to apply discount codes (they did not work!)I added them at checkout but it was not accepted 😔

records.title: Silly website glitches that make it annoying
records.text: The website asked for delivery address but then reverted back to the default (my) address before payment so one order came to myself instead. When re-ordered to the correct address it had the wrong gift message in it - addressed to strangers, so person receiving gift wasn't sure who sent it. But it arrived on time, and apparently the coffee was great.

records.title: Apprehensive
records.text: Hi I love the coffee but a little disappointed with the genius coffee bags tasteless the big shot and heroine are so nice. My partner recommended me I didn't receive £10 off but got 15% as a new customer Also to mention my partner orders fro you all the time the artisan free gift is mot compatible to everyone's machine so the free gift to alot of your customers is worthless don't you think

records.title: Beware capsule size
records.text: While the coffee is very good I find that many of the capsules are marginally too big to fit into my machine.  I have to force them before I can close the capsule door Not all the capsules are the same so whether there are some manufactured differently I don’t know

records.title: Their coffee is amazing but
records.text: Their coffee is amazing! I was trying to take advantage of a 20% sale they had on to stock up! Couldn’t understand why I didn’t have an account as I purchased before. I started to register and immediately realised why I hadn’t created one before. The registration process was painful!  It kept popping up a sale notification while I was registering causing it to reset so I’d have to start the process over and over again always just as the password was being created! That was annoying.  If I didn’t love their coffee as much as I do I would have skipped the whole thing and not bought! Finally got registered the next day but missed the sale.  Got 15% off as a newb but sale I missed was 20% off.  So sort that out for a better customer experience. Again your coffee is delicious!

records.title: Great coffee but capsules …..
records.text: Great coffee , super range available but the pods just aren’t as good as the Nespresso, it seems the capsule is softer and deforms very easily when inserting. I’d say I lost the use of 1 in 5

records.title: Slow delivery compared with Nespresso.
records.text: Slow delivery compared with Nespresso.Pods equal in flavour to Lavazza but more expensive.Pods work better than Lavazza compatibles.

records.title: Wrong message inside
records.text: I just received my order with the wrong message on it for someone's 50th birthday from Rehana & family so assume they may have mine too!

records.title: Great website but delayed discount code until after purchase.
records.text: Website experience is great, however, I joined the club and didn’t receive my 15% discount code until after making my first purchase.

records.title: Difficult web site. Fantastic coffee
records.text: Your website isn't user friendly for a ludite like me. I love your coffee though. This is the second time I have done so. I will buy again

records.title: Is a present and sellotape branded all…
records.text: Is a present and sellotape branded all over parcel not good!

records.title: Short shelf life
records.text: I bought an artisan coffee bag selection box; it was well packaged and arrived promptly, but I was disappointed that the “best before” date was for four weeks time! So, the coffee bags had a rather short shelf life, hence why only three stars in this review.

records.title: Nice Gift
records.text: Product was purchased as a gift and arrived promptly and beautifully displayed. My only real complaint is that it arrived with 'Artisan Coffee Co' displayed ALL OVER the box and my partner, who I purchased the gift for (as a surprise) took receipt of the box from the delivery driver and asked me outright who it was for, kind of ruining the surprise element. Also all of the coffee bags were quite weak when brewed even after being left for the recommended 3+ minutes to brew.

records.title: The coffee pods are okay
records.text: The ordering and delivery experience was easy, and I even got a box of chocolates in the package which I wasn't expecting, however I'm reviewing the coffee here. Specifically the nespresso compatible pods. The best I can say about them is that they're okay. They all taste a little on the bland side for me, even more so when paired with milk. I see all the great reviews, which played a role in my decision to purchase, so I was surprised by the results. I don't claim to have the most sophisticated palette for coffee but I know I've been able to discern more depth and flavour from other brands. So, I'm not saying they're bad, they're okay, but just okay, from my point of view.

records.title: Too much packaging
records.text: The coffee bags are OK/pleasant,  but the packaging is excessive.  Also we're not that keen on chocolate, so why include it?   Could I suggest cardamom as a much better thing to pair the coffee with - the Swedes have done this for years.  Nice with a cardamom shortbread too.

records.title: Long delay in arriving- more than 3…
records.text: Long delay in arriving- more than 3 weeks. I had to chase. It was meant to be a surprise gift but I had to tell the recipient to find out why it had not arrived. I was offered a 20% discount for another purchase but I won’t be using the service again.

records.title: Rapid delivery but coffee for me didn’t…
records.text: Rapid delivery but coffee for me didn’t quite hit the mark. Flows slower out of Nespresso machine than the real branded pods. Gifted chocolates to match the coffees were exceptional.

records.title: Great Coffee, Rubbish Fulfilment
records.text: Artisan make great coffee. Like really great. But their shipping is hopeless. On yet another order I paid for expedited delivery, Royal Mail tracking says they don’t have it, you chase Isurus Fulfilment, they blame the shipping company and then dispatch it. And when you ask for a refund on the expedited delivery they haven’t provided, they grudgingly refund as a ‘goodwill gesture’. As I say, great coffee but keep your expectations very low regarding when you might get it.

records.title: The boxes were both quite squished when…
records.text: The boxes were both quite squished when arrived and they were part of a box I was making for Mother’s Day. I ended up putting Nespresso tubes in instead as they were much better packaged than your coffees.

records.title: Short date on capsules!
records.text: The box of coffee capsules have a very short shelf life so need to be used up within 1 month therefore not impressed, I guess that’s why they offered this with the recycling unit which can be bought on Amazon for £10. The recycling unit works well though.

records.title: I had typed a birthday message to be…
records.text: I had typed a birthday message to be sent with the item in the gift option of the website but it was not included in the parcel and therefore the recipient had no idea who had sent the gift which was very disappointing.

records.title: The coffee bags arrived quickly
records.text: The coffee bags arrived quickly. However, I have now tried all the different brews and quite frankly the only one that is anywhere near strong enough is The Big Shot. I am disappointed because the review in the Mail said that I wouldn't be able to differentiate between the coffee bag and a filter coffee. Admittedly they were reviewing The Big Shot.Your service however is excellent but I am not sure I will be changing to Artisan permanently.Thank youTricia Upton

records.title: Not a good start
records.text: Didnt receive coffee machine and only pods. Thought it was odd after a few days that I didn't have a follow up delivery so I contacted them and once they realised the error and that they hadn't sent my machine they sent one out with courier immediately. Didn't receive the extra coffee pods that they said I'd get but I get the machine.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Disappointing - I was really looking forward to trying the coffee but was very underwhelmed. Both blends (The Heroine and The Smart Cookie) I found to be weak and I was left needing more than a double shot to get the same coffee hit of a single Nespresso or L’Or pod. When you factor in the price of a pack it becomes very expensive (more than £1 per coffee compared with about 30-35 pence for others).I do really like the pod recycler though.

records.title: Order awaited
records.text: EDIT: I have now made contact with the company who advised there was an error with the order tracking and have arranged for another calendar to be sent out on next day delivery.************************Ordered an advent calendar with Royal Mail 48 hour delivery. Received email confirmation of my order stating another email would be sent when the item got dispatched. One week later I have still not received any further emails or the advent calendar. Contacted the company via social media and was advised to email info@artisancoffeeco. comI have still not received a reply to this or my 2 subsequent emails. Currently I’m £69.99 out of pocket. Terrible service, would not order again unless this can be rectified quickly.

records.title: I had to use 2 pods for a single cup of…
records.text: I had to use 2 pods for a single cup of coffee because the coffee wasn’t strong enough. Very nice package but very disappointing product I must say.

records.title: Sorry to say that that coffee didn't…of columbian  coffee and not strong enough, kind regards Ms Linda
records.text: Sorry to say that that coffee didn't taste of co

description:
Chocolate Trading Company have the widest range of premium chocolates available online in the UK.
From superior quality chocolate gift boxes through to economically priced chocolate ingredients and decorations.

records.title: I have only just ‘found’ Booja Booja…
records.text: I have only just ‘found’ Booja Booja and I am delighted with these wonderful chocolates.And Chocolate Trading were also a welcome find, efficient in every aspect.Thank you !

records.title: Extra special chocolates
records.text: I've been a customer of the Chocolate Trading Company for quite a few years now and they never disappoint.  The chocolates are a little on the expensive side but well worth paying that little bit more for.  Cannot fault the quality or the service.  Would highly recommend.

records.title: great chocolate
records.text: great chocolate , at decent prices, promptly delivered. Thank you!

records.title: Impressed with the delivery time 🙂
records.text: I was impressed with the delivery time this close to Christmas.And I'm really pleased to know where I can get booja-booja chocolates if I'm not feeling like driving anywhere! Many thanks 🙏🏼

records.title: Blissfully unproblematic
records.text: Unusually pleasant ordering process -- the touch of being able to split an order between addresses, though not needed, is nice.Chocolate arrived fine.  I haven't checked the dates one it, but I'm sure it's fine.  Will likely order again eventually.Box arrives without chocolate pasted all over it which is handy for gifts in household.  Dissolvable packing material.  Arrived in a few days, as stipulated.  Thumbs up.

records.title: The order was received quickly and the…
records.text: The order was received quickly and the order was exactly what I was looking for, I am so pleased

records.title: Fantastic buying experience
records.text: Fantastic buying experience. Thank you.Ordered on Tues lunchtime and delivered within 24 hours. The week before Xmas.Extremely happy and whilst I cannot comment on the items I ordered (they are a Xmas present for a friend), they look fab.Thank you again

records.title: If you want the best dark chocolate…
records.text: If you want the best dark chocolate produced anywhere in the world then the Chocolate Trading Company offers it. You won't bother buying chocolate in the shops and supermarkets again

records.title: So far very positive experience
records.text: So far, great experience with the Chocolate trading Company. Cannot review the product yet, as I've not used it.Order came within the timeline stated, in a well packed and wrapped box/packaging.Thank you.

records.title: Great
records.text: Gift for a friend well received they enjoyed the chocos and liked the cards the dragon cat and frog choco was cute in the wrapper almost to cute to eat as was told ! Great delivery as quick as could be and all arrived safely

records.title: The products came in a well protected…
records.text: The products came in a well protected packaging. However, there are still some broken chocolate shell found.

records.title: Easy to find the vegan chocolate I…
records.text: Easy to find the vegan chocolate I wanted. Easy to order arrived within a couple of days of ordering

records.title: I had to phone my order through and the…
records.text: I had to phone my order through and the gentleman was curtious, polite and gave excellent customer service. Will use them now for all my gift buying.

records.title: Goods arrived but shipping info would have been helpful
records.text: Suspect chocolates OK but as Christmas presents don't know. After order placed and confirmed, would have been nice to know when shipped so as to work out when to expect them. Nice they used Royal Mail not a courier though. Check v carefully that promised discounts actually are given by them in the final price

records.title: Christmas tree chocolate
records.text: I spent over £20 on chocolate for my grandchildren’s Christmas tree. The parcel didn’t arrive then I received an email from Royal Mail saying my address was unidentified, found out that the wrong number was on the package even though my correct address was on my account. When I rang the company I was more or less told it was my error! I can’t prove that I typed the right address so had to accept this from customer service. Then I was told that they would let me know when the parcel comes back to them I would need to pay another delivery charge over the phone. Also got told that my invoice/ receipt had the wrong address and could have query this at time of purchase, unfortunately I didn’t pick this error up and told customer service the typing was so small it was hard to read and I’m a pensioner again blamed me for the error. I’m not impressed and am out of pocket by nearly £25 no goods or refund.I have managed to intercept my parcel and have now received it! I am pleased with the product!

records.title: Chocolate Trading Company dealt with…
records.text: Chocolate Trading Company dealt with every thing very well -DPD caused a delay however by damaging the packaging.

records.title: Delicate and decadent chocolates.
records.text: Firstly the chocolates, majority of them, are really delicious! A definite treat.The prompt delivery, and well packaged items.I'm taking away one star. On the basis of selling chocolate with incorrect ingredient listing on the website. I think it's very important to give correct listing of ingredients in the website as stated on the product simply due to dietry requirements. This small change would make a massive difference.

records.title: 4 stars for customer service.
records.text: 4 stars for customer service.I telephoned to purchase some items as my internet was down, l was told to ring back as the person was busy. I asked if she could take my number and the person could call back when free. She reluctantly took the telephone number but no call back was received.I called back later and spoke with a pleasant gentleman who dealt with my purchase. Delivery was on time and products in good condition.

records.title: A fantastic range of high quality…
records.text: A fantastic range of high quality chocolate makers.   If you want to impress and show people what real chocolate tastes like, this company has it.   Please can I make a suggestion though,  I ordered Michel Cluizel Mushrooms, all the top of the mushrooms came off, still tasted good.  Maybe these novelty items needs surrounding in big bubble wrap to take any transport journey's vibrations.

records.title: wish the packing was different
records.text: fair prices and good product, always ships in a timely manner. i recommend them for these purposes. however, the sheer amount of packing peanuts feels so excessive - 3/4 of the box was packing peanuts! i understand some hard plastic containers may benefit from them, but there surely has to be an appropriate paper packing alternative to pad out the boxes that could be used for orders like bags of couverture? next time i will likely seek out a different seller because of this, which is a shame honestly.edit to address the reply: this is interesting news, thank you! perhaps this could be made more clear in the packaging, even if only a small business card sized note to let customers know this?

records.title: One missing chocolate bee
records.text: I ordered enough chocolate bees for my class of 30 children. There were only 29 if them in the bags so one child will miss out on their end of term gift. Really disappointed 😔The company contacted me immediately after this review to send me the additional bee that was needed. Very happy with their friendly service and quick response to solving the issue!

records.title: Prompt delivery, a little disappointed with some aspects of the product
records.text: The parcel arrived swiftly and well packaged but one of the chocolate coins was badly damaged, so obviously not in transit, and could not be used as part of the gift. The gift bag was a little disappointing as it was just a circle of cellophane tied with a ribbon.

records.title: Good service but low stock
records.text: Disappointed that there was so little Pralus in stock. I like doing business with the company but had to order directly from Pralus on this occasion.

records.title: The only thing that prevents a 5-star…
records.text: The only thing that prevents a 5-star rating is the taste of the chocolate mini-eggs. Could this be a quality issue? Either in the manufacturing or the quality of the chocolate used? Otherwise, certainly 5-stars.

records.title: Packaging excellent
records.text: Packaging and delivery excellent.  Chocolates look good, but not tasted as gift. Hopefully will hear back soon.

records.title: I brought the pink heart chocolates…
records.text: I brought the pink heart chocolates box's as favors for our wedding I'm so pleased with them the only thing I didn't like was the sell by date is stuck on the side and not under the box

records.title: Paid extra for next day delivery and…
records.text: Paid extra for next day delivery and should have arrived on time but didn’t so I can’t give full feedback

records.title: Website difficulties.
records.text: I made four attempts to have password reset link sent to me and none arrived. I then called and spoke with a very helpful assistant. My order was processed over the phone and a password reset arranged. Chocolate trading company is the only place I have found which sells good quality chocolate vermicelli. Please don’t stop supplying!!!

records.title: Broken shells
records.text: After saying my order was in stock I then got an email to say that due to quality control it was not able to be sent and would have to wait a week, which was annoying but ok as I would rather a good quality product arrive. However when it did arrive half the shells were broken.

records.title: Have just discovered that Callebaut is a pro Russian organisation.
records.text: Always found this Company to be very good and the chocolate is excellent quality HOWEVER I have just discovered that Callebaut is a pro Russia company and I find the fact that you sell their products slightly disturbing. Sadly I’ve bought lots of it previously but I no longer want to support them so need to find a more ethical option.

records.title: Great chocolate
records.text: Great chocolate. Quick delivery.Just a bit shocked at how much they have gone up in price.

records.title: Colourful but expensive
records.text: Easy to order and looks colourful. The chocolate itself is small for the price but don’t know what they taste like but in the sellers defence I didn’t look at the size but it will do the job as it is for Christmas.

records.title: Good selection & easy to order
records.text: Good selection & easy to order - shame 3 small chocolate bars arrived in a giant box......

records.title: Arrived punctually and then…..
records.text: Arrived punctually, well wrapped in both internal and external box . However 3 caps had become detached from the mushrooms, despite the packaging. I have already written an email with my complaint.Fortunately the caps were not damaged and I put caps and stalks together with melted chocolate and all seems well. But these are expensive chocolates at £2 per chocolate and I would not expect to have had to rescue the situation. I won’t be a returning customer.

records.title: I chose this company to send chocolates…
records.text: I chose this company to send chocolates to my granddaughter who is Coeliac.  They sell Booja books chocolates which are delicious and gluten free.  They were delivered on time.

records.title: Would happily have given 5 stars but…
records.text: Would happily have given 5 stars but for Royal Mail Delivery.  No tracking available after arrival in their depot on Friday 6th.   Email received stating delivery Saturday 7th 10.20 to 2.30.  No delivery.  Finally delivered afternoon of Monday 9th!

records.title: Limited availability
records.text: Limited stock has been a little disappointing.  Having bought chocolate cubes from you in the past, over the years, the bulk box of them have hardly ever been available.  They are a good product when you can get hold of them!!

records.title: I liked the chocolate but they didn’t write on it what I asked .
records.text: I liked the chocolate . The box was well presented . However, I personalized the box: online I was given the chance to write happy birthday with the name of the person but when she got it there was nothing written . Disappointing 😞

records.title: The App to choose an alternative address was not clear
records.text: The parcel was not delivered the following labor day but the next. I wanted to have the parcel delivered to my daughter’s address only if she wasn’t in. Instead it was delivered directly to the neighbor

records.title: Great product,  delivery not so!
records.text: I ordered 3x10 chocolate bees on Friday and paid extra for next day delivery and they arrived Tuesday! That’s not next day delivery in my book. Not impressed with that. The bees however are very cute

records.title: Wasn't anything to run home about.
records.text: It was ok.  Some of the chocolate was good some wasn't to my tastes.  I don't like how the milk chocolate bars are actually dark in most cases.  Not a fan of the selections I ordered. Very creamy chocolate though.

records.title: Products beautifully advertised but…
records.text: Products beautifully advertised but goods received were small and disappointing

records.title: Out of date b4 xmas
records.text: I bought these as xmas presents but go out of date xmas eve so will need to reorder nearer the time now I guess. Would help if this was more clearly presented when buying online, especially this time of year?

records.title: I was disappointed in the product
records.text: I was disappointed in the product.  Eggs smaller than anticipated but that was my fault for not measuring what 2.5cm looked like.  But the main problem was that several of the eggs were not completely covered in foil and the chocolate was showing.  It will b hard to use them for my granddaughters' egg hunt.

records.title: Delivery problem
records.text: The packaging was excellent and I have no problems with the product itself. The problem was that I paid extra for next day delivery as I wanted the delivery to be made on the recipient’s birthday, which was obviously the day after I placed the order. However, the package was not delivered until the day after the birthday. Disappointing, since I purposely paid extra money for this service.

records.title: Order didn't arrive on time!
records.text: I paid for 1st class 1-2 day delivery on the  8th October 2023..It was weekend and so I was confident that it would be here and expected it by 10th October 2023.I was decorating a cake for a birthday needed on 11th October 2023 evening.We are on the 12th, and no sign of the order.I'm not too pleased because I ordered in enough time and was let down.

records.title: Expensive Chocolates
records.text: I think your chocolates are very expensive. I was expecting to receive hard/chewy caramel covered in chocolate but not one of the six was any different to any of the chocolates on offer in any supermarket or speciality shop.The Callebaut chocolate chips make a very good drink but I won’t be buying anymore chocolates

records.title: No order received
records.text: Ordered with 1-2 days delivery. 4 working days later no tracking number given and order still not here. Had to email customer service. Considering that I live in London the postal carrier is very poor that they use.

records.title: Disappointment on best before dates
records.text: I received my order successfully, no complaints but was very disappointed to find the best before date on the marbled chocolate pencils was just 2 months when the rest of my order was well into 2024 with some 2025. I was told when phoning that white chocolate had less time on the best before which I find odd as the white Callets are dated 08/09/24. I shall not be using all the marbled pencils until Christmas so am extremely disappointed. I am not a new customer and would have expected better customer service  - perhaps a gesture of even a little money off my next order but was told I could return the product for a refund. This is not really viable as the box is heavy and it would cost a lot in postage to return

records.title: I don't think the chocolate is worth…
records.text: I don't think the chocolate is worth the money. In response to the reply:The description is given and my response remains that the size taste and quality of the chocolate does not warrant such an inflated price.

records.title: Ordering process
records.text: First time visit/order and wasted time navigating the order process.Web site needs improving, as it has put me off ordering again.

description:
At Coffee Hit we offer the best gear to make coffee on the planet. We have our own range gear under the brand Rhinowares and we are partners with Brewista to develop a range of products that is innovative, high in quality and a reasonable price.
We also bring innovative new products to market in the UK and Europe, products we believe offer innovation and quality.

records.title: Outstanding customer service from Leigh…
records.text: Outstanding customer service from Leigh at Coffee Hit, nothing has been too much trouble and emails are answered promptly! I have also just discovered their amazing range of coffee beans (I had initially been ordering a spare part for my Nutramilk machine from them) so will be a regular customer from now on.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Ordered a grinder at a competitive price and it turned up when promised without any fuss or excuses.Amazing that this kind of service needs to be highlighted as a five star, above and beyond type experience given that a company has done what it agreed to, do but here we are in 2024.I'd recommend Coffee Hit and definitely use them again, solid service.

records.title: Great after-sales support
records.text: I bought a coffee machine just over a year ago from Coffee Hit - I was happy with it but within quick succession two parts broke. I checked with the manufacturer and they only sold spares to the US and Mexico so I reached out to Coffee Hit and asked if they knew how I could get spares. I had an answer immediately when they opened the next day, they found some spares that would work for me, and I had everything good-as-new less than a day later. Brilliant support and I'd definitely use them again.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service.
records.text: Excellent Customer Service.I purchased a Commandate C40 from Coffee Hit after my 1zpresso grinder failed irreparably. I forgot to take advantage of their Red Clix add on deal, so I contacted Customer Services and John sorted things out for me very quickly; the Red Clix arrived less than 24 hours later!The Commandate is a fantastic grinder. Much smoother than my previous grinder and very easy to maintain. Also I can't believe how much of an improvement it's made to the quality of my brews!

records.title: Comandante grinder
records.text: Bought Comandante grinder, what a fantastic piece of engineering, so impressed.Coffee Hit were excellent, great price, great follow up welcome and restrained marketing (so far).  Package delivered promptly and on time with courier keeping me up to date.Compare Amazon which was 40-50 pounds dearer and a delivery of several weeks.  No brainer.

records.title: Great technical knowledge and after sales care
records.text: After 2 years of daily usage, my Baratza grinder micro adjustment ring became loose. I called Coffee Hit and spoke to John?, who diagnose issue over phone. I was sent a replacement part, that was easily fitted (instructions and video online) and solved the issue immediately.

Ordered a grinder from another company and they didn't send the product and took 3 weeks to get a response, had to get Paypal involved to get my money back. Ordered from Coffee Hit and it was shipped the next day on the Bank Holiday Monday and it came in 3 days later. Can't fault the service, quick delivery, plenty of emails to let me know when it was arriving, tracking, brilliantly packaged. Will definitely be using Coffee Hit for all my coffee items from now on! 10/10 service

records.title: Excellent repair service.
records.text: I recently used Coffee Hut's Sette grinder repair service which includes shipping, any repairs required and a full service and calibration of the machine.The following, which is the text of my thank you email to the company, will serve as my review.I have just received my repaired Sette coffee grinder, it arrived very quickly, thank you.I could not wait to give it a try...... wow, it's like a new machine, it ground a perfect dose straight out of the box without any adjustments!The quality of the grind was excellent giving a lovely crema. (I did not appreciate how bad it had become previously).Thank you also for the new and upgraded display/control panel, it's very nice to have the extra memory facilities.You have done a great job and i will be posting an excellent review.

records.title: Products always arrive but courier misinformation.
records.text: I made my order for V60 01 filter papers and they arrived 4 days later.The courier information even just after the delivery still told me they were at the depot waiting for despatch that day and would update me when they were?After trying 4 different kinds of papers the white ones in the crinkly bag are one of the best for being neutral during a pour over.

records.title: The best customer service
records.text: I bought a Baratza Encore grinder from here. It arrived quickly. I had an issue setting it up so it didn't grind correctly. I emailed their customer support and got a quick response from John who was very helpful troubleshooting over email and eventually sent a courier to collect it from my home and send it back to them to fix. He very quickly fixed it and sent it back to me. The whole process was so quick and effective, I now have a perfect grinder. Thanks!

records.title: Great service and good communications
records.text: Products were all spot on but unfortunately there was a small delay due to company relocating premises, aside from this service was great and will order from them again no doubt.

records.title: Great service.
records.text: Great service.No issues other than the mammoth size of box that arrive and it was massive for the product. Must have been 10 or 20 times the size of the products box.Please review deliver boxes.

records.title: Good price
records.text: Good price. Good customers service. Poor courier. Change to    Royal Mail or DPD and I would have rated a 5

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service. Quick delivery. No issues. Item as described.

records.title: Good for coffee equipment and accessories
records.text: Good website, good stock, very slow to ship and deliver.

records.title: Must try the coffee here
records.text: Must try the coffee here! Grab yours now and enjoy!

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great customer service; helpful quick replies to Email query and parts bought restored grinder to good as new. Only hesitation on five stars was packaging related - new baratza motor and burrs came loosely packed, there was a whole in the side of the box (not sellers fault) and connection on motor got bent in transit. Worked fine but was a minor concern.

records.title: The service is fast and trustworthy
records.text: The service is fast and trustworthy. The only think that was a bit disapointing is that I did have to pay quite a few more pounds (30GBP) because the import fees. I know this is not Coffee Hit's fault, but it would be appreciated to have an estimate of those extra costs when you are making your payment, and not to be taken by surprise when you receive your purchase.

records.title: Overall I was fantastically impressed…
records.text: Overall I was fantastically impressed with Coffee Hit's service.Good aspects:- Fantastic quality products- Very fast serviceAspects for improvement- There was a lot of packaging for three cups and saucers. I appreciate they probably usually have much bigger orders, but I feel there should be packaging for smaller ones (from an environmental responsibility perspective).

records.title: Fast delivery, great product
records.text: Fast delivery, good service, great product. Only fault I have is the size of the packaging! - For 2 coffee cups, the size of the outer box was ridiculously huge! I appreciate fragile items need protecting but that can still be done as effectively in a smaller box. - No plastic at least though 🙂

records.title: hello hello to the UK
records.text: hello hello to the UKregarding my order / invoice from 19.06.17 / invoice # SI-146297by the item # BVG360ML / Brewista Glass Server - there were 2 lids in black are missing  !!!how you handle this ??p.s. i would order today the TODDY 11ltr ! maybe you can put these 2 lids in the package ?meanwhile the best from munich.jürgen altmannAROMA KAFFEEBAR

records.title: You're good, Post Office is rubbish
records.text: Please do not use the post office delivery service if you want to keep customers happy.  They are rubbish. They dropped a card in my door at 7.25AM when I was up and about but they didn't ring the door bell.  Now I have to wait in again for a re-delivery or go queue at the post office. This is not the first time.  If I'd known you were using the Post Office for delivery I would not have purchased from you.

records.title: Very good, but one component missing
records.text: My experience with coffee hit is excellent. I have two feedbacks for the product (sette 270w) I bought though :1- the coffee beans cover is missing 2- the power cable is UK only (I missed this information)For 1 I am in touch with aftersales contactFor 2 I would like to propose to make this information clear for continental buyers and eventually propose two sets of cords (or option to buy one...)Great experience nevertheless

records.title: Good service, misleading banner
records.text: I've got only one complaint: the banner at the top of the page advertises free European delivery over £50 spend, but I got hit with £12 delivery fee when buying an item worth £80. That's a little dishonest, in my humble opinion. Apart from that, everything was top rate and the package got delivered to Germany in under a week.

records.title: Good products and customer service
records.text: I've ordered a couple of replacement parts for my Baratza Maestro Plus grinder over the last few years and I've been please with the speed of delivery and the customer service when responding to queries.  The lack of a 5th start is purely down to the packaging of my most recent order - sticking a heavy electric motor in a thin cardboard box with no padding whatsoever was far from ideal and I think I was lucky it arrived in working order.

records.title: Quit good  !!!
records.text: Date of experience: 17 September 2020

records.title: It is too expensive to return things…
records.text: It is too expensive to return things bought if you don't live in England.Other than that, the service is good.

records.title: Very good service. But the item bought Doesn't fit properly
records.text: I bought a primo attachment for an AeropressIt arrived quickly and in good order 5 starsBUT the gadget is seriously flawed. Basically it does not fit properlyGood coffee and if you get lucky with screwing the cap on all the coffee goes in the cupI suspect from other reviews that Aeropress have changed the design slightly and if you have a recent model, as compared to the earlier one that was used to test the Prismo

records.title: A bit slow to come but it came fine.
records.text: A bit slow to come but it came fine.The plastic filter holder is fine but the glass one has a bigger base so it doesn't fit on my mugs. I may have missed this info on the site it's a shame. The pointed filter papers make a better but slower cup of coffee although the provided scoop was too big and I'm too poor to use it. The glass holder would have been good for the little ritual experience I am after but that will have to wait.

records.title: In stock but it is not
records.text: I tried to buy something seen on their website. It was in stock according to website. After I tried to change business type of sending method to personal type of sending I messaged them about my situation. But they said they were expecting my order from US. I saw it was 'in stock' so I decided to buy from Coffee Hit. Unfortunatelly they do not have in their stock. I was dissappointed and mailed about my disappointment.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, very fast delivery but I only ordered a spring, it turned up in a Jiffy bag and was sent by courier at a cost of £7!! How about sending it via "signed for"post and charging me £3?? The cost of the spring was less than £2.Apart from that I was happy with my order.

records.title: Customer service
records.text: Everything OK with the ordering phase.One of the items received (IMS Filter) was different from the one ordered and did not match with any of the product on the website.Sent a mail on the 28/11received a reply on the 29/11 saying that they were investigating the problem; haven't heard since.

records.title: Fast delivery but goods with slight drawbacks
records.text: The delivery from UK to Germany was very fast. But both products have a deficiency.The screw-thread of the diecast folding crank handle was cut obliquely. However, the function remains.The scale is not flat. So you have to find the perfect place on the desk or the display shows not the exact value.

records.title: A Mixed Bag
records.text: Bought the Aeropress travel kit and have mixed feelings. All of the individual parts are great, the Aeropress is a great bit of kit that I've been using for years and I'm really looking forward to getting it out on the road but I feel selling this as a 'kit' is a little deceptive. The tote bag doesn't fit all of the individual parts of the Aeropress, (I can't get the funnel in there) and the grinder has to travel separately which to my mind doesn't necessarily constitute a true, 'travel kit'. I'm sure that little gripe will fade once I get using it and have grade A coffee while I'm travelling but feel the makeup of the kit could have been made a bit clearer.

records.title: Not impressed
records.text: The service and delivery were prompt, but the wrong item was sent.  Since I required it over the Christmas period, I have made do with it, but am not impressed with Coffee Hit's care and attention.

records.title: Disappointed that my purchases weren't…
records.text: Disappointed that my purchases weren't sent in a plain box.  They were bought for my son's Xmas and as he took delivery of the box as I was out, he knew right away that it's stuff for him.

records.title: Not sure if I order again !
records.text: I order some gasket, with the regular Royal Mail.They told me , I can track my package, but it's not available on the web, the tracking number.....so just waiting, don't know how long until it arrive!

records.title: Ok service but delivery cost out of proportion
records.text: Ok service but a £1.50 flat spring that could have been posted in a 1st class small envelope cost a whopping £6.30 in total. Out of proportion . Shame really

records.title: Free delivery is not offered from £50 as mentioned
records.text: On website is written free European shipping over £50 spend, but system starts to offer free delivery when you have around £120 in your cart.

records.title: Wrong plug
records.text: I ordered a coffee machine delivered in France for my coffeehouse. The plug is not compatible with the standard here... frustrating

records.title: Fast shipping from UK
records.text: Fast shipping from UK, very cool, but big problem with UPS in France, I hate UPS!! 10 days instead of 3 days to get the package

records.title: Poor communication around a delay in my…
records.text: Poor communication around a delay in my delivery. I had to email twice to find out it wasn't coming and although a partial refund was issued, when it finally arrived it was marked. I was told these marks were normal machining marks and if I wanted to return it I could. I don't believe that to be correct but needless to say this was their final response. I won't be ordering again.

records.title: There were bad delays in having the…
records.text: There were bad delays in having the item shipped and despite this, no attempt was made to speed the process up (ie. using a more expedited shipping method). Also, at the time when I placed the order the issues were already known, but this wasn’t communicated Until several days later (already after the item should have been delivered)

records.title: Ordering experiences
records.text: Positive experiences-Website is well presented and easy to use-Product pricing is reasonable-Purchases arrive in good conditionNegative experiences-Customer service/sales are not very helpful. Requested help to correct the address on my order, their response was not helpful and nothing was done about it. The package was shipped regardless of the highlighted issue. Contacted the courier company myself to resolve the logistical issue, which resulted in a delay in receiving the package.

records.title: product never arrived however I was…
records.text: product never arrived however I was informed that is not in stock waiting time is a month

records.title: Dropped consignment no response...
records.text: Arrived a day late. Consignment was dropped during UPS shipment, the outer box split and the rather expensive coffee grinder carton was compressed at one corner. I contacted Coffee Hit by email with photographs explaining the potential problem - not a dicky bird! Fortunately the grinder works perfectly.Reply to Coffee Hit:-You are incorrect, I wrote "I'll test it tonight and contact you again if there's any issues." There wasn't an issue with the grinder hence no further email. My original email sets out my concerns that you did not respond to.

records.title: Quick postage but poor customer service
records.text: Quick postage but not hot with customer service I called to say how dangerous these glasses were and I was asked well did you burn yourself or did the crack with the hot coffee to which I replied no. Only be told well they are not faulty then so please return themAnd pay your return postage! Not a good service fromCoffee hit

records.title: Poor Delivery
records.text: I had ordered 2 small items which were delivered in a large cardboard box, with a generous amount of packaging within to protect the items (sightly unnecessary and wasteful), and yet somehow my item was torn and damaged. The item would have been damaged before posting as there was no way that with all the protective packaging this would have happened in transit. All a bit of a joke.

records.title: Packaging was really inadequate
records.text: Even though the order was correct and sent quite fast the ordered burr blades were sent in a single plastic bag with the burrs and the screws freely hitting each other and leaving marks to the burrs. Mail order shops should understand the importance of packaging so that the ordered products would be in a perfect condition when reaching the customer.

records.title: frustrating :(
records.text: im very sad with coffee hit, i ordered a few things a couple times and had no problem, until my last order 3 months ago, that never arrived, i email them several times, they said they resent it but i never got it or even any tracking number. when you have a coffee shop and you need something asap its quite frustrating, i like the things they have in their website too bad im not sure if i order anything else it will ever arrive.

records.title: my replacement Baratza ring burr holder …
records.text: my replacement Baratza ring burr holder has arrived. Next day delivery took 2 days.Item arrived loose  in flimsy jiffy envelope. Tiny item, total weight of package 10 gms.Cost of item £4.39Cost of shipping £6.95I have generously given 2 stars because it has arrived and is in one piece.

description:
British Corner Shop is the British Brand Export Company – helping connect people worldwide with their favourite products from the UK.

Stocking thousands of British food & drink items, we deliver worldwide using through our established international courier and freight networks.
