We don’t just lead the way on quality, we are also No.1 for trust and innovation. We deliver on integrity, expertise and ambition, quintessentially British values that resonate worldwide.

records.title: The service was great but ...
records.text: The service was great, but disappointed that I emailed the company NUMEROUS times to enquire about offering Marks & Spencer & seasonal items again but never received a response. Shipping is prompt & items are well packed. Miss the M&S products especially Christmas products & bakery. Thank you

records.title: A different experience to the first…
records.text: A different experience to the first owners of BCS. Not as much stock, especially Marks and Spencer’s a miss this year. Prices seem much higher. Overall happy with service. It’s early days for a new company taking over, hopefully things will improve and more stock and better pricing to come 😊

records.title: All the products that we enjoy
records.text: All the products that we enjoy and cannot find in the States, we were able to purchase for the holidays.  The package arrived promptly, was in very good condition (two slightly dented cans despite packaging precautions...this led to a prompt beans on toast supper, which made us all happy). Adjustments in shipping charges actually led to a credit back to us as well.

records.title: UK chocolate lover
records.text: When we were in London over the summer, my kids loved the candy section of corner shops. I’m so glad I found this site to bring them more of the candy they so liked! Thank you so much! Perfect quality, shipping time and packaging!

records.title: I will definitely be in touch with British Corner Shop next Christmas! My package was delivered in the USA…
records.text: My package was delivered in the USA within a few days of placing the order here in England.  Everything I ordered was there and my family, who used to live in the UK, were delighted to see many of their longed for British products again - especially Christmas crackers and chocolate!  Thank you for adding to their Christmas festivities!

records.title: I shopped here Brit Kits cause nowadays…
records.text: I shopped here Brit Kits cause nowadays is high time to get prepared for upcoming holidays and I was shocked with a variety of brit kits! My children adore various sweeties, Picnic, Maltesers and other snacks. I bought here Candbut Cholocate Selection Full House and Yummy Tummy Kit. Plus I got a nice discount for subscribing to newsletters. Uh... another spam in my mailbox, but the game is worth the candle, to be honest. My kids will be on the seventh heaven from such a good gift on holidays.

records.title: Great variety.
records.text: Easy to view website, lots of variety & I find the best shipping rates from UK too USA compared to all the other companies who send Brit food abroad. The food products arrive extremely well packaged. After trying to purchase some boxes of Brit candy from a certain retailer beginning with 'A' & ending with 'N', they arrived completely crushed, so will happily continue to purchase from the British Corner Shop.

records.title: Missing  my favorite foods
records.text: Living so far from home,I love shopping at the British Corner shop for my favorite Engish foods that  I cannot get in the USA.My order is something that I look forward to receiving,always delivered on time.Gwyneth G

records.title: Timely delivery
records.text: My items were ordered last minute during the holidays and were delivered to upstate NYC on time, and in fact arrived early. Very happy.

records.title: Most Amazing Store
records.text: Delivery is amazingly quick.  Everything I've purchased has been wonderful when received.  Truly not disappointed.  Will continue to order items from British Corner Store.  Absolutely LOVE them!!

records.title: Love receiving my order from BCS
records.text: Love receiving my order from BCS. The shipping is prompt and keeps me updated of when it will be arriving. I was a little disappointed that some of the items I wanted to purchase were not available this year but some new items added to my enjoyment. Most of my package arrived in great condition except the chocolate Christmas tree ornaments having two broken. Thank you for making an expat in California very happy.

records.title: I’ve been ordering from you for many…
records.text: I’ve been ordering from you for many years now and have always been very satisfied. The one issue I had this year was the lack of choice. In previous years you offered a larger range of items such as M&S gifts and produce. So I was a little disappointed this year, but overall I am happy with your service and hope to continue ordering my seasonal items from you in the future.

records.title: Back in business Hoorah
records.text: Just two items were sold out so I hope they get them back in stock. I have my parcel and true to instructions it was delivered as per instructions. Thank you. The packing was super nothing broke. You guys are great at packing any order. I am so glad you are back in business and hope forever. I missed you. Have a great Christmas everyone.

records.title: I love that I can get my favorites
records.text: I love that I can get my favorites, though I docked a star for having so many out of stocks. Be great to have some more info about each product, like a photo of the nutritional value. Delivery is much quicker than whenever anyone sends me thinks from the UK and everything is nicely packed.

records.title: Adust packing and you will get a 5 star review
records.text: Overall the company delivered all but one of my goods in a timely manner and well packed. However, a pack of Warburton's tea cakes a Jamica ginger cake were placed under heavy boxes and cans and were completely squashed on arrival.

records.title: Delivery took a bit longer than usual…
records.text: Delivery took a bit longer than usual to reach us but that's on DHL. It was a big order and items were well packed and arrived in great shape. A few minor items were missed from the order but but not a huge deal. Overall very glad to see them back in business and still shipping at $25 ish for 30kg.

records.title: Is BCS still in business?
records.text: I recently discovered BCS has been bought by new owners. Good news, but I had a few questions about their website. They say they only deliver to the UK and USA, but apparently, I can open a page for the Netherlands and make an order. This is confusing. Also they mention there is a cut-off date for Christmas orders as being in December 2023. I sent 2 emails asking for clarification, but despite the webpage saying they will reply within 48 hours I have not had any responses. The previous owners were on the ball and very helpful. I am unsure about making any orders and it would be helpful if the new business replied to my concerns.UPDATE. I have received an email reply explaining the delay in replying and an expectation they will be in business as soon as possible. I will amend my rating accordingly.

records.title: Great experience!
records.text: Ordering was easy. Website easy to navigate. Timely shipping & excellent packaging. Thank you!

records.title: Christmas mini order
records.text: First parcel of a couple of orders placed over the past year or so to come earlier than the rest! Only downside there were some dented tinned foods although well packaged! Other than that all good! Unsure whether chilled meat products have previously been frozen before being sent out to customers!

records.title: Products were of good quality
records.text: Products were of good quality. The chick pea cans openers werent that good and broke while opening in half of those. Import duties were high but all in all we are happy with the English products. Frosties cereals were one exception that had paprika allergens possibly in a missing ingredient or a preservative. Thanks for serving us.

records.title: Problems with delivery company
records.text: No problem with British Corner Shop order and processing.It was the French courier that let you down.  Each time we have a delivery by that Company the day before scheduled delivery we get an email to say there has been a delay and please click link to arrange an alternate delivery. Which we now ignore.  Then when we check delivery progress online there is no mention of delay.  And then parcel gets delivered without warning

records.title: British corner shop is part of the Christmas tradition…
records.text: Ordered goodies for Christmas as I've done for several years. Ordered soon after christmas products are online but missed out on a couple of items which were ordered but not in stock when the delivery was prepared. Excellent service, easy to order, pay and regular e mails received regarding the stage in delivery. Arrived beautifully packed and on time. Many thanks to all the hard workers!!

records.title: Really happy with the rapid delivery of…
records.text: Really happy with the rapid delivery of my order.However the box containing the goods was slightly damaged on one corner and on opening, one of the Xmas puddings had lost it's cardboard surround and the plastic cover was half off, leaving the pudding exposed. Hoping it will still be edible on the 25th December.

records.title: Overall, good experience
records.text: The overall experience was favorable.  The two areas that could have been better are: 1) many of the standard items were out of stock (bbq sauce, cranberry sauce, chili mix, etc) and have been for weeks, and 2) the prices increased perhaps above the odds.  Otherwise, the shipment was quick and well packed.

records.title: I've been eating Quality Streets my…
records.text: I've been eating Quality Streets my entire life.  Sadly, I feel that the Quality Streets that I bought were old and the chocolate was partially white.   Unfortunately, this was a gift I give every year to my parents along with other goodies and my mom requested to not buy Quality Streets anymore due to the bad quality.

records.title: I have bought crackers in the past at…
records.text: I have bought crackers in the past at Costco. The ones I received were of low quality. Will not order them again

records.title: Some of the boxes of chocolate were…
records.text: Some of the boxes of chocolate were squashed and broken because they had packed too many into the size of box they were trying to use to send them to me. It was a shame really as the order came quite quickly.

records.title: Great packaging - poor substitutions.
records.text: Unfortunately I did not receive what I ordered.  I ordered 3 cans of birds custard powder and received 3 packages of instant mix instead. Also I ordered Bisto gravy powder and received the granules. Both of these products I don’t use in this format.  Apart from that, the weight was different as was the cost.  Generally the packaging is excellent and with one broken jar of marmalade (mostly contained) and a broken seal on the canister of twiglets, it arrived safely. I have been purchasing a box of goods each year close to Christmas to satisfy our British cravings - I will think twice before spending close to 500 pounds again on this luxury.

records.title: Normally great- had a missing item and…
records.text: Normally great- had a missing item and no response after two attempts to email/report it. Taking the few dollars loss. Love the products, probably won’t order next Christmas.

records.title: The chocolate santa was in pieces
records.text: The chocolate santa was in pieces. However the cream crackers and chocolate oranges were great

records.title: The Fox cookie box are hard
records.text: The Fox cookie box are hard. It’s a little expensive too.

records.title: I stopped buying from them (Rovaniemi
records.text: I stopped buying from them (Rovaniemi, Finland) when they upped my delivery fee a lot.  Yet my son who lives 2 hours from me in Oulu had the same delivery fee as before! The delivery fee out priced itself, as it would be only worth it if I bought a huge amount of goods, rather than several frequent ones.I hope whoever takes BCS over after its administration, takes this into account, because otherwise I was happy with the service.

records.title: The poor delivery service used for Italian part if journey!!
records.text: The grocery selection is good, prices as expected on imported goods, but the Italian Courier subcontracted by DHD in Italy is poor. Takes a week to deliver after it gets to Area Depot.Complained 3 times about telling DHD to use another Italian delivery service, or Post Italiane even. All much more reliable than BRT!  Took 13 days from Netherlands: arriving 14/12/23. Last order took 18 days of staying as they kept saying our order was out for delivery for 12 days!!

records.title: Great Service but not quite perfect
records.text: Some product was crushed (crisps) and so become a littlee stale because the pack had been compromised.  Sell/Eat-by date was before Christmas - my error (I should have checked) - so Santa Treats became Halloween Treats.Can I suggest Sell/Eat-by dates are visible or available if needed.Otherwise great service and support - fast shipping; great product range - thanks

records.title: Thank you for good communication and broken item received
records.text: Thank you for good communication and relatively fast delivery (UK-SK) just a few days.On the other hand, the package was partially damaged and 1 out of 2 items ordered was smashed and went straight to the rubbish.Since it can not be veryfied when / where and how did this incident happened, supplier, in any case, should have taken action to prevent such damage - e.g. better wraping

records.title: Long delivery
records.text: Been using BCS for a few years now, but disappointed with the length of time from order acceptance till delivery this time.Order accepted on 30th November Order dispatched on 5th December Order delivered on 12th December As a result several bakery items were past sell/use by dates by 3-4 days.

records.title: There does not seem much difference…
records.text: There does not seem much difference between Yorkshire Tea and Yorkshire Gold in taste or in strength.Can you please advise what the difference is and why the Gold has a significant increase price value.In addition, DHL took more than 10 days to deliver the package from the time it arrived in Israel. This or the delivery cost value is not acceptable.

records.title: Parcel well packed - Website needs fixing
records.text: I loved the way "Paul" carefully packed my parcel and everything arrived in pristine condition.I didn't like the website which didn't let me put the country code of my mobile phone.  In an increasingly international world, you cannot assume the phone is registered in the country of delivery of your goods.  It may well be, but if it isn't, users can't give you and the courier accurate information, and the delivery might be compromised.  You shuould fix this.  When you do, I'll give you 5-stars.

records.title: Parcel arrived minus 2 items but replaced quickly
records.text: Parcel arrived minus 2 items. As this was a present for a friend who does not speak English I only discovered this by chance discussion .Phoned company , very pleasant lady ,who immediately sent the missing items in another parcel but it did seem as though the packing company often made mistakes. Best to check with recipients exactly what arrives.

records.title: order switch
records.text: Somehow the Hot Cross Buns ordered morphed into chocolate buns instead. Either someone made a mistake with the order or I made a mistake in what I ordered. In latter case, there may be an argument for greater clarity in the ordering process on the screen so that I don't click on the ones I don't want. BTW, the chocolate buns were perfectly edible - just not what I thought I'd ordered.

records.title: Order was not packed
records.text: Order was not packed, just thrown into the carton.All good but lack of internal packing most of the cake based items arrived in some degree of distress, icing on an expensive cake dented, mince pies as crumbs.Have purchased on previous occasions and no issues.

records.title: Now don’t carry stock
records.text: Having ordered on a large number of occasions I have always been impressed by the choice and speed and cost of delivery. However since the business made a choice to relocate I have found over the last three months, during which time I checked daily, that between 60pc and 90pc of my favorites are out of stock. This business has therefore made itself irrelevant to me as it is impossible to order what does not exist. This is sad. Update - has gone into administration

records.title: Christmas pudding no longer in stock
records.text: We ordered a Christmas Pudding that the website stated was in stock and would arrive by Christmas.  The shipment dispatched email for our order was received, followed by a second email saying sorry your Christmas pudding is no longer available and you have been refunded. The Christmas pudding was the main point of the order.  We would have chosen a different Christmas pudding had we known.

records.title: Need Better Packing and Shipping
records.text: Took 2 weeks to arrive. Shipping 20%+ of cost. A chocolate santa was crushed, covering everything in chocolate dust. Nothing arrived in time to be used, nor in a giftable condition, as all boxes were at least a little crushed and covered in chocolate dust. You get 2 stars because I appreciate the access to non-American versions of products. The arrival of this particular order is actually ZERO stars.

records.title: Missing items
records.text: I had some missing items in my order, still got charged for them. Emailed twice and never received a response or refund. Which makes me sad because I’ve used them quite regularly. But I won’t anymore

records.title: I still haven't received my package
records.text: I still haven't received my package. It's christmas eve, so I now won't receive it until AFTER christmas. The website stated to receive in time for Christmas the cut off date was the 15th of December, i ordered on the 11th so not even the cut off date, and it's not here. Pretty disappointed. After I placed the order it took 6 days for British corner shop to even label my package for pickup. If you are that busy then you should say that on website and move the date earlier as the cut off when to order to receive it in time for Christmas. I've ordered from British corner shop before in the past and didn't have this issue, they were fast.

records.title: Your DHL delivery was terrible and took…
records.text: Your DHL delivery was terrible and took 5 days which meant that everything was out of date. DHL misread address and driver failed to see unit number which was clearly on the address.

records.title: I guess it's a good enough service but…
records.text: I guess it's a good enough service but it's a very strange website. After 20 minutes or so adding things to my basket and taking them out, thinking about weight and price, wondering what flavours of home I might send someone, I entered the check out. Only to be told that they were only shipping to the US and the UK. I can send things to the US myself, so I'm not really sure what the point of this site is but, one way or another, it would be really handy to be told those limitations at the start of the process rather than the end.

records.title: Delivery was very bad
records.text: Delivery was very bad.  Still waiting and no text to advise why late or when it will be.

records.title: Packaging
records.text: Packaging, the box was too large and very poorly packed so that biscuits, and tea were damaged. Of the 30 kilos of package allowance the whole parcel weighed just over 14 kg. I filled it to my limit on the sliding scale, and would have bought more if I could. So feel a bit cheated about quantity. The quality, as usual looks fine. I will place another order early in the new year and hope this was just a ‘blip’.

records.title: Must Try Harder
records.text: Sadly I have to give BCS a low score simply because of the delay in delivering my parcel. My order was placed on 17th December (for Christmas delivery) but not delivered until January 6th. And as stated by BCS in the emails I received when reporting the delay, the problem lies with their ordering system and how it communicates with DHL. That being said, the products were exactly as I ordered and hadn't reached any use by dates.

records.title: Probably not really BCS’s fault but…..
records.text: Probably not really BCS’s fault, but delivery failed in Sweden. No notification of delivery, had to call postal sevice who said parcel was at delivery point. Had to spend half an hour at delivery point to explain situation and convince them pacel was in their store room, even though the computer said NO. Parcel eventually handed over, 2 boxes of Ready Brek damaged and twiglets broken to crumbs.
